input: to Telugu: Whole slide images (WSIs) are digital representations of histological slides used in biomedical diagnostics.
target: Whole slide images (WSIs) అనేవి biomedical diagnostics లో ఉపయోగించే histological slides యొక్క digital రూపాలు.
target_en: Whole slide images (WSIs) are digital representations of histological slides used in biomedical diagnostics.

input: to Telugu: A physical phenomenon where changing magnetic fields induce unwanted currents and noise in nearby conductive loops or components.
target: మారుతున్న magnetic fields దగ్గరలో ఉన్న conductive loops లేదా components లో అనవసరమైన currents మరియు noise ను induce చేసే ఒక భౌతిక దృగ్విషయం.
target_en: A physical phenomenon where changing magnetic fields induce unwanted currents and noise in nearby conductive loops or components.

input: to Telugu: The traveling wave propagating from the source toward the load along a transmission line.
target: Transmission line వెంబడి source నుండి load వైపు ప్రయాణించే traveling wave.
target_en: The traveling wave propagating from the source toward the load along a transmission line.

input: to Telugu: A type of electrical current that flows in one direction and was produced by early dynamos.
target: ఒకే దిశలో ప్రవహించే, తొలి dynamos ఉత్పత్తి చేసిన ఒక రకమైన electrical current.
target_en: A type of electrical current that flows in one direction and was produced by early dynamos.

input: to Telugu: A procedure that processes input data and returns a result, forming the core building blocks of the MapReduce paradigm.
target: Input data ను process చేసి ఒక result ను తిరిగి ఇచ్చే procedure; ఇవే MapReduce paradigm యొక్క ముఖ్యమైన building blocks.
target_en: A procedure that processes input data and returns a result, forming the core building blocks of the MapReduce paradigm.

input: to Telugu: A theoretical engine that operates on the ideal Carnot cycle to achieve maximum reversible efficiency.
target: గరిష్ట reversible efficiency సాధించడానికి ideal Carnot cycle పై పనిచేసే ఒక సైద్ధాంతిక engine.
target_en: A theoretical engine that operates on the ideal Carnot cycle to achieve maximum reversible efficiency.

input: to Telugu: Signal modulation is the process of varying a carrier waveform's properties to encode information for transmission over a communication channel.
target: Signal modulation అంటే communication channel ద్వారా ప్రసారం చేయడానికి information ను encode చేసేందుకు carrier waveform యొక్క లక్షణాలను మార్చే ప్రక్రియ.
target_en: Signal modulation is the process of varying a carrier waveform's properties to encode information for transmission over a communication channel.

input: to Telugu: The fundamental operation of reading data from or writing data into the main system memory, which instruction set architectures aim to minimize to improve performance.
target: Main system memory నుండి data ను చదవడం లేదా దానిలోకి data ను రాయడం అనే ప్రాథమిక operation; performance పెంచడానికి instruction set architectures దీన్ని తగ్గించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాయి.
target_en: The fundamental operation of reading data from or writing data into the main system memory, which instruction set architectures aim to minimize to improve performance.

input: to Telugu: The total time taken by the computational tasks (map, reduce) in a distributed processing job.
target: ఒక distributed processing job లో computational tasks (map, reduce) తీసుకునే మొత్తం సమయం.
target_en: The total time taken by the computational tasks (map, reduce) in a distributed processing job.

input: to Telugu: The resultant internal force acting parallel to the cross-section of a beam, balancing external transverse loads.
target: Beam యొక్క cross-section కు సమాంతరంగా పనిచేస్తూ, బాహ్య transverse loads ను balance చేసే resultant internal force.
target_en: The resultant internal force acting parallel to the cross-section of a beam, balancing external transverse loads.

input: to Telugu: The ratio of the electron gyrofrequency to the electron-heavy particle collision frequency in a plasma.
target: Plasma లో electron gyrofrequency కు, electron-heavy particle collision frequency కు మధ్య ఉన్న నిష్పత్తి.
target_en: The ratio of the electron gyrofrequency to the electron-heavy particle collision frequency in a plasma.

input: to Telugu: A computer vision algorithm used to detect and describe local image features that are invariant to scale, rotation, and illumination.
target: Scale, rotation, మరియు illumination మార్పులకు ప్రభావితం కాని local image features ను గుర్తించి వివరించడానికి ఉపయోగించే ఒక computer vision algorithm.
target_en: A computer vision algorithm used to detect and describe local image features that are invariant to scale, rotation, and illumination.

input: to Telugu: An experimental, research-oriented filesystem designed to implement transactional features for greater data coherence.
target: ఎక్కువ data coherence కోసం transactional features ను అమలు చేయడానికి రూపొందించిన ఒక ప్రయోగాత్మక, research ఆధారిత filesystem.
target_en: An experimental, research-oriented filesystem designed to implement transactional features for greater data coherence.

input: to Telugu: a communication mode that allows characters to be sent and received simultaneously using two different shift registers
target: రెండు వేర్వేరు shift registers ఉపయోగించి characters ను ఒకేసారి పంపడానికి మరియు స్వీకరించడానికి అనుమతించే ఒక communication mode.
target_en: a communication mode that allows characters to be sent and received simultaneously using two different shift registers

input: to Telugu: One-sided Z-transform evaluated only from index zero to positive infinity, standard for analyzing causal systems with initial conditions.
target: Index సున్నా నుండి positive infinity వరకు మాత్రమే లెక్కించే One-sided Z-transform; initial conditions ఉన్న causal systems ను విశ్లేషించడానికి ఇది ప్రామాణికం.
target_en: One-sided Z-transform evaluated only from index zero to positive infinity, standard for analyzing causal systems with initial conditions.

input: to Telugu: A regime where significant changes in fluid density occur, typically at high Mach numbers, requiring modifications to the standard Bernoulli equation.
target: Fluid density లో గణనీయమైన మార్పులు జరిగే ఒక regime; సాధారణంగా ఎక్కువ Mach numbers వద్ద వస్తుంది, దీనికి standard Bernoulli equation లో మార్పులు అవసరం.
target_en: A regime where significant changes in fluid density occur, typically at high Mach numbers, requiring modifications to the standard Bernoulli equation.

input: to Telugu: A region or material in a semiconductor containing an excess of donor electrons as majority charge carriers.
target: Majority charge carriers గా అదనపు donor electrons ఉన్న semiconductor లోని ఒక region లేదా material.
target_en: A region or material in a semiconductor containing an excess of donor electrons as majority charge carriers.

input: to Telugu: A classification of mechanical models that categorize analysis based on the assumption of how large the rotations and displacements are relative to the original body.
target: అసలు body తో పోలిస్తే rotations మరియు displacements ఎంత పెద్దవి అనే assumption ఆధారంగా analysis ను వర్గీకరించే mechanical models యొక్క ఒక classification.
target_en: A classification of mechanical models that categorize analysis based on the assumption of how large the rotations and displacements are relative to the original body.

input: to Telugu: DDoS attacks that target the underlying network infrastructure, such as bandwidth and connection limits, rather than applications.
target: Applications ను కాకుండా, bandwidth మరియు connection limits వంటి network infrastructure ను లక్ష్యంగా చేసుకునే DDoS attacks.
target_en: DDoS attacks that target the underlying network infrastructure, such as bandwidth and connection limits, rather than applications.

input: to Telugu: Systems characterized by having exactly one input and one output, a special case of general system models.
target: సరిగ్గా ఒక input మరియు ఒక output మాత్రమే ఉండే systems; ఇవి general system models యొక్క ఒక ప్రత్యేక సందర్భం.
target_en: Systems characterized by having exactly one input and one output, a special case of general system models.

input: to Telugu: A common regression metric that calculates the average squared difference between the estimated values and the actual target values.
target: అంచనా వేసిన values కు మరియు నిజమైన target values కు మధ్య ఉన్న squared difference యొక్క సగటును లెక్కించే ఒక సాధారణ regression metric.
target_en: A common regression metric that calculates the average squared difference between the estimated values and the actual target values.

input: to Telugu: A function that estimates the value of a game state to guide the search toward more promising branches.
target: ఎక్కువ ఆశాజనకమైన branches వైపు search ను నడిపించడానికి ఒక game state యొక్క value ను అంచనా వేసే function.
target_en: A function that estimates the value of a game state to guide the search toward more promising branches.

input: to Telugu: An insulating transition zone around a p-n interface depleted of mobile carriers and containing uncovered immobile ions.
target: p-n interface చుట్టూ mobile carriers లేకుండా, బయటపడిన immobile ions ఉండే ఒక insulating transition zone.
target_en: An insulating transition zone around a p-n interface depleted of mobile carriers and containing uncovered immobile ions.

input: to Telugu: A set of rules for assigning positive or negative signs to quantities like direction of integration, area vector, and current in the law.
target: Law లో integration దిశ, area vector, మరియు current వంటి quantities కు positive లేదా negative signs ను కేటాయించడానికి ఉండే నియమాల సమితి.
target_en: A set of rules for assigning positive or negative signs to quantities like direction of integration, area vector, and current in the law.

input: to Telugu: The technique of anticipating the direction of a conditional branch before it is executed.
target: ఒక conditional branch execute కాకముందే దాని దిశను ముందుగా అంచనా వేసే technique.
target_en: The technique of anticipating the direction of a conditional branch before it is executed.

input: to Telugu: A matrix that describes the state of a linear dynamic system at a future time given its state at an initial time.
target: ఒక initial time వద్ద ఉన్న state ఇచ్చినప్పుడు, భవిష్యత్ సమయంలో linear dynamic system యొక్క state ను వివరించే matrix.
target_en: A matrix that describes the state of a linear dynamic system at a future time given its state at an initial time.

input: to Telugu: A method for edge detection that identifies edges by finding points where a second-order derivative expression crosses zero.
target: ఒక second-order derivative expression zero ను దాటే points ను కనుగొనడం ద్వారా edges ను గుర్తించే edge detection పద్ధతి.
target_en: A method for edge detection that identifies edges by finding points where a second-order derivative expression crosses zero.

input: to Telugu: A vertex directly connected by an edge to another vertex in a graph.
target: Graph లో మరొక vertex కు ఒక edge ద్వారా నేరుగా కలిసి ఉన్న vertex.
target_en: A vertex directly connected by an edge to another vertex in a graph.

input: to Telugu: The total magnetic field passing through a given surface area, which must vary to induce a voltage.
target: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట surface area గుండా వెళ్ళే మొత్తం magnetic field; voltage ను induce చేయాలంటే ఇది మారాలి.
target_en: The total magnetic field passing through a given surface area, which must vary to induce a voltage.

input: to Telugu: A physical phenomenon where fluid pressure decreases as the fluid velocity increases when passing through a constricted section of a pipe.
target: Pipe లోని ఇరుకైన భాగం గుండా fluid వెళ్ళేటప్పుడు దాని velocity పెరిగితే fluid pressure తగ్గే భౌతిక దృగ్విషయం.
target_en: A physical phenomenon where fluid pressure decreases as the fluid velocity increases when passing through a constricted section of a pipe.

input: to Telugu: A statistical technique used for dimensionality reduction that transforms a large set of variables into a smaller set of uncorrelated principal components.
target: పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో ఉన్న variables ను చిన్న సంఖ్యలోని uncorrelated principal components గా మార్చే, dimensionality reduction కోసం ఉపయోగించే statistical technique.
target_en: A statistical technique used for dimensionality reduction that transforms a large set of variables into a smaller set of uncorrelated principal components.

input: to Telugu: The specific moment when a clock signal transitions from a low voltage to a high voltage.
target: Clock signal low voltage నుండి high voltage కు మారే నిర్దిష్ట క్షణం.
target_en: The specific moment when a clock signal transitions from a low voltage to a high voltage.

input: to Telugu: The unique identifier or location code assigned to a specific storage cell in the computer's primary memory.
target: Computer యొక్క primary memory లోని ఒక నిర్దిష్ట storage cell కు కేటాయించిన ప్రత్యేక identifier లేదా location code.
target_en: The unique identifier or location code assigned to a specific storage cell in the computer's primary memory.

input: to Telugu: A formulation of Gauss's law expressing the divergence of the electric field as proportional to the local volume charge density.
target: Electric field యొక్క divergence స్థానిక volume charge density కు అనుపాతంలో ఉంటుందని చెప్పే Gauss's law యొక్క ఒక రూపం.
target_en: A formulation of Gauss's law expressing the divergence of the electric field as proportional to the local volume charge density.

input: to Telugu: A transmission technology utilizing direct current at very high voltages for specific applications like submarine cables or long-distance lines.
target: Submarine cables లేదా long-distance lines వంటి ప్రత్యేక applications కోసం చాలా ఎక్కువ voltages వద్ద direct current ను ఉపయోగించే transmission technology.
target_en: A transmission technology utilizing direct current at very high voltages for specific applications like submarine cables or long-distance lines.

input: to Telugu: A circuit that reduces a set of input bits into a smaller number of output bits while preserving the total sum.
target: మొత్తం sum ను మార్చకుండా, input bits సమితిని తక్కువ సంఖ్యలోని output bits గా తగ్గించే circuit.
target_en: A circuit that reduces a set of input bits into a smaller number of output bits while preserving the total sum.

input: to Telugu: Signature generation is the process of creating a digital signature by computing a hash of a message and encrypting it with a private key.
target: Signature generation అంటే ఒక message యొక్క hash ను compute చేసి దాన్ని private key తో encrypt చేయడం ద్వారా digital signature ను సృష్టించే ప్రక్రియ.
target_en: Signature generation is the process of creating a digital signature by computing a hash of a message and encrypting it with a private key.

input: to Telugu: Spell checking is a process of identifying and correcting misspelled words, often using a dictionary data structure like a trie.
target: Spell checking అంటే తప్పుగా రాసిన పదాలను గుర్తించి సరిచేసే ప్రక్రియ; దీనికి తరచుగా trie వంటి dictionary data structure ను ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: Spell checking is a process of identifying and correcting misspelled words, often using a dictionary data structure like a trie.

input: to Telugu: A data hazard occurs when an instruction depends on the result of a preceding instruction that has not yet completed.
target: ఒక instruction, ఇంకా పూర్తి కాని ముందు instruction యొక్క result పై ఆధారపడినప్పుడు data hazard ఏర్పడుతుంది.
target_en: A data hazard occurs when an instruction depends on the result of a preceding instruction that has not yet completed.

input: to Telugu: A secondary indexing structure that references the primary index to locate data, used to support complex query operations.
target: Data ను కనుగొనడానికి primary index ను refer చేసే secondary indexing structure; complex query operations కు support ఇవ్వడానికి దీన్ని ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: A secondary indexing structure that references the primary index to locate data, used to support complex query operations.

input: to Telugu: Deep Canonical Correlation Analysis, a foundational method for maximizing agreement between different data views.
target: Deep CCA (Deep Canonical Correlation Analysis) అనేది విభిన్న data views మధ్య agreement ను గరిష్టీకరించడానికి (maximize చేయడానికి) ఉపయోగించే ఒక ప్రాథమిక పద్ధతి.
target_en: Deep Canonical Correlation Analysis, a foundational method for maximizing agreement between different data views.

input: to Telugu: The process of recovering plaintext from ciphertext without possessing the corresponding private key.
target: సంబంధిత private key లేకుండానే ciphertext నుండి plaintext ను తిరిగి పొందే ప్రక్రియ.
target_en: The process of recovering plaintext from ciphertext without possessing the corresponding private key.

input: to Telugu: A network architecture where information flows in one direction from the input layer to the output layer.
target: Information input layer నుండి output layer కు ఒకే దిశలో ప్రవహించే network architecture.
target_en: A network architecture where information flows in one direction from the input layer to the output layer.

input: to Telugu: An unaligned force acting on a body that causes parts of the material to slide or deform in opposite, parallel directions relative to each other.
target: Shear force అనేది ఒక వస్తువుపై పనిచేసే unaligned force, ఇది పదార్థంలోని భాగాలు ఒకదానికొకటి వ్యతిరేక, సమాంతర దిశలలో జారడానికి లేదా deform కావడానికి కారణమవుతుంది.
target_en: An unaligned force acting on a body that causes parts of the material to slide or deform in opposite, parallel directions relative to each other.

input: to Telugu: The algorithm combining the contributions of Stuart Lloyd and Edward Forgy, an alternative name for the standard k-means method.
target: Stuart Lloyd మరియు Edward Forgy ల కృషిని కలిపిన algorithm; ఇది standard k-means పద్ధతికి మరొక పేరు.
target_en: The algorithm combining the contributions of Stuart Lloyd and Edward Forgy, an alternative name for the standard k-means method.

input: to Telugu: A non-destructive evaluation method that uses guided waves to detect flaws within materials without damaging them.
target: Guided wave testing (GWT) అనేది పదార్థాలను పాడుచేయకుండా వాటిలోని లోపాలను గుర్తించడానికి guided waves ను ఉపయోగించే ఒక non-destructive evaluation పద్ధతి.
target_en: A non-destructive evaluation method that uses guided waves to detect flaws within materials without damaging them.

input: to Telugu: A public value computed by a party and transmitted over the network, derived from their private key.
target: Bob public అనేది ఒక పార్టీ ద్వారా లెక్కించబడి, వారి private key నుండి పొందబడి, network ద్వారా పంపబడే ఒక public value.
target_en: A public value computed by a party and transmitted over the network, derived from their private key.

input: to Telugu: A physical, handwritten mark on paper used to identify a person, which can be copied or forged unlike a digital signature.
target: Handwritten signature అనేది ఒక వ్యక్తిని గుర్తించడానికి కాగితంపై చేతితో పెట్టే గుర్తు, ఇది digital signature వలె కాకుండా కాపీ చేయడానికి లేదా ఫోర్జరీ చేయడానికి అవకాశం ఉంటుంది.
target_en: A physical, handwritten mark on paper used to identify a person, which can be copied or forged unlike a digital signature.

input: to Telugu: A constraint applied during matrix factorization algorithms that ensures all resulting coefficients and factor matrices contain only non-negative values.
target: Matrix factorization algorithms లో, వచ్చే అన్ని coefficients మరియు factor matrices లో non-negative values మాత్రమే ఉండేలా చూసే constraint.
target_en: A constraint applied during matrix factorization algorithms that ensures all resulting coefficients and factor matrices contain only non-negative values.

input: to Telugu: A discrete value representing the intensity or brightness of a pixel, typically ranging from 0 to 255 in an 8-bit image.
target: Gray level అనేది ఒక pixel యొక్క intensity లేదా brightness ను సూచించే discrete value, ఇది సాధారణంగా 8-bit image లో 0 నుండి 255 వరకు ఉంటుంది.
target_en: A discrete value representing the intensity or brightness of a pixel, typically ranging from 0 to 255 in an 8-bit image.

input: to Telugu: the boundary in the z-plane with a radius of unity that must be contained within the ROC for discrete-time stability
target: Discrete-time stability కోసం ROC లోపల ఉండాల్సిన, radius unity గా ఉన్న z-plane లోని boundary.

target_en: Elastic material is a substance that deforms under stress but returns to its original shape when the stress is removed.

input: to Telugu: An attribute set that functionally determines all attributes in a relation, making it a candidate for a primary key.
target: ఒక relation లోని అన్ని attributes ను functionally determine చేసే attribute set, ఇది primary key కి candidate అవుతుంది.
target_en: An attribute set that functionally determines all attributes in a relation, making it a candidate for a primary key.

input: to Telugu: A physical law describing the relationship between an object's motion and the forces acting upon it, forming the foundation of classical mechanics.
target: ఒక వస్తువు చలనం మరియు దానిపై పనిచేసే forces మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని వివరించే, classical mechanics కి పునాది అయిన భౌతిక నియమం.
target_en: A physical law describing the relationship between an object's motion and the forces acting upon it, forming the foundation of classical mechanics.

input: to Telugu: A mathematical formulation that expresses a real-valued sinusoid as the product of a complex constant and a rotating time-frequency factor.
target: Real-valued sinusoid ను ఒక complex constant మరియు తిరిగే time-frequency factor యొక్క లబ్ధంగా వ్యక్తపరిచే గణిత సూత్రీకరణ.
target_en: A mathematical formulation that expresses a real-valued sinusoid as the product of a complex constant and a rotating time-frequency factor.

input: to Telugu: The energy range in a solid where no electron states can exist, separating the valence band from the conduction band.
target: Valence band ను conduction band నుండి వేరు చేసే, ఏ electron states ఉండలేని solid లోని energy పరిధి.
target_en: The energy range in a solid where no electron states can exist, separating the valence band from the conduction band.

input: to Telugu: The index of the first occurrence of a target value within an array containing duplicate elements.
target: Duplicate elements ఉన్న array లో target value మొదటిసారి కనిపించే స్థానం యొక్క index.
target_en: The index of the first occurrence of a target value within an array containing duplicate elements.

input: to Telugu: An operation on a language that generates all possible concatenations of its strings with itself any number of times.
target: ఒక language లోని strings ను వాటితోనే ఎన్నిసార్లైనా కలపడం ద్వారా సాధ్యమైన అన్ని concatenations ను ఉత్పత్తి చేసే operation.
target_en: An operation on a language that generates all possible concatenations of its strings with itself any number of times.

input: to Telugu: The science and engineering of searching for information within documents, for information related to the documents themselves, and for metadata about documents.
target: Documents లోపల సమాచారం కోసం, documents కి సంబంధించిన సమాచారం కోసం, మరియు documents గురించిన metadata కోసం వెతికే శాస్త్రం మరియు engineering.
target_en: The science and engineering of searching for information within documents, for information related to the documents themselves, and for metadata about documents.

input: to Telugu: A branch that targets a later instruction in the program, typically an if-then structure.
target: Program లో తర్వాత వచ్చే instruction ను target చేసే branch, సాధారణంగా if-then structure.
target_en: A branch that targets a later instruction in the program, typically an if-then structure.

input: to Telugu: A standard marking scheme identifying terminals with identical relative instantaneous voltage polarities.
target: ఒకే విధమైన సాపేక్ష తక్షణ voltage polarities ఉన్న terminals ను గుర్తించే ప్రామాణిక marking పద్ధతి.
target_en: A standard marking scheme identifying terminals with identical relative instantaneous voltage polarities.

input: to Telugu: A cipher that systematically replaces letters or groups of letters with other letters or groups.
target: Letters లేదా letters సమూహాలను క్రమపద్ధతిలో ఇతర letters లేదా సమూహాలతో మార్చే cipher.
target_en: A cipher that systematically replaces letters or groups of letters with other letters or groups.

input: to Telugu: An RF signal is a real-valued passband signal generated by combining I and Q baseband components onto a high-frequency carrier.
target: RF signal అనేది I మరియు Q baseband భాగాలను high-frequency carrier పై కలపడం ద్వారా ఉత్పత్తి అయ్యే real-valued passband signal.
target_en: An RF signal is a real-valued passband signal generated by combining I and Q baseband components onto a high-frequency carrier.

input: to Telugu: Fully connected neurons are artificial neurons in a layer that receive inputs from every neuron in the preceding layer via learnable weights.
target: Fully connected neurons అంటే learnable weights ద్వారా ముందు layer లోని ప్రతి neuron నుండి inputs ను పొందే layer లోని artificial neurons.
target_en: Fully connected neurons are artificial neurons in a layer that receive inputs from every neuron in the preceding layer via learnable weights.

input: to Telugu: A system type where the output is a linear combination of inputs and remains consistent over time.
target: Output inputs యొక్క linear combination గా ఉండి, కాలంతో పాటు స్థిరంగా ఉండే system రకం.
target_en: A system type where the output is a linear combination of inputs and remains consistent over time.

input: to Telugu: The ratio of the reflected wave amplitude to the incident wave amplitude at a load termination on a transmission line.
target: Transmission line పై load termination వద్ద incident wave amplitude కి reflected wave amplitude యొక్క నిష్పత్తి.
target_en: The ratio of the reflected wave amplitude to the incident wave amplitude at a load termination on a transmission line.

input: to Telugu: A tree structure built incrementally by combining parsed subtrees from the bottom up during parsing.
target: Parsing సమయంలో parse చేసిన subtrees ను కింది నుండి పైకి కలుపుతూ క్రమంగా నిర్మించే tree structure.
target_en: A tree structure built incrementally by combining parsed subtrees from the bottom up during parsing.

input: to Telugu: The phenomenon where alternating current density is highest near the surface of a conductor and decays exponentially towards the interior due to opposing induced electromagnetic fields.
target: వ్యతిరేకించే induced electromagnetic fields కారణంగా, alternating current density conductor ఉపరితలం దగ్గర అత్యధికంగా ఉండి లోపలికి వెళ్ళేకొద్దీ exponential గా తగ్గే దృగ్విషయం.
target_en: The phenomenon where alternating current density is highest near the surface of a conductor and decays exponentially towards the interior due to opposing induced electromagnetic fields.

input: to Telugu: A dominant semiconductor technology that combines n-type and p-type MOSFETs to implement logic gates with low power consumption.
target: తక్కువ power వినియోగంతో logic gates ను implement చేయడానికి n-type మరియు p-type MOSFETs ను కలిపే ప్రధాన semiconductor technology.
target_en: A dominant semiconductor technology that combines n-type and p-type MOSFETs to implement logic gates with low power consumption.

input: to Telugu: The part of a CPU that performs arithmetic and bitwise logic operations on integer numeric data.
target: Integer numeric data పై arithmetic మరియు bitwise logic operations చేసే CPU భాగం.
target_en: The part of a CPU that performs arithmetic and bitwise logic operations on integer numeric data.

input: to Telugu: A DC-to-DC converter that increases output voltage while decreasing current using a switch, inductor, diode, and capacitor.
target: Switch, inductor, diode మరియు capacitor ఉపయోగించి current ను తగ్గిస్తూ output voltage ను పెంచే DC-to-DC converter.
target_en: A DC-to-DC converter that increases output voltage while decreasing current using a switch, inductor, diode, and capacitor.

input: to Telugu: A fundamental feedback principle where a portion of the system output is subtracted from the input, which is essential for ensuring stability and reducing error.
target: System output లో కొంత భాగాన్ని input నుండి తీసివేసే ప్రాథమిక feedback సూత్రం, ఇది stability ని నిర్ధారించడానికి మరియు error ను తగ్గించడానికి అవసరం.
target_en: A fundamental feedback principle where a portion of the system output is subtracted from the input, which is essential for ensuring stability and reducing error.

input: to Telugu: Computer networks that cover a broad geographical area, often connecting smaller local networks across cities, regions, or countries.
target: విస్తృత భౌగోళిక ప్రాంతాన్ని కవర్ చేసే computer networks, ఇవి తరచుగా నగరాలు, ప్రాంతాలు లేదా దేశాల మధ్య చిన్న local networks ను కలుపుతాయి.
target_en: Computer networks that cover a broad geographical area, often connecting smaller local networks across cities, regions, or countries.

input: to Telugu: A representation where the most significant bit indicates sign and the rest represent magnitude.
target: Most significant bit sign ను సూచించి, మిగతా bits magnitude ను సూచించే representation.
target_en: A representation where the most significant bit indicates sign and the rest represent magnitude.

input: to Telugu: A classifier that performs only slightly better than random guessing, used as a base model in boosting.
target: Random guessing కంటే కొంచెం మాత్రమే మెరుగ్గా పనిచేసే classifier, దీనిని boosting లో base model గా ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: A classifier that performs only slightly better than random guessing, used as a base model in boosting.

input: to Telugu: A signature that successfully passes the verification algorithm, confirming the message's authenticity to any recipient.
target: Verification algorithm ను విజయవంతంగా దాటి, ఏ recipient కైనా message యొక్క authenticity ని నిర్ధారించే signature.
target_en: A signature that successfully passes the verification algorithm, confirming the message's authenticity to any recipient.

input: to Telugu: A radio technology using a wide bandwidth to transmit data, often utilizing wavelet transforms for signal processing.
target: Data ను పంపడానికి విస్తృత bandwidth ఉపయోగించే radio technology, ఇది signal processing కోసం తరచుగా wavelet transforms ను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.
target_en: A radio technology using a wide bandwidth to transmit data, often utilizing wavelet transforms for signal processing.

input: to Telugu: A generalized frequency variable used in system analysis to represent sinusoidal and exponential signals in the s-domain.
target: s-domain లో sinusoidal మరియు exponential signals ను సూచించడానికి system analysis లో ఉపయోగించే సాధారణీకృత frequency variable.
target_en: A generalized frequency variable used in system analysis to represent sinusoidal and exponential signals in the s-domain.

input: to Telugu: Software evolution refers to changes that expand functionality beyond maintenance, such as deliberate releases of incomplete software to be finished post-release.
target: Software evolution అంటే maintenance కు మించి functionality ని విస్తరించే మార్పులు, ఉదాహరణకు release తర్వాత పూర్తి చేయడానికి అసంపూర్ణ software ను ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా release చేయడం.
target_en: Software evolution refers to changes that expand functionality beyond maintenance, such as deliberate releases of incomplete software to be finished post-release.

input: to Telugu: An activation function that serves as a smooth, probabilistic approximation of the rectifier, widely used in state-of-the-art transformer models.
target: Rectifier కి smooth, probabilistic approximation గా పనిచేసే activation function, దీనిని అత్యాధునిక transformer models లో విస్తృతంగా ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: An activation function that serves as a smooth, probabilistic approximation of the rectifier, widely used in state-of-the-art transformer models.

input: to Telugu: A pipeline conflict occurring when two instructions simultaneously require the same hardware resource.
target: రెండు instructions ఒకేసారి ఒకే hardware resource ను కోరినప్పుడు ఏర్పడే pipeline conflict.
target_en: A pipeline conflict occurring when two instructions simultaneously require the same hardware resource.

input: to Telugu: The maximum number of successors for any given state in a search tree.
target: Search tree లో ఏదైనా state కి ఉండగల గరిష్ట successors సంఖ్య.
target_en: The maximum number of successors for any given state in a search tree.

input: to Telugu: The range of frequencies that a filter allows to pass through with minimal attenuation.
target: Filter కనిష్ట attenuation తో దాటనిచ్చే frequencies పరిధి.
target_en: The range of frequencies that a filter allows to pass through with minimal attenuation.

input: to Telugu: The stack pointer is a register that points to the top of the current stack, tracking active function calls.
target: Stack pointer అనేది ప్రస్తుత stack పై భాగాన్ని సూచిస్తూ, active function calls ను track చేసే register.
target_en: The stack pointer is a register that points to the top of the current stack, tracking active function calls.

input: to Telugu: A circuit containing inductors and capacitors designed to pass a narrow band of frequencies while rejecting others.
target: ఇతర frequencies ను తిరస్కరిస్తూ, ఒక సన్నని frequency band ను మాత్రమే దాటనిచ్చేలా రూపొందించిన inductors మరియు capacitors ఉన్న circuit.
target_en: A circuit containing inductors and capacitors designed to pass a narrow band of frequencies while rejecting others.

input: to Telugu: A perspective where probability represents a quantifiable degree of rational belief or certainty in a specific proposition.
target: Probability ఒక నిర్దిష్ట ప్రతిపాదనపై కొలవగల తార్కిక నమ్మకం లేదా నిశ్చయత స్థాయిని సూచిస్తుందనే దృక్పథం.
target_en: A perspective where probability represents a quantifiable degree of rational belief or certainty in a specific proposition.

input: to Telugu: Delay slots are empty cycles in a pipeline where a processor executes unrelated instructions to fill the gap after a branch.
target: Delay slots అంటే branch తర్వాత ఖాళీని నింపడానికి processor సంబంధం లేని instructions ను execute చేసే pipeline లోని ఖాళీ cycles.
target_en: Delay slots are empty cycles in a pipeline where a processor executes unrelated instructions to fill the gap after a branch.

input: to Telugu: A standard model for a communication channel where noise is added to the signal and is uniformly distributed across frequencies.
target: Signal కి noise కలిసే, ఆ noise అన్ని frequencies లో సమానంగా పంపిణీ అయి ఉండే communication channel యొక్క ప్రామాణిక model.
target_en: A standard model for a communication channel where noise is added to the signal and is uniformly distributed across frequencies.

input: to Telugu: The intermediate data generated by the map functions and moved between nodes during the shuffle phase of a MapReduce job.

target_en: The intermediate data generated by the map functions and moved between nodes during the shuffle phase of a MapReduce job.

input: to Telugu: A technique for controlling power delivery to devices by varying the duty cycle of a digital signal, often used for motor speed or LED brightness control.
target: Digital signal యొక్క duty cycle ను మార్చడం ద్వారా devices కి power అందించడాన్ని నియంత్రించే technique, దీనిని తరచుగా motor speed లేదా LED brightness నియంత్రణకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: A technique for controlling power delivery to devices by varying the duty cycle of a digital signal, often used for motor speed or LED brightness control.

input: to Telugu: Additional indexing structures that support the main database index, improving query performance for specific access patterns.
target: ప్రధాన database index కి సహాయపడే అదనపు indexing structures, ఇవి నిర్దిష్ట access patterns కోసం query performance ను మెరుగుపరుస్తాయి.
target_en: Additional indexing structures that support the main database index, improving query performance for specific access patterns.

input: to Telugu: The poles of the closed-loop transfer function, which determine the stability and dynamic behavior of the system.
target: System యొక్క stability మరియు dynamic ప్రవర్తనను నిర్ణయించే closed-loop transfer function యొక్క poles.
target_en: The poles of the closed-loop transfer function, which determine the stability and dynamic behavior of the system.

input: to Telugu: A random forest variant that assigns higher weights to more accurate trees in the final prediction.
target: చివరి prediction లో ఎక్కువ ఖచ్చితమైన trees కు ఎక్కువ weights కేటాయించే random forest variant.
target_en: A random forest variant that assigns higher weights to more accurate trees in the final prediction.

input: to Telugu: A numerical array of a specified dimension, such as the x-values of data points, used as input for a model.
target: Model కి input గా ఉపయోగించే, data points యొక్క x-values వంటి నిర్దిష్ట dimension కలిగిన numerical array.
target_en: A numerical array of a specified dimension, such as the x-values of data points, used as input for a model.

input: to Telugu: The primary processing component of a computer that executes instructions, performs calculations, and manages data flow for the entire system.
target: మొత్తం system కోసం instructions ను execute చేసి, లెక్కలు చేసి, data ప్రవాహాన్ని నిర్వహించే computer యొక్క ప్రధాన processing భాగం.
target_en: The primary processing component of a computer that executes instructions, performs calculations, and manages data flow for the entire system.

input: to Telugu: Predictions where the model correctly identifies the absence of a condition, which are notably ignored by the standard F-score calculation.
target: ఒక condition లేదని model సరిగ్గా గుర్తించే predictions, ప్రామాణిక F-score లెక్కింపు వీటిని ప్రత్యేకంగా పట్టించుకోదు.
target_en: Predictions where the model correctly identifies the absence of a condition, which are notably ignored by the standard F-score calculation.

input: to Telugu: The organizational practice of situating team members together in a shared physical space to improve communication and team identity.
target: Communication మరియు team identity ని మెరుగుపరచడానికి team సభ్యులను ఒకే భౌతిక ప్రదేశంలో కలిసి ఉంచే సంస్థాగత పద్ధతి.
target_en: The organizational practice of situating team members together in a shared physical space to improve communication and team identity.

input: to Telugu: The mathematical and physical framework used to analyze signal propagation, reflection, and impedance matching in high-frequency cables.
target: High-frequency cables లో signal propagation, reflection మరియు impedance matching ను విశ్లేషించడానికి ఉపయోగించే గణిత మరియు భౌతిక framework.
target_en: The mathematical and physical framework used to analyze signal propagation, reflection, and impedance matching in high-frequency cables.

input: to Telugu: A filter that allows frequencies below a certain cutoff to pass through while attenuating higher frequencies.
target: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట cutoff కంటే తక్కువ frequencies ను దాటనిచ్చి, ఎక్కువ frequencies ను attenuate చేసే filter.
target_en: A filter that allows frequencies below a certain cutoff to pass through while attenuating higher frequencies.

input: to Telugu: An operation that removes an element from the front of the queue.
target: Queue ముందు భాగం నుండి ఒక element ను తొలగించే operation.
target_en: An operation that removes an element from the front of the queue.

input: to Telugu: A machine language instruction is a single binary command that a CPU executes to perform a specific operation.
target: Machine language instruction అనేది ఒక నిర్దిష్ట operation చేయడానికి CPU execute చేసే ఒకే binary command.
target_en: A machine language instruction is a single binary command that a CPU executes to perform a specific operation.

input: to Telugu: The characteristic of forces described by Newton's third law, where two interacting bodies exert forces on each other that are equal in magnitude but opposite in direction.
target: Newton's third law వివరించే forces యొక్క లక్షణం, ఇందులో పరస్పరం చర్య జరిపే రెండు వస్తువులు ఒకదానిపై ఒకటి magnitude లో సమానమైన కానీ దిశలో వ్యతిరేకమైన forces ను ప్రయోగిస్తాయి.
target_en: The characteristic of forces described by Newton's third law, where two interacting bodies exert forces on each other that are equal in magnitude but opposite in direction.

input: to Telugu: A voltage buffer configuration that provides high input impedance and low output impedance to prevent loading effects.

target_en: A widely used differential method for optical flow estimation that assumes motion is approximately constant within a local neighborhood of pixels.

input: to Telugu: The theoretical minimum error rate achievable by any classifier given the true underlying probability distribution of the data.
target: Data యొక్క నిజమైన underlying probability distribution తెలిసినప్పుడు, ఏ classifier అయినా సాధించగల సైద్ధాంతిక కనిష్ఠ error rate.
target_en: The theoretical minimum error rate achievable by any classifier given the true underlying probability distribution of the data.

input: to Telugu: A filter that passes signals with a frequency lower than a certain cutoff frequency and attenuates signals with frequencies higher than the cutoff frequency.
target: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట cutoff frequency కంటే తక్కువ frequency ఉన్న signals ను పంపించి, cutoff frequency కంటే ఎక్కువ frequency ఉన్న signals ను attenuate చేసే filter.
target_en: A filter that passes signals with a frequency lower than a certain cutoff frequency and attenuates signals with frequencies higher than the cutoff frequency.

input: to Telugu: The ratio between the strongest un-distorted signal on a channel and the minimum discernible signal level.
target: ఒక channel పై distortion లేని అత్యంత బలమైన signal కి మరియు గుర్తించగలిగే కనిష్ఠ signal level కి మధ్య ఉన్న నిష్పత్తి.
target_en: The ratio between the strongest un-distorted signal on a channel and the minimum discernible signal level.

input: to Telugu: The physical or logical pathway that allows data to be transmitted between two network nodes.
target: రెండు network nodes మధ్య data పంపడానికి వీలు కల్పించే physical లేదా logical మార్గం.
target_en: The physical or logical pathway that allows data to be transmitted between two network nodes.

input: to Telugu: A method of grouping data points based on their similarities, often used in unsupervised learning to discover underlying structures.
target: Data points ను వాటి మధ్య ఉన్న పోలికల ఆధారంగా గుంపులుగా విభజించే పద్ధతి, దీన్ని తరచుగా unsupervised learning లో అంతర్లీన structures ను కనుగొనడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: A method of grouping data points based on their similarities, often used in unsupervised learning to discover underlying structures.

input: to Telugu: The process of performing mathematical operations, such as addition or subtraction, on pointer variables to navigate through arrays or memory structures.
target: Arrays లేదా memory structures లో ముందుకు వెనక్కు వెళ్ళడానికి pointer variables పై addition లేదా subtraction వంటి గణిత operations చేసే ప్రక్రియ.
target_en: The process of performing mathematical operations, such as addition or subtraction, on pointer variables to navigate through arrays or memory structures.

input: to Telugu: a combinational circuit that adds three binary bits to produce a sum and a carry output
target: మూడు binary bits ను కలిపి ఒక sum మరియు ఒక carry output ను ఇచ్చే combinational circuit.
target_en: a combinational circuit that adds three binary bits to produce a sum and a carry output

input: to Telugu: The high-voltage backbone of the power system that moves bulk electricity from generating plants to distribution substations over long distances.
target: Generating plants నుండి distribution substations కు ఎక్కువ దూరం పెద్ద మొత్తంలో విద్యుత్తును తీసుకువెళ్ళే power system యొక్క high-voltage backbone.
target_en: The high-voltage backbone of the power system that moves bulk electricity from generating plants to distribution substations over long distances.

input: to Telugu: A basic error control protocol where the sender transmits one packet and waits for an acknowledgment before sending the next.
target: Sender ఒక packet పంపి, తదుపరి packet పంపే ముందు acknowledgment కోసం ఎదురుచూసే ఒక ప్రాథమిక error control protocol.
target_en: A basic error control protocol where the sender transmits one packet and waits for an acknowledgment before sending the next.

input: to Telugu: A digital representation of an analog signal consisting of a sequence of quantized values captured at uniform time intervals.
target: సమాన time intervals వద్ద తీసుకున్న quantized values యొక్క క్రమంతో కూడిన, ఒక analog signal యొక్క digital రూపం.
target_en: A digital representation of an analog signal consisting of a sequence of quantized values captured at uniform time intervals.

input: to Telugu: An I2C transaction where a controller issues multiple reads or writes to one or more targets.
target: ఒక controller ఒకటి లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ targets కు అనేక reads లేదా writes జారీ చేసే I2C transaction.
target_en: An I2C transaction where a controller issues multiple reads or writes to one or more targets.

input: to Telugu: A type of flip-flop that captures the value of the data input at a specific clock edge.
target: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట clock edge వద్ద data input యొక్క విలువను పట్టుకునే ఒక రకమైన flip-flop.
target_en: A type of flip-flop that captures the value of the data input at a specific clock edge.

input: to Telugu: Another name for the logistic function, characterized by its S-shaped curve that maps any real input to a value between 0 and 1.
target: Logistic function కి మరో పేరు, ఇది S-ఆకారపు curve కలిగి ఉండి ఏ real input నైనా 0 మరియు 1 మధ్య విలువకు map చేస్తుంది.
target_en: Another name for the logistic function, characterized by its S-shaped curve that maps any real input to a value between 0 and 1.

input: to Telugu: A domain where signals are defined for every possible instant of time within a given continuous interval.
target: ఇచ్చిన continuous interval లో ప్రతి సాధ్యమైన క్షణానికీ signals నిర్వచించబడి ఉండే domain.
target_en: A domain where signals are defined for every possible instant of time within a given continuous interval.

input: to Telugu: A metric describing how much a component degrades the signal-to-noise ratio in a cascaded amplifier system.
target: ఒక cascaded amplifier system లో ఒక component signal-to-noise ratio ను ఎంత తగ్గిస్తుందో వివరించే metric.
target_en: A metric describing how much a component degrades the signal-to-noise ratio in a cascaded amplifier system.

input: to Telugu: A mathematical function added to a node in a neural network to determine if it should be fired, enabling the network to learn non-linear decision boundaries.
target: ఒక neural network లోని node కు జోడించే గణిత function, ఆ node fire కావాలా వద్దా అని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది; దీని వల్ల network non-linear decision boundaries ను నేర్చుకోగలుగుతుంది.
target_en: A mathematical function added to a node in a neural network to determine if it should be fired, enabling the network to learn non-linear decision boundaries.

input: to Telugu: A key manufacturing process that uses metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors to create integrated circuits, which allowed for the development of early microprocessors.
target: Integrated circuits తయారు చేయడానికి metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors ను ఉపయోగించే ఒక ముఖ్యమైన manufacturing ప్రక్రియ, ఇది తొలి microprocessors అభివృద్ధికి వీలు కల్పించింది.
target_en: A key manufacturing process that uses metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors to create integrated circuits, which allowed for the development of early microprocessors.

input: to Telugu: When a model learns the training data too well, including noise, and fails to generalize.
target: ఒక model training data ను noise తో సహా మరీ బాగా నేర్చుకుని, generalize చేయడంలో విఫలమైనప్పుడు.
target_en: When a model learns the training data too well, including noise, and fails to generalize.

input: to Telugu: A statistical method used to determine the optimal number of clusters by identifying the point of diminishing returns on variance explained.
target: Variance explained లో diminishing returns మొదలయ్యే point ను గుర్తించడం ద్వారా clusters యొక్క optimal సంఖ్యను నిర్ణయించడానికి ఉపయోగించే ఒక statistical పద్ధతి.
target_en: A statistical method used to determine the optimal number of clusters by identifying the point of diminishing returns on variance explained.

input: to Telugu: Region mean is the average pixel value within a segmented region, used to recompute cluster centers in algorithms like K-means.
target: Region mean అంటే ఒక segmented region లోని సగటు pixel value, దీన్ని K-means వంటి algorithms లో cluster centers ను మళ్ళీ లెక్కించడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: Region mean is the average pixel value within a segmented region, used to recompute cluster centers in algorithms like K-means.

input: to Telugu: The class of languages that can be described by regular expressions and recognized or accepted by finite automata models.
target: Regular expressions ద్వారా వివరించగల మరియు finite automata models ద్వారా గుర్తించబడే లేదా accept చేయబడే languages యొక్క class.
target_en: The class of languages that can be described by regular expressions and recognized or accepted by finite automata models.

input: to Telugu: The wave-like phenomenon in which electrons scatter when encountering an obstacle, demonstrating matter wave interference patterns.
target: Electrons ఒక అడ్డంకిని ఎదుర్కొన్నప్పుడు scatter అయ్యే తరంగ లాంటి దృగ్విషయం, ఇది matter wave interference patterns ను నిరూపిస్తుంది.
target_en: The wave-like phenomenon in which electrons scatter when encountering an obstacle, demonstrating matter wave interference patterns.

input: to Telugu: The mathematical principle that determines the necessary rate to sample a band-limited signal for perfect reconstruction.
target: ఒక band-limited signal ను పూర్తిగా తిరిగి నిర్మించడానికి దాన్ని ఏ rate లో sample చేయాలో నిర్ణయించే గణిత సూత్రం.
target_en: The mathematical principle that determines the necessary rate to sample a band-limited signal for perfect reconstruction.

input: to Telugu: A rule used by lexers to select the longest possible sequence of characters that matches a token pattern.
target: ఒక token pattern కు సరిపోయే అత్యంత పొడవైన characters sequence ను ఎంచుకోవడానికి lexers ఉపయోగించే నియమం.
target_en: A rule used by lexers to select the longest possible sequence of characters that matches a token pattern.

input: to Telugu: An integrated circuit designed to be configured by a customer or designer after manufacturing through repeated programming.
target: తయారీ తర్వాత మళ్ళీ మళ్ళీ programming చేయడం ద్వారా customer లేదా designer configure చేసుకునేలా రూపొందించిన integrated circuit.
target_en: An integrated circuit designed to be configured by a customer or designer after manufacturing through repeated programming.

input: to Telugu: An advanced routing protocol developed by Cisco that combines features of both distance-vector and link-state routing to improve convergence and efficiency.
target: Convergence మరియు efficiency ని మెరుగుపరచడానికి distance-vector మరియు link-state routing రెండింటి లక్షణాలను కలిపే, Cisco అభివృద్ధి చేసిన ఒక advanced routing protocol.
target_en: An advanced routing protocol developed by Cisco that combines features of both distance-vector and link-state routing to improve convergence and efficiency.

input: to Telugu: Models that predict a continuous output value based on input features.
target: Input features ఆధారంగా ఒక continuous output value ను predict చేసే models.
target_en: Models that predict a continuous output value based on input features.

input: to Telugu: An electric current that periodically reverses its direction and continuous magnitude over time, widely used for efficient energy delivery.
target: కాలక్రమంలో తన దిశను మరియు నిరంతర magnitude ను periodic గా మార్చుకునే electric current, దీన్ని సమర్థవంతమైన energy సరఫరా కోసం విస్తృతంగా ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
target_en: An electric current that periodically reverses its direction and continuous magnitude over time, widely used for efficient energy delivery.

input: to Telugu: The representation of a signal in both the time and frequency domains to analyze its characteristics.
target: ఒక signal యొక్క లక్షణాలను విశ్లేషించడానికి దాన్ని time మరియు frequency domains రెండింటిలోనూ సూచించడం.
target_en: The representation of a signal in both the time and frequency domains to analyze its characteristics.

input: to Telugu: Modern solid-state devices that use semiconductor switches to rapidly interrupt fault currents without mechanical contact separation.
target: Mechanical contacts ను వేరు చేయకుండానే fault currents ను వేగంగా ఆపడానికి semiconductor switches ను ఉపయోగించే ఆధునిక solid-state పరికరాలు.
target_en: Modern solid-state devices that use semiconductor switches to rapidly interrupt fault currents without mechanical contact separation.

input: to Telugu: Error detection is identifying when noise or impairments have introduced errors into transmitted digital data.
target: Error detection అంటే పంపిన digital data లో noise లేదా impairments వల్ల errors వచ్చాయని గుర్తించడం.
target_en: Error detection is identifying when noise or impairments have introduced errors into transmitted digital data.

input: to Telugu: A signal sent to the processor from hardware or software indicating an event that needs immediate attention, requiring the CPU to pause current tasks.
target: తక్షణ శ్రద్ధ అవసరమైన ఒక event గురించి hardware లేదా software నుండి processor కు పంపే signal, దీని వల్ల CPU ప్రస్తుత పనులను ఆపవలసి ఉంటుంది.
target_en: A signal sent to the processor from hardware or software indicating an event that needs immediate attention, requiring the CPU to pause current tasks.

input: to Telugu: Condition where network packets arrive at the destination in a sequence different from the order in which they were sent.
target: Network packets పంపిన క్రమం కంటే వేరే క్రమంలో destination కు చేరే పరిస్థితి.
target_en: Condition where network packets arrive at the destination in a sequence different from the order in which they were sent.

input: to Telugu: Elements in the search tree that represent a specific state or subset of the problem's variables during enumeration.
target: Enumeration సమయంలో problem యొక్క variables లో ఒక నిర్దిష్ట state లేదా subset ను సూచించే search tree లోని elements.
target_en: Elements in the search tree that represent a specific state or subset of the problem's variables during enumeration.

input: to Telugu: Thermodynamic equilibrium is a state where macroscopic properties like temperature and pressure are uniform, and there are no net flows of heat or work.
target: Thermodynamic equilibrium అంటే temperature మరియు pressure వంటి macroscopic లక్షణాలు అంతటా ఒకేలా ఉండి, heat లేదా work యొక్క net ప్రవాహాలు లేని స్థితి.
target_en: Thermodynamic equilibrium is a state where macroscopic properties like temperature and pressure are uniform, and there are no net flows of heat or work.

input: to Telugu: A mathematical representation of a digital image where each coordinate maps to a specific brightness or color value.
target: ఒక digital image యొక్క గణిత రూపం, ఇందులో ప్రతి coordinate ఒక నిర్దిష్ట brightness లేదా color value కు map అవుతుంది.
target_en: A mathematical representation of a digital image where each coordinate maps to a specific brightness or color value.

input: to Telugu: A standard programming language specifically designed for managing, querying, and manipulating data within relational database management systems.
target: Relational database management systems లో data ను manage చేయడానికి, query చేయడానికి మరియు మార్చడానికి ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించిన ఒక standard programming language.
target_en: A standard programming language specifically designed for managing, querying, and manipulating data within relational database management systems.

input: to Telugu: A layer that maps a graph representation to an updated representation such that reordering the nodes reorders the outputs identically.
target: Nodes క్రమాన్ని మార్చినప్పుడు outputs కూడా అదే విధంగా క్రమం మారేలా, ఒక graph representation ను updated representation కు map చేసే layer.
target_en: A layer that maps a graph representation to an updated representation such that reordering the nodes reorders the outputs identically.

input: to Telugu: A networking device that forwards data packets between computer networks, connecting disparate networks by determining the optimal path for data transmission.
target: Data transmission కోసం optimal మార్గాన్ని నిర్ణయించి వేర్వేరు networks ను కలుపుతూ, computer networks మధ్య data packets ను forward చేసే networking పరికరం.
target_en: A networking device that forwards data packets between computer networks, connecting disparate networks by determining the optimal path for data transmission.

input: to Telugu: The ability of a transform to distinguish between two closely spaced frequencies in the frequency domain.
target: Frequency domain లో దగ్గర దగ్గరగా ఉన్న రెండు frequencies మధ్య తేడాను గుర్తించగల ఒక transform యొక్క సామర్థ్యం.
target_en: The ability of a transform to distinguish between two closely spaced frequencies in the frequency domain.

input: to Telugu: Operations that determine the position or count of elements less than a given target value in a sorted array.
target: ఒక sorted array లో ఇచ్చిన target value కంటే తక్కువ ఉన్న elements యొక్క position లేదా count ను నిర్ణయించే operations.
target_en: Operations that determine the position or count of elements less than a given target value in a sorted array.

input: to Telugu: Minimum description length (MDL) principle is a concept where the optimal model is the one that minimizes the total length of the model and the data given the model.
target: Minimum description length (MDL) principle అనేది, model యొక్క length మరియు ఆ model ఇచ్చినప్పుడు data యొక్క length కలిపిన మొత్తం length ను minimize చేసే model యే optimal అని చెప్పే భావన.
target_en: Minimum description length (MDL) principle is a concept where the optimal model is the one that minimizes the total length of the model and the data given the model.

input: to Telugu: A probabilistic assumption where the likelihood of all pixels is independent given the shape parameters.
target: Shape parameters ఇచ్చినప్పుడు అన్ని pixels యొక్క likelihood స్వతంత్రంగా ఉంటుందని భావించే ఒక probabilistic assumption.
target_en: A probabilistic assumption where the likelihood of all pixels is independent given the shape parameters.

input: to Telugu: A specialized conductor or structure designed to transport electromagnetic signals between two points while maintaining signal integrity.
target: Signal integrity ని కాపాడుతూ రెండు points మధ్య electromagnetic signals ను తీసుకువెళ్ళడానికి రూపొందించిన ప్రత్యేక conductor లేదా structure.
target_en: A specialized conductor or structure designed to transport electromagnetic signals between two points while maintaining signal integrity.

input: to Telugu: A weighted sum is the linear combination of a neuron's inputs, where each input is multiplied by its corresponding synaptic weight.
target: Weighted sum అంటే ఒక neuron యొక్క inputs యొక్క linear combination, ఇందులో ప్రతి input ను దానికి సంబంధించిన synaptic weight తో గుణిస్తారు.
target_en: A weighted sum is the linear combination of a neuron's inputs, where each input is multiplied by its corresponding synaptic weight.

input: to Telugu: The XOR of the indices of all bit positions containing a 1 in a received message.
target: అందుకున్న message లో 1 ఉన్న అన్ని bit positions యొక్క indices యొక్క XOR.
target_en: The XOR of the indices of all bit positions containing a 1 in a received message.

input: to Telugu: A standard for high-quality video compression that succeeds older MPEG standards, utilizing integer approximations of the discrete cosine transform to achieve efficient data rates.
target: పాత MPEG standards తర్వాత వచ్చిన, high-quality video compression కోసం ఒక standard; ఇది సమర్థవంతమైన data rates సాధించడానికి discrete cosine transform యొక్క integer approximations ను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a feature store in a machine learning pipeline? A) To automatically generate features using deep learning algorithms without human intervention B) To handle the inherent issues with clustering algorithms using manifold learning techniques C) To reduce the dimensionality of the dataset using Principal Components Analysis D) To serve as a centralized location for storing, organizing, and serving features for training and prediction ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Machine learning pipeline లో feature store యొక్క ప్రధాన పని ఏమిటి? A) మనిషి జోక్యం లేకుండా deep learning algorithms ఉపయోగించి features ను స్వయంచాలకంగా generate చేయడం B) Manifold learning techniques ఉపయోగించి clustering algorithms లోని సహజ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించడం C) Principal Components Analysis ఉపయోగించి dataset యొక్క dimensionality ని తగ్గించడం D) Training మరియు prediction కోసం features ను store చేయడానికి, organize చేయడానికి మరియు serve చేయడానికి ఒక కేంద్రీకృత స్థానంగా పనిచేయడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a feature store in a machine learning pipeline? A) To automatically generate features using deep learning algorithms without human intervention B) To handle the inherent issues with clustering algorithms using manifold learning techniques C) To reduce the dimensionality of the dataset using Principal Components Analysis D) To serve as a centralized location for storing, organizing, and serving features for training and prediction ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a write-miss in a write-back cache require two memory accesses to the backing store? A) To first write back dirty data and then fetch the requested block from the backing store B) To first update the tag and then write the data to the backing store C) To first check permissions and then write the data to the backing store D) To first fetch the block into cache and then write it back to the backing store ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Write-back cache లో ఒక write-miss కు backing store కు రెండు memory accesses ఎందుకు అవసరం కావచ్చు? A) ముందుగా dirty data ను write back చేసి, తర్వాత అడిగిన block ను backing store నుండి fetch చేయడానికి B) ముందుగా tag ను update చేసి, తర్వాత data ను backing store కు write చేయడానికి C) ముందుగా permissions ను check చేసి, తర్వాత data ను backing store కు write చేయడానికి D) ముందుగా block ను cache లోకి fetch చేసి, తర్వాత దాన్ని backing store కు తిరిగి write చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why might a write-miss in a write-back cache require two memory accesses to the backing store? A) To first write back dirty data and then fetch the requested block from the backing store B) To first update the tag and then write the data to the backing store C) To first check permissions and then write the data to the backing store D) To first fetch the block into cache and then write it back to the backing store ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which combination of logic gates is used in the simplest implementation of a half adder to produce the sum and carry outputs respectively? A) XOR gate for sum and OR gate for carry B) OR gate for sum and XOR gate for carry C) AND gate for sum and OR gate for carry D) XOR gate for sum and AND gate for carry ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Half adder యొక్క అత్యంత సరళమైన implementation లో sum మరియు carry outputs ను వరుసగా ఉత్పత్తి చేయడానికి ఏ logic gates కలయికను ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) Sum కోసం XOR gate మరియు carry కోసం OR gate B) Sum కోసం OR gate మరియు carry కోసం XOR gate C) Sum కోసం AND gate మరియు carry కోసం OR gate D) Sum కోసం XOR gate మరియు carry కోసం AND gate జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which combination of logic gates is used in the simplest implementation of a half adder to produce the sum and carry outputs respectively? A) XOR gate for sum and OR gate for carry B) OR gate for sum and XOR gate for carry C) AND gate for sum and OR gate for carry D) XOR gate for sum and AND gate for carry ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are seizure medications typically withdrawn during an admission to an Epilepsy Monitoring Unit? A) To reduce the financial cost of the clinical procedure.
