B) Chemical జోక్యం లేకుండా patient బాగా నిద్రపోవడానికి. C) Hospital లో ఉన్న సమయంలో ఒక ictal event ను record చేసే అవకాశాన్ని గరిష్ఠం చేయడానికి. D) Patient కు ఆ medication పై allergy ఉందో లేదో నిర్ధారించడానికి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why are seizure medications typically withdrawn during an admission to an Epilepsy Monitoring Unit? A) To reduce the financial cost of the clinical procedure. B) To allow the patient to sleep better without chemical interference. C) To maximize the chance of recording an ictal event during the hospital stay. D) To verify if the patient is allergic to the medication. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the choice of search algorithm often dependent on the data structure being searched? A) Because data structures only affect memory usage, not speed B) Because the search problem is always the same regardless of structure C) Because the data structure's organization determines how efficiently an algorithm can access elements D) Because all algorithms perform identically on any data structure ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Search algorithm ఎంపిక తరచుగా search చేస్తున్న data structure పై ఎందుకు ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే data structures కేవలం memory usage ను మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి, speed ను కాదు B) ఎందుకంటే structure ఏదైనా search problem ఎప్పుడూ ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే data structure యొక్క అమరిక ఒక algorithm elements ను ఎంత సమర్థవంతంగా access చేయగలదో నిర్ణయిస్తుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అన్ని algorithms ఏ data structure పైనైనా ఒకేలా పనిచేస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the choice of search algorithm often dependent on the data structure being searched? A) Because data structures only affect memory usage, not speed B) Because the search problem is always the same regardless of structure C) Because the data structure's organization determines how efficiently an algorithm can access elements D) Because all algorithms perform identically on any data structure ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Young's modulus considered a measure of material stiffness? A) Because it is the ratio of stress to strain, indicating resistance to deformation B) Because it is the same for all materials regardless of type C) Because it is directly proportional to the applied force D) Because it is measured in units of strain ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Young's modulus ను పదార్థం యొక్క stiffness కు కొలతగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే ఇది stress కు strain కు మధ్య నిష్పత్తి, deformation కు ఉన్న నిరోధాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే పదార్థం రకం ఏదైనా ఇది అన్నింటికీ ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే ఇది ప్రయోగించిన force కు నేరుగా అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది D) ఎందుకంటే దీన్ని strain units లో కొలుస్తారు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is Young's modulus considered a measure of material stiffness? A) Because it is the ratio of stress to strain, indicating resistance to deformation B) Because it is the same for all materials regardless of type C) Because it is directly proportional to the applied force D) Because it is measured in units of strain ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason Lloyd's algorithm is considered efficient in practice despite the k-means problem being NP-hard? A) It uses the Forgy initialization method, which is always optimal. B) It avoids the NP-hard nature by only working on two-dimensional data. C) It guarantees finding the global optimum in polynomial time for all datasets. D) It converges to a local optimum very quickly, often in a small number of iterations. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: k-means problem NP-hard అయినప్పటికీ Lloyd's algorithm ఆచరణలో సమర్థవంతమైనదిగా పరిగణించబడటానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) ఇది ఎప్పుడూ optimal అయిన Forgy initialization method ను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) ఇది కేవలం two-dimensional data పై మాత్రమే పనిచేయడం ద్వారా NP-hard స్వభావాన్ని తప్పించుకుంటుంది. C) ఇది అన్ని datasets కు polynomial time లో global optimum ను కనుగొంటుందని హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) ఇది చాలా వేగంగా, తరచుగా కొన్ని iterations లోనే, ఒక local optimum కు converge అవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason Lloyd's algorithm is considered efficient in practice despite the k-means problem being NP-hard? A) It uses the Forgy initialization method, which is always optimal. B) It avoids the NP-hard nature by only working on two-dimensional data. C) It guarantees finding the global optimum in polynomial time for all datasets. D) It converges to a local optimum very quickly, often in a small number of iterations. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Divergence Theorem simplify the calculation of flux across a complicated closed surface? A) It replaces the vector field with an equivalent constant scalar field. B) It converts the boundary surface integral into a volume integral of divergence over the enclosed region. C) It projects the surface into a 1D line integral along the perimeter. D) It restricts evaluation to only the points where the outward unit normal is constant. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: సంక్లిష్టమైన closed surface గుండా flux లెక్కింపును Divergence Theorem ఎలా సరళీకరిస్తుంది? A) ఇది vector field ను సమానమైన స్థిర scalar field తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. B) ఇది boundary surface integral ను, లోపల ఉన్న ప్రాంతంపై divergence యొక్క volume integral గా మారుస్తుంది. C) ఇది surface ను perimeter వెంబడి 1D line integral గా project చేస్తుంది. D) ఇది outward unit normal స్థిరంగా ఉన్న points వద్ద మాత్రమే evaluation ను పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the Divergence Theorem simplify the calculation of flux across a complicated closed surface? A) It replaces the vector field with an equivalent constant scalar field. B) It converts the boundary surface integral into a volume integral of divergence over the enclosed region. C) It projects the surface into a 1D line integral along the perimeter. D) It restricts evaluation to only the points where the outward unit normal is constant. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does machine learning fundamentally differ from traditional statistical analysis in terms of model creation? A) Statistics is restricted to small datasets, while machine learning is only for large data. B) Machine learning requires predefined, significant variables. C) Machine learning allows data to shape the model structure, whereas statistics often requires a priori model selection. D) Machine learning is purely algorithmic and never uses statistical principles. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Model సృష్టి విషయంలో machine learning సాంప్రదాయ statistical analysis నుండి ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Statistics చిన్న datasets కు మాత్రమే పరిమితం, machine learning కేవలం పెద్ద data కోసం మాత్రమే. B) Machine learning కు ముందే నిర్వచించిన, ముఖ్యమైన variables అవసరం. C) Machine learning లో data యే model structure ను రూపొందిస్తుంది, అయితే statistics లో తరచుగా a priori model selection అవసరం. D) Machine learning పూర్తిగా algorithmic, ఇది ఎప్పుడూ statistical principles ను ఉపయోగించదు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does machine learning fundamentally differ from traditional statistical analysis in terms of model creation? A) Statistics is restricted to small datasets, while machine learning is only for large data. B) Machine learning requires predefined, significant variables. C) Machine learning allows data to shape the model structure, whereas statistics often requires a priori model selection. D) Machine learning is purely algorithmic and never uses statistical principles. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to an FM signal if the received signal strength falls significantly below the noise threshold? A) The signal-to-noise ratio performance degrades rapidly compared to standard AM B) The signal-to-noise ratio improves drastically C) The receiver captures the signal perfectly D) The modulation index increases to compensate ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: అందుకున్న signal strength noise threshold కంటే చాలా తక్కువకు పడిపోతే FM signal కు ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Standard AM తో పోలిస్తే signal-to-noise ratio పనితీరు వేగంగా క్షీణిస్తుంది B) Signal-to-noise ratio గణనీయంగా మెరుగుపడుతుంది C) Receiver signal ను సంపూర్ణంగా పట్టుకుంటుంది D) భర్తీ చేయడానికి modulation index పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to an FM signal if the received signal strength falls significantly below the noise threshold? A) The signal-to-noise ratio performance degrades rapidly compared to standard AM B) The signal-to-noise ratio improves drastically C) The receiver captures the signal perfectly D) The modulation index increases to compensate ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a necessary condition for deadlock to occur in an operating system? A) Preemption B) Mutual exclusion C) Process scheduling D) Resource allocation ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Operating system లో deadlock జరగడానికి కింది వాటిలో ఏది అవసరమైన condition? A) Preemption B) Mutual exclusion C) Process scheduling D) Resource allocation జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a necessary condition for deadlock to occur in an operating system? A) Preemption B) Mutual exclusion C) Process scheduling D) Resource allocation ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a shift register, what determines when a bit moves from one flip-flop to the next? A) The presence of a buffer register B) The transition of the clock signal C) The size of the bit array D) The serial data input voltage ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక shift register లో ఒక bit ఒక flip-flop నుండి తదుపరి దానికి ఎప్పుడు కదులుతుందో ఏది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది? A) ఒక buffer register ఉండటం B) Clock signal యొక్క transition C) Bit array యొక్క పరిమాణం D) Serial data input voltage జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In a shift register, what determines when a bit moves from one flip-flop to the next? A) The presence of a buffer register B) The transition of the clock signal C) The size of the bit array D) The serial data input voltage ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a pseudovector field (such as the curl of a velocity field) behave under a spatial reflection map? A) It remains completely identical to a true vector B) It reverses sign relative to a true vector C) Its magnitude doubles D) It vanishes identically ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక spatial reflection map కింద pseudovector field (velocity field యొక్క curl వంటిది) ఎలా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది? A) ఇది true vector తో పూర్తిగా ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది B) True vector తో పోలిస్తే ఇది sign మార్చుకుంటుంది C) దీని magnitude రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది D) ఇది పూర్తిగా సున్నా అవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a pseudovector field (such as the curl of a velocity field) behave under a spatial reflection map? A) It remains completely identical to a true vector B) It reverses sign relative to a true vector C) Its magnitude doubles D) It vanishes identically ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Boolean satisfiability problem significant in the study of NP-completeness? A) It is the only problem in the class P B) It is the first problem proven to be NP-complete via the Cook-Levin theorem C) It is the only problem that is NP-complete D) It is a problem that requires only logarithmic space to solve ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: NP-completeness అధ్యయనంలో Boolean satisfiability problem ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైనది? A) ఇది class P లో ఉన్న ఏకైక problem B) Cook-Levin theorem ద్వారా NP-complete అని నిరూపించబడిన మొదటి problem ఇదే C) NP-complete అయిన ఏకైక problem ఇదే D) దీన్ని పరిష్కరించడానికి కేవలం logarithmic space మాత్రమే అవసరం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Boolean satisfiability problem significant in the study of NP-completeness? A) It is the only problem in the class P B) It is the first problem proven to be NP-complete via the Cook-Levin theorem C) It is the only problem that is NP-complete D) It is a problem that requires only logarithmic space to solve ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the equivalent circuit model of a real transformer, how is core loss typically represented? A) An inductor placed in series with the secondary winding B) A resistance connected in series with the primary winding C) A resistance connected in parallel across the induced EMF branch D) A variable capacitor placed across the load terminals ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక real transformer యొక్క equivalent circuit model లో core loss ను సాధారణంగా ఎలా సూచిస్తారు? A) Secondary winding తో series లో ఉంచిన ఒక inductor B) Primary winding తో series లో కనెక్ట్ చేసిన ఒక resistance C) Induced EMF branch కు parallel గా కనెక్ట్ చేసిన ఒక resistance D) Load terminals కు అడ్డంగా ఉంచిన ఒక variable capacitor జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In the equivalent circuit model of a real transformer, how is core loss typically represented? A) An inductor placed in series with the secondary winding B) A resistance connected in series with the primary winding C) A resistance connected in parallel across the induced EMF branch D) A variable capacitor placed across the load terminals ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which statement correctly describes a meromorphic function on an open domain in the complex plane? A) It must be bounded everywhere on the entire complex plane. B) It is holomorphic everywhere except at isolated poles. C) It contains at least one essential singularity within its domain. D) It cannot be represented by a Laurent series near its singularities. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex plane లోని ఒక open domain పై meromorphic function ను కింది వాటిలో ఏ వాక్యం సరిగ్గా వివరిస్తుంది? A) ఇది మొత్తం complex plane పై అన్ని చోట్లా bounded గా ఉండాలి. B) ఇది isolated poles వద్ద తప్ప అన్ని చోట్లా holomorphic గా ఉంటుంది. C) దీని domain లో కనీసం ఒక essential singularity ఉంటుంది. D) దీని singularities దగ్గర దీన్ని Laurent series ద్వారా సూచించలేము. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which statement correctly describes a meromorphic function on an open domain in the complex plane? A) It must be bounded everywhere on the entire complex plane. B) It is holomorphic everywhere except at isolated poles. C) It contains at least one essential singularity within its domain. D) It cannot be represented by a Laurent series near its singularities. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a clamping circuit differ from a clipping circuit? A) Clamping shifts the DC level while preserving peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping removes parts of the waveform B) Clamping only works with AC signals, while clipping only works with DC signals C) Clamping restricts peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping does not D) There is no difference; both terms describe the same electronic function ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Clamping circuit, clipping circuit నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Clamping peak-to-peak excursion ను మార్చకుండా DC level ను shift చేస్తుంది, అయితే clipping waveform లోని భాగాలను తొలగిస్తుంది B) Clamping కేవలం AC signals తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది, clipping కేవలం DC signals తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది C) Clamping peak-to-peak excursion ను పరిమితం చేస్తుంది, clipping చేయదు D) ఎలాంటి తేడా లేదు; రెండు పదాలు ఒకే electronic function ను వివరిస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does a clamping circuit differ from a clipping circuit? A) Clamping shifts the DC level while preserving peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping removes parts of the waveform B) Clamping only works with AC signals, while clipping only works with DC signals C) Clamping restricts peak-to-peak excursion, while clipping does not D) There is no difference; both terms describe the same electronic function ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is feature engineering a critical preprocessing step in supervised machine learning? A) It automates the selection of deep learning architectures for the given dataset B) It replaces the need for domain expertise by generating features algorithmically C) It transforms raw data into informative inputs that significantly enhance model predictive accuracy D) It reduces the dimensionality of the feature space by removing all redundant features ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Supervised machine learning లో feature engineering ఎందుకు ఒక కీలకమైన preprocessing step? A) ఇచ్చిన dataset కోసం deep learning architectures ఎంపికను ఇది స్వయంచాలకం చేస్తుంది B) Features ను algorithmic గా generate చేయడం ద్వారా domain expertise అవసరాన్ని ఇది తొలగిస్తుంది C) ఇది raw data ను model యొక్క predictive accuracy ని గణనీయంగా పెంచే సమాచారపూర్వక inputs గా మారుస్తుంది D) అన్ని redundant features ను తొలగించడం ద్వారా ఇది feature space యొక్క dimensionality ని తగ్గిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is feature engineering a critical preprocessing step in supervised machine learning? A) It automates the selection of deep learning architectures for the given dataset B) It replaces the need for domain expertise by generating features algorithmically C) It transforms raw data into informative inputs that significantly enhance model predictive accuracy D) It reduces the dimensionality of the feature space by removing all redundant features ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a potential drawback of fine-tuning a model on a new task? A) It can degrade the model's performance on the original task due to distribution shifts. B) It always increases the model's robustness to out-of-distribution data. C) It requires the model to be retrained from zero. D) It makes the model completely unable to perform the original task. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: కొత్త task పై ఒక model ను fine-tune చేయడం వల్ల కలిగే ఒక సంభావ్య లోపం ఏమిటి? A) Distribution shifts వల్ల అసలు task పై model పనితీరు తగ్గవచ్చు. B) ఇది out-of-distribution data కు model యొక్క robustness ను ఎప్పుడూ పెంచుతుంది. C) దీనికి model ను మొదటి నుండి మళ్ళీ train చేయాల్సి ఉంటుంది. D) ఇది model ను అసలు task చేయడానికి పూర్తిగా అసమర్థంగా చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is a potential drawback of fine-tuning a model on a new task? A) It can degrade the model's performance on the original task due to distribution shifts. B) It always increases the model's robustness to out-of-distribution data. C) It requires the model to be retrained from zero. D) It makes the model completely unable to perform the original task. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How do tension forces differ from shear forces regarding the alignment of the applied loads? A) Tension forces always cause sliding while shear forces always cause elongation. B) Tension forces are collinear while shear forces act along parallel planes. C) There is no difference in alignment, only in magnitude. D) Tension forces act on parallel planes while shear forces are collinear. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Applied loads యొక్క alignment విషయంలో tension forces మరియు shear forces ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటాయి? A) Tension forces ఎప్పుడూ sliding ను, shear forces ఎప్పుడూ elongation ను కలిగిస్తాయి. B) Tension forces collinear గా ఉంటాయి, shear forces parallel planes వెంబడి పనిచేస్తాయి. C) Alignment లో తేడా లేదు, magnitude లో మాత్రమే తేడా ఉంది. D) Tension forces parallel planes పై పనిచేస్తాయి, shear forces collinear గా ఉంటాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How do tension forces differ from shear forces regarding the alignment of the applied loads? A) Tension forces always cause sliding while shear forces always cause elongation. B) Tension forces are collinear while shear forces act along parallel planes. C) There is no difference in alignment, only in magnitude. D) Tension forces act on parallel planes while shear forces are collinear. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of using DCT in image compression? A) To convert images to analog format B) To transform spatial data into frequency components for efficient compression C) To increase image resolution D) To remove all image noise completely ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Image compression లో DCT ను ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Images ను analog format కి మార్చడానికి B) సమర్థవంతమైన compression కోసం spatial data ను frequency components గా transform చేయడానికి C) Image resolution ను పెంచడానికి D) Image noise మొత్తాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగించడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of using DCT in image compression? A) To convert images to analog format B) To transform spatial data into frequency components for efficient compression C) To increase image resolution D) To remove all image noise completely ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the false positive rate (FPR) when the true negative rate (TNR) of a diagnostic test increases? A) It becomes equal to the true positive rate. B) It increases proportionally with the true negative rate. C) It remains unaffected because FPR only depends on true positives. D) It decreases, because FPR equals 1 minus TNR. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక diagnostic test యొక్క true negative rate (TNR) పెరిగినప్పుడు false positive rate (FPR) కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) అది true positive rate కి సమానమవుతుంది. B) అది true negative rate తో పాటు అనుపాతంగా పెరుగుతుంది. C) FPR true positives పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడుతుంది కాబట్టి అది ప్రభావితం కాదు. D) FPR అంటే 1 minus TNR కాబట్టి అది తగ్గుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens to the false positive rate (FPR) when the true negative rate (TNR) of a diagnostic test increases? A) It becomes equal to the true positive rate. B) It increases proportionally with the true negative rate. C) It remains unaffected because FPR only depends on true positives. D) It decreases, because FPR equals 1 minus TNR. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a communication system, what is the primary role of a demultiplexer used alongside a multiplexer? A) To separate a single data stream back into its original component streams B) To combine multiple signals into one C) To increase the frequency of the input signal D) To select a single data source from many ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక communication system లో multiplexer తో పాటు వాడే demultiplexer యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) ఒకే data stream ను తిరిగి దాని అసలు component streams గా వేరు చేయడం B) అనేక signals ను ఒకటిగా కలపడం C) Input signal యొక్క frequency ను పెంచడం D) అనేక data sources నుండి ఒక దానిని ఎంచుకోవడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a communication system, what is the primary role of a demultiplexer used alongside a multiplexer? A) To separate a single data stream back into its original component streams B) To combine multiple signals into one C) To increase the frequency of the input signal D) To select a single data source from many ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does Occam's razor relate to the selection of a machine learning model? A) It suggests preferring simpler models over more complex ones when both fit equally well B) It mandates the use of the most complex model available C) It states that all models are equally probable D) It requires models to be trained on the largest possible dataset ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Machine learning model ఎంపికకు Occam's razor ఎలా సంబంధించినది? A) రెండూ సమానంగా fit అయినప్పుడు సంక్లిష్టమైన models కంటే సరళమైన models ను ఇష్టపడాలని అది సూచిస్తుంది B) అందుబాటులో ఉన్న అత్యంత సంక్లిష్టమైన model ను వాడాలని అది తప్పనిసరి చేస్తుంది C) అన్ని models సమానంగా probable అని అది చెబుతుంది D) Models ను సాధ్యమైనంత పెద్ద dataset పై train చేయాలని అది కోరుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does Occam's razor relate to the selection of a machine learning model? A) It suggests preferring simpler models over more complex ones when both fit equally well B) It mandates the use of the most complex model available C) It states that all models are equally probable D) It requires models to be trained on the largest possible dataset ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which logical form is most effectively synthesized using the programmable planes of a PLA? A) Sum of products B) Sequential state transitions C) Product of sums D) NAND-only logic ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: PLA యొక్క programmable planes ను ఉపయోగించి ఏ logical form ను అత్యంత సమర్థవంతంగా synthesize చేయవచ్చు? A) Sum of products B) Sequential state transitions C) Product of sums D) NAND-only logic జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which logical form is most effectively synthesized using the programmable planes of a PLA? A) Sum of products B) Sequential state transitions C) Product of sums D) NAND-only logic ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is batch normalization performed using mini-batch statistics during training instead of the entire dataset's statistics? A) Because it prevents the network from overfitting to the training data. B) Because the entire dataset's statistics are too large to store in memory. C) Because it allows the normalization to be differentiable and compatible with stochastic gradient descent. D) Because the entire dataset's statistics change too slowly during training. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Training సమయంలో batch normalization ను మొత్తం dataset statistics బదులు mini-batch statistics తో ఎందుకు చేస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది network training data కి overfit కాకుండా నిరోధిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే మొత్తం dataset statistics memory లో store చేయడానికి చాలా పెద్దవి. C) ఎందుకంటే అది normalization ను differentiable గా, stochastic gradient descent తో అనుకూలంగా ఉండేలా చేస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే training సమయంలో మొత్తం dataset statistics చాలా నెమ్మదిగా మారుతాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is batch normalization performed using mini-batch statistics during training instead of the entire dataset's statistics? A) Because it prevents the network from overfitting to the training data. B) Because the entire dataset's statistics are too large to store in memory. C) Because it allows the normalization to be differentiable and compatible with stochastic gradient descent. D) Because the entire dataset's statistics change too slowly during training. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of Test-Driven Development, what does a 'failing test' signify? A) The software requirements are poorly defined B) The test framework is incompatible with the production code C) The programmer wrote incorrect code D) The test is fulfilling its role by identifying a missing feature or bug ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Test-Driven Development సందర్భంలో 'failing test' దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది? A) Software requirements సరిగ్గా నిర్వచించబడలేదు B) Test framework production code తో అనుకూలంగా లేదు C) Programmer తప్పు code రాశాడు D) లేని feature ను లేదా bug ను గుర్తించడం ద్వారా test తన పాత్రను నెరవేరుస్తోంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of Test-Driven Development, what does a 'failing test' signify? A) The software requirements are poorly defined B) The test framework is incompatible with the production code C) The programmer wrote incorrect code D) The test is fulfilling its role by identifying a missing feature or bug ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition can the superposition principle be applied to analyze a physical system? A) The governing equations of the system must be strictly linear B) The system must operate at zero absolute temperature C) The stimulus must consist of a single frequency sinusoid D) The system output must be inversely proportional to the input ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో ఒక physical system ను analyze చేయడానికి superposition principle ను apply చేయవచ్చు? A) System యొక్క governing equations ఖచ్చితంగా linear గా ఉండాలి B) System zero absolute temperature వద్ద పనిచేయాలి C) Stimulus ఒకే frequency sinusoid గా ఉండాలి D) System output input కి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉండాలి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under what condition can the superposition principle be applied to analyze a physical system? A) The governing equations of the system must be strictly linear B) The system must operate at zero absolute temperature C) The stimulus must consist of a single frequency sinusoid D) The system output must be inversely proportional to the input ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the performance of a hash table generally deteriorate as the load factor increases? A) Because memory addresses become fragmented B) Because the hash function becomes less accurate C) Because collisions become more frequent, requiring more work to resolve D) Because the computer cannot process large integer values ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Load factor పెరిగే కొద్దీ hash table పనితీరు సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు దిగజారుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే memory addresses fragmented అవుతాయి B) ఎందుకంటే hash function తక్కువ ఖచ్చితంగా అవుతుంది C) ఎందుకంటే collisions ఎక్కువగా జరుగుతాయి, వాటిని పరిష్కరించడానికి ఎక్కువ పని అవసరం D) ఎందుకంటే computer పెద్ద integer values ను process చేయలేదు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does the performance of a hash table generally deteriorate as the load factor increases? A) Because memory addresses become fragmented B) Because the hash function becomes less accurate C) Because collisions become more frequent, requiring more work to resolve D) Because the computer cannot process large integer values ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What primarily causes truncation error when solving an equation with an iterative algorithm? A) Choosing an ill-conditioned formulation of the physical model. B) Hardware limitations that store real numbers with a fixed bit length. C) Replacing a continuous geometric area with finite discrete intervals. D) Halting the process after a finite number of iterations instead of running infinitely. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Iterative algorithm తో ఒక equation ను solve చేసేటప్పుడు truncation error కి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Physical model కి ill-conditioned formulation ను ఎంచుకోవడం. B) Real numbers ను fixed bit length తో store చేసే hardware పరిమితులు. C) నిరంతర geometric area ను finite discrete intervals తో భర్తీ చేయడం. D) Infinite గా నడపకుండా finite సంఖ్యలో iterations తర్వాత process ను ఆపడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What primarily causes truncation error when solving an equation with an iterative algorithm? A) Choosing an ill-conditioned formulation of the physical model. B) Hardware limitations that store real numbers with a fixed bit length. C) Replacing a continuous geometric area with finite discrete intervals. D) Halting the process after a finite number of iterations instead of running infinitely. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of two's complement over one's complement regarding the representation of zero? A) One's complement has only one zero B) Two's complement has only one representation for zero C) Two's complement has two zeros D) One's complement is used for unsigned numbers ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Zero యొక్క representation విషయంలో one's complement కంటే two's complement యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) One's complement లో ఒకే zero ఉంటుంది B) Two's complement లో zero కి ఒకే representation ఉంటుంది C) Two's complement లో రెండు zeros ఉంటాయి D) One's complement ను unsigned numbers కోసం వాడతారు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of two's complement over one's complement regarding the representation of zero? A) One's complement has only one zero B) Two's complement has only one representation for zero C) Two's complement has two zeros D) One's complement is used for unsigned numbers ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is static polymorphism typically faster than dynamic polymorphism? A) It resolves implementations at compile time with no runtime overhead. B) It allows for duck typing. C) It requires virtual function tables. D) It is only used in dynamically typed languages. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Static polymorphism సాధారణంగా dynamic polymorphism కంటే ఎందుకు వేగంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అది runtime overhead లేకుండా compile time లోనే implementations ను resolve చేస్తుంది. B) అది duck typing ను అనుమతిస్తుంది. C) దానికి virtual function tables అవసరం. D) అది dynamically typed languages లో మాత్రమే వాడబడుతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is static polymorphism typically faster than dynamic polymorphism? A) It resolves implementations at compile time with no runtime overhead. B) It allows for duck typing. C) It requires virtual function tables. D) It is only used in dynamically typed languages. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary limitation of a digital signature scheme in preventing replay attacks? A) It requires a physical signature B) It cannot verify the identity of the sender C) It is too slow for real-time transactions D) It cannot prevent a valid signed message from being reused ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Replay attacks ను నిరోధించడంలో digital signature scheme యొక్క ప్రధాన పరిమితి ఏమిటి? A) దానికి physical signature అవసరం B) అది sender identity ని verify చేయలేదు C) Real-time transactions కి అది చాలా నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటుంది D) సరైన signed message ను మళ్లీ వాడకుండా అది నిరోధించలేదు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary limitation of a digital signature scheme in preventing replay attacks? A) It requires a physical signature B) It cannot verify the identity of the sender C) It is too slow for real-time transactions D) It cannot prevent a valid signed message from being reused ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the 'Dying ReLU' problem considered a significant issue in training deep neural networks? A) It causes the output to explode to infinity B) It makes the network non-differentiable at all points C) It results in neurons that stop outputting non-zero values, blocking all gradient flow D) It forces the network to become zero-centered unnecessarily ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Deep neural networks ను train చేయడంలో 'Dying ReLU' problem ను ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైన సమస్యగా భావిస్తారు? A) అది output ను infinity కి explode చేస్తుంది B) అది network ను అన్ని points వద్ద non-differentiable చేస్తుంది C) దాని వల్ల neurons non-zero values ను output చేయడం ఆపేస్తాయి, మొత్తం gradient flow ఆగిపోతుంది D) అది అనవసరంగా network ను zero-centered గా మారేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the 'Dying ReLU' problem considered a significant issue in training deep neural networks? A) It causes the output to explode to infinity B) It makes the network non-differentiable at all points C) It results in neurons that stop outputting non-zero values, blocking all gradient flow D) It forces the network to become zero-centered unnecessarily ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What occurs when a MOD-10 counter reaches its maximum count of 9 and receives another clock pulse? A) The counter enters an error state. B) The counter resets to zero via rollover. C) The counter transitions to a Gray code state. D) The counter stops incrementing. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: MOD-10 counter తన maximum count 9 కి చేరి, మరొక clock pulse అందుకున్నప్పుడు ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Counter ఒక error state లోకి వెళ్తుంది. B) Rollover ద్వారా counter zero కి reset అవుతుంది. C) Counter ఒక Gray code state కి మారుతుంది. D) Counter increment అవ్వడం ఆగిపోతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What occurs when a MOD-10 counter reaches its maximum count of 9 and receives another clock pulse? A) The counter enters an error state. B) The counter resets to zero via rollover. C) The counter transitions to a Gray code state. D) The counter stops incrementing. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of time-series analysis, what does a normalized cross-correlation value of -1 indicate? A) The signals are perfectly identical in magnitude and phase B) A strong positive relationship between the signals C) A complete absence of any statistical relationship D) Perfect anti-correlation between the two signals ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Time-series analysis సందర్భంలో normalized cross-correlation value -1 దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది? A) Signals magnitude మరియు phase లో పూర్తిగా ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయి B) Signals మధ్య బలమైన positive సంబంధం C) ఎలాంటి statistical సంబంధం పూర్తిగా లేకపోవడం D) రెండు signals మధ్య perfect anti-correlation జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of time-series analysis, what does a normalized cross-correlation value of -1 indicate? A) The signals are perfectly identical in magnitude and phase B) A strong positive relationship between the signals C) A complete absence of any statistical relationship D) Perfect anti-correlation between the two signals ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a boosting algorithm primarily improve the overall accuracy of its final strong learner? A) By training all weak learners in parallel to reduce computation time. B) By sequentially training new weak learners to focus on correcting the errors of previous ones. C) By randomly sampling training data for each weak learner independently. D) By using a single highly complex weak learner instead of multiple simple ones. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Boosting algorithm తన final strong learner యొక్క మొత్తం accuracy ని ప్రధానంగా ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) Computation time తగ్గించడానికి అన్ని weak learners ను parallel గా train చేయడం ద్వారా. B) మునుపటి వాటి errors ను సరిదిద్దడంపై దృష్టి పెట్టేలా కొత్త weak learners ను వరుసగా train చేయడం ద్వారా. C) ప్రతి weak learner కి training data ను స్వతంత్రంగా random గా sample చేయడం ద్వారా. D) అనేక సరళమైన వాటి బదులు ఒకే అత్యంత సంక్లిష్టమైన weak learner ను వాడడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a boosting algorithm primarily improve the overall accuracy of its final strong learner? A) By training all weak learners in parallel to reduce computation time. B) By sequentially training new weak learners to focus on correcting the errors of previous ones. C) By randomly sampling training data for each weak learner independently. D) By using a single highly complex weak learner instead of multiple simple ones. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary consequence of adding an emitter degeneration resistor to a common-emitter amplifier? A) Increased bandwidth and higher output impedance. B) Increased voltage gain and higher input impedance. C) Zero voltage gain and maximum current gain. D) Decreased voltage gain and improved stability. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Common-emitter amplifier కి emitter degeneration resistor ను జోడించడం వల్ల వచ్చే ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Bandwidth పెరుగుతుంది మరియు output impedance ఎక్కువ అవుతుంది. B) Voltage gain పెరుగుతుంది మరియు input impedance ఎక్కువ అవుతుంది. C) Voltage gain zero, current gain గరిష్ఠం అవుతాయి. D) Voltage gain తగ్గుతుంది మరియు stability మెరుగవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a primary consequence of adding an emitter degeneration resistor to a common-emitter amplifier? A) Increased bandwidth and higher output impedance. B) Increased voltage gain and higher input impedance. C) Zero voltage gain and maximum current gain. D) Decreased voltage gain and improved stability. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of mutual exclusion in concurrent systems? A) To maximize the speed of all threads by running them in parallel. B) To schedule threads based on their priority levels. C) To ensure that only one thread accesses a shared resource at a time to prevent race conditions. D) To allow multiple threads to read and write to shared memory simultaneously. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Concurrent systems లో mutual exclusion యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) అన్ని threads ను parallel గా నడిపి వాటి వేగాన్ని గరిష్ఠం చేయడం. B) Threads ను వాటి priority levels ఆధారంగా schedule చేయడం. C) Race conditions ను నివారించడానికి ఒక సమయంలో ఒకే thread shared resource ను access చేసేలా చూడడం. D) అనేక threads ఒకేసారి shared memory కి read, write చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of mutual exclusion in concurrent systems? A) To maximize the speed of all threads by running them in parallel. B) To schedule threads based on their priority levels. C) To ensure that only one thread accesses a shared resource at a time to prevent race conditions. D) To allow multiple threads to read and write to shared memory simultaneously. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a hysteresis motor produce torque when the rotor is below synchronous speed? A) The magnetic field in the rotor lags behind the stator field due to magnetic hysteresis. B) The rotor is driven by external direct current through slip rings. C) The air gap reluctance is minimized through high-speed rotation. D) The rotor poles align perfectly with the stator poles at all speeds. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Rotor synchronous speed కంటే తక్కువలో ఉన్నప్పుడు hysteresis motor torque ను ఎందుకు ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది? A) Magnetic hysteresis వల్ల rotor లోని magnetic field stator field కంటే వెనుకబడి ఉంటుంది. B) Slip rings ద్వారా బయటి direct current తో rotor నడుస్తుంది. C) High-speed rotation ద్వారా air gap reluctance కనిష్ఠం అవుతుంది. D) అన్ని speeds వద్ద rotor poles stator poles తో పూర్తిగా align అవుతాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why does a hysteresis motor produce torque when the rotor is below synchronous speed? A) The magnetic field in the rotor lags behind the stator field due to magnetic hysteresis. B) The rotor is driven by external direct current through slip rings. C) The air gap reluctance is minimized through high-speed rotation. D) The rotor poles align perfectly with the stator poles at all speeds. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a periodic function is purely real and even, how do its Fourier coefficients behave in standard trigonometric form? A) The fundamental frequency doubles and the constant term vanishes B) All sine coefficients (b_n) vanish, leaving only cosine terms and the constant term C) All cosine coefficients (a_n) vanish, leaving only odd harmonics of sine D) The complex exponential coefficients become purely imaginary ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక periodic function పూర్తిగా real మరియు even అయితే, standard trigonometric form లో దాని Fourier coefficients ఎలా ప్రవర్తిస్తాయి? A) Fundamental frequency రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది, constant term అదృశ్యమవుతుంది B) అన్ని sine coefficients (b_n) అదృశ్యమవుతాయి, cosine terms మరియు constant term మాత్రమే మిగులుతాయి C) అన్ని cosine coefficients (a_n) అదృశ్యమవుతాయి, sine యొక్క odd harmonics మాత్రమే మిగులుతాయి D) Complex exponential coefficients పూర్తిగా imaginary అవుతాయి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a periodic function is purely real and even, how do its Fourier coefficients behave in standard trigonometric form? A) The fundamental frequency doubles and the constant term vanishes B) All sine coefficients (b_n) vanish, leaving only cosine terms and the constant term C) All cosine coefficients (a_n) vanish, leaving only odd harmonics of sine D) The complex exponential coefficients become purely imaginary ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does early stopping act as a form of regularization? A) By increasing the complexity of the model architecture B) By reducing the learning rate over time C) By stopping the training process before the model begins to overfit D) By adding a penalty term to the loss function ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Early stopping ఒక రకమైన regularization గా ఎలా పనిచేస్తుంది? A) Model architecture యొక్క complexity ని పెంచడం ద్వారా B) కాలక్రమేణా learning rate ను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా C) Model overfit అవ్వడం ప్రారంభించే ముందే training process ను ఆపడం ద్వారా D) Loss function కి ఒక penalty term ను జోడించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does early stopping act as a form of regularization? A) By increasing the complexity of the model architecture B) By reducing the learning rate over time C) By stopping the training process before the model begins to overfit D) By adding a penalty term to the loss function ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary characteristic that distinguishes a mid-tread quantizer from a mid-riser quantizer? A) The mid-tread quantizer is exclusively used for non-linear quantization. B) The mid-tread quantizer has a zero-valued reconstruction level. C) The mid-tread quantizer has a non-zero output for zero input. D) The mid-tread quantizer does not introduce any quantization noise. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Mid-tread quantizer ను mid-riser quantizer నుండి వేరు చేసే ప్రధాన లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Mid-tread quantizer ను non-linear quantization కోసం మాత్రమే వాడతారు. B) Mid-tread quantizer కి zero-valued reconstruction level ఉంటుంది. C) Mid-tread quantizer zero input కి non-zero output ఇస్తుంది. D) Mid-tread quantizer ఎలాంటి quantization noise ను కలిగించదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary characteristic that distinguishes a mid-tread quantizer from a mid-riser quantizer? A) The mid-tread quantizer is exclusively used for non-linear quantization. B) The mid-tread quantizer has a zero-valued reconstruction level. C) The mid-tread quantizer has a non-zero output for zero input. input: to Telugu: Q: How does a photon generated by stimulated emission compare to the incident photon triggering it? A) Higher in frequency but matching in phase B) Identical in frequency, phase, polarization, and direction C) Opposite in phase due to energy conservation D) Identical in energy but emitted in a random spatial direction ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Stimulated emission ద్వారా ఉత్పత్తైన photon, దానిని ప్రేరేపించిన incident photon తో పోలిస్తే ఎలా ఉంటుంది? A) Frequency లో ఎక్కువ కానీ phase లో సరిపోలుతుంది B) Frequency, phase, polarization మరియు direction లో ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) Energy conservation వల్ల phase లో వ్యతిరేకంగా ఉంటుంది D) Energy లో ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది కానీ random spatial direction లో emit అవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a photon generated by stimulated emission compare to the incident photon triggering it? A) Higher in frequency but matching in phase B) Identical in frequency, phase, polarization, and direction C) Opposite in phase due to energy conservation D) Identical in energy but emitted in a random spatial direction ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the programmability of a PLA differ from that of a PAL? A) PLA has programmable AND gates only B) PLA has fixed AND gates and programmable OR gates C) Both devices have fixed OR gates D) PLA has programmable AND and OR gates ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: PLA యొక్క programmability PAL దాని నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) PLA లో programmable AND gates మాత్రమే ఉంటాయి B) PLA లో fixed AND gates మరియు programmable OR gates ఉంటాయి C) రెండు devices లోనూ fixed OR gates ఉంటాయి D) PLA లో programmable AND మరియు OR gates ఉంటాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does the programmability of a PLA differ from that of a PAL? A) PLA has programmable AND gates only B) PLA has fixed AND gates and programmable OR gates C) Both devices have fixed OR gates D) PLA has programmable AND and OR gates ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens if a user attempts to 'pop' an element from an empty stack? A) An underflow condition occurs B) The stack pointer resets to zero C) The last element is returned automatically D) The program terminates immediately ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఖాళీ stack నుండి ఒక element ను 'pop' చేయడానికి user ప్రయత్నిస్తే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Underflow condition ఏర్పడుతుంది B) Stack pointer zero కి reset అవుతుంది C) చివరి element స్వయంచాలకంగా return అవుతుంది D) Program వెంటనే terminate అవుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens if a user attempts to 'pop' an element from an empty stack? A) An underflow condition occurs B) The stack pointer resets to zero C) The last element is returned automatically D) The program terminates immediately ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a cloud service experiences downtime, why might a customer still be responsible for the loss, according to standard cloud SLAs? A) The provider is only liable if the outage lasts longer than a week. B) The customer is legally required to fix all provider-side network issues. C) Cloud providers are legally exempt from all forms of liability. D) SLAs often exclude downtimes caused by external factors like network issues or user misconfigurations. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక cloud service కి downtime వస్తే, standard cloud SLAs ప్రకారం నష్టానికి customer ఇంకా ఎందుకు బాధ్యుడు కావచ్చు? A) Outage ఒక వారం కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉంటేనే provider బాధ్యుడు. B) Provider వైపు ఉన్న అన్ని network issues ను customer చట్టపరంగా సరిచేయాలి. C) Cloud providers కి అన్ని రకాల liability నుండి చట్టపరమైన మినహాయింపు ఉంది. D) Network issues లేదా user misconfigurations వంటి బయటి కారణాల వల్ల వచ్చే downtimes ను SLAs తరచుగా మినహాయిస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a cloud service experiences downtime, why might a customer still be responsible for the loss, according to standard cloud SLAs? A) The provider is only liable if the outage lasts longer than a week. B) The customer is legally required to fix all provider-side network issues. C) Cloud providers are legally exempt from all forms of liability. D) SLAs often exclude downtimes caused by external factors like network issues or user misconfigurations. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is an anti-aliasing filter used before sampling a signal? A) To remove high-frequency components above the Nyquist frequency B) To increase the sample rate C) To amplify the signal D) To convert analog to digital ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Signal ను sample చేసే ముందు anti-aliasing filter ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) Nyquist frequency కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉన్న high-frequency components ను తొలగించడానికి B) Sample rate ను పెంచడానికి C) Signal ను amplify చేయడానికి D) Analog ను digital కి మార్చడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is an anti-aliasing filter used before sampling a signal? A) To remove high-frequency components above the Nyquist frequency B) To increase the sample rate C) To amplify the signal D) To convert analog to digital ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key limitation or criticism associated with the use of stereotyping in UML? A) It is considered insufficient and untenable for extending the metamodel B) It requires knowledge of the Object Constraint Language to implement C) It prevents the use of class diagrams in the design process D) It can only be applied to behavioral diagrams, not structural ones ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: UML లో stereotyping వాడకానికి సంబంధించిన ఒక ముఖ్య పరిమితి లేదా విమర్శ ఏమిటి? A) Metamodel ను extend చేయడానికి అది సరిపోనిదిగా, నిలబడలేనిదిగా పరిగణించబడుతుంది B) దానిని implement చేయడానికి Object Constraint Language జ్ఞానం అవసరం C) Design process లో class diagrams వాడకాన్ని అది నిరోధిస్తుంది D) దానిని behavioral diagrams కి మాత్రమే apply చేయగలం, structural వాటికి కాదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is a key limitation or criticism associated with the use of stereotyping in UML? A) It is considered insufficient and untenable for extending the metamodel B) It requires knowledge of the Object Constraint Language to implement C) It prevents the use of class diagrams in the design process D) It can only be applied to behavioral diagrams, not structural ones ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does an asynchronous IPC mechanism differ from a synchronous one? A) Asynchronous IPC requires the sender to block until the receiver acknowledges. B) Asynchronous IPC cannot use synchronization primitives. C) Asynchronous IPC allows the sender to continue execution immediately after sending. D) Asynchronous IPC only works on microkernels. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Asynchronous IPC mechanism synchronous దాని నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Asynchronous IPC లో receiver acknowledge చేసే వరకు sender block అవ్వాలి. B) Asynchronous IPC synchronization primitives ను వాడలేదు. C) Asynchronous IPC లో పంపిన వెంటనే sender execution ను కొనసాగించవచ్చు. D) Asynchronous IPC microkernels పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does an asynchronous IPC mechanism differ from a synchronous one? A) Asynchronous IPC requires the sender to block until the receiver acknowledges. B) Asynchronous IPC cannot use synchronization primitives. C) Asynchronous IPC allows the sender to continue execution immediately after sending. D) Asynchronous IPC only works on microkernels. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a vector field $\mathbf{F}$ satisfies $\nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}$ everywhere across an open surface $S$ bounded by a closed curve $C$, what is the circulation $\oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$? A) 0 B) Equal to the surface area of $S$ C) Dependent on the specific choice of path $C$ D) Infinite ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక closed curve $C$ తో bounded అయిన open surface $S$ అంతటా ఒక vector field $\mathbf{F}$ ప్రతిచోటా $\nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}$ ను satisfy చేస్తే, circulation $\oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$ ఎంత? A) 0 B) $S$ యొక్క surface area కి సమానం C) Path $C$ యొక్క నిర్దిష్ట ఎంపికపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది D) Infinite జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If a vector field $\mathbf{F}$ satisfies $\nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}$ everywhere across an open surface $S$ bounded by a closed curve $C$, what is the circulation $\oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}$? A) 0 B) Equal to the surface area of $S$ C) Dependent on the specific choice of path $C$ D) Infinite ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the depletion region width when an external forward bias is applied across a p-n junction? A) It remains unchanged because fixed donor and acceptor ions cannot move in the lattice. B) It decreases as mobile carriers are pushed into the junction, opposing the built-in potential. C) It immediately expands to the physical boundaries of the semiconductor chip. D) It increases due to the attraction of majority carriers away from the metallurgical interface. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: p-n junction అంతటా బయటి forward bias ను apply చేసినప్పుడు depletion region width కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Fixed donor మరియు acceptor ions lattice లో కదలలేవు కాబట్టి అది మారదు. B) Mobile carriers junction లోకి నెట్టబడి built-in potential ను వ్యతిరేకించడంతో అది తగ్గుతుంది. C) అది వెంటనే semiconductor chip యొక్క భౌతిక సరిహద్దుల వరకు విస్తరిస్తుంది. D) Majority carriers metallurgical interface నుండి దూరంగా ఆకర్షించబడడం వల్ల అది పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the depletion region width when an external forward bias is applied across a p-n junction? A) It remains unchanged because fixed donor and acceptor ions cannot move in the lattice. B) It decreases as mobile carriers are pushed into the junction, opposing the built-in potential. C) It immediately expands to the physical boundaries of the semiconductor chip. D) It increases due to the attraction of majority carriers away from the metallurgical interface. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under standard conditions with a simple root, what does quadratic convergence imply about the error at step n? A) The number of correct significant digits roughly doubles with each step B) The error decreases linearly with the total number of iterations C) The error decreases by exactly 50 percent each step D) The execution time scales quadratically with matrix dimension ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Simple root తో standard conditions లో, quadratic convergence step n వద్ద error గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) ప్రతి step తో సరైన significant digits సంఖ్య దాదాపు రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది B) మొత్తం iterations సంఖ్యతో error linear గా తగ్గుతుంది C) ప్రతి step లో error సరిగ్గా 50 percent తగ్గుతుంది D) Execution time matrix dimension తో quadratic గా పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under standard conditions with a simple root, what does quadratic convergence imply about the error at step n? A) The number of correct significant digits roughly doubles with each step B) The error decreases linearly with the total number of iterations C) The error decreases by exactly 50 percent each step D) The execution time scales quadratically with matrix dimension ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the complex conjugate of current (I*) used in the complex power formula S = V · I*? A) To ensure inductive loads with lagging current yield a positive reactive power Q B) Because current cannot be expressed directly as a phasor C) To invert the phase of voltage relative to the reference bus D) To prevent the apparent power from becoming an imaginary number ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex power formula S = V · I* లో current యొక్క complex conjugate (I*) ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) Lagging current ఉన్న inductive loads positive reactive power Q ఇచ్చేలా చూడడానికి B) Current ను నేరుగా phasor గా వ్యక్తపరచలేము కాబట్టి C) Reference bus తో పోలిస్తే voltage phase ను invert చేయడానికి D) Apparent power imaginary number కాకుండా నిరోధించడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the complex conjugate of current (I*) used in the complex power formula S = V · I*? A) To ensure inductive loads with lagging current yield a positive reactive power Q B) Because current cannot be expressed directly as a phasor C) To invert the phase of voltage relative to the reference bus D) To prevent the apparent power from becoming an imaginary number ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what circumstances is underground transmission by high-voltage cables preferred over overhead lines? A) In crowded urban areas or for high-voltage direct-current submarine connections. B) When using mechanical power transmission systems. C) When transmitting power over the shortest possible distances. D) When the power being transmitted is thermal rather than electrical. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితుల్లో overhead lines కంటే high-voltage cables ద్వారా underground transmission ను ఇష్టపడతారు? A) రద్దీగా ఉండే urban areas లో లేదా high-voltage direct-current submarine connections కోసం. B) Mechanical power transmission systems ను వాడినప్పుడు. C) సాధ్యమైనంత తక్కువ దూరాలకు power ను transmit చేసినప్పుడు. D) Transmit అవుతున్న power electrical కాకుండా thermal అయినప్పుడు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under what circumstances is underground transmission by high-voltage cables preferred over overhead lines? A) In crowded urban areas or for high-voltage direct-current submarine connections. B) When using mechanical power transmission systems. C) When transmitting power over the shortest possible distances. D) When the power being transmitted is thermal rather than electrical. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a primary benefit of performing logic optimization on a circuit? A) It converts combinational logic into sequential logic B) It removes the need for Boolean algebra C) It makes the circuit smaller and easier to build or analyze D) It allows the circuit to function without any inputs ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక circuit పై logic optimization చేయడం వల్ల కలిగే ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం కింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) అది combinational logic ను sequential logic గా మారుస్తుంది B) అది Boolean algebra అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది C) అది circuit ను చిన్నదిగా, build లేదా analyze చేయడానికి సులభంగా చేస్తుంది D) ఎలాంటి inputs లేకుండా circuit పనిచేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a primary benefit of performing logic optimization on a circuit? A) It converts combinational logic into sequential logic B) It removes the need for Boolean algebra C) It makes the circuit smaller and easier to build or analyze D) It allows the circuit to function without any inputs ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which statement best describes the role of optimal substructure in an algorithm? A) It eliminates the need for any base case B) It guarantees the algorithm is the fastest possible C) It ensures the global solution is built from optimal sub-solutions D) It means the problem cannot be solved recursively ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక algorithm లో optimal substructure పాత్రను ఏ statement బాగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) అది ఏ base case అవసరాన్నైనా తొలగిస్తుంది B) Algorithm సాధ్యమైనంత వేగవంతమైనదని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది C) Global solution optimal sub-solutions నుండి నిర్మించబడేలా అది చూస్తుంది D) Problem ను recursively solve చేయలేమని దాని అర్థం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which statement best describes the role of optimal substructure in an algorithm? A) It eliminates the need for any base case B) It guarantees the algorithm is the fastest possible C) It ensures the global solution is built from optimal sub-solutions D) It means the problem cannot be solved recursively ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the relationship between a DFA and an NFA? A) A DFA is a special case of an NFA where each transition is unique. B) DFAs and NFAs are completely unrelated models. C) An NFA is a special case of a DFA with additional epsilon moves. D) DFAs and NFAs recognize different classes of languages, with DFAs recognizing more. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: DFA మరియు NFA మధ్య సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) DFA అనేది ప్రతి transition unique గా ఉండే NFA యొక్క ప్రత్యేక సందర్భం. B) DFAs మరియు NFAs పూర్తిగా సంబంధం లేని models. C) NFA అనేది అదనపు epsilon moves ఉన్న DFA యొక్క ప్రత్యేక సందర్భం. D) DFAs మరియు NFAs వేర్వేరు classes of languages ను గుర్తిస్తాయి, DFAs ఎక్కువ వాటిని గుర్తిస్తాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the relationship between a DFA and an NFA? A) A DFA is a special case of an NFA where each transition is unique. B) DFAs and NFAs are completely unrelated models. C) An NFA is a special case of a DFA with additional epsilon moves. D) DFAs and NFAs recognize different classes of languages, with DFAs recognizing more. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a routine EEG comes back normal in a patient suspected of having epilepsy, what is the most scientifically accurate conclusion? A) The patient definitely does not have epilepsy. B) The patient should be immediately scheduled for brain surgery. C) The electrodes were placed incorrectly, requiring a repeat of the test. input: to Telugu: Q: What role does the totient function play in RSA key generation? A) It is used to compute the private exponent d B) It is used to select the public exponent e C) It is used to generate the prime numbers p and q D) It is used to encrypt the message directly ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the result of dereferencing a pointer that currently contains the address of an integer variable? A) It returns the memory address of the next variable in the stack. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ప్రస్తుతం ఒక integer variable యొక్క address ను కలిగి ఉన్న pointer ను dereference చేస్తే ఫలితం ఏమిటి? A) అది stack లోని తర్వాతి variable యొక్క memory address ను return చేస్తుంది. B) అది ఆ నిర్దిష్ట address వద్ద store అయిన అసలు integer value ను తెస్తుంది. C) అది pointer లోని address ను null ని point చేసేలా మారుస్తుంది. target_en: Q: What is the result of dereferencing a pointer that currently contains the address of an integer variable? A) It returns the memory address of the next variable in the stack. B) It retrieves the actual integer value stored at that specific address. C) It modifies the address held by the pointer to point to null. D) It deletes the variable located at that address. ANSWER: B

B) ఎందుకంటే అది అసలు dimensions బదులు abstract symbols ను వాడుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే forces ను స్పష్టంగా చూపడానికి diagram body యొక్క అసలు size ను మినహాయించాలి. target: ప్రశ్న: I2C bus lines కోసం pull-up resistors తో open-drain design ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) Bus పై idle devices యొక్క power consumption ను తగ్గించడానికి. B) Bus maximum speed ను 1 Mbit/s కంటే ఎక్కువకు పెంచడానికి. C) Data మరియు clock signals కి ఒకే wire వాడడానికి వీలుగా. D) Short circuits కలగకుండా అనేక nodes సురక్షితంగా connect అవ్వడానికి వీలుగా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is an open-drain design with pull-up resistors used for the I2C bus lines? A) To reduce the power consumption of idle devices on the bus. B) To increase the maximum speed of the bus beyond 1 Mbit/s. C) To enable the use of only a single wire for data and clock signals. D) To allow multiple nodes to safely connect without causing short circuits. ANSWER: D

A) భౌతికంగా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న దాని కంటే ఎక్కువ memory అవసరమైనా programs నడవడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది. B) అది CPU clock speed ను పెంచుతుంది. C) అది operating system అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. B) It increases the clock speed of the CPU. C) It eliminates the need for an operating system entirely. D) It makes the computer's hardware more physically durable. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What characterizes a system undergoing steady-state conduction? A) Heat is transferred exclusively by radiation. B) The system is at thermal equilibrium with its surroundings. C) The temperature at every point in the system remains constant over time. D) The temperature difference across the system is constantly increasing. ANSWER: C

C) System లోని ప్రతి point వద్ద temperature కాలంతో పాటు స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. D) System అంతటా temperature difference నిరంతరం పెరుగుతూ ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What characterizes a system undergoing steady-state conduction? A) Heat is transferred exclusively by radiation. B) The system is at thermal equilibrium with its surroundings. C) The temperature at every point in the system remains constant over time. D) The temperature difference across the system is constantly increasing. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What mathematical relationship exists between the impulse response and the transfer function of an LTI system? A) Transfer function అనేది impulse response యొక్క integral B) Transfer function అనేది impulse response యొక్క Laplace transform C) Impulse response అనేది transfer function యొక్క Fourier transform D) Transfer function అనేది impulse response యొక్క time derivative జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What mathematical relationship exists between the impulse response and the transfer function of an LTI system? A) The transfer function is the integral of the impulse response B) The transfer function is the Laplace transform of the impulse response C) The impulse response is the Fourier transform of the transfer function D) The transfer function is the time derivative of the impulse response ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the strict channel capacity of a slow-fading channel considered to be zero? A) Because the transmitter has no knowledge of the channel state. target: ప్రశ్న: Slow-fading channel యొక్క strict channel capacity ని zero గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే transmitter కి channel state గురించి తెలియదు. B) ఎందుకంటే channel coherence time చాలా తక్కువ. C) ఎందుకంటే bandwidth కఠినంగా పరిమితం. D) ఎందుకంటే noise power అనంతంగా ఎక్కువ. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the strict channel capacity of a slow-fading channel considered to be zero? A) Because the transmitter has no knowledge of the channel state. B) Because the channel coherence time is too short. C) Because the bandwidth is strictly limited. D) Because the noise power is infinitely high. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the output of an LTI system calculated if the impulse response is known? input: to Telugu: Q: If a continuous audio signal containing frequencies up to 20 kHz is sampled at 32 kHz, what is the Nyquist frequency and will aliasing occur? A) 16 kHz, and aliasing will occur because the maximum signal frequency exceeds it B) 32 kHz, and no aliasing will occur because the rates match C) 64 kHz, and aliasing will occur due to oversampling D) 16 kHz, and no aliasing will occur because 32 kHz is standard ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: 20 kHz వరకు frequencies ఉన్న ఒక continuous audio signal ను 32 kHz వద్ద sample చేస్తే, Nyquist frequency ఎంత, aliasing జరుగుతుందా? A) 16 kHz, maximum signal frequency దానిని మించుతుంది కాబట్టి aliasing జరుగుతుంది B) 32 kHz, rates సరిపోలుతాయి కాబట్టి aliasing జరగదు C) 64 kHz, oversampling వల్ల aliasing జరుగుతుంది D) 16 kHz, 32 kHz standard కాబట్టి aliasing జరగదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If a continuous audio signal containing frequencies up to 20 kHz is sampled at 32 kHz, what is the Nyquist frequency and will aliasing occur? A) 16 kHz, and aliasing will occur because the maximum signal frequency exceeds it B) 32 kHz, and no aliasing will occur because the rates match C) 64 kHz, and aliasing will occur due to oversampling D) 16 kHz, and no aliasing will occur because 32 kHz is standard ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of applying regularization in regression models? A) To make the model more complex and flexible. target: ప్రశ్న: Regression models లో regularization ను apply చేయడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Model ను మరింత సంక్లిష్టంగా, flexible గా చేయడానికి. C) To reduce the model's variance at the cost of increasing bias. D) To eliminate all sources of bias in the model. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: When evaluating the real improper integral ∫_{-∞}^{∞} 1/(x^2 + 1) dx using a semicircular contour in the upper half-plane, which pole is enclosed? A) Neither, as poles lie on the real axis B) z = -i C) z = i D) Both z = i and z = -i ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: When evaluating the real improper integral ∫_{-∞}^{∞} 1/(x^2 + 1) dx using a semicircular contour in the upper half-plane, which pole is enclosed? A) Neither, as poles lie on the real axis B) z = -i C) z = i D) Both z = i and z = -i ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How can the steady-state frequency response of an RLC circuit be directly obtained from its transfer function H(s)? A) By evaluating H(s) along the imaginary axis by substituting s = jω. B) By computing the inverse Laplace transform and setting initial conditions to one. C) By finding the roots of the numerator polynomial and setting them to infinity. D) By setting s equal to zero and integrating over time. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: RLC circuit యొక్క steady-state frequency response ను దాని transfer function H(s) నుండి నేరుగా ఎలా పొందవచ్చు? A) s = jω ని substitute చేసి imaginary axis వెంబడి H(s) ను evaluate చేయడం ద్వారా. B) Inverse Laplace transform ను compute చేసి initial conditions ను one గా set చేయడం ద్వారా. C) Numerator polynomial యొక్క roots కనుగొని వాటిని infinity కి set చేయడం ద్వారా. D) s ను zero కి సమానం చేసి time పై integrate చేయడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How can the steady-state frequency response of an RLC circuit be directly obtained from its transfer function H(s)? A) By evaluating H(s) along the imaginary axis by substituting s = jω. B) By computing the inverse Laplace transform and setting initial conditions to one. C) By finding the roots of the numerator polynomial and setting them to infinity. D) By setting s equal to zero and integrating over time. ANSWER: A
