input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using self-excitation in a generator design? A) It converts AC output into DC output B) It eliminates the need for a commutator C) It makes the generator operate without a prime mover D) It allows the generator to produce more power by using its own output ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Generator design లో self-excitation ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది AC output ను DC output గా మారుస్తుంది B) అది commutator అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది C) అది prime mover లేకుండా generator పనిచేసేలా చేస్తుంది D) తన సొంత output ను వాడుకొని generator ఎక్కువ power ఉత్పత్తి చేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using self-excitation in a generator design? A) It converts AC output into DC output B) It eliminates the need for a commutator C) It makes the generator operate without a prime mover D) It allows the generator to produce more power by using its own output ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a processor recover from a control hazard when a branch instruction jumps to a new memory location? A) By flushing the pipeline to clear invalid instructions. B) By inserting NOPs until the branch completes. C) By executing the branch in-order with a delay. D) By using operand forwarding to bypass the branch. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Branch instruction ఒక కొత్త memory location కి jump చేసినప్పుడు processor control hazard నుండి ఎలా కోలుకుంటుంది? A) Invalid instructions ను తొలగించడానికి pipeline ను flush చేయడం ద్వారా. B) Branch పూర్తయ్యే వరకు NOPs ను insert చేయడం ద్వారా. C) Branch ను delay తో in-order గా execute చేయడం ద్వారా. D) Branch ను bypass చేయడానికి operand forwarding ను వాడడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does a processor recover from a control hazard when a branch instruction jumps to a new memory location? A) By flushing the pipeline to clear invalid instructions. B) By inserting NOPs until the branch completes. C) By executing the branch in-order with a delay. D) By using operand forwarding to bypass the branch. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FFT often utilized when performing discrete convolutions in digital signal processing? A) To ensure that all signals become complex-valued B) To convert time-domain signals into periodic summations C) To bypass the need for a Laplace transform D) To reduce the computational complexity from O(N^2) to O(N log N) ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital signal processing లో discrete convolutions చేసేటప్పుడు FFT ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) అన్ని signals complex-valued అయ్యేలా చూడడానికి B) Time-domain signals ను periodic summations గా మార్చడానికి C) Laplace transform అవసరాన్ని దాటవేయడానికి D) Computational complexity ని O(N^2) నుండి O(N log N) కి తగ్గించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the FFT often utilized when performing discrete convolutions in digital signal processing? A) To ensure that all signals become complex-valued B) To convert time-domain signals into periodic summations C) To bypass the need for a Laplace transform D) To reduce the computational complexity from O(N^2) to O(N log N) ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary goal of using ensemble methods instead of a single learning algorithm? A) To reduce the training time of the model B) To ensure every model is a strong learner C) To make the hypothesis space smaller D) To achieve better predictive performance through combination ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒకే learning algorithm బదులు ensemble methods ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి? A) Model training time ను తగ్గించడం B) ప్రతి model ఒక strong learner అయ్యేలా చూడడం C) Hypothesis space ను చిన్నదిగా చేయడం D) కలపడం ద్వారా మెరుగైన predictive performance ను సాధించడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary goal of using ensemble methods instead of a single learning algorithm? A) To reduce the training time of the model B) To ensure every model is a strong learner C) To make the hypothesis space smaller D) To achieve better predictive performance through combination ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition is a conductor strictly considered to obey Ohm's law? A) The material exhibits zero internal resistance across all operating temperatures. B) The current through the conductor remains entirely independent of the applied voltage. C) The ratio of voltage to current remains constant as the applied voltage varies. D) The current increases nonlinearly with electric field strength under high fields. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో ఒక conductor ఖచ్చితంగా Ohm's law ను పాటిస్తుందని పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అన్ని operating temperatures వద్ద పదార్థానికి zero internal resistance ఉంటుంది. B) Conductor గుండా వెళ్లే current applied voltage పై పూర్తిగా ఆధారపడదు. C) Applied voltage మారుతున్నప్పుడు voltage కి current కి ఉన్న ratio స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. D) High fields వద్ద electric field strength తో current nonlinear గా పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Under what condition is a conductor strictly considered to obey Ohm's law? A) The material exhibits zero internal resistance across all operating temperatures. B) The current through the conductor remains entirely independent of the applied voltage. C) The ratio of voltage to current remains constant as the applied voltage varies. D) The current increases nonlinearly with electric field strength under high fields. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is an IR designed to be independent of any particular source or target language? A) To make the compiler easier to write B) To ensure the IR is always human-readable C) To reduce the size of the final executable D) To allow the same IR to be used by many different source and target languages ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: IR ను ఏ నిర్దిష్ట source లేదా target language పైనా ఆధారపడకుండా ఎందుకు రూపొందిస్తారు? A) Compiler రాయడం సులభం చేయడానికి B) IR ఎప్పుడూ మనుషులు చదవగలిగేలా ఉండేలా చూడడానికి C) Final executable పరిమాణాన్ని తగ్గించడానికి D) ఒకే IR ను అనేక వేర్వేరు source మరియు target languages వాడడానికి వీలుగా జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is an IR designed to be independent of any particular source or target language? A) To make the compiler easier to write B) To ensure the IR is always human-readable C) To reduce the size of the final executable D) To allow the same IR to be used by many different source and target languages ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If a system uses 'incomplete' (partial) address decoding, what is the most likely result? A) The CPU cannot distinguish between RAM and I/O devices. B) The system becomes significantly faster than with complete decoding. C) The system cannot access any RAM above the first 64KB. D) A single hardware register may be accessible via multiple different memory addresses. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక system 'incomplete' (partial) address decoding ను వాడితే, అత్యంత సంభావ్య ఫలితం ఏమిటి? A) CPU RAM మరియు I/O devices మధ్య తేడాను గుర్తించలేదు. B) Complete decoding తో పోలిస్తే system గణనీయంగా వేగంగా అవుతుంది. C) System మొదటి 64KB పైన ఉన్న ఏ RAM నీ access చేయలేదు. D) ఒకే hardware register ను అనేక వేర్వేరు memory addresses ద్వారా access చేయవచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a system uses 'incomplete' (partial) address decoding, what is the most likely result? A) The CPU cannot distinguish between RAM and I/O devices. B) The system becomes significantly faster than with complete decoding. C) The system cannot access any RAM above the first 64KB. D) A single hardware register may be accessible via multiple different memory addresses. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a pulse oximeter, what primarily causes the AC component of the PPG signal? A) The light from the LED source B) The bulk absorption of skin tissue C) The light reflected from the photodiode D) The variation in blood volume due to the pressure pulse ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Pulse oximeter లో PPG signal యొక్క AC component కి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) LED source నుండి వచ్చే కాంతి B) Skin tissue యొక్క bulk absorption C) Photodiode నుండి reflect అయిన కాంతి D) Pressure pulse వల్ల blood volume లో వచ్చే మార్పు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In a pulse oximeter, what primarily causes the AC component of the PPG signal? A) The light from the LED source B) The bulk absorption of skin tissue C) The light reflected from the photodiode D) The variation in blood volume due to the pressure pulse ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the IDF value of a term that appears in almost every document in the corpus? A) It becomes very large. B) It becomes close to zero. C) It remains constant. D) It becomes negative. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Corpus లోని దాదాపు ప్రతి document లో కనిపించే term యొక్క IDF value కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) అది చాలా పెద్దదవుతుంది. B) అది zero కి దగ్గరవుతుంది. C) అది స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. D) అది negative అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the IDF value of a term that appears in almost every document in the corpus? A) It becomes very large. B) It becomes close to zero. C) It remains constant. D) It becomes negative. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why did the Faraday disk generator produce low power output compared to modern generators? A) It suffered from self-cancelling counterflows in the copper disc B) It generated alternating current instead of direct current C) It required an external excitation system to start D) It used permanent magnets instead of field coils ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఆధునిక generators తో పోలిస్తే Faraday disk generator తక్కువ power output ను ఎందుకు ఇచ్చింది? A) Copper disc లో self-cancelling counterflows సమస్య దానికి ఉంది B) అది direct current బదులు alternating current ను generate చేసింది C) Start అవ్వడానికి దానికి బయటి excitation system అవసరం D) అది field coils బదులు permanent magnets ను వాడింది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why did the Faraday disk generator produce low power output compared to modern generators? A) It suffered from self-cancelling counterflows in the copper disc B) It generated alternating current instead of direct current C) It required an external excitation system to start D) It used permanent magnets instead of field coils ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are tri-state outputs critical for a multidrop SPI bus configuration? A) They enable the daisy chain topology to function without external buffers B) They reduce the power consumption of the slave devices during idle periods C) They prevent electrical signal conflicts when multiple slaves share the MISO line D) They allow the master to change the clock polarity dynamically ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Multidrop SPI bus configuration కి tri-state outputs ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) బయటి buffers లేకుండా daisy chain topology పనిచేయడానికి అవి వీలు కల్పిస్తాయి B) Idle సమయాల్లో slave devices యొక్క power consumption ను అవి తగ్గిస్తాయి C) అనేక slaves MISO line ను పంచుకున్నప్పుడు electrical signal conflicts ను అవి నివారిస్తాయి D) Master clock polarity ని dynamic గా మార్చడానికి అవి వీలు కల్పిస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why are tri-state outputs critical for a multidrop SPI bus configuration? A) They enable the daisy chain topology to function without external buffers B) They reduce the power consumption of the slave devices during idle periods C) They prevent electrical signal conflicts when multiple slaves share the MISO line D) They allow the master to change the clock polarity dynamically ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of data in a relational database? A) It is only accessible through proprietary APIs B) It is structured into relations with defined interdependencies C) It is stored in a single flat file D) It is always stored in a distributed architecture ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Relational database లోని data యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) దానిని proprietary APIs ద్వారా మాత్రమే access చేయగలం B) అది నిర్వచించిన పరస్పర ఆధారాలతో relations గా structure చేయబడి ఉంటుంది C) అది ఒకే flat file లో store చేయబడుతుంది D) అది ఎప్పుడూ distributed architecture లో store చేయబడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of data in a relational database? A) It is only accessible through proprietary APIs B) It is structured into relations with defined interdependencies C) It is stored in a single flat file D) It is always stored in a distributed architecture ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does an inference engine function within an expert system architecture? A) It compiles the source code of the expert system into executable binaries. B) It evaluates current facts in the knowledge base against relevant rules to derive new conclusions. C) It automatically upgrades the system software when new domain information is discovered. D) It acts as a database manager that stores user profiles and historical data. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Expert system architecture లో inference engine ఎలా పనిచేస్తుంది? A) అది expert system యొక్క source code ను executable binaries గా compile చేస్తుంది. B) కొత్త conclusions ను రాబట్టడానికి knowledge base లోని ప్రస్తుత facts ను సంబంధిత rules తో పోల్చి evaluate చేస్తుంది. C) కొత్త domain information కనుగొనబడినప్పుడు అది system software ను స్వయంచాలకంగా upgrade చేస్తుంది. D) User profiles మరియు historical data ను store చేసే database manager గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does an inference engine function within an expert system architecture? A) It compiles the source code of the expert system into executable binaries. B) It evaluates current facts in the knowledge base against relevant rules to derive new conclusions. C) It automatically upgrades the system software when new domain information is discovered. D) It acts as a database manager that stores user profiles and historical data. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a disjoint-set data structure used during the execution of Kruskal's algorithm? A) To calculate the total weight of the spanning tree B) To store the sorted list of edges C) To traverse the graph vertices in descending order D) To efficiently detect if adding an edge will form a cycle ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Kruskal's algorithm execution సమయంలో disjoint-set data structure ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) Spanning tree యొక్క మొత్తం weight ను లెక్కించడానికి B) Edges యొక్క sorted list ను store చేయడానికి C) Graph vertices ను descending order లో traverse చేయడానికి D) ఒక edge ను జోడిస్తే cycle ఏర్పడుతుందో లేదో సమర్థవంతంగా గుర్తించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is a disjoint-set data structure used during the execution of Kruskal's algorithm? A) To calculate the total weight of the spanning tree B) To store the sorted list of edges C) To traverse the graph vertices in descending order D) To efficiently detect if adding an edge will form a cycle ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is OFDM preferred over conventional FDM for wideband applications? A) It requires separate filters for each subcarrier B) It has a very low peak-to-average-power ratio C) It requires complex time-domain equalization D) It uses orthogonal subcarriers to increase spectral efficiency ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Wideband applications కి సాంప్రదాయ FDM కంటే OFDM ను ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) దానికి ప్రతి subcarrier కి వేర్వేరు filters అవసరం B) దానికి చాలా తక్కువ peak-to-average-power ratio ఉంటుంది C) దానికి సంక్లిష్టమైన time-domain equalization అవసరం D) Spectral efficiency ని పెంచడానికి అది orthogonal subcarriers ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is OFDM preferred over conventional FDM for wideband applications? A) It requires separate filters for each subcarrier B) It has a very low peak-to-average-power ratio C) It requires complex time-domain equalization D) It uses orthogonal subcarriers to increase spectral efficiency ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of pumping in a laser design? A) To cool the mirrors of the optical cavity during oscillation B) To elevate atoms into excited states to enable net optical amplification C) To prevent optical feedback from reaching the output coupler D) To ensure all spontaneous emissions travel along the resonator axis ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Laser design లో pumping యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Oscillation సమయంలో optical cavity mirrors ను చల్లబరచడం B) Net optical amplification సాధ్యమయ్యేలా atoms ను excited states కి పెంచడం C) Optical feedback output coupler కి చేరకుండా నిరోధించడం D) అన్ని spontaneous emissions resonator axis వెంబడి ప్రయాణించేలా చూడడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of pumping in a laser design? A) To cool the mirrors of the optical cavity during oscillation B) To elevate atoms into excited states to enable net optical amplification C) To prevent optical feedback from reaching the output coupler D) To ensure all spontaneous emissions travel along the resonator axis ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are recursive systematic convolutional codes particularly important in modern communication systems? A) They are decoded using hard decisions B) They have the highest possible code rate C) They are the only codes that can be punctured D) They are used as constituent codes in turbo codes ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఆధునిక communication systems లో recursive systematic convolutional codes ప్రత్యేకంగా ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైనవి? A) వాటిని hard decisions తో decode చేస్తారు B) వాటికి సాధ్యమైనంత ఎక్కువ code rate ఉంటుంది C) Puncture చేయగల codes అవి మాత్రమే D) వాటిని turbo codes లో constituent codes గా వాడతారు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why are recursive systematic convolutional codes particularly important in modern communication systems? A) They are decoded using hard decisions B) They have the highest possible code rate C) They are the only codes that can be punctured D) They are used as constituent codes in turbo codes ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What occurs when two waves with identical amplitudes and opposite phases undergo superposition at a point? A) The frequency of the combined wave doubles B) The light or sound wave converts into a non-linear wave C) The amplitude doubles due to constructive interference D) The resultant amplitude becomes zero due to destructive interference ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒకే amplitudes మరియు వ్యతిరేక phases ఉన్న రెండు waves ఒక point వద్ద superposition చెందితే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) కలిసిన wave యొక్క frequency రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది B) కాంతి లేదా ధ్వని wave non-linear wave గా మారుతుంది C) Constructive interference వల్ల amplitude రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది D) Destructive interference వల్ల ఫలిత amplitude zero అవుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What occurs when two waves with identical amplitudes and opposite phases undergo superposition at a point? A) The frequency of the combined wave doubles B) The light or sound wave converts into a non-linear wave C) The amplitude doubles due to constructive interference D) The resultant amplitude becomes zero due to destructive interference ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which condition must be met for a circuit to be classified as an amplifier by its power gain? A) The power gain must be less than the input power B) The power gain must be equal to zero C) The power gain must be exactly one D) The power gain must be greater than one ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Power gain ఆధారంగా ఒక circuit ను amplifier గా వర్గీకరించడానికి ఏ షరతు నెరవేరాలి? A) Power gain input power కంటే తక్కువగా ఉండాలి B) Power gain zero కి సమానంగా ఉండాలి C) Power gain సరిగ్గా one గా ఉండాలి D) Power gain one కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండాలి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which condition must be met for a circuit to be classified as an amplifier by its power gain? A) The power gain must be less than the input power B) The power gain must be equal to zero C) The power gain must be exactly one D) The power gain must be greater than one ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does the continuum hypothesis typically fail, requiring a transition to statistical mechanics? A) When the velocity of the fluid is too low. B) When the fluid is highly incompressible. C) When the fluid flow is turbulent. D) When the characteristic length scale of the system is comparable to the molecular mean free path. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో continuum hypothesis సాధారణంగా విఫలమై, statistical mechanics కి మారవలసి వస్తుంది? A) Fluid velocity చాలా తక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు. B) Fluid అత్యంత incompressible గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. C) Fluid flow turbulent గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. D) System యొక్క characteristic length scale molecular mean free path తో పోల్చదగినదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition does the continuum hypothesis typically fail, requiring a transition to statistical mechanics? A) When the velocity of the fluid is too low. B) When the fluid is highly incompressible. C) When the fluid flow is turbulent. D) When the characteristic length scale of the system is comparable to the molecular mean free path. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the basic Paxos protocol not guarantee liveness? A) Because it requires a majority of acceptors to be online at all times. B) Because it only guarantees safety and fault tolerance, per the FLP result. C) Because it is designed to handle Byzantine failures, which slow down consensus. D) Because the Prepare and Promise phases can deadlock indefinitely. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Basic Paxos protocol liveness కి ఎందుకు హామీ ఇవ్వదు? A) ఎందుకంటే దానికి ఎప్పుడూ majority acceptors online లో ఉండాలి. B) ఎందుకంటే FLP result ప్రకారం అది safety మరియు fault tolerance కి మాత్రమే హామీ ఇస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే అది consensus ను నెమ్మదింపజేసే Byzantine failures ను handle చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడింది. D) ఎందుకంటే Prepare మరియు Promise phases నిరవధికంగా deadlock కావచ్చు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the basic Paxos protocol not guarantee liveness? A) Because it requires a majority of acceptors to be online at all times. B) Because it only guarantees safety and fault tolerance, per the FLP result. C) Because it is designed to handle Byzantine failures, which slow down consensus. D) Because the Prepare and Promise phases can deadlock indefinitely. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an SVM use the kernel trick? A) To directly compute the margin in the original input space B) To implicitly map data into a higher-dimensional space for linear classification C) To replace the need for a hyperplane with a decision tree D) To reduce computational complexity by avoiding high-dimensional transformations ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: SVM kernel trick ను ఎందుకు వాడుతుంది? A) Original input space లో margin ను నేరుగా compute చేయడానికి B) Linear classification కోసం data ను implicitly ఒక higher-dimensional space కి map చేయడానికి C) Hyperplane అవసరాన్ని decision tree తో భర్తీ చేయడానికి D) High-dimensional transformations ను నివారించి computational complexity ని తగ్గించడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does an SVM use the kernel trick? A) To directly compute the margin in the original input space B) To implicitly map data into a higher-dimensional space for linear classification C) To replace the need for a hyperplane with a decision tree D) To reduce computational complexity by avoiding high-dimensional transformations ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why do RISC processors typically require more machine code than CISC processors to accomplish the same task? A) Because RISC instructions are longer in length B) Because RISC instructions are simpler and perform fewer operations per instruction C) Because RISC compilers are less efficient D) Because RISC processors have less memory capacity ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒకే పనిని చేయడానికి CISC processors కంటే RISC processors కి సాధారణంగా ఎక్కువ machine code ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఎందుకంటే RISC instructions పొడవుగా ఉంటాయి B) ఎందుకంటే RISC instructions సరళంగా ఉంటాయి మరియు ఒక్కో instruction కి తక్కువ operations చేస్తాయి C) ఎందుకంటే RISC compilers తక్కువ సమర్థవంతమైనవి D) ఎందుకంటే RISC processors కి తక్కువ memory capacity ఉంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why do RISC processors typically require more machine code than CISC processors to accomplish the same task? A) Because RISC instructions are longer in length B) Because RISC instructions are simpler and perform fewer operations per instruction C) Because RISC compilers are less efficient D) Because RISC processors have less memory capacity ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the upper-left corner of the ROC space (0, 1) considered the ideal point? A) It indicates a classifier with zero specificity. B) It maximizes both true positives and false positives simultaneously. C) It corresponds to the diagonal no-discrimination line. D) It represents 100% sensitivity with 0% false positive rate. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ROC space లోని upper-left corner (0, 1) ను ideal point గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది zero specificity ఉన్న classifier ను సూచిస్తుంది. B) అది true positives మరియు false positives రెండింటినీ ఒకేసారి గరిష్ఠం చేస్తుంది. C) అది diagonal no-discrimination line కి సంబంధించినది. D) అది 0% false positive rate తో 100% sensitivity ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the upper-left corner of the ROC space (0, 1) considered the ideal point? A) It indicates a classifier with zero specificity. B) It maximizes both true positives and false positives simultaneously. C) It corresponds to the diagonal no-discrimination line. D) It represents 100% sensitivity with 0% false positive rate. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does the integral ∮ f(z) dz along a simple closed curve C evaluate strictly to zero according to Cauchy's integral theorem? A) f(z) is holomorphic on and inside the region bounded by C B) The contour C is symmetric about the imaginary axis C) f(z) is a real-valued function along the real axis D) f(z) has only simple poles inside C whose residues sum to zero ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Cauchy's integral theorem ప్రకారం ఏ పరిస్థితిలో simple closed curve C వెంబడి integral ∮ f(z) dz ఖచ్చితంగా zero అవుతుంది? A) C తో bounded అయిన region పై మరియు లోపల f(z) holomorphic గా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) Contour C imaginary axis గురించి symmetric గా ఉన్నప్పుడు C) Real axis వెంబడి f(z) ఒక real-valued function అయినప్పుడు D) C లోపల f(z) కి simple poles మాత్రమే ఉండి వాటి residues sum zero అయినప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under what condition does the integral ∮ f(z) dz along a simple closed curve C evaluate strictly to zero according to Cauchy's integral theorem? A) f(z) is holomorphic on and inside the region bounded by C B) The contour C is symmetric about the imaginary axis C) f(z) is a real-valued function along the real axis D) f(z) has only simple poles inside C whose residues sum to zero ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of using a diode in a rectifier circuit? A) To boost the voltage of the input signal B) To convert alternating current into direct current C) To increase the frequency of the AC signal D) To prevent any current from flowing at all ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Rectifier circuit లో diode ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Input signal voltage ను boost చేయడానికి B) Alternating current ను direct current గా మార్చడానికి C) AC signal frequency ను పెంచడానికి D) ఎలాంటి current ప్రవహించకుండా పూర్తిగా నిరోధించడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of using a diode in a rectifier circuit? A) To boost the voltage of the input signal B) To convert alternating current into direct current C) To increase the frequency of the AC signal D) To prevent any current from flowing at all ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary geometric effect of the convolution operation on an input function? A) It purely shifts the function without changing its shape B) It reflects the function across the x-axis only C) It eliminates all amplitude variations D) It modifies the shape of the input function based on a weighting function ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక input function పై convolution operation యొక్క ప్రధాన geometric ప్రభావం ఏమిటి? A) అది function ఆకారాన్ని మార్చకుండా కేవలం shift చేస్తుంది B) అది function ను x-axis వెంబడి మాత్రమే reflect చేస్తుంది C) అది అన్ని amplitude మార్పులను తొలగిస్తుంది D) ఒక weighting function ఆధారంగా అది input function ఆకారాన్ని మారుస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary geometric effect of the convolution operation on an input function? A) It purely shifts the function without changing its shape B) It reflects the function across the x-axis only C) It eliminates all amplitude variations D) It modifies the shape of the input function based on a weighting function ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of including an activation function in a neural network layer? A) To introduce non-linearity into the network output B) To calculate the final prediction error C) To increase the total number of trainable weights D) To normalize input features for faster convergence ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Neural network layer లో activation function ను చేర్చడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Network output లోకి non-linearity ని తీసుకురావడానికి B) Final prediction error ను లెక్కించడానికి C) మొత్తం trainable weights సంఖ్యను పెంచడానికి D) వేగవంతమైన convergence కోసం input features ను normalize చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of including an activation function in a neural network layer? A) To introduce non-linearity into the network output B) To calculate the final prediction error C) To increase the total number of trainable weights D) To normalize input features for faster convergence ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the first principal component defined as a unit vector that maximizes variance? A) To normalize the direction so that only its orientation matters. B) To align with the original data axes. C) To ensure the component has the largest possible magnitude. D) To make the component orthogonal to the second component. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: మొదటి principal component ను variance ను గరిష్ఠం చేసే unit vector గా ఎందుకు నిర్వచిస్తారు? A) దాని orientation మాత్రమే ముఖ్యమయ్యేలా direction ను normalize చేయడానికి. B) Original data axes తో align అవ్వడానికి. C) Component కి సాధ్యమైనంత పెద్ద magnitude ఉండేలా చూడడానికి. D) Component ను రెండో component కి orthogonal గా చేయడానికి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the first principal component defined as a unit vector that maximizes variance? A) To normalize the direction so that only its orientation matters. B) To align with the original data axes. C) To ensure the component has the largest possible magnitude. D) To make the component orthogonal to the second component. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the Optimal Brain Damage algorithm, how is the 'saliency' of a parameter defined? A) By approximating the increase in loss that would occur if that parameter were set to zero B) By the magnitude of the weight value itself C) By the distance between the parameter and the bias term D) By the frequency with which the parameter is updated during backpropagation ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Optimal Brain Damage algorithm లో ఒక parameter యొక్క 'saliency' ని ఎలా నిర్వచిస్తారు? A) ఆ parameter ను zero గా set చేస్తే loss లో వచ్చే పెరుగుదలను approximate చేయడం ద్వారా B) Weight value యొక్క magnitude ద్వారానే C) Parameter మరియు bias term మధ్య దూరం ద్వారా D) Backpropagation సమయంలో parameter ఎంత తరచుగా update అవుతుందో దాని ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the Optimal Brain Damage algorithm, how is the 'saliency' of a parameter defined? A) By approximating the increase in loss that would occur if that parameter were set to zero B) By the magnitude of the weight value itself C) By the distance between the parameter and the bias term D) By the frequency with which the parameter is updated during backpropagation ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes the 'count to infinity' problem in routing? A) Two routers continuously increment the hop count for a destination that is no longer reachable. B) A network loop is formed where packets travel only between two routers indefinitely. C) A router chooses the path with the highest possible number of hops. D) The routing table exceeds the maximum allowed memory storage on a router. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Routing లో 'count to infinity' problem ను ఏ సందర్భం బాగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) ఇకపై చేరలేని ఒక destination కోసం రెండు routers నిరంతరం hop count ను పెంచుతూ ఉంటాయి. B) Packets రెండు routers మధ్య మాత్రమే నిరవధికంగా ప్రయాణించే network loop ఏర్పడుతుంది. C) ఒక router సాధ్యమైనంత ఎక్కువ hops ఉన్న path ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. D) Routing table router పై అనుమతించిన maximum memory storage ను మించిపోతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes the 'count to infinity' problem in routing? A) Two routers continuously increment the hop count for a destination that is no longer reachable. B) A network loop is formed where packets travel only between two routers indefinitely. C) A router chooses the path with the highest possible number of hops. D) The routing table exceeds the maximum allowed memory storage on a router. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does the Minimax theorem fail to guarantee that the move order between the generator and discriminator is irrelevant? A) When the networks are trained using backpropagation. B) When the strategy sets are continuous and not finitely spanned. C) When the discriminator uses a deep neural network function. D) When the generator uses a normal distribution for input. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో generator మరియు discriminator మధ్య move order అప్రస్తుతమని Minimax theorem హామీ ఇవ్వడంలో విఫలమవుతుంది? A) Networks ను backpropagation తో train చేసినప్పుడు. B) Strategy sets continuous గా ఉండి finitely spanned కానప్పుడు. C) Discriminator deep neural network function ను వాడినప్పుడు. D) Generator input కోసం normal distribution ను వాడినప్పుడు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Under what condition does the Minimax theorem fail to guarantee that the move order between the generator and discriminator is irrelevant? A) When the networks are trained using backpropagation. B) When the strategy sets are continuous and not finitely spanned. C) When the discriminator uses a deep neural network function. D) When the generator uses a normal distribution for input. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: If a language cannot be decided by a finite-state automaton but is recognizable by a pushdown automaton, what is its classification? A) Recursively enumerable language B) Context-sensitive language C) Context-free language D) Regular language ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక language ను finite-state automaton decide చేయలేకపోయి, pushdown automaton గుర్తించగలిగితే, దాని వర్గీకరణ ఏమిటి? A) Recursively enumerable language B) Context-sensitive language C) Context-free language D) Regular language జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: If a language cannot be decided by a finite-state automaton but is recognizable by a pushdown automaton, what is its classification? A) Recursively enumerable language B) Context-sensitive language C) Context-free language D) Regular language ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If an alternating current enters the dotted terminal of a transformer primary winding, what happens at the secondary winding? A) The secondary dotted terminal becomes instantaneously positive in potential B) The mutual flux in the core instantly drops to zero C) Direct current flows out of the undotted terminal D) The secondary dotted terminal becomes instantaneously negative in potential ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Transformer primary winding యొక్క dotted terminal లోకి alternating current ప్రవేశిస్తే, secondary winding వద్ద ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Secondary dotted terminal తక్షణం positive potential పొందుతుంది B) Core లోని mutual flux వెంటనే zero కి పడిపోతుంది C) Undotted terminal నుండి direct current బయటకు ప్రవహిస్తుంది D) Secondary dotted terminal తక్షణం negative potential పొందుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If an alternating current enters the dotted terminal of a transformer primary winding, what happens at the secondary winding? A) The secondary dotted terminal becomes instantaneously positive in potential B) The mutual flux in the core instantly drops to zero C) Direct current flows out of the undotted terminal D) The secondary dotted terminal becomes instantaneously negative in potential ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a major challenge when designing asynchronous sequential circuits? A) The lack of available logic gates B) The requirement of a constant clock signal C) The occurrence of race conditions due to signal timing D) The circuit being too slow to use ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Asynchronous sequential circuits ను design చేసేటప్పుడు ఒక ప్రధాన సవాలు ఏమిటి? A) అందుబాటులో logic gates లేకపోవడం B) స్థిరమైన clock signal అవసరం C) Signal timing వల్ల race conditions ఏర్పడడం D) Circuit వాడడానికి చాలా నెమ్మదిగా ఉండడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a major challenge when designing asynchronous sequential circuits? A) The lack of available logic gates B) The requirement of a constant clock signal C) The occurrence of race conditions due to signal timing D) The circuit being too slow to use ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is switching between threads of the same process generally faster than switching between two separate processes? A) Threads share the same virtual memory maps B) Threads use less memory C) Threads do not use a program counter D) Threads run in kernel mode by default ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: రెండు వేర్వేరు processes మధ్య switch చేయడం కంటే ఒకే process యొక్క threads మధ్య switch చేయడం సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు వేగంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Threads ఒకే virtual memory maps ను పంచుకుంటాయి B) Threads తక్కువ memory వాడతాయి C) Threads program counter ను వాడవు D) Threads default గా kernel mode లో నడుస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is switching between threads of the same process generally faster than switching between two separate processes? A) Threads share the same virtual memory maps B) Threads use less memory C) Threads do not use a program counter D) Threads run in kernel mode by default ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must both the transmitting and receiving UARTs be set to the same bit rate? A) To eliminate the need for a start bit B) To allow the use of parallel transmission C) To prevent the need for a shift register D) To ensure the receiver samples the incoming signal at the correct intervals ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Transmit చేసే మరియు receive చేసే UARTs రెండూ ఒకే bit rate కి ఎందుకు set చేయబడాలి? A) Start bit అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి B) Parallel transmission వాడడానికి వీలుగా C) Shift register అవసరం లేకుండా చేయడానికి D) Receiver వచ్చే signal ను సరైన intervals వద్ద sample చేసేలా చూడడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why must both the transmitting and receiving UARTs be set to the same bit rate? A) To eliminate the need for a start bit B) To allow the use of parallel transmission C) To prevent the need for a shift register D) To ensure the receiver samples the incoming signal at the correct intervals ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the construction of a mux tree? A) Combining analog switches to replace digital select lines B) Connecting many multiplexers in parallel to a single output C) Connecting multiple multiplexers in a hierarchical structure to handle more inputs D) Using a single large gate to replace all smaller multiplexers ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Mux tree నిర్మాణాన్ని కింది వాటిలో ఏది బాగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Digital select lines ను భర్తీ చేయడానికి analog switches ను కలపడం B) అనేక multiplexers ను ఒకే output కి parallel గా connect చేయడం C) ఎక్కువ inputs ను handle చేయడానికి అనేక multiplexers ను hierarchical structure లో connect చేయడం D) చిన్న multiplexers అన్నింటినీ భర్తీ చేయడానికి ఒకే పెద్ద gate ను వాడడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the construction of a mux tree? A) Combining analog switches to replace digital select lines B) Connecting many multiplexers in parallel to a single output C) Connecting multiple multiplexers in a hierarchical structure to handle more inputs D) Using a single large gate to replace all smaller multiplexers ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: According to the robustness principle, how should a protocol implementation behave? A) Only accept inputs that perfectly match the formal specification B) Be conservative in sending and liberal in accepting inputs C) Be aggressive in sending and strictly reject any malformed input D) Ignore all protocol errors to maintain maximum network speed ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Robustness principle ప్రకారం ఒక protocol implementation ఎలా ప్రవర్తించాలి? A) Formal specification కి పూర్తిగా సరిపోలే inputs ను మాత్రమే అంగీకరించాలి B) పంపడంలో జాగ్రత్తగా, inputs ను అంగీకరించడంలో ఉదారంగా ఉండాలి C) పంపడంలో దూకుడుగా ఉండి, ఏ malformed input నైనా కఠినంగా తిరస్కరించాలి D) Maximum network speed ను కాపాడడానికి అన్ని protocol errors ను పట్టించుకోకూడదు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to the robustness principle, how should a protocol implementation behave? A) Only accept inputs that perfectly match the formal specification B) Be conservative in sending and liberal in accepting inputs C) Be aggressive in sending and strictly reject any malformed input D) Ignore all protocol errors to maintain maximum network speed ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Wilson central terminal considered a virtual electrode rather than a physical one? A) It is a software filter that removes motion artifacts from the ECG signal. B) It is a physical electrode placed on the patient's right leg. C) It is generated by averaging the potentials of the three standard limb leads. D) It is the positive pole for the augmented limb leads aVR and aVL. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Wilson central terminal ను physical electrode గా కాకుండా virtual electrode గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది ECG signal నుండి motion artifacts ను తొలగించే software filter. B) అది patient కుడి కాలిపై పెట్టే physical electrode. C) మూడు standard limb leads యొక్క potentials ను average చేయడం ద్వారా అది generate అవుతుంది. D) Augmented limb leads aVR మరియు aVL కి అది positive pole. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the Wilson central terminal considered a virtual electrode rather than a physical one? A) It is a software filter that removes motion artifacts from the ECG signal. B) It is a physical electrode placed on the patient's right leg. C) It is generated by averaging the potentials of the three standard limb leads. D) It is the positive pole for the augmented limb leads aVR and aVL. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Diffie-Hellman key exchange considered secure against an eavesdropper? A) Because the modulus p is kept secret by the communicating parties. B) Because the eavesdropper cannot compute the shared secret without solving the discrete logarithm problem. C) Because the protocol requires physical verification of the parties beforehand. D) Because the shared secret is encrypted before being transmitted. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Eavesdropper కి వ్యతిరేకంగా Diffie-Hellman key exchange ను ఎందుకు secure గా భావిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే modulus p ను communicate చేసే parties రహస్యంగా ఉంచుతారు. B) ఎందుకంటే discrete logarithm problem ను solve చేయకుండా eavesdropper shared secret ను compute చేయలేడు. C) ఎందుకంటే protocol కి ముందుగానే parties యొక్క physical verification అవసరం. D) ఎందుకంటే shared secret ను transmit చేసే ముందు encrypt చేస్తారు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Diffie-Hellman key exchange considered secure against an eavesdropper? A) Because the modulus p is kept secret by the communicating parties. B) Because the eavesdropper cannot compute the shared secret without solving the discrete logarithm problem. C) Because the protocol requires physical verification of the parties beforehand. D) Because the shared secret is encrypted before being transmitted. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of the feature function in a maximum entropy language model? A) To replace the parameter vector entirely B) To calculate the partition function C) To measure model perplexity D) To encode the relationship between a word and its n-gram history ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Maximum entropy language model లో feature function యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Parameter vector ను పూర్తిగా భర్తీ చేయడం B) Partition function ను లెక్కించడం C) Model perplexity ని కొలవడం D) ఒక word కి దాని n-gram history కి మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని encode చేయడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of the feature function in a maximum entropy language model? A) To replace the parameter vector entirely B) To calculate the partition function C) To measure model perplexity D) To encode the relationship between a word and its n-gram history ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must K-map cells be arranged using Gray code instead of standard binary? A) To reduce the total number of cells in the map B) To ensure only one variable changes between adjacent cells C) To simplify the conversion from decimal to binary D) To allow for more than two input states per cell ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: K-map cells ను standard binary బదులు Gray code తో ఎందుకు అమర్చాలి? A) Map లోని మొత్తం cells సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడానికి B) పక్కపక్కన ఉన్న cells మధ్య ఒకే variable మారేలా చూడడానికి C) Decimal నుండి binary కి మార్పిడిని సులభం చేయడానికి D) ఒక్కో cell కి రెండు కంటే ఎక్కువ input states ను అనుమతించడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why must K-map cells be arranged using Gray code instead of standard binary? A) To reduce the total number of cells in the map B) To ensure only one variable changes between adjacent cells C) To simplify the conversion from decimal to binary D) To allow for more than two input states per cell ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary operational difference between symmetric-key and asymmetric-key encryption regarding key management? A) Symmetric-key is always faster but less secure than asymmetric-key methods. B) Asymmetric-key encryption does not require a secret key at all. C) Symmetric-key encryption is solely used for authentication, not for data privacy. D) Symmetric-key uses one key for both, while asymmetric-key uses a distinct key pair. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Key management విషయంలో symmetric-key మరియు asymmetric-key encryption మధ్య ప్రధాన operational తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Symmetric-key ఎప్పుడూ asymmetric-key methods కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటుంది కానీ తక్కువ secure. B) Asymmetric-key encryption కి secret key అసలు అవసరం లేదు. C) Symmetric-key encryption ను authentication కోసం మాత్రమే వాడతారు, data privacy కోసం కాదు. D) Symmetric-key రెండింటికీ ఒకే key ను వాడుతుంది, asymmetric-key వేరే key pair ను వాడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary operational difference between symmetric-key and asymmetric-key encryption regarding key management? A) Symmetric-key is always faster but less secure than asymmetric-key methods. B) Asymmetric-key encryption does not require a secret key at all. C) Symmetric-key encryption is solely used for authentication, not for data privacy. D) Symmetric-key uses one key for both, while asymmetric-key uses a distinct key pair. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why do low-voltage miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) typically use arc chutes instead of oil or gas? A) Oil and gas are too expensive for household use B) MCBs are not designed to handle high voltages C) Arc chutes provide a safe, compact, and cost-effective way to split and cool the arc D) Arc chutes are required by international standards ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Low-voltage miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) సాధారణంగా oil లేదా gas బదులు arc chutes ను ఎందుకు వాడతాయి? A) Household వాడకానికి oil మరియు gas చాలా ఖరీదైనవి B) MCBs high voltages ను handle చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడలేదు C) Arc ను విభజించి చల్లబరచడానికి arc chutes సురక్షితమైన, compact, తక్కువ ఖర్చు మార్గాన్ని ఇస్తాయి D) International standards ప్రకారం arc chutes తప్పనిసరి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why do low-voltage miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) typically use arc chutes instead of oil or gas? A) Oil and gas are too expensive for household use B) MCBs are not designed to handle high voltages C) Arc chutes provide a safe, compact, and cost-effective way to split and cool the arc D) Arc chutes are required by international standards ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of persistent connections in HTTP/1.1? A) To encrypt data between the client and server. B) To compress the response body for faster transfer. C) To reduce latency by reusing the same TCP connection for multiple requests. D) To allow the client to send multiple requests without waiting for responses. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: HTTP/1.1 లో persistent connections యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Client మరియు server మధ్య data ను encrypt చేయడానికి. B) వేగవంతమైన transfer కోసం response body ని compress చేయడానికి. C) అనేక requests కి ఒకే TCP connection ను మళ్లీ వాడడం ద్వారా latency ని తగ్గించడానికి. D) Responses కోసం ఎదురుచూడకుండా client అనేక requests పంపడానికి వీలుగా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of persistent connections in HTTP/1.1? A) To encrypt data between the client and server. B) To compress the response body for faster transfer. C) To reduce latency by reusing the same TCP connection for multiple requests. D) To allow the client to send multiple requests without waiting for responses. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must developers be cautious when using caches with Memory-mapped I/O? A) Caches are always too slow to access I/O devices. B) Caches consume too much power when communicating with I/O devices. C) Caches prevent direct memory access (DMA) from functioning. D) Caches can reorder writes, potentially causing peripheral registers to be accessed in the wrong order. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Memory-mapped I/O తో caches ను వాడేటప్పుడు developers ఎందుకు జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండాలి? A) I/O devices ను access చేయడానికి caches ఎప్పుడూ చాలా నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటాయి. B) I/O devices తో communicate చేసేటప్పుడు caches చాలా ఎక్కువ power ను వినియోగిస్తాయి. C) Caches direct memory access (DMA) పనిచేయకుండా నిరోధిస్తాయి. D) Caches writes ను reorder చేయగలవు, దాని వల్ల peripheral registers తప్పు క్రమంలో access కావచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why must developers be cautious when using caches with Memory-mapped I/O? A) Caches are always too slow to access I/O devices. B) Caches consume too much power when communicating with I/O devices. C) Caches prevent direct memory access (DMA) from functioning. D) Caches can reorder writes, potentially causing peripheral registers to be accessed in the wrong order. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If the normal force on a block is doubled, what happens to the friction force? A) It halves B) It doubles C) It quadruples D) It stays the same ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక block పై normal force రెట్టింపు అయితే friction force కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) అది సగం అవుతుంది B) అది రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది C) అది నాలుగు రెట్లు అవుతుంది D) అది అలాగే ఉంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If the normal force on a block is doubled, what happens to the friction force? A) It halves B) It doubles C) It quadruples D) It stays the same ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following statements regarding the Chomsky hierarchy is true? A) Recursively enumerable languages are the most restrictive B) Every context-free language is regular C) Every regular language is context-free D) Every context-sensitive language is regular ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Chomsky hierarchy గురించి కింది statements లో ఏది నిజం? A) Recursively enumerable languages అత్యంత పరిమితమైనవి B) ప్రతి context-free language regular C) ప్రతి regular language context-free D) ప్రతి context-sensitive language regular జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following statements regarding the Chomsky hierarchy is true? A) Recursively enumerable languages are the most restrictive B) Every context-free language is regular C) Every regular language is context-free D) Every context-sensitive language is regular ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the emitted wavelength of a light-emitting diode when the band gap energy of its active material is increased? A) The emitted wavelength remains constant while the radiative emission rate drops to zero. B) The emitted wavelength shifts toward shorter values (blue/UV shift). C) The emitted wavelength shifts toward longer values (infrared shift). D) The device switches from emitting photons to exclusively emitting phonons. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Light-emitting diode యొక్క active material band gap energy పెరిగితే, దాని emitted wavelength కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Radiative emission rate zero కి పడిపోగా emitted wavelength స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. B) Emitted wavelength తక్కువ values వైపు (blue/UV shift) జరుగుతుంది. C) Emitted wavelength ఎక్కువ values వైపు (infrared shift) జరుగుతుంది. D) Device photons ను emit చేయడం నుండి కేవలం phonons ను emit చేయడానికి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the emitted wavelength of a light-emitting diode when the band gap energy of its active material is increased? A) The emitted wavelength remains constant while the radiative emission rate drops to zero. B) The emitted wavelength shifts toward shorter values (blue/UV shift). C) The emitted wavelength shifts toward longer values (infrared shift). D) The device switches from emitting photons to exclusively emitting phonons. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using an FPGA over an ASIC during the research and development phase? A) FPGAs are physically smaller and consume less power than ASICs B) FPGAs offer higher performance for specific single-purpose tasks C) FPGAs have significantly lower unit costs for mass production D) FPGAs allow for repeated reconfiguration without manufacturing new chips ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Research and development దశలో ASIC కంటే FPGA ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) FPGAs భౌతికంగా ASICs కంటే చిన్నవి మరియు తక్కువ power ను వినియోగిస్తాయి B) నిర్దిష్ట single-purpose పనులకు FPGAs ఎక్కువ performance ను ఇస్తాయి C) Mass production కి FPGAs కి గణనీయంగా తక్కువ unit costs ఉంటాయి D) కొత్త chips తయారు చేయకుండానే FPGAs ను పదే పదే reconfigure చేయవచ్చు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using an FPGA over an ASIC during the research and development phase? A) FPGAs are physically smaller and consume less power than ASICs B) FPGAs offer higher performance for specific single-purpose tasks C) FPGAs have significantly lower unit costs for mass production D) FPGAs allow for repeated reconfiguration without manufacturing new chips ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is dropout performed during the training process but not during inference? A) It is intended to prevent co-adaptation during learning, not to remove data during prediction B) It would make the model too slow during inference C) Inference requires the use of mean field theory which contradicts dropout D) The weight matrix is permanently changed after training ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Dropout ను training process లో చేసి inference సమయంలో ఎందుకు చేయరు? A) అది learning సమయంలో co-adaptation ను నిరోధించడానికి ఉద్దేశించబడింది, prediction సమయంలో data ను తొలగించడానికి కాదు B) Inference సమయంలో అది model ను చాలా నెమ్మదిగా చేస్తుంది C) Inference కి dropout కి విరుద్ధమైన mean field theory వాడకం అవసరం D) Training తర్వాత weight matrix శాశ్వతంగా మారిపోతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is dropout performed during the training process but not during inference? A) It is intended to prevent co-adaptation during learning, not to remove data during prediction B) It would make the model too slow during inference C) Inference requires the use of mean field theory which contradicts dropout D) The weight matrix is permanently changed after training ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of using a simple diode clamp in precision applications? A) The capacitor discharges too quickly regardless of the load B) It requires an op-amp to function C) It cannot handle high-frequency signals D) The forward voltage drop of the diode varies with temperature ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Precision applications లో సాధారణ diode clamp ను వాడడం వల్ల ప్రధాన నష్టం ఏమిటి? A) Load తో సంబంధం లేకుండా capacitor చాలా వేగంగా discharge అవుతుంది B) పనిచేయడానికి దానికి op-amp అవసరం C) అది high-frequency signals ను handle చేయలేదు D) Diode యొక్క forward voltage drop temperature తో మారుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of using a simple diode clamp in precision applications? A) The capacitor discharges too quickly regardless of the load B) It requires an op-amp to function C) It cannot handle high-frequency signals D) The forward voltage drop of the diode varies with temperature ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a fixed-program computer, how would a user typically change the machine's task? A) By updating the operating system. B) By physically rewiring or restructuring the hardware. C) By changing the input data only. D) By loading a new file from a hard drive. ANSWER: B

C) Input data ను మాత్రమే మార్చడం ద్వారా. D) Hard drive నుండి కొత్త file ను load చేయడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In a fixed-program computer, how would a user typically change the machine's task? A) By updating the operating system. B) By physically rewiring or restructuring the hardware. C) By changing the input data only. D) By loading a new file from a hard drive. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary objective of the maximum-margin hyperplane in SVM? target_en: Q: What is the primary objective of the maximum-margin hyperplane in SVM? A) To find the hyperplane with the smallest bias term B) To maximize the distance between the margin boundaries C) To minimize the computational complexity of training D) To minimize the number of support vectors ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a foreign key in a relational database? A) To ensure that each tuple in a relation has a unique identifier. B) To establish a link between two tables by referencing a candidate key in another table. C) To define the physical storage structure of a database. D) To store default values for missing data in a table. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Relational database లో foreign key యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) ఒక relation లోని ప్రతి tuple కి unique identifier ఉండేలా చూడడం. B) మరో table లోని candidate key ని reference చేయడం ద్వారా రెండు tables మధ్య link ఏర్పరచడం. C) Database యొక్క physical storage structure ను నిర్వచించడం. D) Table లో లేని data కోసం default values ను store చేయడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a foreign key in a relational database? A) To ensure that each tuple in a relation has a unique identifier. B) To establish a link between two tables by referencing a candidate key in another table. C) To define the physical storage structure of a database. D) To store default values for missing data in a table. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key difference between L1 and L2 regularization? A) L1 regularization is an explicit form, while L2 is an implicit form B) L1 regularization is only used in neural networks, while L2 is used in linear models C) L1 regularization penalizes the square of coefficients, while L2 penalizes the absolute value D) L1 regularization encourages sparse models, while L2 encourages smaller, distributed coefficients ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: L1 మరియు L2 regularization మధ్య ముఖ్య తేడా ఏమిటి? A) L1 regularization explicit రూపం, L2 implicit రూపం B) L1 regularization ను neural networks లో మాత్రమే, L2 ను linear models లో వాడతారు C) L1 regularization coefficients యొక్క square ను, L2 absolute value ను penalize చేస్తుంది D) L1 regularization sparse models ను ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది, L2 చిన్న, పంపిణీ అయిన coefficients ను ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key difference between L1 and L2 regularization? A) L1 regularization is an explicit form, while L2 is an implicit form B) L1 regularization is only used in neural networks, while L2 is used in linear models C) L1 regularization penalizes the square of coefficients, while L2 penalizes the absolute value D) L1 regularization encourages sparse models, while L2 encourages smaller, distributed coefficients ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of an RTL instruction set? target: ప్రశ్న: RTL instruction set యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) అది ఎప్పుడూ explicit control flow information ను కలిగి ఉంటుంది B) అది మనుషులు చదవడానికి అనువుగా రూపొందించబడింది C) ప్రతి instruction సరిగ్గా ఒక fundamental operation ను సూచిస్తుంది D) అది 'shift-add' వంటి సంక్లిష్ట addressing modes ను కలిగి ఉంటుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of an RTL instruction set? A) It always includes explicit control flow information B) It is designed for human readability C) Each instruction represents exactly one fundamental operation D) It includes complex addressing modes like 'shift-add' ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In a hypothetical lossless transmission line, what happens to the signal as it travels along the line? A) It undergoes exponential decay due to resistance. B) The signal frequency doubles due to wave interaction. C) The velocity of the signal decreases to zero. D) It travels without attenuation, maintaining its original amplitude. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఊహాత్మక lossless transmission line లో, line వెంబడి ప్రయాణించేటప్పుడు signal కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Resistance వల్ల అది exponential decay కి లోనవుతుంది. B) Wave interaction వల్ల signal frequency రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది. C) Signal velocity zero కి తగ్గుతుంది. D) అది attenuation లేకుండా, తన అసలు amplitude ను కాపాడుకుంటూ ప్రయాణిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In a hypothetical lossless transmission line, what happens to the signal as it travels along the line? A) It undergoes exponential decay due to resistance. B) The signal frequency doubles due to wave interaction. C) The velocity of the signal decreases to zero. D) It travels without attenuation, maintaining its original amplitude. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following statements accurately describes the relationship between regular expressions and finite automata? A) Regular expressions describe context-free languages, whereas automata describe regular languages. B) Regular expressions can be converted into equivalent minimal finite state machines for equivalence checking. C) Finite automata can only process literal characters and not metacharacters. D) Regular expressions are strictly more powerful than any finite automaton. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Regular expressions మరియు finite automata మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని కింది statements లో ఏది ఖచ్చితంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Regular expressions context-free languages ను వివరిస్తాయి, automata regular languages ను వివరిస్తాయి. B) Equivalence checking కోసం regular expressions ను సమానమైన minimal finite state machines గా మార్చవచ్చు. C) Finite automata literal characters ను మాత్రమే process చేయగలవు, metacharacters ను కాదు. D) Regular expressions ఏ finite automaton కంటే అయినా ఖచ్చితంగా ఎక్కువ శక్తివంతమైనవి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following statements accurately describes the relationship between regular expressions and finite automata? A) Regular expressions describe context-free languages, whereas automata describe regular languages. B) Regular expressions can be converted into equivalent minimal finite state machines for equivalence checking. C) Finite automata can only process literal characters and not metacharacters. D) Regular expressions are strictly more powerful than any finite automaton. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the DNS described as a hierarchical and distributed system? A) It requires every device to hold a copy of the entire Internet directory. B) It delegates authority across multiple servers to avoid a single point of failure. C) It uses a single database file shared by every ISP in the world. D) It stores all Internet data in one central location for fast access. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: DNS ను hierarchical మరియు distributed system గా ఎందుకు వర్ణిస్తారు? A) ప్రతి device మొత్తం Internet directory కాపీని కలిగి ఉండాలి. B) Single point of failure ను నివారించడానికి అది authority ని అనేక servers కి అప్పగిస్తుంది. C) ప్రపంచంలోని ప్రతి ISP పంచుకునే ఒకే database file ను అది వాడుతుంది. D) వేగవంతమైన access కోసం అది మొత్తం Internet data ను ఒకే కేంద్ర స్థానంలో store చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the DNS described as a hierarchical and distributed system? A) It requires every device to hold a copy of the entire Internet directory. B) It delegates authority across multiple servers to avoid a single point of failure. C) It uses a single database file shared by every ISP in the world. D) It stores all Internet data in one central location for fast access. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a typical FPGA architecture, what is the main purpose of Configurable Logic Blocks? A) To act as the primary storage for the operating system B) To implement the actual digital logic functions of the design C) To manage the power distribution across the entire chip D) To provide high-speed analog-to-digital conversion ANSWER: B

A) Operating system కి primary storage గా పనిచేయడం B) Design యొక్క అసలు digital logic functions ను implement చేయడం C) మొత్తం chip అంతటా power distribution ను నిర్వహించడం D) High-speed analog-to-digital conversion ను అందించడం జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is true regarding 16-bit register pairs in the 8085? A) వాటిని flags store చేయడానికి మాత్రమే వాడతారు B) అవి 16-bit values ను store చేయగలవు మరియు memory address pointer గా పనిచేయగలవు C) అన్ని arithmetic operations కి అవి accumulator ను నేరుగా భర్తీ చేస్తాయి D) అవి HL register పై ఆధారపడవు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is true regarding 16-bit register pairs in the 8085? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary goal of using Random Early Detection (RED) in a network? A) To permanently block traffic from specific IP addresses B) To increase the total bandwidth of the network link C) To proactively signal endpoints to slow transmission before the queue becomes full D) To increase the maximum packet size allowed in the buffer ANSWER: C
