A) నిర్దిష్ట IP addresses నుండి traffic ను శాశ్వతంగా block చేయడం B) Network link యొక్క మొత్తం bandwidth ను పెంచడం C) Queue నిండక ముందే transmission నెమ్మదింపజేయమని endpoints కి ముందుగానే signal ఇవ్వడం D) Buffer లో అనుమతించే maximum packet size ను పెంచడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary goal of using Random Early Detection (RED) in a network? A) To permanently block traffic from specific IP addresses B) To increase the total bandwidth of the network link C) To proactively signal endpoints to slow transmission before the queue becomes full D) To increase the maximum packet size allowed in the buffer ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental difference between an expert system and a traditional procedural computer program? A) Expert systems use only machine learning, while procedural programs use if-then rules. B) Expert systems can only run on specialized hardware, unlike procedural programs. C) Expert systems are designed to replace the user interface, while procedural programs focus on data storage. D) Expert systems separate domain knowledge from the reasoning logic, while procedural programs embed logic in the code. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Expert system కి సాంప్రదాయ procedural computer program కి మధ్య మౌలిక తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Expert systems machine learning ను మాత్రమే వాడతాయి, procedural programs if-then rules ను వాడతాయి. B) Procedural programs లా కాకుండా expert systems ప్రత్యేక hardware పై మాత్రమే నడుస్తాయి. C) Expert systems user interface ను భర్తీ చేయడానికి రూపొందించబడ్డాయి, procedural programs data storage పై దృష్టి పెడతాయి. D) Expert systems domain knowledge ను reasoning logic నుండి వేరు చేస్తాయి, procedural programs logic ను code లోనే పొందుపరుస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental difference between an expert system and a traditional procedural computer program? A) Expert systems use only machine learning, while procedural programs use if-then rules. B) Expert systems can only run on specialized hardware, unlike procedural programs. C) Expert systems are designed to replace the user interface, while procedural programs focus on data storage. D) Expert systems separate domain knowledge from the reasoning logic, while procedural programs embed logic in the code. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the lumped element model break down when applied to very high-frequency transmission lines? A) Ohm's law ceases to be valid for resistive metallic materials at high frequencies B) Conducting wires lose all self-inductance at high frequencies C) Magnetic fields completely cancel electric fields at high frequencies D) The physical dimensions of the circuit become comparable to or larger than the signal wavelength ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: చాలా high-frequency transmission lines కి apply చేసినప్పుడు lumped element model ఎందుకు విఫలమవుతుంది? A) High frequencies వద్ద resistive metallic materials కి Ohm's law వర్తించదు B) High frequencies వద్ద conducting wires తమ self-inductance మొత్తాన్ని కోల్పోతాయి C) High frequencies వద్ద magnetic fields electric fields ను పూర్తిగా రద్దు చేస్తాయి D) Circuit యొక్క భౌతిక dimensions signal wavelength తో పోల్చదగినవిగా లేదా దాని కంటే పెద్దవిగా అవుతాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does the lumped element model break down when applied to very high-frequency transmission lines? A) Ohm's law ceases to be valid for resistive metallic materials at high frequencies B) Conducting wires lose all self-inductance at high frequencies C) Magnetic fields completely cancel electric fields at high frequencies D) The physical dimensions of the circuit become comparable to or larger than the signal wavelength ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If an electromagnetic wave is propagating through a lossless medium, how does the intrinsic impedance relate the electric field (E) to the magnetic field (H)? A) H is the product of E and the intrinsic impedance B) E and H are independent of the intrinsic impedance C) E equals H squared D) E is the product of H and the intrinsic impedance ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక electromagnetic wave lossless medium గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తుంటే, intrinsic impedance electric field (E) ని magnetic field (H) తో ఎలా సంబంధింపజేస్తుంది? A) H అనేది E మరియు intrinsic impedance యొక్క product B) E మరియు H intrinsic impedance పై ఆధారపడవు C) E అనేది H squared కి సమానం D) E అనేది H మరియు intrinsic impedance యొక్క product జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If an electromagnetic wave is propagating through a lossless medium, how does the intrinsic impedance relate the electric field (E) to the magnetic field (H)? A) H is the product of E and the intrinsic impedance B) E and H are independent of the intrinsic impedance C) E equals H squared D) E is the product of H and the intrinsic impedance ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In multivariate Big O expressions, what does a subscript to the Big O symbol typically indicate about the implied constant? A) The constant is independent of the domain size. B) The constant is always equal to 1. C) The constant depends on one or more specific variables or parameters. D) The constant refers to the error term in a Taylor series. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Multivariate Big O expressions లో Big O symbol కి ఉన్న subscript implied constant గురించి సాధారణంగా ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Constant domain size పై ఆధారపడదు. B) Constant ఎప్పుడూ 1 కి సమానం. C) Constant ఒకటి లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ నిర్దిష్ట variables లేదా parameters పై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. D) Constant Taylor series లోని error term ను సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In multivariate Big O expressions, what does a subscript to the Big O symbol typically indicate about the implied constant? A) The constant is independent of the domain size. B) The constant is always equal to 1. C) The constant depends on one or more specific variables or parameters. D) The constant refers to the error term in a Taylor series. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of a systematic error correction scheme over a non-systematic code? A) It requires fewer check bits to achieve the same level of error correction. B) It allows the receiver to easily access the original data bits without decoding. C) It can be decoded using a simpler Viterbi algorithm. D) It is more resistant to burst errors during transmission. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Non-systematic code కంటే systematic error correction scheme యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అదే స్థాయి error correction సాధించడానికి దానికి తక్కువ check bits అవసరం. B) Decode చేయకుండానే receiver అసలు data bits ను సులభంగా access చేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది. C) దానిని సరళమైన Viterbi algorithm తో decode చేయవచ్చు. D) Transmission సమయంలో burst errors కి అది ఎక్కువ నిరోధకత కలిగి ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of a systematic error correction scheme over a non-systematic code? A) It requires fewer check bits to achieve the same level of error correction. B) It allows the receiver to easily access the original data bits without decoding. C) It can be decoded using a simpler Viterbi algorithm. D) It is more resistant to burst errors during transmission. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a minimax search tree, what is the fundamental assumption the maximizing player makes about the minimizing player's turn? A) The minimizing player will only move if it leads to a draw B) The minimizing player will play randomly C) The minimizing player will choose the move that is best for the minimizing player (worst for the maximizer) D) The minimizing player will cooperate to maximize the total game score ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Minimax search tree లో minimizing player turn గురించి maximizing player చేసుకునే మౌలిక ఊహ ఏమిటి? A) Draw కి దారితీస్తేనే minimizing player move చేస్తాడు B) Minimizing player random గా ఆడతాడు C) Minimizing player తనకు ఉత్తమమైన (maximizer కి చెత్తదైన) move ను ఎంచుకుంటాడు D) మొత్తం game score ను గరిష్ఠం చేయడానికి minimizing player సహకరిస్తాడు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In a minimax search tree, what is the fundamental assumption the maximizing player makes about the minimizing player's turn? A) The minimizing player will only move if it leads to a draw B) The minimizing player will play randomly C) The minimizing player will choose the move that is best for the minimizing player (worst for the maximizer) D) The minimizing player will cooperate to maximize the total game score ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary physical implementation of space-division multiplexing in wireless communications? A) Using multiple antenna elements to form a phased array. B) Using different frequency ranges for each channel. C) Using orthogonal polarization states. D) Using different time slots for each channel. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Wireless communications లో space-division multiplexing యొక్క ప్రధాన భౌతిక implementation ఏమిటి? A) Phased array ను ఏర్పరచడానికి అనేక antenna elements ను వాడడం. B) ప్రతి channel కి వేర్వేరు frequency ranges ను వాడడం. C) Orthogonal polarization states ను వాడడం. D) ప్రతి channel కి వేర్వేరు time slots ను వాడడం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary physical implementation of space-division multiplexing in wireless communications? A) Using multiple antenna elements to form a phased array. B) Using different frequency ranges for each channel. C) Using orthogonal polarization states. D) Using different time slots for each channel. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental difference between combinational logic and sequential logic? A) Combinational logic requires a clock signal, while sequential does not B) Sequential logic is implemented by Boolean circuits, while combinational is not C) Combinational logic lacks memory, whereas sequential logic depends on previous input history D) Sequential logic depends on the present input only, while combinational depends on history ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Combinational logic మరియు sequential logic మధ్య మౌలిక తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Combinational logic కి clock signal అవసరం, sequential కి అవసరం లేదు B) Sequential logic ను Boolean circuits తో implement చేస్తారు, combinational ను కాదు C) Combinational logic కి memory ఉండదు, sequential logic మునుపటి input history పై ఆధారపడుతుంది D) Sequential logic ప్రస్తుత input పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడుతుంది, combinational history పై ఆధారపడుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental difference between combinational logic and sequential logic? A) Combinational logic requires a clock signal, while sequential does not B) Sequential logic is implemented by Boolean circuits, while combinational is not C) Combinational logic lacks memory, whereas sequential logic depends on previous input history D) Sequential logic depends on the present input only, while combinational depends on history ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following conditions must be met for the standard Bernoulli equation to be valid? A) The flow must be viscous and rotational. B) The fluid must have a varying density along the streamline. C) The fluid must be compressible and experiencing heat transfer. D) The flow must be steady, incompressible, and inviscid. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard Bernoulli equation valid అవ్వడానికి కింది షరతుల్లో ఏది నెరవేరాలి? A) Flow viscous మరియు rotational గా ఉండాలి. B) Streamline వెంబడి fluid density మారుతూ ఉండాలి. C) Fluid compressible గా ఉండి heat transfer కి లోనవ్వాలి. D) Flow steady, incompressible మరియు inviscid గా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following conditions must be met for the standard Bernoulli equation to be valid? A) The flow must be viscous and rotational. B) The fluid must have a varying density along the streamline. C) The fluid must be compressible and experiencing heat transfer. D) The flow must be steady, incompressible, and inviscid. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which is true regarding the relationship between control gain and system stability? A) Higher gain always improves stability without exception B) Lower gain always results in faster settling times C) Gain has no effect on the stability of a control loop D) Excessive gain can cause a system to oscillate or diverge ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Control gain మరియు system stability మధ్య సంబంధం గురించి ఏది నిజం? A) ఎక్కువ gain మినహాయింపు లేకుండా ఎప్పుడూ stability ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది B) తక్కువ gain ఎప్పుడూ వేగవంతమైన settling times ను ఇస్తుంది C) Control loop యొక్క stability పై gain ప్రభావం ఉండదు D) అధిక gain వల్ల system oscillate లేదా diverge కావచ్చు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which is true regarding the relationship between control gain and system stability? A) Higher gain always improves stability without exception B) Lower gain always results in faster settling times C) Gain has no effect on the stability of a control loop D) Excessive gain can cause a system to oscillate or diverge ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the determinant of a square matrix if two identical rows are swapped? A) It doubles in magnitude B) It remains unchanged and strictly positive C) It changes sign, which implies its value must be zero D) It becomes one ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక square matrix లోని రెండు ఒకేలాంటి rows ను swap చేస్తే దాని determinant కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) దాని magnitude రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది B) అది మారకుండా ఖచ్చితంగా positive గా ఉంటుంది C) దాని sign మారుతుంది, అంటే దాని value తప్పనిసరిగా zero D) అది one అవుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens to the determinant of a square matrix if two identical rows are swapped? A) It doubles in magnitude B) It remains unchanged and strictly positive C) It changes sign, which implies its value must be zero D) It becomes one ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary difference between a synchronous motor and an induction motor regarding rotor speed? A) Synchronous motors require slip to maintain constant speed. B) Synchronous motors rotate at a speed locked to the supply frequency without slip. C) Both motors must operate at slightly different frequencies than the stator field. D) Induction motors rotate at a speed locked to the line frequency. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Rotor speed విషయంలో synchronous motor మరియు induction motor మధ్య ప్రధాన తేడా ఏమిటి? A) స్థిరమైన speed కోసం synchronous motors కి slip అవసరం. B) Synchronous motors slip లేకుండా supply frequency కి lock అయిన speed తో తిరుగుతాయి. C) రెండు motors stator field కంటే కొద్దిగా భిన్నమైన frequencies వద్ద పనిచేయాలి. D) Induction motors line frequency కి lock అయిన speed తో తిరుగుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary difference between a synchronous motor and an induction motor regarding rotor speed? A) Synchronous motors require slip to maintain constant speed. B) Synchronous motors rotate at a speed locked to the supply frequency without slip. C) Both motors must operate at slightly different frequencies than the stator field. D) Induction motors rotate at a speed locked to the line frequency. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary effect of unintended capacitive coupling in a circuit? A) It creates a direct short between power supply rails B) It increases the thermal noise of resistive elements C) It causes ground loops between different chassis points D) It allows an AC signal from one part of the circuit to induce noise in another part ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక circuit లో అనుకోని capacitive coupling యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రభావం ఏమిటి? A) అది power supply rails మధ్య direct short ను సృష్టిస్తుంది B) అది resistive elements యొక్క thermal noise ను పెంచుతుంది C) అది వేర్వేరు chassis points మధ్య ground loops ను కలిగిస్తుంది D) Circuit లోని ఒక భాగం నుండి వచ్చే AC signal మరో భాగంలో noise ను induce చేయడానికి అది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary effect of unintended capacitive coupling in a circuit? A) It creates a direct short between power supply rails B) It increases the thermal noise of resistive elements C) It causes ground loops between different chassis points D) It allows an AC signal from one part of the circuit to induce noise in another part ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of the backpropagation algorithm in a neural network? A) To pre-process input data before it enters the network B) To efficiently compute the gradient of the loss function for weight updates C) To select the optimal activation function for the hidden layers D) To randomly initialize the network weights ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Neural network లో backpropagation algorithm యొక్క ప్రధాన పని ఏమిటి? A) Network లోకి ప్రవేశించే ముందు input data ను pre-process చేయడం B) Weight updates కోసం loss function యొక్క gradient ను సమర్థవంతంగా compute చేయడం C) Hidden layers కి optimal activation function ను ఎంచుకోవడం D) Network weights ను random గా initialize చేయడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of the backpropagation algorithm in a neural network? A) To pre-process input data before it enters the network B) To efficiently compute the gradient of the loss function for weight updates C) To select the optimal activation function for the hidden layers D) To randomly initialize the network weights ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the vanishing gradient problem primarily occur in classic RNNs during training? A) Because the input data is too complex for neural networks B) Because backpropagation is not applicable to sequential data C) Because the hidden state becomes too large to compute D) Because gradients are repeatedly multiplied by small weights during backpropagation through time ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Training సమయంలో classic RNNs లో vanishing gradient problem ప్రధానంగా ఎందుకు వస్తుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే input data neural networks కి చాలా సంక్లిష్టమైనది B) ఎందుకంటే sequential data కి backpropagation వర్తించదు C) ఎందుకంటే hidden state compute చేయడానికి చాలా పెద్దదవుతుంది D) ఎందుకంటే backpropagation through time సమయంలో gradients చిన్న weights తో పదే పదే గుణించబడతాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does the vanishing gradient problem primarily occur in classic RNNs during training? A) Because the input data is too complex for neural networks B) Because backpropagation is not applicable to sequential data C) Because the hidden state becomes too large to compute D) Because gradients are repeatedly multiplied by small weights during backpropagation through time ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of the inversion layer in a MOSFET? A) To allow current to flow between source and drain B) To define the threshold voltage value C) To prevent gate leakage current D) To act as an insulating barrier ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: MOSFET లో inversion layer యొక్క ప్రధాన పని ఏమిటి? A) Source మరియు drain మధ్య current ప్రవహించడానికి వీలు కల్పించడం B) Threshold voltage value ను నిర్వచించడం C) Gate leakage current ను నిరోధించడం D) Insulating barrier గా పనిచేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of the inversion layer in a MOSFET? A) To allow current to flow between source and drain B) To define the threshold voltage value C) To prevent gate leakage current D) To act as an insulating barrier ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary mechanism by which a ferroresonant transformer regulates voltage? A) By adjusting the input frequency. B) By physically rotating the secondary coil. C) By utilizing magnetic saturation in the core. D) By using active semiconductor switches. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Ferroresonant transformer voltage ను regulate చేసే ప్రధాన mechanism ఏమిటి? A) Input frequency ని సర్దుబాటు చేయడం ద్వారా. B) Secondary coil ను భౌతికంగా తిప్పడం ద్వారా. C) Core లో magnetic saturation ను ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా. D) Active semiconductor switches ను వాడడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary mechanism by which a ferroresonant transformer regulates voltage? A) By adjusting the input frequency. B) By physically rotating the secondary coil. C) By utilizing magnetic saturation in the core. D) By using active semiconductor switches. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a power series is differentiated term-by-term inside its open interval of convergence, how does its radius of convergence change? A) It decreases by half B) It changes depending on the constant term C) It increases to infinity D) It remains strictly unchanged ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక power series ను దాని open interval of convergence లోపల term-by-term differentiate చేస్తే, దాని radius of convergence ఎలా మారుతుంది? A) అది సగానికి తగ్గుతుంది B) Constant term ను బట్టి అది మారుతుంది C) అది infinity కి పెరుగుతుంది D) అది ఖచ్చితంగా మారకుండా ఉంటుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a power series is differentiated term-by-term inside its open interval of convergence, how does its radius of convergence change? A) It decreases by half B) It changes depending on the constant term C) It increases to infinity D) It remains strictly unchanged ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of an anisotropic material? A) It has a lower Young's modulus than isotropic materials B) Its Young's modulus is the same in all directions C) Its mechanical properties depend on the direction of the applied force D) It always behaves non-linearly under stress ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Anisotropic material యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) దానికి isotropic materials కంటే తక్కువ Young's modulus ఉంటుంది B) దాని Young's modulus అన్ని directions లో ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది C) దాని mechanical properties applied force యొక్క direction పై ఆధారపడి ఉంటాయి D) Stress కింద అది ఎప్పుడూ non-linear గా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of an anisotropic material? A) It has a lower Young's modulus than isotropic materials B) Its Young's modulus is the same in all directions C) Its mechanical properties depend on the direction of the applied force D) It always behaves non-linearly under stress ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental requirement for a system to be considered controllable? A) The system must have a single input and output. B) Any initial state must be transferable to any final state in finite time. C) The system's output must be observable over time. D) The system must be linear and time-invariant. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక system ను controllable గా పరిగణించడానికి మౌలిక అవసరం ఏమిటి? A) System కి ఒకే input మరియు output ఉండాలి. B) ఏ initial state నైనా finite time లో ఏ final state కైనా మార్చగలగాలి. C) System output కాలక్రమేణా observable గా ఉండాలి. D) System linear మరియు time-invariant గా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental requirement for a system to be considered controllable? A) The system must have a single input and output. B) Any initial state must be transferable to any final state in finite time. C) The system's output must be observable over time. D) The system must be linear and time-invariant. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) over traditional FDM? A) It eliminates the need for a guard band between adjacent subcarriers. B) It transmits data at a much higher symbol rate per subcarrier. C) It uses fewer total subcarriers to transmit the same amount of data. D) It requires less complex modulation schemes like BPSK or QPSK. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: సాంప్రదాయ FDM కంటే Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) ను వాడడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) పక్కపక్కన ఉన్న subcarriers మధ్య guard band అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. B) అది ఒక్కో subcarrier కి చాలా ఎక్కువ symbol rate తో data ను transmit చేస్తుంది. C) అదే మొత్తం data ను transmit చేయడానికి అది తక్కువ మొత్తం subcarriers ను వాడుతుంది. D) దానికి BPSK లేదా QPSK వంటి తక్కువ సంక్లిష్ట modulation schemes అవసరం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) over traditional FDM? A) It eliminates the need for a guard band between adjacent subcarriers. B) It transmits data at a much higher symbol rate per subcarrier. C) It uses fewer total subcarriers to transmit the same amount of data. D) It requires less complex modulation schemes like BPSK or QPSK. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a circuit has a Thévenin voltage of 12 V and a Thévenin resistance of 4 Ω, what are the values of its Norton equivalent? A) 48 A in parallel with 4 Ω B) 12 A in parallel with 3 Ω C) 3 A in series with 4 Ω D) 3 A in parallel with 4 Ω ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక circuit కి Thévenin voltage 12 V మరియు Thévenin resistance 4 Ω అయితే, దాని Norton equivalent values ఏమిటి? A) 4 Ω తో parallel లో 48 A B) 3 Ω తో parallel లో 12 A C) 4 Ω తో series లో 3 A D) 4 Ω తో parallel లో 3 A జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a circuit has a Thévenin voltage of 12 V and a Thévenin resistance of 4 Ω, what are the values of its Norton equivalent? A) 48 A in parallel with 4 Ω B) 12 A in parallel with 3 Ω C) 3 A in series with 4 Ω D) 3 A in parallel with 4 Ω ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How can the Cauchy–Riemann equations be expressed using the Wirtinger derivative with respect to the complex conjugate z̄? A) ∂f/∂z̄ = ∂f/∂z B) ∂f/∂z = 0 C) ∂²f/∂z∂z̄ = 0 D) ∂f/∂z̄ = 0 ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex conjugate z̄ కి సంబంధించి Wirtinger derivative ను వాడి Cauchy–Riemann equations ను ఎలా వ్యక్తపరచవచ్చు? A) ∂f/∂z̄ = ∂f/∂z B) ∂f/∂z = 0 C) ∂²f/∂z∂z̄ = 0 D) ∂f/∂z̄ = 0 జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How can the Cauchy–Riemann equations be expressed using the Wirtinger derivative with respect to the complex conjugate z̄? A) ∂f/∂z̄ = ∂f/∂z B) ∂f/∂z = 0 C) ∂²f/∂z∂z̄ = 0 D) ∂f/∂z̄ = 0 ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is RSA considered a public-key cryptosystem? A) Because it was developed by multiple researchers simultaneously B) Because it uses symmetric key exchange protocols C) Because the same key is used for both encryption and decryption D) Because it relies on the difficulty of factoring large prime numbers ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: RSA ను public-key cryptosystem గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే దానిని అనేక researchers ఒకేసారి అభివృద్ధి చేశారు B) ఎందుకంటే అది symmetric key exchange protocols ను వాడుతుంది C) ఎందుకంటే encryption మరియు decryption రెండింటికీ ఒకే key వాడతారు D) ఎందుకంటే అది పెద్ద prime numbers ను factor చేయడంలో ఉన్న కష్టంపై ఆధారపడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is RSA considered a public-key cryptosystem? A) Because it was developed by multiple researchers simultaneously B) Because it uses symmetric key exchange protocols C) Because the same key is used for both encryption and decryption D) Because it relies on the difficulty of factoring large prime numbers ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the root locus method primarily used for analyzing feedback control systems? A) To calculate the exact transfer function coefficients B) To graphically determine how system stability changes with a varying gain parameter C) To find the steady-state error for a given input D) To convert a system from the time domain to the frequency domain ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Feedback control systems ను analyze చేయడానికి root locus method ను ప్రధానంగా ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) ఖచ్చితమైన transfer function coefficients ను లెక్కించడానికి B) మారుతున్న gain parameter తో system stability ఎలా మారుతుందో graphically నిర్ణయించడానికి C) ఇచ్చిన input కి steady-state error ను కనుగొనడానికి D) System ను time domain నుండి frequency domain కి మార్చడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the root locus method primarily used for analyzing feedback control systems? A) To calculate the exact transfer function coefficients B) To graphically determine how system stability changes with a varying gain parameter C) To find the steady-state error for a given input D) To convert a system from the time domain to the frequency domain ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: If a lexer encounters the input '==' and the rules allow both '=' and '==', which rule dictates it selects '=='? A) Backtracking B) Lookahead C) Maximal munch D) Minimum match ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక lexer కి input '==' ఎదురై, rules '=' మరియు '==' రెండింటినీ అనుమతిస్తే, అది '==' ను ఎంచుకోవాలని ఏ rule నిర్దేశిస్తుంది? A) Backtracking B) Lookahead C) Maximal munch D) Minimum match జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: If a lexer encounters the input '==' and the rules allow both '=' and '==', which rule dictates it selects '=='? A) Backtracking B) Lookahead C) Maximal munch D) Minimum match ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the value of a probability density function (PDF) at a specific point not equal to the probability of the random variable taking that exact value? A) Because PDF values must always sum to zero across the sample space B) Because the cumulative distribution function is non-continuous C) Because the probability of a continuous random variable taking any exact single point is zero D) Because PDFs apply only to discrete random variables ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట point వద్ద probability density function (PDF) value, random variable సరిగ్గా ఆ value తీసుకునే probability కి ఎందుకు సమానం కాదు? A) ఎందుకంటే sample space అంతటా PDF values sum ఎప్పుడూ zero కావాలి B) ఎందుకంటే cumulative distribution function non-continuous C) ఎందుకంటే continuous random variable ఏదైనా ఒక ఖచ్చితమైన point ను తీసుకునే probability zero D) ఎందుకంటే PDFs discrete random variables కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the value of a probability density function (PDF) at a specific point not equal to the probability of the random variable taking that exact value? A) Because PDF values must always sum to zero across the sample space B) Because the cumulative distribution function is non-continuous C) Because the probability of a continuous random variable taking any exact single point is zero D) Because PDFs apply only to discrete random variables ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a modern OS give each application a share of CPU time? A) To reduce the need for system calls between applications B) To ensure applications can run faster than the hardware allows C) To prevent one program from monopolizing limited hardware resources D) To increase the physical memory capacity of the computer ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఆధునిక OS ప్రతి application కి CPU time లో ఒక వాటా ఎందుకు ఇస్తుంది? A) Applications మధ్య system calls అవసరాన్ని తగ్గించడానికి B) Hardware అనుమతించే దాని కంటే applications వేగంగా నడిచేలా చూడడానికి C) పరిమిత hardware resources ను ఒకే program గుత్తాధిపత్యం చేయకుండా నిరోధించడానికి D) Computer యొక్క physical memory capacity ని పెంచడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does a modern OS give each application a share of CPU time? A) To reduce the need for system calls between applications B) To ensure applications can run faster than the hardware allows C) To prevent one program from monopolizing limited hardware resources D) To increase the physical memory capacity of the computer ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of continuous integration in software engineering? A) To manually review all code changes before merging B) To deploy software directly to users without testing C) To manage project timelines and schedules D) To frequently integrate code changes and automatically verify the build state ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Software engineering లో continuous integration యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Merge చేసే ముందు అన్ని code changes ను manual గా review చేయడం B) Testing లేకుండా software ను నేరుగా users కి deploy చేయడం C) Project timelines మరియు schedules ను నిర్వహించడం D) Code changes ను తరచుగా integrate చేసి build state ను స్వయంచాలకంగా verify చేయడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of continuous integration in software engineering? A) To manually review all code changes before merging B) To deploy software directly to users without testing C) To manage project timelines and schedules D) To frequently integrate code changes and automatically verify the build state ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does self-supervised learning generate supervisory signals without external labels? A) By creating pseudo-labels from the data itself through transformations B) By using manually annotated ground truth data C) By using pre-trained models from supervised learning D) By relying solely on unsupervised clustering algorithms ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: బయటి labels లేకుండా self-supervised learning supervisory signals ను ఎలా generate చేస్తుంది? A) Transformations ద్వారా data నుండే pseudo-labels ను సృష్టించడం ద్వారా B) Manual గా annotate చేసిన ground truth data ను వాడడం ద్వారా C) Supervised learning నుండి pre-trained models ను వాడడం ద్వారా D) Unsupervised clustering algorithms పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does self-supervised learning generate supervisory signals without external labels? A) By creating pseudo-labels from the data itself through transformations B) By using manually annotated ground truth data C) By using pre-trained models from supervised learning D) By relying solely on unsupervised clustering algorithms ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What allows Gaussian quadrature to integrate higher-degree polynomials exactly compared to Newton-Cotes formulas using the same number of points? A) It restricts evaluation exclusively to uniformly spaced points B) It avoids evaluating the integrand anywhere within the interior of the domain C) Both the evaluation nodes and their weights are treated as free variables to be optimized D) It uses symbolic differentiation instead of function evaluations ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: అదే సంఖ్యలో points ను వాడే Newton-Cotes formulas తో పోలిస్తే Gaussian quadrature ఎక్కువ degree ఉన్న polynomials ను ఖచ్చితంగా integrate చేయడానికి ఏది వీలు కల్పిస్తుంది? A) అది evaluation ను సమాన దూరంలో ఉన్న points కి మాత్రమే పరిమితం చేస్తుంది B) Domain లోపల ఎక్కడా integrand ను evaluate చేయకుండా అది నివారిస్తుంది C) Evaluation nodes మరియు వాటి weights రెండింటినీ optimize చేయవలసిన free variables గా పరిగణిస్తారు D) అది function evaluations బదులు symbolic differentiation ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What allows Gaussian quadrature to integrate higher-degree polynomials exactly compared to Newton-Cotes formulas using the same number of points? A) It restricts evaluation exclusively to uniformly spaced points B) It avoids evaluating the integrand anywhere within the interior of the domain C) Both the evaluation nodes and their weights are treated as free variables to be optimized D) It uses symbolic differentiation instead of function evaluations ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does unsupervised learning primarily differ from supervised learning in terms of data processing? A) It relies on human experts to correct errors at every step. B) It requires a specific 'target' variable to function correctly. C) It uses only labeled data to predict future outputs. D) It identifies patterns in unlabeled data without predefined target outputs. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Data processing విషయంలో unsupervised learning supervised learning నుండి ప్రధానంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) ప్రతి step లో errors సరిచేయడానికి అది human experts పై ఆధారపడుతుంది. B) సరిగ్గా పనిచేయడానికి దానికి నిర్దిష్ట 'target' variable అవసరం. C) భవిష్యత్ outputs ను predict చేయడానికి అది labeled data ను మాత్రమే వాడుతుంది. D) ముందే నిర్వచించిన target outputs లేకుండా unlabeled data లో patterns ను అది గుర్తిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does unsupervised learning primarily differ from supervised learning in terms of data processing? A) It relies on human experts to correct errors at every step. B) It requires a specific 'target' variable to function correctly. C) It uses only labeled data to predict future outputs. D) It identifies patterns in unlabeled data without predefined target outputs. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of the BM25 algorithm, what is the primary role of the IDF component? A) To rank documents based solely on their total word length. B) To count how many times a term appears in one document. C) To determine the number of documents in the collection. D) To assign higher weights to rare, informative terms and lower weights to common, non-informative terms. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: BM25 algorithm సందర్భంలో IDF component యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Documents ను వాటి మొత్తం word length ఆధారంగా మాత్రమే rank చేయడం. B) ఒక document లో ఒక term ఎన్నిసార్లు కనిపిస్తుందో లెక్కించడం. C) Collection లోని documents సంఖ్యను నిర్ణయించడం. D) అరుదైన, సమాచారం ఉన్న terms కి ఎక్కువ weights ను, సాధారణ, సమాచారం లేని terms కి తక్కువ weights ను కేటాయించడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of the BM25 algorithm, what is the primary role of the IDF component? A) To rank documents based solely on their total word length. B) To count how many times a term appears in one document. C) To determine the number of documents in the collection. D) To assign higher weights to rare, informative terms and lower weights to common, non-informative terms. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is knowing the step response of a dynamical system important for overall system performance? A) It is the only way to measure the system's static gain accurately. B) It reveals potential large, fast deviations from steady state that could damage components or delay the system. C) It simplifies the mathematical description of the system to a single pole. D) It directly determines the system's frequency response characteristics. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: మొత్తం system performance కి ఒక dynamical system యొక్క step response తెలుసుకోవడం ఎందుకు ముఖ్యం? A) System యొక్క static gain ను ఖచ్చితంగా కొలవడానికి అదే ఏకైక మార్గం. B) Components ను పాడు చేయగల లేదా system ను ఆలస్యం చేయగల steady state నుండి పెద్ద, వేగవంతమైన విచలనాలను అది బయటపెడుతుంది. C) అది system యొక్క గణిత వివరణను ఒకే pole కి సరళీకరిస్తుంది. D) అది system యొక్క frequency response లక్షణాలను నేరుగా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is knowing the step response of a dynamical system important for overall system performance? A) It is the only way to measure the system's static gain accurately. B) It reveals potential large, fast deviations from steady state that could damage components or delay the system. C) It simplifies the mathematical description of the system to a single pole. D) It directly determines the system's frequency response characteristics. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What phenomenon in deep GNNs is characterized by node representations converging to a uniform value? A) Oversquashing, where the receptive field becomes too large. B) Oversmoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable. C) Vanishing gradients, where updates become negligible. D) Exploding gradients, where updates become excessively large. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Deep GNNs లో node representations ఒకే value కి converge అవ్వడం ఏ phenomenon యొక్క లక్షణం? A) Oversquashing, ఇందులో receptive field చాలా పెద్దదవుతుంది. B) Oversmoothing, ఇందులో node representations ఒకదాని నుండి మరొకటి వేరు చేయలేనివిగా అవుతాయి. C) Vanishing gradients, ఇందులో updates నామమాత్రంగా అవుతాయి. D) Exploding gradients, ఇందులో updates అతిగా పెద్దవి అవుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What phenomenon in deep GNNs is characterized by node representations converging to a uniform value? A) Oversquashing, where the receptive field becomes too large. B) Oversmoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable. C) Vanishing gradients, where updates become negligible. D) Exploding gradients, where updates become excessively large. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What does it mean if a root locus plot has branches in the right half of the s-plane? A) The system is marginally stable B) The system is critically damped C) The system is unstable because poles have positive real parts D) The system has a high damping ratio ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Root locus plot కి s-plane యొక్క right half లో branches ఉంటే దాని అర్థం ఏమిటి? A) System marginally stable B) System critically damped C) Poles కి positive real parts ఉన్నందున system unstable D) System కి ఎక్కువ damping ratio ఉంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What does it mean if a root locus plot has branches in the right half of the s-plane? A) The system is marginally stable B) The system is critically damped C) The system is unstable because poles have positive real parts D) The system has a high damping ratio ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why do B+ trees generally outperform Binary Search Trees in disk-based storage systems? A) They have a higher fanout, leading to fewer I/O operations B) Binary trees are not used in databases C) They store data in internal nodes for faster access D) They require less memory for pointers ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Disk-based storage systems లో B+ trees సాధారణంగా Binary Search Trees కంటే ఎందుకు మెరుగ్గా పనిచేస్తాయి? A) వాటికి ఎక్కువ fanout ఉంటుంది, దాంతో తక్కువ I/O operations అవసరమవుతాయి B) Databases లో binary trees ను వాడరు C) వేగవంతమైన access కోసం అవి data ను internal nodes లో store చేస్తాయి D) వాటికి pointers కోసం తక్కువ memory అవసరం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why do B+ trees generally outperform Binary Search Trees in disk-based storage systems? A) They have a higher fanout, leading to fewer I/O operations B) Binary trees are not used in databases C) They store data in internal nodes for faster access D) They require less memory for pointers ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary benefit of co-location in an agile team? A) It enables face-to-face conversation, which is the most efficient way to convey information and establish team identity. B) It ensures that all team members use the exact same hardware and software tools. C) It guarantees that the project will be completed ahead of schedule. D) It reduces the need for any communication at all. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Agile team లో co-location యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది ముఖాముఖి సంభాషణను సాధ్యం చేస్తుంది, సమాచారాన్ని అందించడానికి మరియు team identity ని ఏర్పరచడానికి అదే అత్యంత సమర్థవంతమైన మార్గం. B) Team సభ్యులందరూ ఒకే hardware మరియు software tools ను వాడేలా అది చూస్తుంది. C) Project schedule కంటే ముందే పూర్తవుతుందని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) అది ఎలాంటి communication అవసరాన్నైనా తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary benefit of co-location in an agile team? A) It enables face-to-face conversation, which is the most efficient way to convey information and establish team identity. B) It ensures that all team members use the exact same hardware and software tools. C) It guarantees that the project will be completed ahead of schedule. D) It reduces the need for any communication at all. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the F1-score considered a harmonic mean rather than a simple arithmetic mean of precision and recall? A) To allow the metric to handle negative values in the confusion matrix B) Because harmonic means are easier to calculate computationally than arithmetic means C) To punish extreme values and ensure a high score requires both precision and recall to be high D) To force the metric to always equal 1.0 regardless of model performance ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: F1-score ను precision మరియు recall యొక్క సాధారణ arithmetic mean గా కాకుండా harmonic mean గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) Confusion matrix లోని negative values ను metric handle చేయడానికి వీలుగా B) ఎందుకంటే harmonic means ను arithmetic means కంటే computationally సులభంగా లెక్కించవచ్చు C) తీవ్ర values ను శిక్షించి, ఎక్కువ score రావాలంటే precision మరియు recall రెండూ ఎక్కువగా ఉండేలా చూడడానికి D) Model performance తో సంబంధం లేకుండా metric ఎప్పుడూ 1.0 కి సమానం అయ్యేలా బలవంతం చేయడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the F1-score considered a harmonic mean rather than a simple arithmetic mean of precision and recall? A) To allow the metric to handle negative values in the confusion matrix B) Because harmonic means are easier to calculate computationally than arithmetic means C) To punish extreme values and ensure a high score requires both precision and recall to be high D) To force the metric to always equal 1.0 regardless of model performance ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is only one clustered index typically allowed per table? A) Because it would violate database constraints B) Because it would slow down write operations C) Because the physical data can only be ordered in one way D) Because it would consume too much storage space ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If u(x, y) is the real part of an analytic function f(z), what equation does u necessarily satisfy? A) Poisson's equation with nonzero charge density B) Laplace's equation (∇²u = 0) C) Wave equation (∂²u/∂t² = c²∇²u) D) Helmholtz equation (∇²u + k²u = 0) ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What characterizes a local automaton's language recognition? A) It is recognized by a Myhill graph B) It is determined by a sliding window of length two C) It is determined by the entire input string D) It requires an even number of 0s ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What characterizes a local automaton's language recognition? A) It is recognized by a Myhill graph B) It is determined by a sliding window of length two C) It is determined by the entire input string D) It requires an even number of 0s ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What causes the accumulation of charges on one side of a current-carrying conductor during the Hall effect? A) Lattice లోని fixed ions మధ్య electrostatic repulsion B) Current ప్రవాహం వల్ల conductor యొక్క thermal expansion C) బరువైన charge carriers పై పనిచేసే gravitational attraction D) Charge carrier trajectories ను వంచే transverse magnetic force జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What causes the accumulation of charges on one side of a current-carrying conductor during the Hall effect? A) Electrostatic repulsion between fixed ions in the lattice B) Thermal expansion of the conductor under current flow C) Gravitational attraction acting on heavy charge carriers D) The transverse magnetic force bending charge carrier trajectories ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the S-box in the SubBytes step constructed to enhance security? input: to Telugu: Q: According to the Wiener-Khinchin theorem, what two functions form a Fourier transform pair? A) Energy spectral density మరియు autocorrelation function B) Power spectral density మరియు cross-correlation function C) Fourier transform మరియు signal యొక్క time derivative D) Signal మరియు దాని autocorrelation function జవాబు: A

A) The energy spectral density and the autocorrelation function B) The power spectral density and the cross-correlation function C) The Fourier transform and the signal's time derivative D) The signal and its autocorrelation function ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is part-of-speech tagging more complex than simply matching words to a fixed list of categories? A) Because many words can function as different parts of speech depending on their grammatical context. B) Because computational systems cannot store large dictionaries of words and their parts of speech. C) Because algorithms are unable to process semantic information like word meanings. D) Because natural languages have fewer parts of speech than artificial languages. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Words ను fixed categories list తో కేవలం match చేయడం కంటే part-of-speech tagging ఎందుకు ఎక్కువ సంక్లిష్టమైనది? A) ఎందుకంటే చాలా words వాటి grammatical context ను బట్టి వేర్వేరు parts of speech గా పనిచేయగలవు. B) ఎందుకంటే computational systems words మరియు వాటి parts of speech ఉన్న పెద్ద dictionaries ను store చేయలేవు. C) ఎందుకంటే word meanings వంటి semantic information ను algorithms process చేయలేవు. D) ఎందుకంటే natural languages లో artificial languages కంటే తక్కువ parts of speech ఉంటాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is part-of-speech tagging more complex than simply matching words to a fixed list of categories? A) Because many words can function as different parts of speech depending on their grammatical context. B) Because computational systems cannot store large dictionaries of words and their parts of speech. C) Because algorithms are unable to process semantic information like word meanings. D) Because natural languages have fewer parts of speech than artificial languages. ANSWER: A

B) Current demand తగ్గి, transmission line losses తగ్గుతాయి. C) Reactive power పెరిగే కొద్దీ current demand zero కి పడిపోతుంది. D) Current demand పెరిగి, ఎక్కువ system line losses కి దారితీస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens to the current demand of an AC load if its power factor decreases while maintaining constant real power delivery? A) The current demand remains unchanged because real power is constant. B) The current demand decreases, reducing transmission line losses. C) The current demand drops to zero as reactive power increases. D) The current demand increases, leading to higher system line losses. ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: Which factor most influences the quality of the K-means solution? A) The image resolution B) The initial set of clusters and the value of K C) The number of pixels in the image D) The color depth of the image ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens when an IP datagram exceeds the MTU of an intermediate link? A) The link automatically increases its MTU to accommodate the larger packet. B) The transport layer resends the data using a different protocol. C) The datagram is dropped and an ICMP error message is sent to the source. D) The datagram is fragmented into smaller units by the IP layer. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక IP datagram మధ్యలోని link యొక్క MTU ని మించితే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) పెద్ద packet కి సరిపడేలా link తన MTU ని స్వయంచాలకంగా పెంచుకుంటుంది. B) Transport layer వేరే protocol ను వాడి data ను మళ్లీ పంపుతుంది. C) Datagram drop చేయబడి source కి ICMP error message పంపబడుతుంది. D) IP layer datagram ను చిన్న units గా fragment చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens when an IP datagram exceeds the MTU of an intermediate link? A) The link automatically increases its MTU to accommodate the larger packet. B) The transport layer resends the data using a different protocol. C) The datagram is dropped and an ICMP error message is sent to the source. D) The datagram is fragmented into smaller units by the IP layer. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which data type is most naturally processed using structural recursion? A) A string of characters. B) A linked list defined inductively. C) A hash map with key-value pairs. D) An array with a fixed size. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the killer heuristic in game tree search? A) To limit the search to a fixed window size. B) To store the best move found at each depth for reuse. C) To force a beta-cutoff by re-examining the last move that caused a cutoff. D) To prioritize captures over non-capturing moves. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Game tree search లో killer heuristic యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Search ను fixed window size కి పరిమితం చేయడం. B) ప్రతి depth వద్ద కనుగొన్న best move ను మళ్లీ వాడడానికి store చేయడం. C) Cutoff కి కారణమైన చివరి move ను మళ్లీ పరిశీలించి beta-cutoff ను బలవంతం చేయడం. D) Non-capturing moves కంటే captures కి ప్రాధాన్యత ఇవ్వడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the killer heuristic in game tree search? A) To limit the search to a fixed window size. B) To store the best move found at each depth for reuse. C) To force a beta-cutoff by re-examining the last move that caused a cutoff. D) To prioritize captures over non-capturing moves. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How can binary search be used to count the number of elements within a specific range [a, b] in a sorted array? A) Binary search cannot be used for range queries. B) By subtracting the rank of 'a' from the rank of 'b'. C) By performing a linear search between a and b. D) By dividing the array into three parts and searching each. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Sorted array లో నిర్దిష్ట range [a, b] లోని elements సంఖ్యను లెక్కించడానికి binary search ను ఎలా వాడవచ్చు? A) Range queries కి binary search ను వాడలేము. B) 'b' rank నుండి 'a' rank ను తీసివేయడం ద్వారా. C) a మరియు b మధ్య linear search చేయడం ద్వారా. D) Array ను మూడు భాగాలుగా విభజించి ప్రతి దానిలో search చేయడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How can binary search be used to count the number of elements within a specific range [a, b] in a sorted array? A) Binary search cannot be used for range queries. B) By subtracting the rank of 'a' from the rank of 'b'. C) By performing a linear search between a and b. D) By dividing the array into three parts and searching each. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Heapsort considered an 'in-place' sorting algorithm? A) It does not require recursion to function. B) It utilizes the existing array to store the heap, requiring no additional storage proportional to the input size. C) It always sorts the array in ascending order without swapping elements. D) It uses a fixed amount of extra memory regardless of the input size. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Heapsort ను 'in-place' sorting algorithm గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) పనిచేయడానికి దానికి recursion అవసరం లేదు. B) Heap ను store చేయడానికి అది ఉన్న array నే వాడుకుంటుంది, input size కి అనుపాతంలో అదనపు storage అవసరం లేదు. C) Elements ను swap చేయకుండా అది ఎప్పుడూ array ను ascending order లో sort చేస్తుంది. D) Input size తో సంబంధం లేకుండా అది స్థిరమైన అదనపు memory ను వాడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Heapsort considered an 'in-place' sorting algorithm? A) It does not require recursion to function. B) It utilizes the existing array to store the heap, requiring no additional storage proportional to the input size. C) It always sorts the array in ascending order without swapping elements. D) It uses a fixed amount of extra memory regardless of the input size. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Direct Form II realization often preferred over Direct Form I in digital filter implementation? A) It eliminates all potential for numerical overflow. B) It always uses fewer delay elements for a given order N. C) It avoids the use of coefficients entirely. D) It is fundamentally more stable for non-linear systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital filter implementation లో Direct Form I కంటే Direct Form II realization ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) అది numerical overflow యొక్క అన్ని అవకాశాలను తొలగిస్తుంది. B) ఇచ్చిన order N కి అది ఎప్పుడూ తక్కువ delay elements ను వాడుతుంది. C) అది coefficients వాడకాన్ని పూర్తిగా నివారిస్తుంది. D) Non-linear systems కి అది మౌలికంగా ఎక్కువ stable. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Direct Form II realization often preferred over Direct Form I in digital filter implementation? A) It eliminates all potential for numerical overflow. B) It always uses fewer delay elements for a given order N. C) It avoids the use of coefficients entirely. D) It is fundamentally more stable for non-linear systems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of a bounding function in a branch-and-bound algorithm? A) To provide an estimate that allows the algorithm to prune suboptimal branches. B) To initialize the queue with heuristic solutions. C) To compute the exact value of the objective function for a candidate solution. D) To determine the branching rule for partitioning the search space. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Branch-and-bound algorithm లో bounding function యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Suboptimal branches ను algorithm prune చేయడానికి వీలు కల్పించే అంచనాను అందించడం. B) Heuristic solutions తో queue ను initialize చేయడం. C) ఒక candidate solution కి objective function యొక్క ఖచ్చితమైన value ను compute చేయడం. D) Search space ను విభజించడానికి branching rule ను నిర్ణయించడం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of a bounding function in a branch-and-bound algorithm? A) To provide an estimate that allows the algorithm to prune suboptimal branches. B) To initialize the queue with heuristic solutions. C) To compute the exact value of the objective function for a candidate solution. D) To determine the branching rule for partitioning the search space. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In phasor domain analysis, taking the time derivative of a sinusoidal quantity d/dt corresponds to which algebraic operation? A) Multiplying the phasor by jω B) Shifting the phasor angle by -90 degrees without scaling C) Dividing the phasor by jω D) Multiplying the phasor by -ω^2 ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Phasor domain analysis లో sinusoidal quantity యొక్క time derivative d/dt తీసుకోవడం ఏ algebraic operation కి సమానం? A) Phasor ను jω తో గుణించడం B) Scaling లేకుండా phasor angle ను -90 degrees shift చేయడం C) Phasor ను jω తో భాగించడం D) Phasor ను -ω^2 తో గుణించడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In phasor domain analysis, taking the time derivative of a sinusoidal quantity d/dt corresponds to which algebraic operation? A) Multiplying the phasor by jω B) Shifting the phasor angle by -90 degrees without scaling C) Dividing the phasor by jω D) Multiplying the phasor by -ω^2 ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: When is a force modeled as a sliding vector? A) When the body is non-rigid and stress matters. B) When the body is a particle and rotation is irrelevant. C) When representing the resultant of two forces graphically. D) When analyzing forces on a rigid extended body. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక force ను sliding vector గా ఎప్పుడు model చేస్తారు? A) Body non-rigid అయి stress ముఖ్యమైనప్పుడు. B) Body ఒక particle అయి rotation అప్రస్తుతమైనప్పుడు. C) రెండు forces యొక్క resultant ను graphically సూచించేటప్పుడు. D) ఒక rigid extended body పై forces ను analyze చేసేటప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: When is a force modeled as a sliding vector? A) When the body is non-rigid and stress matters. B) When the body is a particle and rotation is irrelevant. C) When representing the resultant of two forces graphically. D) When analyzing forces on a rigid extended body. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is edge detection considered a fundamental tool in image processing and computer vision? A) It increases the amount of data to be processed by adding structural information. B) It is only used for detecting changes in scene illumination. C) It is primarily used for color correction in images. D) It reduces data by filtering out less relevant information while preserving important structural properties. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Image processing మరియు computer vision లో edge detection ను మౌలిక tool గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) Structural information జోడించడం ద్వారా process చేయవలసిన data మొత్తాన్ని అది పెంచుతుంది. B) అది scene illumination లో మార్పులను గుర్తించడానికి మాత్రమే వాడబడుతుంది. C) అది ప్రధానంగా images లో color correction కోసం వాడబడుతుంది. D) ముఖ్యమైన structural properties ను కాపాడుతూ తక్కువ సంబంధిత సమాచారాన్ని filter చేసి అది data ను తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is edge detection considered a fundamental tool in image processing and computer vision? A) It increases the amount of data to be processed by adding structural information. B) It is only used for detecting changes in scene illumination. C) It is primarily used for color correction in images. D) It reduces data by filtering out less relevant information while preserving important structural properties. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens if a user attempts to insert a tuple with a non-null foreign key value that does not exist in the referenced table? A) The tuple is inserted, and a warning is logged in the system. B) The foreign key value is automatically changed to NULL. C) The tuple is rejected by the DBMS, and the operation fails. D) The referenced row in the parent table is automatically created. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Referenced table లో లేని non-null foreign key value తో ఒక tuple ను insert చేయడానికి user ప్రయత్నిస్తే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Tuple insert అవుతుంది, system లో ఒక warning log అవుతుంది. B) Foreign key value స్వయంచాలకంగా NULL గా మారుతుంది. C) DBMS tuple ను తిరస్కరిస్తుంది, operation విఫలమవుతుంది. D) Parent table లో referenced row స్వయంచాలకంగా సృష్టించబడుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens if a user attempts to insert a tuple with a non-null foreign key value that does not exist in the referenced table? A) The tuple is inserted, and a warning is logged in the system. B) The foreign key value is automatically changed to NULL. C) The tuple is rejected by the DBMS, and the operation fails. D) The referenced row in the parent table is automatically created. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of a natural join compared to a standard equi-join? A) It only works with tables that have no foreign keys. B) It uses all columns with the same name in both tables as join conditions. C) It requires an explicit ON clause to define the join condition. D) It automatically filters the result to only include rows with matching primary keys. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard equi-join తో పోలిస్తే natural join యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Foreign keys లేని tables తో మాత్రమే అది పనిచేస్తుంది. B) రెండు tables లోనూ ఒకే పేరు ఉన్న అన్ని columns ను అది join conditions గా వాడుతుంది. C) Join condition ను నిర్వచించడానికి దానికి explicit ON clause అవసరం. D) Matching primary keys ఉన్న rows మాత్రమే ఉండేలా అది result ను స్వయంచాలకంగా filter చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of a natural join compared to a standard equi-join? A) It only works with tables that have no foreign keys. B) It uses all columns with the same name in both tables as join conditions. C) It requires an explicit ON clause to define the join condition. D) It automatically filters the result to only include rows with matching primary keys. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the threshold voltage important in a semiconductor diode circuit? A) It is the voltage below which almost no current flows through the diode B) It is the amount of voltage required to switch the diode to AC mode C) It determines the maximum current the diode can handle D) It defines the point where the diode's physical structure fails ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Semiconductor diode circuit లో threshold voltage ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైనది? A) దాని కంటే తక్కువ voltage వద్ద diode గుండా దాదాపు current ప్రవహించదు B) Diode ను AC mode కి switch చేయడానికి అవసరమైన voltage అది C) Diode handle చేయగల maximum current ను అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది D) Diode physical structure విఫలమయ్యే point ను అది నిర్వచిస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the threshold voltage important in a semiconductor diode circuit? A) It is the voltage below which almost no current flows through the diode B) It is the amount of voltage required to switch the diode to AC mode C) It determines the maximum current the diode can handle D) It defines the point where the diode's physical structure fails ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are LTI systems particularly amenable to frequency-domain analysis techniques? A) They are always governed by nonlinear differential equations. B) They obey the superposition principle and use constant parameters. C) They cannot be represented by a transfer function. D) Their parameters change with time, simplifying transforms. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Frequency-domain analysis techniques కి LTI systems ప్రత్యేకంగా ఎందుకు అనుకూలంగా ఉంటాయి? A) అవి ఎప్పుడూ nonlinear differential equations ద్వారా నియంత్రించబడతాయి. B) అవి superposition principle ను పాటిస్తాయి మరియు స్థిరమైన parameters ను వాడతాయి. C) వాటిని transfer function తో సూచించలేము. D) వాటి parameters కాలంతో మారుతాయి, దాంతో transforms సరళమవుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why are LTI systems particularly amenable to frequency-domain analysis techniques? A) They are always governed by nonlinear differential equations. B) They obey the superposition principle and use constant parameters. C) They cannot be represented by a transfer function. D) Their parameters change with time, simplifying transforms. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which property is held constant in both frequency modulation and phase modulation? A) The instantaneous phase B) The carrier frequency C) The modulating signal amplitude D) The carrier amplitude ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Frequency modulation మరియు phase modulation రెండింటిలోనూ ఏ property స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Instantaneous phase B) Carrier frequency C) Modulating signal amplitude D) Carrier amplitude జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which property is held constant in both frequency modulation and phase modulation? A) The instantaneous phase B) The carrier frequency C) The modulating signal amplitude D) The carrier amplitude ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Miller effect influence the bandwidth of a common-emitter amplifier? A) It has no effect on bandwidth as it only affects output impedance. B) It decreases bandwidth by increasing the effective input capacitance. C) It increases bandwidth by reducing input capacitance. D) It increases bandwidth by providing positive feedback. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Common-emitter amplifier యొక్క bandwidth ను Miller effect ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది output impedance ను మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది కాబట్టి bandwidth పై ప్రభావం ఉండదు. B) Effective input capacitance ను పెంచడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Input capacitance ను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను పెంచుతుంది. D) Positive feedback ను అందించడం ద్వారా అది bandwidth ను పెంచుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the Miller effect influence the bandwidth of a common-emitter amplifier? A) It has no effect on bandwidth as it only affects output impedance. B) It decreases bandwidth by increasing the effective input capacitance. C) It increases bandwidth by reducing input capacitance. D) It increases bandwidth by providing positive feedback. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: If a new problem is shown to be NP-complete, what does this imply? A) It is proven to be outside the class NP B) It is not a decision problem C) It is definitely solvable in polynomial time D) It is likely intractable and requires heuristic or approximation approaches ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక కొత్త problem NP-complete అని చూపబడితే, దాని అర్థం ఏమిటి? A) అది class NP బయట ఉందని నిరూపించబడింది B) అది decision problem కాదు C) అది ఖచ్చితంగా polynomial time లో solve చేయగలది D) అది బహుశా intractable, దానికి heuristic లేదా approximation పద్ధతులు అవసరం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If a new problem is shown to be NP-complete, what does this imply? A) It is proven to be outside the class NP B) It is not a decision problem C) It is definitely solvable in polynomial time D) It is likely intractable and requires heuristic or approximation approaches ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a 'complex' instruction implemented via microcode actually decrease performance compared to a sequence of simple instructions? A) Microcode is too simple to perform arithmetic operations. B) It forces the compiler to ignore high-level language optimizations. C) Microcode instructions require more memory space than hardwired logic. D) It may include side effects or unnecessary hardware interactions that demand extra, inefficient clock cycles. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Microcode ద్వారా implement చేసిన 'complex' instruction, సరళమైన instructions క్రమంతో పోలిస్తే performance ను నిజానికి ఎందుకు తగ్గించవచ్చు? A) Arithmetic operations చేయడానికి microcode చాలా సరళమైనది. B) అది compiler ను high-level language optimizations ను పట్టించుకోకుండా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. C) Microcode instructions కి hardwired logic కంటే ఎక్కువ memory space అవసరం. D) దానిలో side effects లేదా అనవసరమైన hardware interactions ఉండవచ్చు, అవి అదనపు, అసమర్థమైన clock cycles ను కోరతాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why might a 'complex' instruction implemented via microcode actually decrease performance compared to a sequence of simple instructions? A) Microcode is too simple to perform arithmetic operations. B) It forces the compiler to ignore high-level language optimizations. C) Microcode instructions require more memory space than hardwired logic. D) It may include side effects or unnecessary hardware interactions that demand extra, inefficient clock cycles. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a series DC motor often preferred for applications like electric trains? A) It generates very high starting torque needed to move heavy inertia B) It is more efficient than a shunt motor at low loads C) It does not require any external power supply to function D) It provides a constant speed regardless of load variations ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Electric trains వంటి applications కి series DC motor ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) బరువైన inertia ను కదిలించడానికి అవసరమైన చాలా ఎక్కువ starting torque ను అది generate చేస్తుంది B) తక్కువ loads వద్ద అది shunt motor కంటే ఎక్కువ efficient C) పనిచేయడానికి దానికి బయటి power supply అవసరం లేదు D) Load మార్పులతో సంబంధం లేకుండా అది స్థిరమైన speed ను ఇస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a series DC motor often preferred for applications like electric trains? A) It generates very high starting torque needed to move heavy inertia B) It is more efficient than a shunt motor at low loads C) It does not require any external power supply to function D) It provides a constant speed regardless of load variations ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: According to Carnot's theorem, what is the relationship between the efficiency of a real engine and a Carnot engine operating between the same two reservoirs? A) The real engine is more efficient because it operates faster. B) The real engine can be more efficient if it uses better materials. C) The real engine can match the Carnot efficiency if it is perfectly insulated. D) The real engine is always less efficient than the Carnot engine. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Carnot's theorem ప్రకారం, అవే రెండు reservoirs మధ్య పనిచేసే real engine మరియు Carnot engine యొక్క efficiency మధ్య సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) Real engine వేగంగా పనిచేస్తుంది కాబట్టి అది ఎక్కువ efficient. B) మెరుగైన materials వాడితే real engine ఎక్కువ efficient కావచ్చు. C) పూర్తిగా insulate చేస్తే real engine Carnot efficiency ని సమం చేయగలదు. D) Real engine ఎప్పుడూ Carnot engine కంటే తక్కువ efficient. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: According to Carnot's theorem, what is the relationship between the efficiency of a real engine and a Carnot engine operating between the same two reservoirs? A) The real engine is more efficient because it operates faster. B) The real engine can be more efficient if it uses better materials. C) The real engine can match the Carnot efficiency if it is perfectly insulated. D) The real engine is always less efficient than the Carnot engine. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does SVD relate to PCA in terms of computational approach? A) SVD is used to compute the covariance matrix directly. B) SVD and PCA are mathematically unrelated. C) SVD provides an alternative method to compute principal components without explicitly forming the covariance matrix. D) SVD is only used for classification tasks. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Computational approach విషయంలో SVD కి PCA తో సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) Covariance matrix ను నేరుగా compute చేయడానికి SVD ను వాడతారు. B) SVD మరియు PCA గణితపరంగా సంబంధం లేనివి. C) Covariance matrix ను explicit గా ఏర్పరచకుండా principal components ను compute చేయడానికి SVD ఒక ప్రత్యామ్నాయ పద్ధతిని అందిస్తుంది. D) SVD ను classification tasks కోసం మాత్రమే వాడతారు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does SVD relate to PCA in terms of computational approach? A) SVD is used to compute the covariance matrix directly. B) SVD and PCA are mathematically unrelated. C) SVD provides an alternative method to compute principal components without explicitly forming the covariance matrix. D) SVD is only used for classification tasks. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which condition is sufficient for a discrete-time LTI system to be BIBO stable? A) The impulse response must be absolutely summable B) The system must have at least one pole on the unit circle C) The output must be a sinusoidal signal D) The input must be zero for all negative time ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Discrete-time LTI system BIBO stable అవ్వడానికి ఏ షరతు సరిపోతుంది? A) Impulse response absolutely summable గా ఉండాలి B) System కి unit circle పై కనీసం ఒక pole ఉండాలి C) Output ఒక sinusoidal signal గా ఉండాలి D) అన్ని negative time కి input zero గా ఉండాలి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which condition is sufficient for a discrete-time LTI system to be BIBO stable? A) The impulse response must be absolutely summable B) The system must have at least one pole on the unit circle C) The output must be a sinusoidal signal D) The input must be zero for all negative time ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the time-independent Schrödinger equation take the mathematical form of an eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ? A) Because quantum mechanics strictly forbids any variation of physical states with spatial coordinates. B) Because the Hamiltonian acting on an energy eigenstate yields the state scaled by its total energy value. C) Because the wave function must decay exponentially to zero at infinite time boundaries. D) Because kinetic energy and potential energy must remain identically equal at all spatial coordinates. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Time-independent Schrödinger equation eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ యొక్క గణిత రూపాన్ని ఎందుకు తీసుకుంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే spatial coordinates తో physical states మారడాన్ని quantum mechanics ఖచ్చితంగా నిషేధిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే energy eigenstate పై పనిచేసే Hamiltonian ఆ state ను దాని మొత్తం energy value తో scale చేసి ఇస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే wave function infinite time boundaries వద్ద exponential గా zero కి decay అవ్వాలి. D) ఎందుకంటే అన్ని spatial coordinates వద్ద kinetic energy మరియు potential energy ఒకేలా సమానంగా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the time-independent Schrödinger equation take the mathematical form of an eigenvalue equation Hψ = Eψ? A) Because quantum mechanics strictly forbids any variation of physical states with spatial coordinates. B) Because the Hamiltonian acting on an energy eigenstate yields the state scaled by its total energy value. C) Because the wave function must decay exponentially to zero at infinite time boundaries. D) Because kinetic energy and potential energy must remain identically equal at all spatial coordinates. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does increasing the damping ratio affect the resonant peak in the frequency response of a harmonic oscillator? C) The peak amplitude increases and the resonant frequency shifts higher. D) The peak amplitude decreases and the peak frequency shifts to lower values. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Damping ratio ని పెంచడం harmonic oscillator యొక్క frequency response లోని resonant peak ను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) Resonant peak పదునుగా మారి undamped natural frequency కి ఖచ్చితంగా సరిపోలుతుంది. B) Bandwidth తగ్గగా peak amplitude స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. C) Peak amplitude పెరిగి resonant frequency ఎక్కువ వైపు shift అవుతుంది. D) Peak amplitude తగ్గి peak frequency తక్కువ values వైపు shift అవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does increasing the damping ratio affect the resonant peak in the frequency response of a harmonic oscillator? A) The resonant peak sharpens and matches the undamped natural frequency precisely. B) The peak amplitude stays constant while bandwidth decreases. C) The peak amplitude increases and the resonant frequency shifts higher. D) The peak amplitude decreases and the peak frequency shifts to lower values. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the receptive field of a neuron in a deep convolutional network as data passes through multiple layers? A) It increases, allowing the neuron to see a larger context of the input. B) It becomes the same size as the fully connected layer. C) It shrinks, focusing only on the most important pixels. D) It remains constant at the size of the convolution kernel. ANSWER: A

A) అది పెరుగుతుంది, దాంతో neuron input యొక్క పెద్ద context ను చూడగలుగుతుంది. B) అది fully connected layer పరిమాణానికి సమానం అవుతుంది. C) అది కుంచించుకుపోయి అత్యంత ముఖ్యమైన pixels పై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెడుతుంది. D) అది convolution kernel పరిమాణం వద్ద స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to the receptive field of a neuron in a deep convolutional network as data passes through multiple layers? A) It increases, allowing the neuron to see a larger context of the input. B) It becomes the same size as the fully connected layer. C) It shrinks, focusing only on the most important pixels. D) It remains constant at the size of the convolution kernel. ANSWER: A
