input: to Telugu: Q: What primarily causes the negative differential resistance region in a forward-biased tunnel diode? A) Thermal generation of electron-hole pairs destroying the depletion layer B) A reversal in the direction of the built-in electric field across the junction C) Avalanche breakdown multiplying minority carriers rapidly within the junction D) Misalignment of the conduction band of the N-side with the valence band of the P-side as bias increases ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Forward-biased tunnel diode లో negative differential resistance region కి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Electron-hole pairs యొక్క thermal generation depletion layer ను నాశనం చేయడం B) Junction అంతటా built-in electric field direction తిరగబడడం C) Avalanche breakdown junction లోపల minority carriers ను వేగంగా గుణించడం D) Bias పెరిగే కొద్దీ N-side conduction band P-side valence band తో misalign అవ్వడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What primarily causes the negative differential resistance region in a forward-biased tunnel diode? A) Thermal generation of electron-hole pairs destroying the depletion layer B) A reversal in the direction of the built-in electric field across the junction C) Avalanche breakdown multiplying minority carriers rapidly within the junction D) Misalignment of the conduction band of the N-side with the valence band of the P-side as bias increases ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the back-off mechanism in CSMA/CD help manage network traffic? A) By synchronizing all stations to transmit at the same time B) By having stations wait a random time proportional to the number of collisions before retrying C) By permanently blocking stations that collide frequently D) By increasing the jam signal length after each collision ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: CSMA/CD లోని back-off mechanism network traffic ను నిర్వహించడంలో ఎలా సహాయపడుతుంది? A) అన్ని stations ఒకేసారి transmit చేసేలా synchronize చేయడం ద్వారా B) మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించే ముందు collisions సంఖ్యకు అనుపాతంలో stations random సమయం ఎదురుచూసేలా చేయడం ద్వారా C) తరచుగా collide అయ్యే stations ను శాశ్వతంగా block చేయడం ద్వారా D) ప్రతి collision తర్వాత jam signal length ను పెంచడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the back-off mechanism in CSMA/CD help manage network traffic? A) By synchronizing all stations to transmit at the same time B) By having stations wait a random time proportional to the number of collisions before retrying C) By permanently blocking stations that collide frequently D) By increasing the jam signal length after each collision ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: According to the classical Drude model, how does an applied electric field generate a steady drift velocity? A) Thermal agitation alone drives electrons preferentially against the applied field vector. B) Continuous electrostatic acceleration is balanced by randomizing collisions with lattice ions. C) Quantum tunneling allows electrons to bypass ionic potentials without kinetic energy loss. D) Electrons move without collisions through an ideal, frictionless crystal lattice. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Classical Drude model ప్రకారం applied electric field స్థిరమైన drift velocity ని ఎలా generate చేస్తుంది? A) Thermal agitation ఒక్కటే electrons ను applied field vector కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ప్రాధాన్యంగా నడిపిస్తుంది. B) నిరంతర electrostatic acceleration ను lattice ions తో జరిగే randomizing collisions balance చేస్తాయి. C) Quantum tunneling వల్ల electrons kinetic energy కోల్పోకుండా ionic potentials ను దాటవేస్తాయి. D) Electrons collisions లేకుండా ఆదర్శ, ఘర్షణ లేని crystal lattice గుండా కదులుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to the classical Drude model, how does an applied electric field generate a steady drift velocity? A) Thermal agitation alone drives electrons preferentially against the applied field vector. B) Continuous electrostatic acceleration is balanced by randomizing collisions with lattice ions. C) Quantum tunneling allows electrons to bypass ionic potentials without kinetic energy loss. D) Electrons move without collisions through an ideal, frictionless crystal lattice. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must an anti-aliasing filter be an analog filter placed before the sampler rather than a digital filter placed after? A) Digital-to-analog converters cannot process discrete data without pre-filtering B) Analog filters consume far less computational power than digital finite impulse response filters C) Once sampling occurs, aliases irrevocably overlap the original spectrum and cannot be separated digitally D) Digital filters introduce phase delays that cause spectral inversion ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Anti-aliasing filter sampler తర్వాత పెట్టే digital filter కాకుండా ముందు పెట్టే analog filter ఎందుకు కావాలి? A) Pre-filtering లేకుండా digital-to-analog converters discrete data ను process చేయలేవు B) Digital finite impulse response filters కంటే analog filters చాలా తక్కువ computational power ను వినియోగిస్తాయి C) Sampling జరిగిన తర్వాత aliases అసలు spectrum తో తిరిగి మార్చలేని విధంగా overlap అవుతాయి, వాటిని digital గా వేరు చేయలేము D) Digital filters spectral inversion కి కారణమయ్యే phase delays ను కలిగిస్తాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why must an anti-aliasing filter be an analog filter placed before the sampler rather than a digital filter placed after? A) Digital-to-analog converters cannot process discrete data without pre-filtering B) Analog filters consume far less computational power than digital finite impulse response filters C) Once sampling occurs, aliases irrevocably overlap the original spectrum and cannot be separated digitally D) Digital filters introduce phase delays that cause spectral inversion ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of PKI, what does a Trusted Third Party (TTP) primarily provide? A) Independent verification of a public key's association with an identity B) A centralized directory for all public keys C) The network protocols for certificate distribution D) The cryptographic algorithms for digital signatures ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: PKI సందర్భంలో Trusted Third Party (TTP) ప్రధానంగా ఏమి అందిస్తుంది? A) ఒక public key కి ఒక identity తో ఉన్న సంబంధం యొక్క స్వతంత్ర verification B) అన్ని public keys కోసం కేంద్రీకృత directory C) Certificate distribution కోసం network protocols D) Digital signatures కోసం cryptographic algorithms జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the context of PKI, what does a Trusted Third Party (TTP) primarily provide? A) Independent verification of a public key's association with an identity B) A centralized directory for all public keys C) The network protocols for certificate distribution D) The cryptographic algorithms for digital signatures ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the exploration-exploitation dilemma considered a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning? A) Because the agent must balance gathering new information about the environment with using current knowledge to maximize rewards. B) Because the number of possible policies can be large or even infinite. C) Because simple exploration methods are the most practical due to a lack of scaling algorithms. D) Because random action selection without reference to an estimated probability distribution shows poor performance. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Reinforcement learning లో exploration-exploitation dilemma ను మౌలిక సవాలుగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే agent environment గురించి కొత్త సమాచారాన్ని సేకరించడాన్ని, rewards ను గరిష్ఠం చేయడానికి ప్రస్తుత జ్ఞానాన్ని వాడడాన్ని balance చేయాలి. B) ఎందుకంటే సాధ్యమైన policies సంఖ్య పెద్దదిగా లేదా infinite గా కూడా ఉండవచ్చు. C) ఎందుకంటే scaling algorithms లేనందున సరళమైన exploration methods అత్యంత ఆచరణాత్మకమైనవి. D) ఎందుకంటే అంచనా వేసిన probability distribution ను పట్టించుకోకుండా random action selection పేలవమైన performance ను చూపుతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the exploration-exploitation dilemma considered a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning? A) Because the agent must balance gathering new information about the environment with using current knowledge to maximize rewards. B) Because the number of possible policies can be large or even infinite. C) Because simple exploration methods are the most practical due to a lack of scaling algorithms. D) Because random action selection without reference to an estimated probability distribution shows poor performance. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the bias term affect the decision boundary in a linear classifier like a perceptron? A) It makes the boundary non-linear B) It shifts the position of the boundary away from the origin C) It increases the number of inputs D) It changes the orientation of the boundary ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Perceptron వంటి linear classifier లో bias term decision boundary ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది boundary ని non-linear గా చేస్తుంది B) అది boundary స్థానాన్ని origin నుండి దూరంగా shift చేస్తుంది C) అది inputs సంఖ్యను పెంచుతుంది D) అది boundary యొక్క orientation ను మారుస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the bias term affect the decision boundary in a linear classifier like a perceptron? A) It makes the boundary non-linear B) It shifts the position of the boundary away from the origin C) It increases the number of inputs D) It changes the orientation of the boundary ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is normalized impedance used on a Smith chart? A) To convert AC signals to DC signals B) To simplify the calculation of resistance only C) To increase the accuracy of the measurements D) To make the values dimensionless and applicable to any system impedance ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Smith chart పై normalized impedance ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) AC signals ను DC signals గా మార్చడానికి B) Resistance లెక్కింపును మాత్రమే సరళీకరించడానికి C) Measurements యొక్క accuracy ని పెంచడానికి D) Values ను dimensionless గా చేసి ఏ system impedance కైనా వర్తించేలా చేయడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is normalized impedance used on a Smith chart? A) To convert AC signals to DC signals B) To simplify the calculation of resistance only C) To increase the accuracy of the measurements D) To make the values dimensionless and applicable to any system impedance ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a sequence of functions converge in the sense of distributions but not pointwise? A) Distributional convergence is a stricter form of pointwise convergence B) Distributional convergence requires the limit to be identical at every coordinate C) Pointwise convergence is only applicable to continuous functions D) Pointwise convergence is a stronger condition than distributional convergence ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక sequence of functions distributions అర్థంలో converge అయి pointwise గా ఎందుకు converge కాకపోవచ్చు? A) Distributional convergence అనేది pointwise convergence యొక్క కఠినమైన రూపం B) Distributional convergence కి ప్రతి coordinate వద్ద limit ఒకేలా ఉండాలి C) Pointwise convergence continuous functions కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది D) Pointwise convergence అనేది distributional convergence కంటే బలమైన షరతు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why might a sequence of functions converge in the sense of distributions but not pointwise? A) Distributional convergence is a stricter form of pointwise convergence B) Distributional convergence requires the limit to be identical at every coordinate C) Pointwise convergence is only applicable to continuous functions D) Pointwise convergence is a stronger condition than distributional convergence ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What critical network failure can occur if all nodes do not maintain the exact same map in a link-state routing protocol? A) Routing loops B) Packet duplication C) Packet fragmentation D) IP address conflicts ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Link-state routing protocol లో అన్ని nodes ఖచ్చితంగా ఒకే map ను కలిగి ఉండకపోతే ఏ కీలకమైన network failure జరగవచ్చు? A) Routing loops B) Packet duplication C) Packet fragmentation D) IP address conflicts జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What critical network failure can occur if all nodes do not maintain the exact same map in a link-state routing protocol? A) Routing loops B) Packet duplication C) Packet fragmentation D) IP address conflicts ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary limitation of a standard Hamming code regarding double-bit errors? A) It may incorrectly decode a double-bit error as a single-bit error. B) It requires twice the number of parity bits to handle double-bit errors. C) It cannot detect any double-bit errors. D) It can correct all double-bit errors. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Double-bit errors విషయంలో standard Hamming code యొక్క ప్రధాన పరిమితి ఏమిటి? A) అది double-bit error ను తప్పుగా single-bit error గా decode చేయవచ్చు. B) Double-bit errors ను handle చేయడానికి దానికి రెట్టింపు parity bits అవసరం. C) అది ఏ double-bit errors నూ గుర్తించలేదు. D) అది అన్ని double-bit errors ను సరిచేయగలదు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary limitation of a standard Hamming code regarding double-bit errors? A) It may incorrectly decode a double-bit error as a single-bit error. B) It requires twice the number of parity bits to handle double-bit errors. C) It cannot detect any double-bit errors. D) It can correct all double-bit errors. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In Bayesian inference, what role does the denominator of Bayes' theorem play in calculating the posterior probability? A) It determines the initial subjective belief prior to observing evidence. B) It maximizes the likelihood function across parameter dimensions. C) It acts as a normalizing constant to ensure posterior probabilities sum to one. D) It represents the likelihood of the hypothesis given the observed data. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Bayesian inference లో posterior probability ని లెక్కించడంలో Bayes' theorem యొక్క denominator ఏ పాత్ర పోషిస్తుంది? A) Evidence ను గమనించే ముందు ఉన్న initial subjective belief ను అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. B) Parameter dimensions అంతటా likelihood function ను అది గరిష్ఠం చేస్తుంది. C) Posterior probabilities sum one అయ్యేలా చూసే normalizing constant గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. D) Observed data ఇచ్చినప్పుడు hypothesis యొక్క likelihood ను అది సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In Bayesian inference, what role does the denominator of Bayes' theorem play in calculating the posterior probability? A) It determines the initial subjective belief prior to observing evidence. B) It maximizes the likelihood function across parameter dimensions. C) It acts as a normalizing constant to ensure posterior probabilities sum to one. D) It represents the likelihood of the hypothesis given the observed data. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of shared memory systems compared to distributed memory systems? A) They suffer from write conflicts that slow down execution B) They require more physical hardware resources C) They cannot execute tasks in parallel D) They do not support message passing protocols ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Distributed memory systems తో పోలిస్తే shared memory systems యొక్క ప్రధాన నష్టం ఏమిటి? A) Execution ను నెమ్మదింపజేసే write conflicts వాటికి ఉంటాయి B) వాటికి ఎక్కువ physical hardware resources అవసరం C) అవి tasks ను parallel గా execute చేయలేవు D) అవి message passing protocols ను support చేయవు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of shared memory systems compared to distributed memory systems? A) They suffer from write conflicts that slow down execution B) They require more physical hardware resources C) They cannot execute tasks in parallel D) They do not support message passing protocols ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of object detection, what is the fundamental distinction between binary and multi-class categorization? A) Binary categorization distinguishes between two categories, while multi-class categorizes among many simultaneously. B) Binary categorization uses only appearance features, while multi-class uses motion features. C) Binary categorization is a supervised task, whereas multi-class is typically unsupervised. D) Binary categorization requires more training data than multi-class categorization. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Object detection సందర్భంలో binary మరియు multi-class categorization మధ్య మౌలిక తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Binary categorization రెండు categories మధ్య తేడాను గుర్తిస్తుంది, multi-class ఒకేసారి అనేక వాటి మధ్య వర్గీకరిస్తుంది. B) Binary categorization appearance features ను మాత్రమే వాడుతుంది, multi-class motion features ను వాడుతుంది. C) Binary categorization supervised task, multi-class సాధారణంగా unsupervised. D) Binary categorization కి multi-class categorization కంటే ఎక్కువ training data అవసరం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the context of object detection, what is the fundamental distinction between binary and multi-class categorization? A) Binary categorization distinguishes between two categories, while multi-class categorizes among many simultaneously. B) Binary categorization uses only appearance features, while multi-class uses motion features. C) Binary categorization is a supervised task, whereas multi-class is typically unsupervised. D) Binary categorization requires more training data than multi-class categorization. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why would a database designer choose to implement a surrogate primary key over a natural key? A) To avoid the complexities of using large or multi-column natural keys B) To ensure the data is more human-readable C) Because natural keys cannot be used in SQL databases D) To strictly follow the relational algebra model requirements ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Database designer natural key కంటే surrogate primary key ను implement చేయడానికి ఎందుకు ఎంచుకుంటాడు? A) పెద్ద లేదా multi-column natural keys వాడడంలోని సంక్లిష్టతలను నివారించడానికి B) Data మనుషులు ఎక్కువగా చదవగలిగేలా ఉండేలా చూడడానికి C) ఎందుకంటే SQL databases లో natural keys ను వాడలేము D) Relational algebra model requirements ను ఖచ్చితంగా పాటించడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why would a database designer choose to implement a surrogate primary key over a natural key? A) To avoid the complexities of using large or multi-column natural keys B) To ensure the data is more human-readable C) Because natural keys cannot be used in SQL databases D) To strictly follow the relational algebra model requirements ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is logistic regression preferred over linear regression for predicting a binary outcome like pass/fail? A) Because it models the log-odds of the outcome as a linear combination of predictors. B) Because it uses the logistic function which is computationally faster. C) Because it can handle both categorical and continuous independent variables. D) Because it ensures predicted probabilities are always between 0 and 1. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Pass/fail వంటి binary outcome ను predict చేయడానికి linear regression కంటే logistic regression ను ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది outcome యొక్క log-odds ను predictors యొక్క linear combination గా model చేస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే అది computationally వేగవంతమైన logistic function ను వాడుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే అది categorical మరియు continuous independent variables రెండింటినీ handle చేయగలదు. D) ఎందుకంటే predicted probabilities ఎప్పుడూ 0 మరియు 1 మధ్య ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is logistic regression preferred over linear regression for predicting a binary outcome like pass/fail? A) Because it models the log-odds of the outcome as a linear combination of predictors. B) Because it uses the logistic function which is computationally faster. C) Because it can handle both categorical and continuous independent variables. D) Because it ensures predicted probabilities are always between 0 and 1. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the core principle used by the Cooley-Tukey algorithm to improve computation speed? A) Converting the signal to a time-domain representation before processing. B) Eliminating all additions in the calculation. C) Replacing the DFT matrix with a random sparse matrix. D) Divide-and-conquer strategy to break down large DFTs into smaller sub-transforms. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Computation వేగాన్ని మెరుగుపరచడానికి Cooley-Tukey algorithm వాడే ప్రధాన సూత్రం ఏమిటి? A) Process చేసే ముందు signal ను time-domain representation కి మార్చడం. B) లెక్కింపులోని అన్ని additions ను తొలగించడం. C) DFT matrix ను random sparse matrix తో భర్తీ చేయడం. D) పెద్ద DFTs ను చిన్న sub-transforms గా విభజించే divide-and-conquer వ్యూహం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the core principle used by the Cooley-Tukey algorithm to improve computation speed? A) Converting the signal to a time-domain representation before processing. B) Eliminating all additions in the calculation. C) Replacing the DFT matrix with a random sparse matrix. D) Divide-and-conquer strategy to break down large DFTs into smaller sub-transforms. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a test environment built to be a scalable version of the production environment? target: ప్రశ్న: Test environment ను production environment యొక్క scalable version గా ఎందుకు నిర్మిస్తారు? A) Technology stack సూక్ష్మతలను కాపాడుతూ replica నిర్మాణ ఖర్చును తగ్గించడానికి B) Developers వేగంగా code రాయడానికి వీలుగా C) Unit testing అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి D) Deployment pipeline వేగాన్ని పెంచడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a test environment built to be a scalable version of the production environment? input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Cartesian product in relational algebra differ from the set-theoretic Cartesian product? A) It produces flattened tuples instead of nested tuples B) It eliminates duplicate tuples automatically C) It requires the relations to be union-compatible D) It only works on relations with the same number of attributes ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Relational algebra లోని Cartesian product set-theoretic Cartesian product నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అది nested tuples బదులు flattened tuples ను ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది B) అది duplicate tuples ను స్వయంచాలకంగా తొలగిస్తుంది C) దానికి relations union-compatible గా ఉండాలి D) అది ఒకే సంఖ్యలో attributes ఉన్న relations పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does the Cartesian product in relational algebra differ from the set-theoretic Cartesian product? A) It produces flattened tuples instead of nested tuples B) It eliminates duplicate tuples automatically C) It requires the relations to be union-compatible D) It only works on relations with the same number of attributes ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the electronic transport band gap differ from the optical band gap in semiconductors? A) Both gaps are always identical because Coulomb attraction between charge carriers is negligible in all solids. B) The electronic transport gap is larger by an amount equal to the exciton binding energy. C) The optical band gap is larger because photons carry more momentum than phonons. D) The electronic transport gap accounts only for thermal phonon transitions without generating free carriers. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Semiconductors లో electronic transport band gap optical band gap నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అన్ని solids లో charge carriers మధ్య Coulomb attraction నామమాత్రం కాబట్టి రెండు gaps ఎప్పుడూ ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి. B) Electronic transport gap exciton binding energy కి సమానమైన మొత్తంలో పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. C) Photons phonons కంటే ఎక్కువ momentum ను కలిగి ఉంటాయి కాబట్టి optical band gap పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. D) Electronic transport gap free carriers ను generate చేయకుండా thermal phonon transitions ను మాత్రమే పరిగణిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the electronic transport band gap differ from the optical band gap in semiconductors? A) Both gaps are always identical because Coulomb attraction between charge carriers is negligible in all solids. B) The electronic transport gap is larger by an amount equal to the exciton binding energy. C) The optical band gap is larger because photons carry more momentum than phonons. D) The electronic transport gap accounts only for thermal phonon transitions without generating free carriers. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a Parallel-in Serial-out (PISO) shift register? target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a Parallel-in Serial-out (PISO) shift register? A) To store data only in a buffer register B) To convert multiple parallel data lines into a single serial data stream C) To increase the clock frequency of a microcontroller D) To convert serial data into many parallel output lines ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under which condition can mean field theory be applied to solve the weight equations in a linear network? A) When a small, fixed fraction of weights are diluted and the number of terms goes to infinite B) When the network is processed by an analog neuromorphic processor C) When the fraction of removed connections is large D) When strong dilution is applied to the input frequencies ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Linear network లో weight equations ను solve చేయడానికి mean field theory ని ఏ పరిస్థితిలో apply చేయవచ్చు? A) Weights లో చిన్న, స్థిరమైన భాగం dilute అయి terms సంఖ్య infinite కి వెళ్లినప్పుడు B) Network ను analog neuromorphic processor process చేసినప్పుడు C) తొలగించిన connections భాగం పెద్దగా ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Input frequencies కి strong dilution ను apply చేసినప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under which condition can mean field theory be applied to solve the weight equations in a linear network? target: ప్రశ్న: AES మరియు Rijndael మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని కింది వాటిలో ఏది బాగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) AES అనేది fixed block size ఉన్న Rijndael cipher family యొక్క ఒక నిర్దిష్ట variant B) Rijndael అనేది తక్కువ rounds ఉన్న AES యొక్క సరళీకృత version C) AES అనేది Rijndael భర్తీ చేసిన పాత standard D) AES మరియు Rijndael పూర్తిగా సంబంధం లేని algorithms జవాబు: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why did the field of neural network research stagnate after the publication of 'Perceptrons' in 1969? target: ప్రశ్న: ప్రాథమిక buck converter operation లో voltage మరియు current మధ్య ప్రధాన సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) Voltage మరియు current రెండూ తగ్గుతాయి B) Voltage తగ్గుతుంది, current పెరుగుతుంది C) Voltage పెరుగుతుంది, current తగ్గుతుంది D) Voltage మరియు current రెండూ పెరుగుతాయి జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the compensation-wave method differ from standard CW transmission? A) It uses multiple carriers instead of a single continuous wave B) It filters the continuous wave to reduce interference C) It modulates the amplitude of the continuous wave to transmit data D) It slightly changes the transmitter frequency instead of turning the signal on and off ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Compensation-wave method standard CW transmission నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) అది ఒకే continuous wave బదులు అనేక carriers ను వాడుతుంది B) Interference తగ్గించడానికి అది continuous wave ను filter చేస్తుంది C) Data ను transmit చేయడానికి అది continuous wave యొక్క amplitude ను modulate చేస్తుంది D) Signal ను on, off చేయడం బదులు అది transmitter frequency ని కొద్దిగా మారుస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does the compensation-wave method differ from standard CW transmission? target_en: Q: If fluid flows horizontally through a pipe with a narrowing cross-section (like a Venturi tube), what happens to the static pressure? A) It decreases as the speed increases. input: to Telugu: Q: Under the residue theorem, what is the value of the contour integral of a function that is completely holomorphic everywhere inside and on a closed contour? A) Infinity B) 2πi times the function evaluated at the center C) Zero D) The arc length of the closed path ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: Under the residue theorem, what is the value of the contour integral of a function that is completely holomorphic everywhere inside and on a closed contour? A) Infinity B) 2πi times the function evaluated at the center C) Zero D) The arc length of the closed path ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary purpose of write-ahead logging in database systems? A) To increase the speed of read operations. target: ప్రశ్న: Database systems లో write-ahead logging యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Read operations వేగాన్ని పెంచడం. B) మార్పులను commit చేసే ముందే record చేయడం ద్వారా durability ని నిర్ధారించడం. C) Concurrent transactions మధ్య isolation ను అమలు చేయడం. D) Transaction సమయంలో data consistency ని validate చేయడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a primary purpose of write-ahead logging in database systems? A) To increase the speed of read operations. B) To ensure durability by recording changes before committing them. C) To enforce isolation between concurrent transactions. D) To validate data consistency during a transaction. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: A continuous sinusoid of 70 Hz is sampled at a rate of 100 Hz. At what apparent frequency does it fold back into the baseband (0 to fs/2)? A) 50 Hz B) 20 Hz C) 30 Hz D) 70 Hz ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: 70 Hz ఉన్న ఒక continuous sinusoid ను 100 Hz rate వద్ద sample చేశారు. అది baseband (0 నుండి fs/2) లోకి ఏ apparent frequency వద్ద fold back అవుతుంది? A) 50 Hz B) 20 Hz C) 30 Hz D) 70 Hz జవాబు: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does TLB thrashing most likely occur? A) When the physical memory is completely full and no page frames are free. B) When the CPU cache is disabled by the operating system. C) When a single instruction references multiple pages across different address spaces. D) When the working set of pages is larger than the TLB's capacity. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: TLB thrashing ఏ పరిస్థితిలో ఎక్కువగా జరుగుతుంది? A) Physical memory పూర్తిగా నిండి ఏ page frames ఖాళీగా లేనప్పుడు. B) Operating system CPU cache ను disable చేసినప్పుడు. C) ఒకే instruction వేర్వేరు address spaces అంతటా అనేక pages ను reference చేసినప్పుడు. D) Pages యొక్క working set TLB capacity కంటే పెద్దదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition does TLB thrashing most likely occur? A) When the physical memory is completely full and no page frames are free. B) When the CPU cache is disabled by the operating system. C) When a single instruction references multiple pages across different address spaces. D) When the working set of pages is larger than the TLB's capacity. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What major advantage do neural network-based methods have over traditional statistical approaches in NLP? A) They are based on explicitly coded symbolic rules. target: ప్రశ్న: NLP లో సాంప్రదాయ statistical approaches కంటే neural network-based methods కి ఉన్న ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అవి explicit గా code చేసిన symbolic rules పై ఆధారపడి ఉంటాయి. target_en: Q: What major advantage do neural network-based methods have over traditional statistical approaches in NLP? A) They are based on explicitly coded symbolic rules. B) They are less robust to misspelled words. C) They can capture semantic properties automatically without intermediate tasks. D) They require extensive manual feature engineering. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What causes a binary search tree to exhibit worst-case performance similar to a linked list? A) Using an iterative search algorithm instead of a recursive one. B) Storing too many keys in the left subtree compared to the right. C) An unbalanced structure resulting from specific, non-random insertion sequences. D) Deleting too many leaf nodes sequentially. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Binary search tree linked list లాంటి worst-case performance చూపడానికి కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Recursive దాని బదులు iterative search algorithm ను వాడడం. B) Right subtree తో పోలిస్తే left subtree లో చాలా ఎక్కువ keys ను store చేయడం. C) నిర్దిష్టమైన, random కాని insertion sequences వల్ల ఏర్పడే unbalanced structure. D) వరుసగా చాలా ఎక్కువ leaf nodes ను delete చేయడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What causes a binary search tree to exhibit worst-case performance similar to a linked list? A) Using an iterative search algorithm instead of a recursive one. B) Storing too many keys in the left subtree compared to the right. C) An unbalanced structure resulting from specific, non-random insertion sequences. D) Deleting too many leaf nodes sequentially. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If the Heaviside step function is defined such that H(0) = 1, how is it characterized at the origin? A) A smooth transition to one B) A discontinuity where the limit from the left is zero C) A vanishing point D) A point of inflection ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Heaviside step function ను H(0) = 1 అయ్యేలా నిర్వచిస్తే, origin వద్ద దానిని ఎలా వర్ణిస్తారు? A) One కి మృదువైన మార్పు B) Left నుండి limit zero గా ఉండే discontinuity C) Vanishing point D) Point of inflection జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If the Heaviside step function is defined such that H(0) = 1, how is it characterized at the origin? A) A smooth transition to one B) A discontinuity where the limit from the left is zero C) A vanishing point D) A point of inflection ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In what scenario is a cross assembler most useful? A) When developing software for an embedded system that lacks a development environment B) When writing high-level applications in C or Python C) When optimizing code for a specific CPU by hand-tuning machine instructions D) When debugging code that is already running on the target device ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ సందర్భంలో cross assembler అత్యంత ఉపయోగకరం? A) Development environment లేని embedded system కోసం software అభివృద్ధి చేసేటప్పుడు B) C లేదా Python లో high-level applications రాసేటప్పుడు C) Machine instructions ను చేతితో tune చేసి ఒక నిర్దిష్ట CPU కోసం code ను optimize చేసేటప్పుడు D) Target device పై ఇప్పటికే నడుస్తున్న code ను debug చేసేటప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In what scenario is a cross assembler most useful? A) When developing software for an embedded system that lacks a development environment B) When writing high-level applications in C or Python C) When optimizing code for a specific CPU by hand-tuning machine instructions D) When debugging code that is already running on the target device ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does engineering shear strain relate to the physical deformation of a rectangular element? A) It measures the change in length of the diagonal of the element. B) It measures the rotation of the entire element without any shape distortion. C) It represents the ratio of volume change to original volume. D) It is defined as the tangent of the change in angle between two initially perpendicular lines. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Engineering shear strain ఒక rectangular element యొక్క భౌతిక deformation కి ఎలా సంబంధించినది? A) అది element యొక్క diagonal పొడవులో మార్పును కొలుస్తుంది. B) ఆకారంలో ఎలాంటి వక్రీకరణ లేకుండా మొత్తం element యొక్క rotation ను అది కొలుస్తుంది. C) అది volume మార్పుకు original volume కి ఉన్న ratio ను సూచిస్తుంది. D) మొదట perpendicular గా ఉన్న రెండు lines మధ్య angle లో మార్పు యొక్క tangent గా అది నిర్వచించబడింది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does engineering shear strain relate to the physical deformation of a rectangular element? A) It measures the change in length of the diagonal of the element. B) It measures the rotation of the entire element without any shape distortion. C) It represents the ratio of volume change to original volume. D) It is defined as the tangent of the change in angle between two initially perpendicular lines. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental principle behind compression-based segmentation? A) Minimizing the coding length by finding patterns in the image B) Applying a sphere mask to detect objects C) Using histogram peaks to locate clusters D) Maximizing the coding length of the data ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Compression-based segmentation వెనుక ఉన్న మౌలిక సూత్రం ఏమిటి? A) Image లో patterns ను కనుగొనడం ద్వారా coding length ను కనిష్ఠం చేయడం B) Objects ను గుర్తించడానికి sphere mask ను apply చేయడం C) Clusters ను గుర్తించడానికి histogram peaks ను వాడడం D) Data యొక్క coding length ను గరిష్ఠం చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental principle behind compression-based segmentation? A) Minimizing the coding length by finding patterns in the image B) Applying a sphere mask to detect objects C) Using histogram peaks to locate clusters D) Maximizing the coding length of the data ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the RMS amplitude used instead of simple peak amplitude when calculating power-based SNR? A) Because RMS is a logarithmic measurement B) Because peak amplitude is always zero in AC signals C) Because RMS relates directly to the average power of the signal D) Because peak amplitude does not account for noise ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Power-based SNR ను లెక్కించేటప్పుడు సాధారణ peak amplitude బదులు RMS amplitude ను ఎందుకు వాడతారు? A) ఎందుకంటే RMS ఒక logarithmic measurement B) ఎందుకంటే AC signals లో peak amplitude ఎప్పుడూ zero C) ఎందుకంటే RMS నేరుగా signal యొక్క average power కి సంబంధించినది D) ఎందుకంటే peak amplitude noise ను పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోదు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the RMS amplitude used instead of simple peak amplitude when calculating power-based SNR? A) Because RMS is a logarithmic measurement B) Because peak amplitude is always zero in AC signals C) Because RMS relates directly to the average power of the signal D) Because peak amplitude does not account for noise ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which mathematical condition satisfies the approximation needed for Fraunhofer diffraction? A) Obstacle size being thousands of times larger than distance to screen B) Observation screen placed extremely close to the aperture edge C) Curved spherical wavefronts reaching the detector plane D) Parallel rays arriving at the observation plane from the aperture ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Fraunhofer diffraction కి అవసరమైన approximation ను ఏ గణిత షరతు satisfy చేస్తుంది? A) Obstacle size screen కి ఉన్న దూరం కంటే వేల రెట్లు పెద్దదిగా ఉండడం B) Observation screen ను aperture అంచుకు చాలా దగ్గరగా పెట్టడం C) వంపు తిరిగిన spherical wavefronts detector plane కి చేరడం D) Aperture నుండి parallel rays observation plane కి చేరడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which mathematical condition satisfies the approximation needed for Fraunhofer diffraction? A) Obstacle size being thousands of times larger than distance to screen B) Observation screen placed extremely close to the aperture edge C) Curved spherical wavefronts reaching the detector plane D) Parallel rays arriving at the observation plane from the aperture ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a standard join condition fail to match NULL values with other NULL values? A) Because NULL values are not stored in the database. B) Because the database system automatically filters out NULLs. C) Because NULL represents an unknown value and does not equal anything, including itself. D) Because NULL is treated as an empty string. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard join condition NULL values ను ఇతర NULL values తో match చేయడంలో ఎందుకు విఫలమవుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే NULL values database లో store చేయబడవు. B) ఎందుకంటే database system NULLs ను స్వయంచాలకంగా filter చేస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే NULL తెలియని value ని సూచిస్తుంది మరియు అది తనతో సహా దేనికీ సమానం కాదు. D) ఎందుకంటే NULL ను empty string గా పరిగణిస్తారు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does a standard join condition fail to match NULL values with other NULL values? A) Because NULL values are not stored in the database. B) Because the database system automatically filters out NULLs. C) Because NULL represents an unknown value and does not equal anything, including itself. D) Because NULL is treated as an empty string. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a purely inductive load affect the relationship between voltage and current in an AC circuit? A) Current waveform becomes non-sinusoidal and distorted. B) Current and voltage remain perfectly in phase. C) Current leads voltage by a phase angle of 90 degrees. D) Current lags voltage by a phase angle of 90 degrees. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: AC circuit లో పూర్తిగా inductive load voltage మరియు current మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) Current waveform non-sinusoidal గా, distorted గా మారుతుంది. B) Current మరియు voltage పూర్తిగా in phase లో ఉంటాయి. C) Current voltage కంటే 90 degrees phase angle తో ముందు ఉంటుంది (leads). D) Current voltage కంటే 90 degrees phase angle తో వెనుక ఉంటుంది (lags). జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a purely inductive load affect the relationship between voltage and current in an AC circuit? A) Current waveform becomes non-sinusoidal and distorted. B) Current and voltage remain perfectly in phase. C) Current leads voltage by a phase angle of 90 degrees. D) Current lags voltage by a phase angle of 90 degrees. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If a master is transmitting data in Mode 0 and receiving data in Mode 1 simultaneously, what does this imply about the configuration? A) The master is configured to use a 16-bit word size for both operations B) The master uses different CPOL/CPHA settings for transmit and receive operations C) The master is using a three-wire variant of the SPI protocol D) The master uses two separate SS lines for each slave device ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక master ఒకేసారి Mode 0 లో data ను transmit చేస్తూ Mode 1 లో data ను receive చేస్తుంటే, configuration గురించి అది ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Master రెండు operations కీ 16-bit word size ను వాడేలా configure చేయబడింది B) Master transmit మరియు receive operations కి వేర్వేరు CPOL/CPHA settings ను వాడుతుంది C) Master SPI protocol యొక్క three-wire variant ను వాడుతోంది D) Master ప్రతి slave device కి రెండు వేర్వేరు SS lines ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a master is transmitting data in Mode 0 and receiving data in Mode 1 simultaneously, what does this imply about the configuration? A) The master is configured to use a 16-bit word size for both operations B) The master uses different CPOL/CPHA settings for transmit and receive operations C) The master is using a three-wire variant of the SPI protocol D) The master uses two separate SS lines for each slave device ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a master-worker architecture, what is the primary role of the worker nodes? A) To execute assigned tasks and report their progress to the master B) To exclusively handle metadata inference for task execution times C) To calculate the optimal performance function for the entire system D) To permanently redistribute tasks among all available nodes ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Master-worker architecture లో worker nodes యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) కేటాయించిన tasks ను execute చేసి వాటి progress ను master కి report చేయడం B) Task execution times కోసం metadata inference ను మాత్రమే handle చేయడం C) మొత్తం system కి optimal performance function ను లెక్కించడం D) అందుబాటులో ఉన్న అన్ని nodes మధ్య tasks ను శాశ్వతంగా తిరిగి పంపిణీ చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a master-worker architecture, what is the primary role of the worker nodes? A) To execute assigned tasks and report their progress to the master B) To exclusively handle metadata inference for task execution times C) To calculate the optimal performance function for the entire system D) To permanently redistribute tasks among all available nodes ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the checksum field in a TCP header? A) To prevent duplicate packets from being processed B) To track the sequence number of the current segment C) To provide flow control feedback to the sender D) To verify the integrity of the header and data against transmission errors ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: TCP header లో checksum field యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? A) Duplicate packets process కాకుండా నిరోధించడం B) ప్రస్తుత segment యొక్క sequence number ను track చేయడం C) Sender కి flow control feedback ను అందించడం D) Transmission errors కి వ్యతిరేకంగా header మరియు data యొక్క integrity ని verify చేయడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the checksum field in a TCP header? A) To prevent duplicate packets from being processed B) To track the sequence number of the current segment C) To provide flow control feedback to the sender D) To verify the integrity of the header and data against transmission errors ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a wired-OR interrupt circuit, why might a spurious interrupt occur? A) The processor clock frequency was too high for the operating system B) Parasitic capacitance causes a delay in the signal returning to a quiescent state C) The software interrupt instruction was executed too many times D) The NMI priority level was set too low by the kernel ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Wired-OR interrupt circuit లో spurious interrupt ఎందుకు రావచ్చు? A) Operating system కి processor clock frequency చాలా ఎక్కువగా ఉంది B) Parasitic capacitance వల్ల signal quiescent state కి తిరిగి రావడంలో delay జరుగుతుంది C) Software interrupt instruction చాలా ఎక్కువ సార్లు execute అయింది D) Kernel NMI priority level ను చాలా తక్కువగా set చేసింది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In a wired-OR interrupt circuit, why might a spurious interrupt occur? A) The processor clock frequency was too high for the operating system B) Parasitic capacitance causes a delay in the signal returning to a quiescent state C) The software interrupt instruction was executed too many times D) The NMI priority level was set too low by the kernel ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why were early ARM designs limited to a 26-bit address space rather than using the full 32-bit capacity of the register? A) Because 32-bit memory was significantly more expensive to manufacture in the 1980s. B) The instruction set architecture required the extra bits for floating-point calculations. C) Early ARM processors were specifically designed for 8-bit systems, which cannot support 32-bit addressing. D) To allow the program counter and processor status flags to share a single 32-bit register. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: తొలి ARM designs register యొక్క పూర్తి 32-bit capacity ని వాడకుండా 26-bit address space కి ఎందుకు పరిమితమయ్యాయి? A) ఎందుకంటే 1980s లో 32-bit memory తయారీ గణనీయంగా ఖరీదైనది. B) Instruction set architecture కి floating-point లెక్కల కోసం అదనపు bits అవసరమయ్యాయి. C) తొలి ARM processors 8-bit systems కోసం ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించబడ్డాయి, అవి 32-bit addressing ను support చేయలేవు. D) Program counter మరియు processor status flags ఒకే 32-bit register ను పంచుకోవడానికి వీలుగా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why were early ARM designs limited to a 26-bit address space rather than using the full 32-bit capacity of the register? A) Because 32-bit memory was significantly more expensive to manufacture in the 1980s. B) The instruction set architecture required the extra bits for floating-point calculations. C) Early ARM processors were specifically designed for 8-bit systems, which cannot support 32-bit addressing. D) To allow the program counter and processor status flags to share a single 32-bit register. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the fringe spacing of an interference pattern when two intersecting plane waves have their intersection angle θ decreased? A) The fringe spacing decreases B) The fringe pattern becomes circular C) The fringe spacing increases D) The fringe spacing remains constant ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Intersect అయ్యే రెండు plane waves యొక్క intersection angle θ తగ్గితే interference pattern యొక్క fringe spacing కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Fringe spacing తగ్గుతుంది B) Fringe pattern వృత్తాకారంగా మారుతుంది C) Fringe spacing పెరుగుతుంది D) Fringe spacing స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది జవాబు: C

C) Fluid motion ను బలవంతం చేసే బయటి fans లేదా pumps. D) Fluid యొక్క thermal expansion వల్ల కలిగే buoyancy forces. జవాబు: D

C) External fans or pumps forcing fluid motion. D) Buoyancy forces caused by thermal expansion of the fluid. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary engineering advantage of AC over DC in early power distribution history? A) AC కి తక్కువ copper wire అవసరం B) Transformers ను వాడి AC voltages ను సులభంగా step up లేదా step down చేయవచ్చు C) Transmission lines లో AC తక్కువ heat ను ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది D) High voltages వద్ద AC ను తాకడం సురక్షితం జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes an authoritative name server from a non-authoritative (caching) server? A) It only handles requests from other authoritative name servers. B) It is always located at the root of the DNS tree structure. C) It provides answers derived directly from the master configuration of the zone. D) It stores the entire database of all IP addresses on the Internet. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Authoritative name server ను non-authoritative (caching) server నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) అది ఇతర authoritative name servers నుండి వచ్చే requests ను మాత్రమే handle చేస్తుంది. B) అది ఎప్పుడూ DNS tree structure యొక్క root వద్ద ఉంటుంది. C) Zone యొక్క master configuration నుండి నేరుగా తీసుకున్న answers ను అది అందిస్తుంది. D) Internet లోని అన్ని IP addresses యొక్క మొత్తం database ను అది store చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What distinguishes an authoritative name server from a non-authoritative (caching) server? A) It only handles requests from other authoritative name servers. D) It stores the entire database of all IP addresses on the Internet. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the main design goal of a partition function in MapReduce? A) To sort the output data in alphabetical order B) To maximize the number of reducers for faster processing C) To encrypt the intermediate data for security D) To ensure an approximately uniform distribution of data for load balancing ANSWER: D

A) Output data ను alphabetical order లో sort చేయడం B) వేగవంతమైన processing కోసం reducers సంఖ్యను గరిష్ఠం చేయడం C) Security కోసం intermediate data ను encrypt చేయడం D) Load balancing కోసం data దాదాపు ఏకరీతిగా పంపిణీ అయ్యేలా చూడడం జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the high latency of secondary storage influence the design of a B-tree? A) It requires the tree to be stored entirely in memory. B) It encourages maximizing the number of keys per node to amortize access costs. C) It reduces the need for balancing operations. D) It makes the tree height irrelevant. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Secondary storage యొక్క ఎక్కువ latency B-tree design ను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) Tree మొత్తం memory లోనే store చేయబడాలి. B) Access costs ను amortize చేయడానికి ఒక్కో node కి keys సంఖ్యను గరిష్ఠం చేయడాన్ని అది ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది. C) అది balancing operations అవసరాన్ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. D) అది tree height ని అప్రస్తుతం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the high latency of secondary storage influence the design of a B-tree? A) It requires the tree to be stored entirely in memory. B) It encourages maximizing the number of keys per node to amortize access costs. C) It reduces the need for balancing operations. D) It makes the tree height irrelevant. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does sharing a common OS kernel among multiple containers introduce a specific security risk? A) It requires each container to have its own independent OS instance. B) It limits the ability to bundle configuration files and dependencies. C) It prevents containers from running on non-cloud environments. D) A vulnerability in the OS can compromise all containers running on that host. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: అనేక containers మధ్య ఒకే OS kernel ను పంచుకోవడం ఒక నిర్దిష్ట security ప్రమాదాన్ని ఎందుకు తెస్తుంది? A) దానికి ప్రతి container కి సొంత స్వతంత్ర OS instance ఉండాలి. B) Configuration files మరియు dependencies ను bundle చేసే సామర్థ్యాన్ని అది పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. C) Non-cloud environments పై containers నడవకుండా అది నిరోధిస్తుంది. D) OS లోని ఒక vulnerability ఆ host పై నడుస్తున్న అన్ని containers ను compromise చేయగలదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does sharing a common OS kernel among multiple containers introduce a specific security risk? A) It requires each container to have its own independent OS instance. B) It limits the ability to bundle configuration files and dependencies. C) It prevents containers from running on non-cloud environments. D) A vulnerability in the OS can compromise all containers running on that host. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is stress considered a macroscopic concept in continuum mechanics? A) Because it averages atomic forces over a volume large enough to ignore molecular details B) Because it only applies to very small particles C) Because it is independent of the material's physical properties D) Because it is measured using quantum mechanical principles ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Continuum mechanics లో stress ను macroscopic భావనగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది molecular వివరాలను పట్టించుకోనవసరం లేనంత పెద్ద volume పై atomic forces ను average చేస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే అది చాలా చిన్న particles కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే అది material యొక్క physical properties పై ఆధారపడదు D) ఎందుకంటే దానిని quantum mechanical సూత్రాలతో కొలుస్తారు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is stress considered a macroscopic concept in continuum mechanics? A) Because it averages atomic forces over a volume large enough to ignore molecular details B) Because it only applies to very small particles C) Because it is independent of the material's physical properties D) Because it is measured using quantum mechanical principles ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary characteristic of a load-store architecture? A) Arithmetic operations can directly access memory B) It has a variable-length instruction set C) Arithmetic operations operate only on registers D) It uses microcode for all operations ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Load-store architecture యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Arithmetic operations memory ని నేరుగా access చేయగలవు B) దానికి variable-length instruction set ఉంటుంది C) Arithmetic operations registers పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి D) అది అన్ని operations కి microcode ను వాడుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary characteristic of a load-store architecture? A) Arithmetic operations can directly access memory B) It has a variable-length instruction set C) Arithmetic operations operate only on registers D) It uses microcode for all operations ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a ReLU activation function is scale-invariant, what does this imply about the network's parameters? A) The network's learning rate must be adjusted based on the input scale B) The network can compute the same output even if weights and biases are scaled proportionally C) The weights must always be positive D) The output is always bounded between 0 and 1 ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ReLU activation function scale-invariant అయితే, network parameters గురించి అది ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Input scale ఆధారంగా network learning rate ను సర్దుబాటు చేయాలి B) Weights మరియు biases ను అనుపాతంగా scale చేసినా network అదే output ను compute చేయగలదు C) Weights ఎప్పుడూ positive గా ఉండాలి D) Output ఎప్పుడూ 0 మరియు 1 మధ్య bounded గా ఉంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a ReLU activation function is scale-invariant, what does this imply about the network's parameters? A) The network's learning rate must be adjusted based on the input scale B) The network can compute the same output even if weights and biases are scaled proportionally C) The weights must always be positive D) The output is always bounded between 0 and 1 ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the ARM philosophy toward hardware-software interaction compare to traditional CISC architectures? A) ARM integrates all possible peripheral functions into the hardware to remove software dependency. B) ARM relies solely on software to manage memory, whereas CISC uses hardware only. C) ARM designs are identical to CISC designs, just with a different marketing name. D) ARM generally prefers simplicity in instructions, pushing more complex logic into software when possible. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hardware-software interaction పట్ల ARM దృక్పథం సాంప్రదాయ CISC architectures తో ఎలా పోలుస్తుంది? A) Software dependency ని తొలగించడానికి ARM సాధ్యమైన అన్ని peripheral functions ను hardware లో integrate చేస్తుంది. B) Memory ని నిర్వహించడానికి ARM కేవలం software పై ఆధారపడుతుంది, CISC hardware ను మాత్రమే వాడుతుంది. C) ARM designs CISC designs తో ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి, కేవలం వేరే marketing పేరుతో. D) ARM సాధారణంగా instructions లో సరళతను ఇష్టపడుతుంది, సాధ్యమైనప్పుడు సంక్లిష్ట logic ను software లోకి నెడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does the ARM philosophy toward hardware-software interaction compare to traditional CISC architectures? A) ARM integrates all possible peripheral functions into the hardware to remove software dependency. B) ARM relies solely on software to manage memory, whereas CISC uses hardware only. C) ARM designs are identical to CISC designs, just with a different marketing name. D) ARM generally prefers simplicity in instructions, pushing more complex logic into software when possible. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a reluctance motor typically achieve starting torque if it cannot start at synchronous speed? A) By using slip rings to provide DC excitation to the rotor. B) By increasing the supply frequency during the start-up phase. C) By using permanent magnets in the rotor. D) By incorporating squirrel-cage windings to act like an induction motor initially. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Synchronous speed వద్ద start కాలేని reluctance motor సాధారణంగా starting torque ను ఎలా సాధిస్తుంది? A) Rotor కి DC excitation అందించడానికి slip rings ను వాడడం ద్వారా. B) Start-up దశలో supply frequency ని పెంచడం ద్వారా. C) Rotor లో permanent magnets ను వాడడం ద్వారా. D) మొదట induction motor లా పనిచేయడానికి squirrel-cage windings ను చేర్చడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a reluctance motor typically achieve starting torque if it cannot start at synchronous speed? A) By using slip rings to provide DC excitation to the rotor. B) By increasing the supply frequency during the start-up phase. C) By using permanent magnets in the rotor. D) By incorporating squirrel-cage windings to act like an induction motor initially. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of written communication models over oral communication models? A) They are faster because they skip authentication checks. B) They prevent nodes from ever failing or crashing. C) They allow receivers to verify the entire communication history of a message using digital signatures. D) They eliminate the need for any message passing between nodes. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Oral communication models కంటే written communication models యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) Authentication checks ను దాటవేస్తాయి కాబట్టి అవి వేగంగా ఉంటాయి. B) Nodes ఎప్పటికీ fail లేదా crash కాకుండా అవి నిరోధిస్తాయి. C) Digital signatures ను వాడి ఒక message యొక్క మొత్తం communication history ని receivers verify చేయడానికి అవి వీలు కల్పిస్తాయి. D) Nodes మధ్య ఎలాంటి message passing అవసరాన్నైనా అవి తొలగిస్తాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of written communication models over oral communication models? A) They are faster because they skip authentication checks. B) They prevent nodes from ever failing or crashing. C) They allow receivers to verify the entire communication history of a message using digital signatures. D) They eliminate the need for any message passing between nodes. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of vehicle cruise control, what is the primary purpose of using a Bode plot? input: to Telugu: Q: How does a binary semaphore differ from a counting semaphore in its typical application? A) A counting semaphore is always faster than a binary semaphore B) A binary semaphore can only be used in single-processor systems C) A binary semaphore cannot be decremented by processes D) A binary semaphore is used for mutual exclusion, while a counting semaphore manages multiple identical resources ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: సాధారణ application లో binary semaphore counting semaphore నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Counting semaphore ఎప్పుడూ binary semaphore కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటుంది B) Binary semaphore ను single-processor systems లో మాత్రమే వాడగలం C) Binary semaphore ను processes decrement చేయలేవు D) Binary semaphore ను mutual exclusion కోసం వాడతారు, counting semaphore అనేక ఒకేలాంటి resources ను నిర్వహిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a binary semaphore differ from a counting semaphore in its typical application? input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of Poynting's theorem, what does the term representing the divergence of the Poynting vector primarily signify? A) The ohmic resistance of the medium B) The rate of electromagnetic energy leaving or entering a small volume C) The speed of light in the medium D) The total energy stored in the volume ANSWER: B

A) Medium యొక్క ohmic resistance B) ఒక చిన్న volume నుండి బయటకు వెళ్లే లేదా లోపలికి వచ్చే electromagnetic energy rate C) Medium లో light speed D) Volume లో store అయిన మొత్తం energy జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of Poynting's theorem, what does the term representing the divergence of the Poynting vector primarily signify? A) The ohmic resistance of the medium B) The rate of electromagnetic energy leaving or entering a small volume C) The speed of light in the medium D) The total energy stored in the volume ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a chopper circuit using PWM, what happens to the average output voltage as the duty cycle increases? A) It increases proportionally B) It becomes zero C) It decreases proportionally D) It remains constant ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: PWM వాడే chopper circuit లో duty cycle పెరిగే కొద్దీ average output voltage కి ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) అది అనుపాతంగా పెరుగుతుంది B) అది zero అవుతుంది C) అది అనుపాతంగా తగ్గుతుంది D) అది స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a chopper circuit using PWM, what happens to the average output voltage as the duty cycle increases? A) It increases proportionally B) It becomes zero C) It decreases proportionally D) It remains constant ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the key advantage of an interlingual approach compared to direct transfer-based methods? A) It can translate between any language pair without new rules B) It is faster than transfer-based methods C) It uses statistical models for better accuracy D) It requires no intermediate representation ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Direct transfer-based methods తో పోలిస్తే interlingual approach యొక్క ముఖ్య ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) కొత్త rules లేకుండానే అది ఏ language pair మధ్య అయినా translate చేయగలదు B) అది transfer-based methods కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటుంది C) మెరుగైన accuracy కోసం అది statistical models ను వాడుతుంది D) దానికి intermediate representation అవసరం లేదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the key advantage of an interlingual approach compared to direct transfer-based methods? A) It can translate between any language pair without new rules B) It is faster than transfer-based methods C) It uses statistical models for better accuracy D) It requires no intermediate representation ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a strict limitation of using open addressing in a hash table? A) It requires a secondary linked list for every slot B) It cannot support dynamic resizing C) It cannot be used with integer keys D) The number of elements stored cannot exceed the number of slots in the array ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hash table లో open addressing వాడకం యొక్క కఠినమైన పరిమితి కింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) దానికి ప్రతి slot కి secondary linked list అవసరం B) అది dynamic resizing ను support చేయలేదు C) దానిని integer keys తో వాడలేము D) Store చేసే elements సంఖ్య array లోని slots సంఖ్యను మించకూడదు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a strict limitation of using open addressing in a hash table? A) It requires a secondary linked list for every slot B) It cannot support dynamic resizing C) It cannot be used with integer keys D) The number of elements stored cannot exceed the number of slots in the array ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why did the statistical approach in NLP lead to an end of the AI winter? A) It used machine learning to find patterns in large corpora, proving more effective. B) It required no computational power to implement successfully. C) It relied on simple, interpretable hand-coded rules. D) It focused exclusively on symbolic manipulation of linguistic symbols. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: NLP లో statistical approach AI winter ముగింపుకు ఎందుకు దారితీసింది? A) పెద్ద corpora లో patterns కనుగొనడానికి అది machine learning ను వాడింది, మరింత సమర్థవంతమైనదని నిరూపించుకుంది. B) విజయవంతంగా implement చేయడానికి దానికి computational power అవసరం లేదు. C) అది సరళమైన, అర్థం చేసుకోదగిన hand-coded rules పై ఆధారపడింది. D) అది linguistic symbols యొక్క symbolic manipulation పై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టింది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why did the statistical approach in NLP lead to an end of the AI winter? A) It used machine learning to find patterns in large corpora, proving more effective. B) It required no computational power to implement successfully. C) It relied on simple, interpretable hand-coded rules. D) It focused exclusively on symbolic manipulation of linguistic symbols. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a filter is described as having a 'high-Q', what does this imply about its passband? A) The filter will pass all frequencies equally. B) The filter has no passband. C) The passband is very narrow. D) The passband is very wide. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక filter కి 'high-Q' ఉందని వర్ణిస్తే, దాని passband గురించి అది ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Filter అన్ని frequencies ను సమానంగా pass చేస్తుంది. B) Filter కి passband లేదు. C) Passband చాలా ఇరుకుగా ఉంటుంది. D) Passband చాలా విశాలంగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: If a filter is described as having a 'high-Q', what does this imply about its passband? A) The filter will pass all frequencies equally. B) The filter has no passband. C) The passband is very narrow. D) The passband is very wide. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does increasing model complexity not always lead to better performance on unseen data? A) Because the number of parameters is a poor measure of complexity. B) Because complex models are harder to train computationally. C) Because increased complexity always decreases both bias and variance. D) Because increased complexity can lead to high variance, causing overfitting. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Model complexity ని పెంచడం unseen data పై ఎప్పుడూ మెరుగైన performance కి ఎందుకు దారితీయదు? A) ఎందుకంటే parameters సంఖ్య complexity కి పేలవమైన కొలమానం. B) ఎందుకంటే సంక్లిష్ట models ను computationally train చేయడం కష్టం. C) ఎందుకంటే పెరిగిన complexity ఎప్పుడూ bias మరియు variance రెండింటినీ తగ్గిస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే పెరిగిన complexity ఎక్కువ variance కి దారితీసి overfitting కి కారణం కావచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does increasing model complexity not always lead to better performance on unseen data? A) Because the number of parameters is a poor measure of complexity. B) Because complex models are harder to train computationally. C) Because increased complexity always decreases both bias and variance. D) Because increased complexity can lead to high variance, causing overfitting. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If a system's output at time t is determined by the input at time t+1, how is this system classified? A) Linear B) Non-causal C) Causal D) Physical ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక system యొక్క time t వద్ద output time t+1 వద్ద input ద్వారా నిర్ణయించబడితే, ఈ system ను ఎలా వర్గీకరిస్తారు? A) Linear B) Non-causal C) Causal D) Physical జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a system's output at time t is determined by the input at time t+1, how is this system classified? A) Linear B) Non-causal C) Causal D) Physical ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why was microcode originally developed as an alternative to hardwired control logic? A) To eliminate the need for an instruction set B) To increase the clock speed of the processor directly C) To simplify the design and debugging of complex instruction sets D) To reduce the physical size of the processor ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Hardwired control logic కి ప్రత్యామ్నాయంగా microcode ను మొదట ఎందుకు అభివృద్ధి చేశారు? A) Instruction set అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి B) Processor clock speed ను నేరుగా పెంచడానికి C) సంక్లిష్ట instruction sets యొక్క design మరియు debugging ను సరళీకరించడానికి D) Processor యొక్క భౌతిక పరిమాణాన్ని తగ్గించడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why was microcode originally developed as an alternative to hardwired control logic? A) To eliminate the need for an instruction set B) To increase the clock speed of the processor directly C) To simplify the design and debugging of complex instruction sets D) To reduce the physical size of the processor ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In a Hybrid ARQ scheme using FEC parity data, when does the receiver request retransmission? A) It requests retransmission only if the parity data was insufficient for successful decoding. B) It requests retransmission after a fixed timeout period regardless of decoding success. C) It requests retransmission immediately after the first transmission attempt. D) It requests retransmission if the channel capacity drops below a threshold. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: FEC parity data ను వాడే Hybrid ARQ scheme లో receiver retransmission ను ఎప్పుడు request చేస్తుంది? A) విజయవంతమైన decoding కి parity data సరిపోనప్పుడు మాత్రమే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. B) Decoding విజయంతో సంబంధం లేకుండా fixed timeout period తర్వాత అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. C) మొదటి transmission ప్రయత్నం తర్వాత వెంటనే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. D) Channel capacity ఒక threshold కంటే తగ్గితే అది retransmission ను request చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a Hybrid ARQ scheme using FEC parity data, when does the receiver request retransmission? A) It requests retransmission only if the parity data was insufficient for successful decoding. B) It requests retransmission after a fixed timeout period regardless of decoding success. C) It requests retransmission immediately after the first transmission attempt. D) It requests retransmission if the channel capacity drops below a threshold. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the noisy-channel coding theorem state about transmission rates above channel capacity? A) The error probability can be reduced to zero by increasing bandwidth. B) The system achieves perfect reliability with advanced coding. C) The channel becomes completely unusable for any communication. D) The error probability approaches 0.5 as block length goes to infinity. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Channel capacity కంటే ఎక్కువ transmission rates గురించి noisy-channel coding theorem ఏమి చెబుతుంది? A) Bandwidth పెంచడం ద్వారా error probability ని సున్నాకు తగ్గించవచ్చు. B) Advanced coding తో system పూర్తి reliability ని సాధిస్తుంది. C) Channel ఏ communication కీ పూర్తిగా ఉపయోగపడదు. D) Block length infinity కి వెళ్ళేకొద్దీ error probability 0.5 కి చేరుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What does the noisy-channel coding theorem state about transmission rates above channel capacity? A) The error probability can be reduced to zero by increasing bandwidth. B) The system achieves perfect reliability with advanced coding. C) The channel becomes completely unusable for any communication. D) The error probability approaches 0.5 as block length goes to infinity. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason the time complexity of Quicksort can degrade to O(n^2)? A) When the array is already sorted and a poor pivot is chosen B) When recursion is not used C) When there are no repeated elements D) When the array size is too large for memory ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Quicksort యొక్క time complexity O(n^2) కి దిగజారడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Array ఇప్పటికే sorted గా ఉండి, సరిగా లేని pivot ఎంచుకున్నప్పుడు B) Recursion ఉపయోగించనప్పుడు C) పునరావృతమయ్యే elements లేనప్పుడు D) Array size memory కి చాలా పెద్దగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason the time complexity of Quicksort can degrade to O(n^2)? A) When the array is already sorted and a poor pivot is chosen B) When recursion is not used C) When there are no repeated elements D) When the array size is too large for memory ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a monitor in the context of the producer-consumer problem? A) To define the structure of the buffer without handling any synchronization logic. B) To implement busy waiting as an alternative to semaphores for synchronization. C) To encapsulate shared data and synchronize access to it through condition variables. D) To allow multiple threads to modify the buffer simultaneously without any synchronization. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Producer-consumer problem సందర్భంలో monitor యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) ఎలాంటి synchronization logic ని handle చేయకుండా buffer యొక్క structure ని నిర్వచించడం. B) Synchronization కోసం semaphores కి ప్రత్యామ్నాయంగా busy waiting ని implement చేయడం. C) Shared data ని encapsulate చేసి, condition variables ద్వారా దానికి access ని synchronize చేయడం. D) ఎలాంటి synchronization లేకుండా అనేక threads ఒకేసారి buffer ని modify చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a monitor in the context of the producer-consumer problem? A) To define the structure of the buffer without handling any synchronization logic. B) To implement busy waiting as an alternative to semaphores for synchronization. C) To encapsulate shared data and synchronize access to it through condition variables. D) To allow multiple threads to modify the buffer simultaneously without any synchronization. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are standard cryptographic hash functions like SHA considered unsafe for password storage? A) They do not provide pre-image resistance. B) They produce outputs that are too short. C) They are designed to be computed quickly, allowing attackers to brute-force passwords rapidly. D) They require a secret key that is difficult to manage. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: SHA వంటి standard cryptographic hash functions password storage కి ఎందుకు సురక్షితం కావు అని భావిస్తారు? A) అవి pre-image resistance ని అందించవు. B) అవి చాలా చిన్న outputs ని ఇస్తాయి. C) అవి వేగంగా compute అయ్యేలా రూపొందించబడ్డాయి, దీనివల్ల attackers passwords ని త్వరగా brute-force చేయగలరు. D) వాటికి manage చేయడం కష్టమైన secret key అవసరం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why are standard cryptographic hash functions like SHA considered unsafe for password storage? A) They do not provide pre-image resistance. B) They produce outputs that are too short. C) They are designed to be computed quickly, allowing attackers to brute-force passwords rapidly. D) They require a secret key that is difficult to manage. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: A beam of electrons moves along the +x direction in a magnetic field oriented along the +z direction. In which direction is the magnetic Lorentz force directed? A) Along the -y direction B) Along the +y direction C) Along the -z direction D) Along the +x direction ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: +z దిశలో ఉన్న magnetic field లో ఒక electrons beam +x దిశలో కదులుతోంది. Magnetic Lorentz force ఏ దిశలో ఉంటుంది? A) -y దిశలో B) +y దిశలో C) -z దిశలో D) +x దిశలో జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: A beam of electrons moves along the +x direction in a magnetic field oriented along the +z direction. In which direction is the magnetic Lorentz force directed? A) Along the -y direction B) Along the +y direction C) Along the -z direction D) Along the +x direction ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does data move between stages in a standard shift register? A) Through random access addressing B) By using a shared clock signal to move bits to adjacent flip-flops C) By using an arithmetic logic unit to calculate positions D) By applying a high voltage to all pins simultaneously ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard shift register లో stages మధ్య data ఎలా కదులుతుంది? A) Random access addressing ద్వారా B) Shared clock signal ఉపయోగించి bits ని పక్కనే ఉన్న flip-flops కి కదిలించడం ద్వారా C) Positions ని లెక్కించడానికి arithmetic logic unit ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా D) అన్ని pins కి ఒకేసారి high voltage ఇవ్వడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does data move between stages in a standard shift register? A) Through random access addressing B) By using a shared clock signal to move bits to adjacent flip-flops C) By using an arithmetic logic unit to calculate positions D) By applying a high voltage to all pins simultaneously ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is heat transfer classified as a process function rather than a function of state? A) Because it is measured in Joules, which is a unit of energy. B) Because it is always proportional to temperature difference. C) Because it depends on the path taken during the process. D) Because it only occurs in solid materials. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Heat transfer ని function of state గా కాకుండా process function గా ఎందుకు వర్గీకరిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది energy యూనిట్ అయిన Joules లో కొలవబడుతుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ temperature difference కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే అది process లో తీసుకున్న path పై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే అది solid materials లో మాత్రమే జరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is heat transfer classified as a process function rather than a function of state? A) Because it is measured in Joules, which is a unit of energy. B) Because it is always proportional to temperature difference. C) Because it depends on the path taken during the process. D) Because it only occurs in solid materials. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary data source used by statistical machine translation systems to learn translation patterns? A) Unilingual dictionaries B) Grammar rule sets C) Human translator guidelines D) Bilingual text corpora ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Translation patterns నేర్చుకోవడానికి statistical machine translation systems ఉపయోగించే ప్రధాన data source ఏమిటి? A) ఏకభాషా dictionaries B) Grammar rule sets C) Human translator guidelines D) Bilingual text corpora జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary data source used by statistical machine translation systems to learn translation patterns? A) Unilingual dictionaries B) Grammar rule sets C) Human translator guidelines D) Bilingual text corpora ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a high temperature typically used in the softmax function during knowledge distillation? A) To decrease the computational complexity of the cross-entropy calculation B) To soften the probability distribution and reveal more information about the teacher's internal representations C) To force the student model to learn only the hard labels of the training set D) To speed up the training convergence of the large model ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Knowledge distillation లో softmax function లో సాధారణంగా high temperature ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) Cross-entropy calculation యొక్క computational complexity ని తగ్గించడానికి B) Probability distribution ని soften చేసి, teacher యొక్క internal representations గురించి ఎక్కువ సమాచారాన్ని బయటపెట్టడానికి C) Student model training set యొక్క hard labels ని మాత్రమే నేర్చుకునేలా చేయడానికి D) పెద్ద model యొక్క training convergence ని వేగవంతం చేయడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is a high temperature typically used in the softmax function during knowledge distillation? A) To decrease the computational complexity of the cross-entropy calculation B) To soften the probability distribution and reveal more information about the teacher's internal representations C) To force the student model to learn only the hard labels of the training set D) To speed up the training convergence of the large model ANSWER: B
