input: to Telugu: Q: How does delta-sigma modulation improve upon standard delta modulation regarding DC content? A) It increases the sampling rate to preserve low-frequency components. B) It transmits DC content separately from the modulated signal. C) It uses a larger step size to prevent DC loss. D) It rearranges the integrator's position so the signal represents amplitude instead of derivative. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: DC content విషయంలో delta-sigma modulation, standard delta modulation ని ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) Low-frequency components ని కాపాడటానికి sampling rate ని పెంచుతుంది. B) DC content ని modulated signal నుండి విడిగా transmit చేస్తుంది. C) DC loss ని నివారించడానికి పెద్ద step size ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. D) Integrator స్థానాన్ని మార్చడం వల్ల signal derivative కి బదులు amplitude ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does delta-sigma modulation improve upon standard delta modulation regarding DC content? A) It increases the sampling rate to preserve low-frequency components. B) It transmits DC content separately from the modulated signal. C) It uses a larger step size to prevent DC loss. D) It rearranges the integrator's position so the signal represents amplitude instead of derivative. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a ripple counter considered unstable during state transitions? A) Each flip-flop introduces a delay, causing bits to change at different times. B) The counter cannot handle more than two bits of data. C) The reset signal is applied asynchronously to the output. D) The clock signal is too weak to trigger all flip-flops. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: State transitions సమయంలో ripple counter ని అస్థిరమైనదిగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ప్రతి flip-flop ఒక delay ని కలిగిస్తుంది, దీనివల్ల bits వేర్వేరు సమయాల్లో మారతాయి. B) Counter రెండు bits కంటే ఎక్కువ data ని handle చేయలేదు. C) Reset signal output కి asynchronous గా ఇవ్వబడుతుంది. D) అన్ని flip-flops ని trigger చేయడానికి clock signal చాలా బలహీనంగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a ripple counter considered unstable during state transitions? A) Each flip-flop introduces a delay, causing bits to change at different times. B) The counter cannot handle more than two bits of data. C) The reset signal is applied asynchronously to the output. D) The clock signal is too weak to trigger all flip-flops. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary architectural difference between a multicomputer and a multiprocessor? A) Multicomputers are always real-time, while multiprocessors are not B) Multicomputers use GUIs while multiprocessors do not C) Multicomputers run only embedded operating systems D) Multicomputers have multiple CPUs with separate memory, while multiprocessors share memory ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Multicomputer మరియు multiprocessor మధ్య ప్రధాన architectural తేడా ఏమిటి? A) Multicomputers ఎల్లప్పుడూ real-time, multiprocessors కావు B) Multicomputers GUIs ఉపయోగిస్తాయి, multiprocessors ఉపయోగించవు C) Multicomputers embedded operating systems ని మాత్రమే run చేస్తాయి D) Multicomputers కి విడివిడి memory తో అనేక CPUs ఉంటాయి, multiprocessors memory ని share చేసుకుంటాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary architectural difference between a multicomputer and a multiprocessor? A) Multicomputers are always real-time, while multiprocessors are not B) Multicomputers use GUIs while multiprocessors do not C) Multicomputers run only embedded operating systems D) Multicomputers have multiple CPUs with separate memory, while multiprocessors share memory ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If a relation satisfies the dependency StudentID → Semester, what happens if two tuples have the same StudentID but different Semester values? A) Relation normalized అవుతుంది B) Relation FD ని violate చేస్తుంది C) Determinant set ఒక superkey అవుతుంది D) Relation ఇంకా FD ని satisfy చేస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a relation satisfies the dependency StudentID → Semester, what happens if two tuples have the same StudentID but different Semester values? A) The relation becomes normalized B) The relation violates the FD C) The determinant set becomes a superkey D) The relation still satisfies the FD ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of a stored-program computer over a fixed-program machine? A) It can execute different programs by simply loading new instructions into memory. B) It requires physical rewiring to change tasks. C) It uses more hardware components to achieve simplicity. D) It can only perform one specific mathematical operation. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Fixed-program machine కంటే stored-program computer యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) Memory లోకి కొత్త instructions ని load చేయడం ద్వారానే అది వేర్వేరు programs ని execute చేయగలదు. B) Tasks మార్చడానికి దానికి physical rewiring అవసరం. C) సరళత సాధించడానికి అది ఎక్కువ hardware components ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. D) అది ఒక నిర్దిష్ట mathematical operation ని మాత్రమే చేయగలదు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of a stored-program computer over a fixed-program machine? A) It can execute different programs by simply loading new instructions into memory. B) It requires physical rewiring to change tasks. C) It uses more hardware components to achieve simplicity. D) It can only perform one specific mathematical operation. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the consequence of a data race in a C or C++ program according to the C11 and C++11 standards? A) The program will exhibit predictable but slow performance. B) The program has undefined behavior, meaning any result is possible. C) The program will automatically terminate to prevent memory corruption. D) The compiler will generate an error during the compilation phase. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: C11 మరియు C++11 standards ప్రకారం C లేదా C++ program లో data race వల్ల కలిగే పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Program ఊహించదగిన కానీ నెమ్మదైన performance ని చూపిస్తుంది. B) Program కి undefined behavior ఉంటుంది, అంటే ఏ ఫలితమైనా రావచ్చు. C) Memory corruption ని నివారించడానికి program automatic గా terminate అవుతుంది. D) Compilation దశలో compiler ఒక error ని generate చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the consequence of a data race in a C or C++ program according to the C11 and C++11 standards? A) The program will exhibit predictable but slow performance. B) The program has undefined behavior, meaning any result is possible. C) The program will automatically terminate to prevent memory corruption. D) The compiler will generate an error during the compilation phase. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a coinductive data definition? A) To define data using a simple base case. B) To define operations on data of infinite size. C) To define data with a finite, fixed size. D) To define data that cannot be modified after creation. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Coinductive data definition యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) ఒక సాధారణ base case ఉపయోగించి data ని నిర్వచించడం. B) Infinite size ఉన్న data పై operations ని నిర్వచించడం. C) Finite, fixed size ఉన్న data ని నిర్వచించడం. D) సృష్టించిన తర్వాత modify చేయలేని data ని నిర్వచించడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a coinductive data definition? A) To define data using a simple base case. B) To define operations on data of infinite size. C) To define data with a finite, fixed size. D) To define data that cannot be modified after creation. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the cumulative distribution function (CDF) critical to the histogram equalization process? A) It acts as the mapping function that spreads out intensities to create a uniform distribution B) It reduces the bit-depth of the image to save storage space C) It acts as a filter to remove high-frequency noise from the image D) It determines the final color balance of the output image ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Histogram equalization process కి cumulative distribution function (CDF) ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) అది intensities ని విస్తరించి uniform distribution ని సృష్టించే mapping function గా పనిచేస్తుంది B) Storage space ఆదా చేయడానికి అది image యొక్క bit-depth ని తగ్గిస్తుంది C) Image నుండి high-frequency noise ని తొలగించే filter గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది D) అది output image యొక్క చివరి color balance ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the cumulative distribution function (CDF) critical to the histogram equalization process? A) It acts as the mapping function that spreads out intensities to create a uniform distribution B) It reduces the bit-depth of the image to save storage space C) It acts as a filter to remove high-frequency noise from the image D) It determines the final color balance of the output image ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition is power spectral density (PSD) more commonly used than energy spectral density (ESD)? A) For transient signals with finite total energy B) For signals with non-finite energy C) For stationary processes existing over all time or a very large interval D) For signals with zero mean and finite variance ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో energy spectral density (ESD) కంటే power spectral density (PSD) ఎక్కువగా ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది? A) Finite total energy ఉన్న transient signals కోసం B) Non-finite energy ఉన్న signals కోసం C) అన్ని కాలాల్లో లేదా చాలా పెద్ద interval లో ఉండే stationary processes కోసం D) Zero mean మరియు finite variance ఉన్న signals కోసం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Under what condition is power spectral density (PSD) more commonly used than energy spectral density (ESD)? A) For transient signals with finite total energy B) For signals with non-finite energy C) For stationary processes existing over all time or a very large interval D) For signals with zero mean and finite variance ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the bandwidth-limited regime, what is the approximate relationship between channel capacity and bandwidth? A) Capacity is approximately linear with bandwidth. B) Capacity decreases exponentially with bandwidth. C) Capacity is independent of bandwidth. D) Capacity is inversely proportional to bandwidth. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Bandwidth-limited regime లో channel capacity మరియు bandwidth మధ్య సుమారు సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) Capacity, bandwidth తో సుమారుగా linear గా ఉంటుంది. B) Bandwidth తో capacity exponential గా తగ్గుతుంది. C) Capacity, bandwidth పై ఆధారపడదు. D) Capacity, bandwidth కి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In the bandwidth-limited regime, what is the approximate relationship between channel capacity and bandwidth? A) Capacity is approximately linear with bandwidth. B) Capacity decreases exponentially with bandwidth. C) Capacity is independent of bandwidth. D) Capacity is inversely proportional to bandwidth. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What describes a logical transaction composed of several physical transactions? A) A single indivisible operation. B) A series of operations that must all execute for the logical transaction to occur. C) A transaction that only reads data. D) A transaction that is always isolated. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: అనేక physical transactions తో కూడిన logical transaction ని ఏది వివరిస్తుంది? A) విభజించలేని ఒకే operation. B) Logical transaction జరగాలంటే అన్నీ execute కావలసిన operations శ్రేణి. C) Data ని మాత్రమే read చేసే transaction. D) ఎల్లప్పుడూ isolated గా ఉండే transaction. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What describes a logical transaction composed of several physical transactions? A) A single indivisible operation. B) A series of operations that must all execute for the logical transaction to occur. C) A transaction that only reads data. D) A transaction that is always isolated. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are clocked flip-flops preferred in synchronous digital systems? A) They require fewer logic gates to implement. B) They ensure all state changes occur at a specific, controlled time. C) They do not require any power to maintain state. D) They are faster than asynchronous latches. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Synchronous digital systems లో clocked flip-flops ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) వాటిని implement చేయడానికి తక్కువ logic gates అవసరం. B) అన్ని state మార్పులు ఒక నిర్దిష్ట, నియంత్రిత సమయంలో జరిగేలా అవి చూస్తాయి. C) State ని నిలుపుకోవడానికి వాటికి ఎలాంటి power అవసరం లేదు. D) అవి asynchronous latches కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why are clocked flip-flops preferred in synchronous digital systems? A) They require fewer logic gates to implement. B) They ensure all state changes occur at a specific, controlled time. C) They do not require any power to maintain state. D) They are faster than asynchronous latches. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of greedy approximation algorithms for NP-complete problems? A) They run in exponential time. B) They always find the exact optimal solution. C) They provide a solution within a provable factor of optimal. D) They are only applicable to graph problems. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: NP-complete problems కోసం greedy approximation algorithms యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) అవి exponential time లో run అవుతాయి. B) అవి ఎల్లప్పుడూ కచ్చితమైన optimal solution ని కనుగొంటాయి. C) అవి optimal కి నిరూపించదగిన factor లోపల ఒక solution ని ఇస్తాయి. D) అవి graph problems కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తాయి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of greedy approximation algorithms for NP-complete problems? A) They run in exponential time. B) They always find the exact optimal solution. C) They provide a solution within a provable factor of optimal. D) They are only applicable to graph problems. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary objective of a network using an energy function during the training phase? A) To keep the energy constant throughout the learning process. B) To minimize the energy of the system to achieve a stable activation pattern. C) To maximize the energy to increase the network's processing speed. D) To ignore the energy state as it is irrelevant to neural network performance. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Training phase లో energy function ఉపయోగించే network యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి? A) Learning process అంతటా energy ని స్థిరంగా ఉంచడం. B) స్థిరమైన activation pattern సాధించడానికి system యొక్క energy ని minimize చేయడం. C) Network processing speed పెంచడానికి energy ని maximize చేయడం. D) Neural network performance కి సంబంధం లేనందున energy state ని పట్టించుకోకపోవడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary objective of a network using an energy function during the training phase? A) To keep the energy constant throughout the learning process. B) To minimize the energy of the system to achieve a stable activation pattern. C) To maximize the energy to increase the network's processing speed. D) To ignore the energy state as it is irrelevant to neural network performance. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the use of pointers considered efficient for traversing large data structures like linked lists compared to copying the data? A) It prevents memory fragmentation within the operating system. B) It avoids the time and memory overhead of copying the actual data payload. C) It allows the CPU to bypass the cache entirely during access. D) It automatically reduces the total number of elements in the data structure. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Data ని copy చేయడంతో పోలిస్తే linked lists వంటి పెద్ద data structures ని traverse చేయడానికి pointers ఉపయోగించడం ఎందుకు సమర్థవంతం? A) అది operating system లో memory fragmentation ని నివారిస్తుంది. B) అసలు data payload ని copy చేసే time మరియు memory overhead ని అది తప్పిస్తుంది. C) Access సమయంలో CPU cache ని పూర్తిగా bypass చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) అది data structure లోని మొత్తం elements సంఖ్యను automatic గా తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the use of pointers considered efficient for traversing large data structures like linked lists compared to copying the data? A) It prevents memory fragmentation within the operating system. B) It avoids the time and memory overhead of copying the actual data payload. C) It allows the CPU to bypass the cache entirely during access. D) It automatically reduces the total number of elements in the data structure. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of material implication (x → y), what happens to the result if the premise 'x' is false? A) The result is always false B) The result is undefined C) The result is always true D) The result depends on the value of 'y' ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Material implication (x → y) సందర్భంలో premise 'x' false అయితే result ఏమవుతుంది? A) Result ఎల్లప్పుడూ false B) Result undefined C) Result ఎల్లప్పుడూ true D) Result 'y' value పై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In the context of material implication (x → y), what happens to the result if the premise 'x' is false? A) The result is always false B) The result is undefined C) The result is always true D) The result depends on the value of 'y' ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of the Bakery algorithm compared to simpler algorithms like Peterson's? A) It does not use shared memory for communication. B) It can handle an arbitrary number of processes without deadlock. C) It requires more than two processes to function correctly. D) It is only applicable to uniprocessor systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Peterson's వంటి సరళమైన algorithms తో పోలిస్తే Bakery algorithm యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Communication కోసం అది shared memory ఉపయోగించదు. B) Deadlock లేకుండా అది ఎన్ని processes నైనా handle చేయగలదు. C) సరిగ్గా పనిచేయడానికి దానికి రెండు కంటే ఎక్కువ processes అవసరం. D) అది uniprocessor systems కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of the Bakery algorithm compared to simpler algorithms like Peterson's? A) It does not use shared memory for communication. B) It can handle an arbitrary number of processes without deadlock. C) It requires more than two processes to function correctly. D) It is only applicable to uniprocessor systems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the sign of the Hall coefficient help characterize a semiconductor? A) It measures the total magnetic permeability of the crystal lattice B) It indicates whether the semiconductor is intrinsic or completely undoped C) It identifies whether conduction is dominated by electrons or holes D) It calculates the exact bandgap energy of the material ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Hall coefficient యొక్క sign ఒక semiconductor ని వర్గీకరించడానికి ఎలా సహాయపడుతుంది? A) అది crystal lattice యొక్క మొత్తం magnetic permeability ని కొలుస్తుంది B) Semiconductor intrinsic గా ఉందా లేదా పూర్తిగా undoped గా ఉందా అని సూచిస్తుంది C) Conduction లో electrons ఆధిపత్యం ఉందా లేదా holes ఆధిపత్యం ఉందా అని గుర్తిస్తుంది D) Material యొక్క కచ్చితమైన bandgap energy ని లెక్కిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does the sign of the Hall coefficient help characterize a semiconductor? A) It measures the total magnetic permeability of the crystal lattice B) It indicates whether the semiconductor is intrinsic or completely undoped C) It identifies whether conduction is dominated by electrons or holes D) It calculates the exact bandgap energy of the material ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes an APDoS attack from a standard DDoS attack? A) It uses a single IP address instead of a botnet. B) It persists for extended periods and may tactically switch targets. C) It relies on brute force rather than reconnaissance. D) It only targets application-layer processes. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard DDoS attack నుండి APDoS attack ని ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) అది botnet కి బదులు ఒకే IP address ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) అది చాలా కాలం పాటు కొనసాగుతుంది మరియు వ్యూహాత్మకంగా targets ని మార్చవచ్చు. C) అది reconnaissance కంటే brute force పై ఆధారపడుతుంది. D) అది application-layer processes ని మాత్రమే target చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What distinguishes an APDoS attack from a standard DDoS attack? A) It uses a single IP address instead of a botnet. B) It persists for extended periods and may tactically switch targets. C) It relies on brute force rather than reconnaissance. D) It only targets application-layer processes. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a MOS capacitor with a p-type substrate, what happens at the surface as the gate voltage increases positively? A) Surface intrinsic గా మరియు conductive గా మారుతుంది B) Surface మరింత p-type గా మారుతుంది C) Surface వద్ద electrons యొక్క inversion layer ఏర్పడుతుంది D) Surface holes తో నిండిపోతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In a MOS capacitor with a p-type substrate, what happens at the surface as the gate voltage increases positively? A) The surface becomes intrinsic and conductive B) The surface becomes more p-type C) The surface forms an inversion layer of electrons D) The surface is flooded with holes ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What problem occurs in a write-back cache when a device uses DMA to write to memory? A) The CPU might read a stale value from its cache that has not been updated in memory. B) The DMA controller cannot access memory without flushing the entire cache. C) The memory address register in the DMA controller becomes invalid. D) The CPU immediately receives an interrupt for every write operation. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక device memory కి write చేయడానికి DMA ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు write-back cache లో ఏ సమస్య వస్తుంది? A) Memory లో update కాని పాత value ని CPU తన cache నుండి read చేయవచ్చు. B) మొత్తం cache ని flush చేయకుండా DMA controller memory ని access చేయలేదు. C) DMA controller లోని memory address register invalid అవుతుంది. D) ప్రతి write operation కి CPU వెంటనే ఒక interrupt ని అందుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What problem occurs in a write-back cache when a device uses DMA to write to memory? A) The CPU might read a stale value from its cache that has not been updated in memory. B) The DMA controller cannot access memory without flushing the entire cache. C) The memory address register in the DMA controller becomes invalid. D) The CPU immediately receives an interrupt for every write operation. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of spectral density in signal processing? A) To determine the time-domain amplitude of a signal B) To calculate the total duration of a signal C) To describe the distribution of a signal's power or energy across frequency components D) To identify the physical location of a signal's source ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Signal processing లో spectral density యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Signal యొక్క time-domain amplitude ని నిర్ణయించడం B) Signal యొక్క మొత్తం duration ని లెక్కించడం C) Frequency components అంతటా signal యొక్క power లేదా energy ఎలా పంపిణీ అయిందో వివరించడం D) Signal source యొక్క భౌతిక స్థానాన్ని గుర్తించడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of spectral density in signal processing? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the ability to 'peek' at k input symbols important for an LL(k) parser? A) It converts the parser into a non-deterministic machine. B) It enables the parser to recognize non-context-free languages. C) It allows the parser to identify which production rule to apply without needing to backtrack. D) It increases the stack size to handle deep recursion. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: LL(k) parser కి k input symbols ని 'peek' చేసే సామర్థ్యం ఎందుకు ముఖ్యం? A) అది parser ని non-deterministic machine గా మారుస్తుంది. B) Non-context-free languages ని parser గుర్తించేలా చేస్తుంది. C) Backtrack చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేకుండా ఏ production rule ని apply చేయాలో parser గుర్తించడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) లోతైన recursion ని handle చేయడానికి stack size ని పెంచుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the ability to 'peek' at k input symbols important for an LL(k) parser? A) It converts the parser into a non-deterministic machine. B) It enables the parser to recognize non-context-free languages. C) It allows the parser to identify which production rule to apply without needing to backtrack. D) It increases the stack size to handle deep recursion. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of flow over a flat plate, what phenomenon occurs within the boundary layer as the flow progresses downstream? B) Boundary layer thickness నిరంతరం తగ్గుతుంది. C) Boundary layer పూర్తిగా stagnant అవుతుంది. D) Boundary layer స్థిరమైన laminar state నుండి అస్థిరమైన turbulent state కి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In which scenario would Weighted Round-Robin be strictly superior to standard Round-Robin? A) When a network administrator wants to prioritize specific traffic flows over others B) When the CPU needs to minimize the number of context switches C) When all data flows have identical packet sizes and requirements D) When the scheduler is non-preemptive and jobs are short ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ సందర్భంలో Weighted Round-Robin, standard Round-Robin కంటే కచ్చితంగా మెరుగైనది? A) Network administrator కొన్ని నిర్దిష్ట traffic flows కి ఇతర వాటి కంటే priority ఇవ్వాలనుకున్నప్పుడు B) CPU context switches సంఖ్యను తగ్గించాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు C) అన్ని data flows కి ఒకే packet sizes మరియు requirements ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Scheduler non-preemptive గా ఉండి jobs చిన్నవిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In which scenario would Weighted Round-Robin be strictly superior to standard Round-Robin? A) When a network administrator wants to prioritize specific traffic flows over others B) When the CPU needs to minimize the number of context switches C) When all data flows have identical packet sizes and requirements D) When the scheduler is non-preemptive and jobs are short ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does negative feedback primarily affect the performance of a modern amplifier? A) It increases the power consumption of the circuit B) It reduces distortion and stabilizes the gain C) It converts a single-port network into a multi-port network D) It increases the overall gain significantly ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: How does negative feedback primarily affect the performance of a modern amplifier? input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary benefit of using parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA? A) It significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters and memory requirements. input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it necessary for the input array to be sorted before performing a binary search? A) To allow the algorithm to eliminate half the remaining elements in each step. B) Algorithm యొక్క space complexity ని పెంచడానికి. C) అది అవసరం లేదు, కానీ code ని శుభ్రంగా కనిపించేలా చేస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే binary search integers పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In which operating mode does a BJT typically function as an amplifier? A) Forward-active region B) Reverse-active mode C) Cut-off mode D) Saturation mode ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the Fourier series representation at a point of finite jump discontinuity for a piecewise-smooth function? A) It oscillates indefinitely without approaching any single finite value B) It converges to the arithmetic mean of the left-hand and right-hand limits C) It always converges strictly to the right-hand limit D) It diverges completely to infinity due to Gibbs phenomenon ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Piecewise-smooth function కి finite jump discontinuity ఉన్న బిందువు వద్ద Fourier series representation కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది ఏ ఒక్క finite value కీ చేరకుండా నిరంతరం oscillate అవుతుంది B) అది left-hand మరియు right-hand limits యొక్క arithmetic mean కి converge అవుతుంది C) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ కచ్చితంగా right-hand limit కి converge అవుతుంది D) Gibbs phenomenon వల్ల అది పూర్తిగా infinity కి diverge అవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the Fourier series representation at a point of finite jump discontinuity for a piecewise-smooth function? A) It oscillates indefinitely without approaching any single finite value B) It converges to the arithmetic mean of the left-hand and right-hand limits C) It always converges strictly to the right-hand limit D) It diverges completely to infinity due to Gibbs phenomenon ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under which condition does the third case of the master theorem apply to a recurrence relation? A) The combination time and subproblem work are asymptotically equal B) The combination time is asymptotically larger than the subproblem work C) The combination time is constant D) The combination time is asymptotically smaller than the subproblem work ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Recurrence relation కి master theorem యొక్క మూడవ case ఏ పరిస్థితిలో వర్తిస్తుంది? A) Combination time మరియు subproblem work asymptotically సమానంగా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) Combination time, subproblem work కంటే asymptotically పెద్దదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు C) Combination time constant గా ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Combination time, subproblem work కంటే asymptotically చిన్నదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Under which condition does the third case of the master theorem apply to a recurrence relation? A) The combination time and subproblem work are asymptotically equal B) The combination time is asymptotically larger than the subproblem work C) The combination time is constant D) The combination time is asymptotically smaller than the subproblem work ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What fundamentally determines the specific form of a propagation mode in a waveguide? A) The solution to the wave equation subject to the waveguide's boundary conditions B) The material's conductivity only C) The source frequency alone D) The length of the waveguide ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Waveguide లో propagation mode యొక్క నిర్దిష్ట రూపాన్ని ప్రాథమికంగా ఏది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది? A) Waveguide యొక్క boundary conditions కి లోబడి wave equation యొక్క solution B) Material యొక్క conductivity మాత్రమే C) Source frequency మాత్రమే D) Waveguide యొక్క length జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What fundamentally determines the specific form of a propagation mode in a waveguide? A) The solution to the wave equation subject to the waveguide's boundary conditions B) The material's conductivity only C) The source frequency alone D) The length of the waveguide ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Minimax algorithm primarily used in two-player zero-sum games? A) It allows players to collaborate to reach a higher shared total B) It guarantees a win every single time regardless of the opponent C) It provides a strategy that minimizes the maximum possible loss against an optimal opponent D) It eliminates the need for calculating heuristic values at leaf nodes ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Two-player zero-sum games లో Minimax algorithm ని ప్రధానంగా ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) ఎక్కువ shared total సాధించడానికి players కలిసి పనిచేయడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది B) Opponent ఎవరైనా ప్రతిసారీ గెలుపుకి హామీ ఇస్తుంది C) Optimal opponent కి వ్యతిరేకంగా గరిష్ట సాధ్యమైన నష్టాన్ని minimize చేసే strategy ని అందిస్తుంది D) Leaf nodes వద్ద heuristic values లెక్కించాల్సిన అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the Minimax algorithm primarily used in two-player zero-sum games? A) It allows players to collaborate to reach a higher shared total B) It guarantees a win every single time regardless of the opponent C) It provides a strategy that minimizes the maximum possible loss against an optimal opponent D) It eliminates the need for calculating heuristic values at leaf nodes ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is object detection in autonomous driving often trained on synthetic data like video game scenes? target_en: Q: Why is object detection in autonomous driving often trained on synthetic data like video game scenes? A) Video game scenes provide higher resolution images than real-world cameras. D) It is easier and cheaper to generate labeled data for synthetic scenes without manual labor. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: At the half-power frequencies (cutoff frequencies) of an RLC band-pass filter, how does the passed signal power compare to that at resonance? A) It drops to zero completely B) It drops to 70.7% of the peak power at resonance C) It doubles compared to the peak power at resonance D) It drops to 50% of the peak power at resonance ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: RLC band-pass filter యొక్క half-power frequencies (cutoff frequencies) వద్ద pass అయ్యే signal power, resonance వద్ద ఉన్న దానితో పోలిస్తే ఎలా ఉంటుంది? A) అది పూర్తిగా సున్నాకు పడిపోతుంది B) అది resonance వద్ద peak power లో 70.7% కి పడిపోతుంది C) Resonance వద్ద peak power తో పోలిస్తే అది రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది D) అది resonance వద్ద peak power లో 50% కి పడిపోతుంది జవాబు: D

D) ARQ కి back channel అవసరం, అది latency ని పెంచుతుంది మరియు high-speed links కి సరిపోదు. జవాబు: D

B) అది తక్కువ electrodes ఉపయోగిస్తుంది, దీనివల్ల setup వేగంగా మరియు సౌకర్యంగా ఉంటుంది. C) Myocardial ischemia ని గుర్తించగల ఏకైక ECG రకం అదే. input: to Telugu: Q: In leave-one-out cross-validation, what happens to the training set for each iteration? A) The entire dataset is used for both training and validation. D) The data is split into k equal folds, with one fold used for training. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Leave-one-out cross-validation లో ప్రతి iteration కి training set కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) మొత్తం dataset ని training మరియు validation రెండింటికీ ఉపయోగిస్తారు. B) ఒక observation తొలగించబడుతుంది, మిగిలిన n-1 observations training కి ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. C) ప్రతి iteration లో validation set, training set కంటే పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. D) Data k సమాన folds గా విభజించబడుతుంది, ఒక fold training కి ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In leave-one-out cross-validation, what happens to the training set for each iteration? A) The entire dataset is used for both training and validation. B) One observation is removed, and the remaining n-1 observations are used for training. C) The validation set is larger than the training set in each iteration. D) The data is split into k equal folds, with one fold used for training. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using a circular buffer to implement a queue over a standard array? A) It makes the queue a purely functional data structure. B) It uses less memory than a standard array implementation. C) It prevents the need to shift elements when dequeuing, improving efficiency. D) It allows the queue to dynamically resize automatically. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard array కంటే queue ని implement చేయడానికి circular buffer ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది queue ని purely functional data structure గా చేస్తుంది. B) Standard array implementation కంటే అది తక్కువ memory ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. C) Dequeue చేసేటప్పుడు elements ని shift చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేకుండా చేసి efficiency ని పెంచుతుంది. D) Queue automatic గా dynamic గా resize అయ్యేలా చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using a circular buffer to implement a queue over a standard array? A) It makes the queue a purely functional data structure. B) It uses less memory than a standard array implementation. C) It prevents the need to shift elements when dequeuing, improving efficiency. D) It allows the queue to dynamically resize automatically. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the decision form of the knapsack problem considered co-NP-complete? A) Because it requires pseudo-polynomial time to solve B) Because it is NP-hard but not in NP C) Because proving no better solution exists is co-NP-complete D) Because verifying a solution takes exponential time ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Knapsack problem యొక్క decision form ని co-NP-complete గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే దాన్ని solve చేయడానికి pseudo-polynomial time అవసరం B) ఎందుకంటే అది NP-hard కానీ NP లో లేదు C) ఎందుకంటే ఇంతకంటే మెరుగైన solution లేదని నిరూపించడం co-NP-complete D) ఎందుకంటే solution ని verify చేయడానికి exponential time పడుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the decision form of the knapsack problem considered co-NP-complete? A) Because it requires pseudo-polynomial time to solve B) Because it is NP-hard but not in NP C) Because proving no better solution exists is co-NP-complete D) Because verifying a solution takes exponential time ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of switched Ethernet compared to traditional shared-bus Ethernet regarding collision domains? A) It eliminates the need for MAC addresses B) It uses wireless signals instead of wires C) It allows for unlimited distance between nodes D) It isolates traffic, effectively creating smaller or single-node collision domains ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Collision domains విషయంలో సాంప్రదాయ shared-bus Ethernet తో పోలిస్తే switched Ethernet యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది MAC addresses అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది B) అది wires కి బదులు wireless signals ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) Nodes మధ్య అపరిమిత దూరాన్ని అనుమతిస్తుంది D) అది traffic ని వేరు చేసి, చిన్న లేదా single-node collision domains ని సమర్థవంతంగా సృష్టిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of switched Ethernet compared to traditional shared-bus Ethernet regarding collision domains? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary distinction between NP-hard and NP-complete problems? input: to Telugu: Q: How does a Zener diode differ from a conventional solid-state diode in its application? A) It cannot handle any reverse voltage. B) It lacks a p-n junction entirely. C) అది forward direction లో మాత్రమే current ప్రవహించడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) Regulation కోసం reverse breakdown region లో పనిచేసేలా అది ప్రత్యేకంగా రూపొందించబడింది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a Zener diode differ from a conventional solid-state diode in its application? A) It cannot handle any reverse voltage. B) It lacks a p-n junction entirely. C) It only allows current to flow in the forward direction. D) It is specifically designed to operate in the reverse breakdown region for regulation. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must transmission lines be modeled using distributed-element parameters rather than standard lumped circuits? A) Because transmission lines are only used for digital signals. B) Because the time taken for signals to traverse the length is significant relative to the signal frequency. C) Because the conductors are made of materials that do not obey Ohm's law. D) Because lumped circuits cannot handle DC power. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Transmission lines ని standard lumped circuits కి బదులు distributed-element parameters తో ఎందుకు model చేయాలి? A) ఎందుకంటే transmission lines digital signals కి మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. B) ఎందుకంటే signals length మొత్తం ప్రయాణించడానికి పట్టే సమయం signal frequency తో పోలిస్తే గణనీయంగా ఉంటుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే conductors Ohm's law ని పాటించని materials తో తయారవుతాయి. D) ఎందుకంటే lumped circuits DC power ని handle చేయలేవు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why must transmission lines be modeled using distributed-element parameters rather than standard lumped circuits? A) Because transmission lines are only used for digital signals. B) Because the time taken for signals to traverse the length is significant relative to the signal frequency. C) Because the conductors are made of materials that do not obey Ohm's law. D) Because lumped circuits cannot handle DC power. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the wavelet transform handle changes in time extension and shape of the basis functions? A) It does not allow any changes in either time extension or shape B) It allows changes in time extension but not shape C) It allows both changes in time extension and shape D) It allows changes in shape but not time extension ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Basis functions యొక్క time extension మరియు shape లో మార్పులను wavelet transform ఎలా handle చేస్తుంది? A) Time extension లో గానీ shape లో గానీ ఎలాంటి మార్పులను అనుమతించదు B) Time extension లో మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది కానీ shape లో కాదు C) Time extension మరియు shape రెండింటిలోనూ మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది D) Shape లో మార్పులను అనుమతిస్తుంది కానీ time extension లో కాదు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the wavelet transform handle changes in time extension and shape of the basis functions? A) It does not allow any changes in either time extension or shape B) It allows changes in time extension but not shape C) It allows both changes in time extension and shape D) It allows changes in shape but not time extension ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a lowpass filter necessary after the expansion step in an integer upsampling process? A) To remove spectral images created by the insertion of zeros during expansion B) To increase the signal amplitude to match the higher sampling rate C) To convert the digital signal back into an analog continuous-time signal D) To shift the phase of the signal so the samples align correctly ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Integer upsampling process లో expansion step తర్వాత lowpass filter ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) Expansion సమయంలో zeros ని చేర్చడం వల్ల ఏర్పడిన spectral images ని తొలగించడానికి B) ఎక్కువ sampling rate కి సరిపోయేలా signal amplitude ని పెంచడానికి C) Digital signal ని తిరిగి analog continuous-time signal గా మార్చడానికి D) Samples సరిగ్గా align అయ్యేలా signal phase ని shift చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a lowpass filter necessary after the expansion step in an integer upsampling process? A) To remove spectral images created by the insertion of zeros during expansion B) To increase the signal amplitude to match the higher sampling rate C) To convert the digital signal back into an analog continuous-time signal D) To shift the phase of the signal so the samples align correctly ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary trade-off when selecting the size of a time quantum in round-robin scheduling? A) Smaller quanta ensure better fairness but increase system overhead due to frequent switching B) Smaller quanta cause starvation for new processes entering the ready queue C) Larger quanta increase context switching overhead D) The size of the quantum has no impact on system performance ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Round-robin scheduling లో time quantum size ఎంచుకునేటప్పుడు ప్రధాన trade-off ఏమిటి? A) చిన్న quanta మెరుగైన fairness ని ఇస్తాయి కానీ తరచుగా switching వల్ల system overhead ని పెంచుతాయి B) చిన్న quanta ready queue లోకి వచ్చే కొత్త processes కి starvation కలిగిస్తాయి C) పెద్ద quanta context switching overhead ని పెంచుతాయి D) Quantum size కి system performance పై ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం లేదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary trade-off when selecting the size of a time quantum in round-robin scheduling? A) Smaller quanta ensure better fairness but increase system overhead due to frequent switching B) Smaller quanta cause starvation for new processes entering the ready queue C) Larger quanta increase context switching overhead D) The size of the quantum has no impact on system performance ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does HTTP/3 typically experience lower latency than HTTP/2? A) It compresses the entire payload more efficiently than HTTP/2. B) It uses a faster compression algorithm for headers. C) It eliminates TCP's slow-start mechanism by using UDP. D) It reduces the number of required round trips during connection establishment. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: HTTP/2 కంటే HTTP/3 కి సాధారణంగా తక్కువ latency ఎందుకు ఉంటుంది? A) అది HTTP/2 కంటే మొత్తం payload ని మరింత సమర్థవంతంగా compress చేస్తుంది. B) Headers కోసం అది వేగవంతమైన compression algorithm ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. C) UDP ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా అది TCP యొక్క slow-start mechanism ని తొలగిస్తుంది. D) Connection establishment సమయంలో అవసరమైన round trips సంఖ్యను అది తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why does HTTP/3 typically experience lower latency than HTTP/2? A) It compresses the entire payload more efficiently than HTTP/2. B) It uses a faster compression algorithm for headers. C) It eliminates TCP's slow-start mechanism by using UDP. D) It reduces the number of required round trips during connection establishment. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of a lead-lag compensator, what do the poles and zeros represent in the transfer function? target: ప్రశ్న: Lead-lag compensator సందర్భంలో transfer function లోని poles మరియు zeros దేనిని సూచిస్తాయి? A) Instability కి కారణమయ్యే input signal యొక్క నిర్దిష్ట values B) System యొక్క output మరియు input సమానంగా ఉండే frequencies C) Circuit board పై components యొక్క భౌతిక స్థానాలు D) Numerator మరియు denominator సున్నా అయ్యే complex variable s యొక్క values జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of a lead-lag compensator, what do the poles and zeros represent in the transfer function? A) The specific values of the input signal that cause instability B) The frequencies where the system's output and input are equal C) The physical locations of components on a circuit board D) The values of the complex variable s where the numerator and denominator are zero ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When a node exceeds its capacity during insertion in a B+ tree, what is the primary consequence? A) The tree is rebuilt from scratch B) The tree increases its height at the leaf level C) The new record is discarded to prevent overflow D) The node is split and a key is promoted to the parent ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: B+ tree లో insertion సమయంలో ఒక node తన capacity ని మించినప్పుడు ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Tree మొదటి నుండి మళ్ళీ నిర్మించబడుతుంది B) Leaf level వద్ద tree తన height ని పెంచుకుంటుంది C) Overflow ని నివారించడానికి కొత్త record విస్మరించబడుతుంది D) Node split చేయబడి, ఒక key parent కి promote చేయబడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: When a node exceeds its capacity during insertion in a B+ tree, what is the primary consequence? A) The tree is rebuilt from scratch B) The tree increases its height at the leaf level C) The new record is discarded to prevent overflow D) The node is split and a key is promoted to the parent ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the chain rule considered the mathematical foundation of backpropagation? A) అది neural network layers యొక్క architecture ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది B) Composite function యొక్క gradient ని layers అంతటా విభజించడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది C) అది loss function అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది D) అది input data loading speed ని optimize చేయడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the chain rule considered the mathematical foundation of backpropagation? A) It determines the architecture of the neural network layers B) It allows for the decomposition of the gradient of a composite function across layers C) It eliminates the necessity of having a loss function D) It helps optimize the speed of input data loading ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under thermal equilibrium (zero bias), why does net current across a p-n junction cease to flow? A) All mobile electrons and holes across the entire semiconductor completely recombine and vanish. B) Fixed dopant ions leave the crystal lattice to physically block charge transfer. C) The bandgap of the semiconductor increases to an infinite value at the metallurgical interface. D) Diffusion current of carriers is exactly balanced by the drift current driven by the built-in electric field. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Thermal equilibrium (zero bias) లో p-n junction అంతటా net current ఎందుకు ప్రవహించడం ఆగిపోతుంది? A) మొత్తం semiconductor లోని అన్ని mobile electrons మరియు holes పూర్తిగా recombine అయి అదృశ్యమవుతాయి. B) Fixed dopant ions crystal lattice ని వదిలి charge transfer ని భౌతికంగా అడ్డుకుంటాయి. C) Metallurgical interface వద్ద semiconductor యొక్క bandgap infinite value కి పెరుగుతుంది. D) Carriers యొక్క diffusion current, built-in electric field నడిపే drift current తో కచ్చితంగా సమతుల్యమవుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under thermal equilibrium (zero bias), why does net current across a p-n junction cease to flow? A) All mobile electrons and holes across the entire semiconductor completely recombine and vanish. B) Fixed dopant ions leave the crystal lattice to physically block charge transfer. C) The bandgap of the semiconductor increases to an infinite value at the metallurgical interface. D) Diffusion current of carriers is exactly balanced by the drift current driven by the built-in electric field. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary application of a deconvolutional neural network? A) Reducing noise in input audio signals. B) Performing initial feature extraction from raw pixels. C) Generating or upsampling images to increase resolution. D) Classifying images into categories. ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: What is a primary application of a deconvolutional neural network? A) Reducing noise in input audio signals. B) Performing initial feature extraction from raw pixels. C) Generating or upsampling images to increase resolution. D) Classifying images into categories. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: According to the Riemann-Lebesgue lemma, what is the behavior of the Fourier transform F(ω) of a function f ∈ L1(R) as |ω| → ∞? A) F(ω) approaches a non-zero finite constant. B) F(ω) oscillates between +1 and -1 indefinitely. C) F(ω) tends to zero. D) F(ω) grows exponentially with frequency. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Riemann-Lebesgue lemma ప్రకారం, |ω| → ∞ అయినప్పుడు f ∈ L1(R) function యొక్క Fourier transform F(ω) ఎలా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది? A) F(ω) ఒక non-zero finite constant కి చేరుతుంది. B) F(ω) +1 మరియు -1 మధ్య నిరంతరం oscillate అవుతుంది. C) F(ω) సున్నాకు చేరుతుంది. D) F(ω) frequency తో exponential గా పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: According to the Riemann-Lebesgue lemma, what is the behavior of the Fourier transform F(ω) of a function f ∈ L1(R) as |ω| → ∞? A) F(ω) approaches a non-zero finite constant. B) F(ω) oscillates between +1 and -1 indefinitely. C) F(ω) tends to zero. D) F(ω) grows exponentially with frequency. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why do packet filter firewalls often use the default action of 'silent discard' for unauthorized packets? A) To maximize network bandwidth usage B) To prioritize UDP traffic C) To keep the CPU cooler D) To prevent attackers from mapping the network via error messages ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Packet filter firewalls అనధికార packets కోసం తరచుగా 'silent discard' ని default action గా ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తాయి? A) Network bandwidth వినియోగాన్ని maximize చేయడానికి B) UDP traffic కి priority ఇవ్వడానికి C) CPU ని చల్లగా ఉంచడానికి D) Error messages ద్వారా attackers network ని map చేయకుండా నివారించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why do packet filter firewalls often use the default action of 'silent discard' for unauthorized packets? A) To maximize network bandwidth usage B) To prioritize UDP traffic C) To keep the CPU cooler D) To prevent attackers from mapping the network via error messages ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: Which of the following is true for a signal classified as an energy signal? A) Total energy is infinite B) It must be a periodic signal C) Average power is zero D) Average power is finite and positive ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary cause of a static race condition in digital electronics? A) When a signal and its complement are combined in a logic gate. B) When an input transitions multiple times during the feedback loop delay. C) When signals propagate along different paths with identical delays. D) When multiple transitions are intended but only one is desired. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital electronics లో static race condition కి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) ఒక signal మరియు దాని complement ఒక logic gate లో కలిపినప్పుడు. B) Feedback loop delay సమయంలో ఒక input అనేకసార్లు మారినప్పుడు. C) Signals ఒకే delays ఉన్న వేర్వేరు paths లో propagate అయినప్పుడు. D) అనేక transitions ఉద్దేశించినా ఒక్కటి మాత్రమే కావాలనుకున్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary cause of a static race condition in digital electronics? A) When a signal and its complement are combined in a logic gate. B) When an input transitions multiple times during the feedback loop delay. C) When signals propagate along different paths with identical delays. D) When multiple transitions are intended but only one is desired. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Median-of-three rule used for pivot selection? A) To ensure the algorithm never uses recursion B) To ensure that all elements in the array are equal C) To make the algorithm use more memory D) To provide a better estimate of the true median and avoid worst-case scenarios ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Pivot selection కోసం Median-of-three rule ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) Algorithm ఎప్పుడూ recursion ఉపయోగించకుండా చూడటానికి B) Array లోని అన్ని elements సమానంగా ఉండేలా చూడటానికి C) Algorithm ఎక్కువ memory ఉపయోగించేలా చేయడానికి D) నిజమైన median కి మెరుగైన అంచనా ఇచ్చి worst-case పరిస్థితులను నివారించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the Median-of-three rule used for pivot selection? A) To ensure the algorithm never uses recursion B) To ensure that all elements in the array are equal C) To make the algorithm use more memory D) To provide a better estimate of the true median and avoid worst-case scenarios ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is phase modulation often preferred in digital transmission coding schemes like Wi-Fi? A) Because it is easier to implement in analog audio receivers than FM. B) Because it allows for efficient encoding of digital states via phase shifts. C) Because it requires a variable amplitude carrier for higher gain. D) Because it completely eliminates the need for a carrier signal. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Wi-Fi వంటి digital transmission coding schemes లో phase modulation ని తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) ఎందుకంటే analog audio receivers లో FM కంటే దాన్ని implement చేయడం సులభం. B) ఎందుకంటే phase shifts ద్వారా digital states ని సమర్థవంతంగా encode చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే ఎక్కువ gain కోసం దానికి variable amplitude carrier అవసరం. D) ఎందుకంటే అది carrier signal అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is phase modulation often preferred in digital transmission coding schemes like Wi-Fi? A) Because it is easier to implement in analog audio receivers than FM. B) Because it allows for efficient encoding of digital states via phase shifts. C) Because it requires a variable amplitude carrier for higher gain. D) Because it completely eliminates the need for a carrier signal. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it necessary to maintain multiple concurrent versions of a software product rather than just keeping the latest version? A) To enable locating and fixing bugs that may exist only in specific historical versions. B) To allow developers to store unrelated projects in a single location. C) To ensure that binary files are automatically converted to text formats. D) To bypass the need for compiling code, saving system memory. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Software product యొక్క తాజా version ని మాత్రమే ఉంచకుండా అనేక concurrent versions ని ఎందుకు నిర్వహించాలి? A) నిర్దిష్ట పాత versions లో మాత్రమే ఉండే bugs ని గుర్తించి సరిచేయడానికి. B) సంబంధం లేని projects ని developers ఒకే చోట store చేయడానికి. C) Binary files automatic గా text formats కి మారేలా చూడటానికి. D) Code ని compile చేయాల్సిన అవసరాన్ని తప్పించి system memory ని ఆదా చేయడానికి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is it necessary to maintain multiple concurrent versions of a software product rather than just keeping the latest version? A) To enable locating and fixing bugs that may exist only in specific historical versions. B) To allow developers to store unrelated projects in a single location. C) To ensure that binary files are automatically converted to text formats. D) To bypass the need for compiling code, saving system memory. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason MLPs require nonlinear activation functions instead of linear ones? A) They are easier to implement than linear functions. B) Linear functions are too slow to compute. C) They are required for the backpropagation algorithm to work. D) Linear functions cause the network to collapse into a two-layer model, losing representational power. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: MLPs కి linear activation functions కి బదులు nonlinear activation functions అవసరమవడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Linear functions కంటే వాటిని implement చేయడం సులభం. B) Linear functions compute చేయడానికి చాలా నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటాయి. C) Backpropagation algorithm పనిచేయడానికి అవి అవసరం. D) Linear functions వల్ల network ఒక two-layer model గా కుదించుకుపోయి representational power ని కోల్పోతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason MLPs require nonlinear activation functions instead of linear ones? A) They are easier to implement than linear functions. B) Linear functions are too slow to compute. C) They are required for the backpropagation algorithm to work. D) Linear functions cause the network to collapse into a two-layer model, losing representational power. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How do direct methods fundamentally differ from iterative methods in exact arithmetic? A) Direct methods reach the exact solution in a finite number of predetermined steps. B) Direct methods can only approximate solutions using continuous limits. C) Direct methods prevent any accumulation of round-off errors in finite precision. D) Direct methods always depend on an initial guess to converge. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Exact arithmetic లో direct methods, iterative methods నుండి ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటాయి? A) Direct methods ముందుగా నిర్ణయించిన finite steps లో exact solution ని చేరుకుంటాయి. B) Direct methods continuous limits ఉపయోగించి solutions ని approximate మాత్రమే చేయగలవు. C) Direct methods finite precision లో round-off errors పేరుకుపోకుండా నివారిస్తాయి. D) Converge అవ్వడానికి direct methods ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒక initial guess పై ఆధారపడతాయి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How do direct methods fundamentally differ from iterative methods in exact arithmetic? A) Direct methods reach the exact solution in a finite number of predetermined steps. B) Direct methods can only approximate solutions using continuous limits. C) Direct methods prevent any accumulation of round-off errors in finite precision. D) Direct methods always depend on an initial guess to converge. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a reverse-biased p–n junction conduct only an extremely small current before breakdown? A) Electrons and holes are converted into photons before crossing the junction. B) The broadened potential barrier blocks majority carriers, allowing only thermally generated minority carriers to cross. C) Majority carriers cancel each other out completely in the external connecting leads. D) The applied electric field neutralizes all donor and acceptor dopants inside the crystal. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Reverse-biased p–n junction breakdown కి ముందు చాలా తక్కువ current ని మాత్రమే ఎందుకు conduct చేస్తుంది? A) Junction ని దాటే ముందు electrons మరియు holes photons గా మారతాయి. B) విస్తరించిన potential barrier majority carriers ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది, thermal గా generate అయిన minority carriers మాత్రమే దాటగలవు. C) External connecting leads లో majority carriers ఒకదానినొకటి పూర్తిగా రద్దు చేసుకుంటాయి. D) Applied electric field crystal లోని అన్ని donor మరియు acceptor dopants ని neutralize చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a reverse-biased p–n junction conduct only an extremely small current before breakdown? A) Electrons and holes are converted into photons before crossing the junction. B) The broadened potential barrier blocks majority carriers, allowing only thermally generated minority carriers to cross. C) Majority carriers cancel each other out completely in the external connecting leads. D) The applied electric field neutralizes all donor and acceptor dopants inside the crystal. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does increasing the order of a Butterworth filter affect its performance? A) It decreases the cutoff frequency B) It introduces ripples in the passband C) It increases the roll-off rate D) It reduces the complexity of the design ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Butterworth filter యొక్క order పెంచడం దాని performance ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది cutoff frequency ని తగ్గిస్తుంది B) అది passband లో ripples ని తీసుకువస్తుంది C) అది roll-off rate ని పెంచుతుంది D) అది design complexity ని తగ్గిస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does increasing the order of a Butterworth filter affect its performance? A) It decreases the cutoff frequency B) It introduces ripples in the passband C) It increases the roll-off rate D) It reduces the complexity of the design ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key implication of using a convex objective function in gradient descent? A) It requires a large step size. B) It eliminates the need for a learning rate. C) It makes the gradient always zero. D) It guarantees convergence to a global minimum. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Gradient descent లో convex objective function ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ముఖ్యమైన implication ఏమిటి? A) దానికి పెద్ద step size అవసరం. B) అది learning rate అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. C) అది gradient ని ఎల్లప్పుడూ సున్నాగా చేస్తుంది. D) అది global minimum కి convergence కి హామీ ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key implication of using a convex objective function in gradient descent? A) It requires a large step size. B) It eliminates the need for a learning rate. C) It makes the gradient always zero. D) It guarantees convergence to a global minimum. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a semaphore in a concurrent system? A) To allocate memory dynamically to processes B) To increase the processing speed of a single thread C) To control access to a shared resource by multiple processes D) To translate machine code into assembly language ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Concurrent system లో semaphore యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Processes కి memory ని dynamic గా కేటాయించడం B) ఒకే thread యొక్క processing speed ని పెంచడం C) అనేక processes ద్వారా shared resource కి access ని నియంత్రించడం D) Machine code ని assembly language లోకి translate చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a semaphore in a concurrent system? A) To allocate memory dynamically to processes B) To increase the processing speed of a single thread C) To control access to a shared resource by multiple processes D) To translate machine code into assembly language ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the hydraulic diameter used instead of the actual diameter for non-circular ducts? A) It is required by all international engineering codes. B) It provides a standardized characteristic length that allows equivalent Reynolds number calculations. C) It accounts for the material thickness of the duct walls. D) It is always smaller than the actual diameter for easier calculations. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Non-circular ducts కోసం అసలు diameter కి బదులు hydraulic diameter ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) అన్ని international engineering codes దాన్ని తప్పనిసరి చేస్తాయి. B) సమానమైన Reynolds number లెక్కింపులకు అనుమతించే ప్రామాణిక characteristic length ని అది అందిస్తుంది. C) Duct walls యొక్క material thickness ని అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకుంటుంది. D) సులభమైన లెక్కింపుల కోసం అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ అసలు diameter కంటే చిన్నదిగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the hydraulic diameter used instead of the actual diameter for non-circular ducts? A) It is required by all international engineering codes. B) It provides a standardized characteristic length that allows equivalent Reynolds number calculations. C) It accounts for the material thickness of the duct walls. D) It is always smaller than the actual diameter for easier calculations. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does alpha-beta pruning effectively reduce the search time in a minimax tree? A) It only searches the first half of the tree depth. B) It reduces the branching factor by half at every node. C) It evaluates nodes in a random order to find cutoffs faster. D) It eliminates branches that cannot possibly influence the final decision. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Minimax tree లో alpha-beta pruning search time ని సమర్థవంతంగా ఎందుకు తగ్గిస్తుంది? A) అది tree depth లో మొదటి సగాన్ని మాత్రమే search చేస్తుంది. B) ప్రతి node వద్ద branching factor ని సగానికి తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Cutoffs ని వేగంగా కనుగొనడానికి nodes ని random order లో evaluate చేస్తుంది. D) చివరి నిర్ణయాన్ని ఏ విధంగానూ ప్రభావితం చేయలేని branches ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does alpha-beta pruning effectively reduce the search time in a minimax tree? A) It only searches the first half of the tree depth. B) It reduces the branching factor by half at every node. C) It evaluates nodes in a random order to find cutoffs faster. D) It eliminates branches that cannot possibly influence the final decision. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary limitation of the F-score that the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) attempts to resolve? A) F-score is too computationally expensive for large datasets B) F-score cannot be averaged across classes C) F-score only works for multi-class problems and not binary classification D) F-score fails to incorporate the true negative counts in its calculation ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) పరిష్కరించడానికి ప్రయత్నించే F-score యొక్క ప్రధాన పరిమితి ఏమిటి? A) పెద్ద datasets కి F-score computationally చాలా ఖరీదైనది B) F-score ని classes అంతటా average చేయలేము C) F-score multi-class problems కి మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది, binary classification కి కాదు D) F-score తన లెక్కింపులో true negative counts ని చేర్చదు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a primary limitation of the F-score that the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) attempts to resolve? A) F-score is too computationally expensive for large datasets B) F-score cannot be averaged across classes C) F-score only works for multi-class problems and not binary classification D) F-score fails to incorporate the true negative counts in its calculation ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If the total variance of a dataset is constant, what does minimizing the Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) imply about the Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS)? A) BCSS remains unchanged as it is independent of WCSS. B) BCSS must increase because the two components are inversely related. C) BCSS must also decrease to maintain the constant total variance. D) BCSS becomes zero, indicating all clusters are identical. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Dataset యొక్క total variance స్థిరంగా ఉంటే, Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) ని minimize చేయడం Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS) గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) BCSS, WCSS పై ఆధారపడనందున మారకుండా ఉంటుంది. B) రెండు components విలోమ సంబంధం కలిగి ఉన్నందున BCSS తప్పనిసరిగా పెరుగుతుంది. C) Total variance స్థిరంగా ఉండటానికి BCSS కూడా తగ్గాలి. D) BCSS సున్నా అవుతుంది, అంటే అన్ని clusters ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If the total variance of a dataset is constant, what does minimizing the Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS) imply about the Between-Cluster Sum of Squares (BCSS)? A) BCSS remains unchanged as it is independent of WCSS. B) BCSS must increase because the two components are inversely related. C) BCSS must also decrease to maintain the constant total variance. D) BCSS becomes zero, indicating all clusters are identical. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of a BDUF model like waterfall in software development? target: ప్రశ్న: Software development లో waterfall వంటి BDUF model యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of a BDUF model like waterfall in software development? A) To limit risks to successful and predictable results B) To encourage continuous iteration and scope changes C) To assess organizational process maturity D) To provide a flexible framework for rapid prototyping ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a vector v is added to a set S, and v is already in Span(S), what happens to Span(S U {v})? A) The dimension of the span increases by one B) The span collapses to the zero vector C) The new set becomes strictly linearly independent D) The span remains completely unchanged ANSWER: D

target_en: Q: If a vector v is added to a set S, and v is already in Span(S), what happens to Span(S U {v})? A) The dimension of the span increases by one B) The span collapses to the zero vector C) The new set becomes strictly linearly independent D) The span remains completely unchanged ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a fundamental difference between rule-based lexical tokenization and LLM tokenization? target_en: Q: Which of the following is a fundamental difference between rule-based lexical tokenization and LLM tokenization? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason for implementing concurrency control in a database system? A) To eliminate the need for database transactions B) To ensure that concurrent transactions produce correct results without violating data integrity C) To reduce the number of transactions processed per second D) To increase the physical storage capacity of the database ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Database system లో concurrency control ని implement చేయడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Database transactions అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి B) Concurrent transactions data integrity ని ఉల్లంఘించకుండా సరైన ఫలితాలు ఇచ్చేలా చూడటానికి C) సెకనుకు process అయ్యే transactions సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడానికి D) Database యొక్క physical storage capacity ని పెంచడానికి జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is software maintenance often considered less rewarding than new development? A) అది సాధారణంగా ఇతర దేశాలకు outsource చేయబడుతుంది B) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ కొత్త development కంటే ఖరీదైనది C) దానిలో ఎలాంటి coding లేదా technical పని ఉండదు D) దానికి తక్కువ skills అవసరం మరియు తక్కువ గుర్తింపు లభిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is software maintenance often considered less rewarding than new development? input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a boost converter step up voltage while stepping down current? A) Because the duty cycle is always greater than 50% B) Because power must be conserved and input power equals output power C) Because the diode blocks the input voltage during the off-state D) Because the inductor stores energy in its magnetic field ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Boost converter current ని తగ్గిస్తూ voltage ని ఎందుకు పెంచుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే duty cycle ఎల్లప్పుడూ 50% కంటే ఎక్కువ B) ఎందుకంటే power conserve కావాలి, input power, output power కి సమానం C) ఎందుకంటే off-state సమయంలో diode input voltage ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది D) ఎందుకంటే inductor తన magnetic field లో energy ని store చేస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a boost converter step up voltage while stepping down current? A) Because the duty cycle is always greater than 50% B) Because power must be conserved and input power equals output power C) Because the diode blocks the input voltage during the off-state D) Because the inductor stores energy in its magnetic field ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens during the process of method overriding in an object-oriented program? A) A subclass replaces a base class method with its own specific implementation B) A base class method is deleted from memory C) The compiler prevents the subclass from using its own version D) A subclass automatically inherits all private methods from the base ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Object-oriented program లో method overriding process సమయంలో ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) ఒక subclass, base class method ని తన స్వంత నిర్దిష్ట implementation తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది B) ఒక base class method memory నుండి తొలగించబడుతుంది C) Subclass తన స్వంత version ఉపయోగించకుండా compiler అడ్డుకుంటుంది D) ఒక subclass, base నుండి అన్ని private methods ని automatic గా inherit చేసుకుంటుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens during the process of method overriding in an object-oriented program? A) A subclass replaces a base class method with its own specific implementation B) A base class method is deleted from memory C) The compiler prevents the subclass from using its own version D) A subclass automatically inherits all private methods from the base ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of combinational logic representation, how is a 'sum of products' constructed? A) By multiplying all inputs together and then adding a constant B) By summing all logical statements which yield true results C) By summing all logical statements that yield false results D) By subtracting products from a total sum of inputs ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Combinational logic representation సందర్భంలో 'sum of products' ఎలా నిర్మించబడుతుంది? A) అన్ని inputs ని గుణించి ఆపై ఒక constant ని కలపడం ద్వారా B) True ఫలితాలు ఇచ్చే అన్ని logical statements ని కలపడం ద్వారా C) False ఫలితాలు ఇచ్చే అన్ని logical statements ని కలపడం ద్వారా D) Inputs యొక్క మొత్తం sum నుండి products ని తీసివేయడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of combinational logic representation, how is a 'sum of products' constructed? A) By multiplying all inputs together and then adding a constant B) By summing all logical statements which yield true results C) By summing all logical statements that yield false results D) By subtracting products from a total sum of inputs ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the stability requirement for a causal discrete-time IIR system in the Z-plane? A) All poles must be outside the unit circle B) All poles must be inside the unit circle C) All poles must be on the unit circle D) Poles must be at the origin ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What does information gain measure in decision tree algorithms? A) The probability of a correct prediction at a leaf. B) The total number of features in the dataset. C) The computational cost of splitting a node. D) The reduction in entropy after a split. ANSWER: D
