input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary physical outcome when an electron in the conduction band recombines with a hole in the valence band? A) The band gap energy of the semiconductor material increases permanently. B) Both charge carriers are annihilated, releasing energy as light or heat. C) An extra free electron is generated in the conduction band. D) The crystal lattice develops structural dislocations. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Conduction band లోని ఒక electron, valence band లోని hole తో recombine అయినప్పుడు ప్రధాన భౌతిక ఫలితం ఏమిటి? A) Semiconductor material యొక్క band gap energy శాశ్వతంగా పెరుగుతుంది. B) రెండు charge carriers నశించి, energy ని కాంతి లేదా వేడి రూపంలో విడుదల చేస్తాయి. C) Conduction band లో ఒక అదనపు free electron generate అవుతుంది. D) Crystal lattice లో structural dislocations ఏర్పడతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary physical outcome when an electron in the conduction band recombines with a hole in the valence band? A) The band gap energy of the semiconductor material increases permanently. B) Both charge carriers are annihilated, releasing energy as light or heat. C) An extra free electron is generated in the conduction band. D) The crystal lattice develops structural dislocations. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a subnet mask in IPv4 addressing? A) To divide an IP address into network and host portions B) To define the physical topology of a network C) To assign a unique MAC address to a network interface D) To encrypt data packets for secure transmission ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: IPv4 addressing లో subnet mask యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) IP address ని network మరియు host భాగాలుగా విభజించడం B) Network యొక్క physical topology ని నిర్వచించడం C) Network interface కి ఒక unique MAC address ని కేటాయించడం D) సురక్షిత transmission కోసం data packets ని encrypt చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a subnet mask in IPv4 addressing? A) To divide an IP address into network and host portions B) To define the physical topology of a network C) To assign a unique MAC address to a network interface D) To encrypt data packets for secure transmission ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the size of the central Airy disk when the diameter of a circular aperture is reduced? A) The Airy disk disappears leaving uniform illumination B) The Airy disk expands, causing greater beam divergence C) The Airy disk diameter remains strictly constant D) The Airy disk contracts into a sharper point ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Circular aperture యొక్క diameter తగ్గించినప్పుడు central Airy disk size కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Airy disk అదృశ్యమై uniform illumination మిగులుతుంది B) Airy disk విస్తరిస్తుంది, దీనివల్ల ఎక్కువ beam divergence కలుగుతుంది C) Airy disk diameter కచ్చితంగా స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది D) Airy disk కుంచించుకుపోయి పదునైన బిందువుగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the size of the central Airy disk when the diameter of a circular aperture is reduced? A) The Airy disk disappears leaving uniform illumination B) The Airy disk expands, causing greater beam divergence C) The Airy disk diameter remains strictly constant D) The Airy disk contracts into a sharper point ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens in an LL parser during a leftmost derivation step? A) The parser ignores non-terminals and only matches terminals. B) The parser expands the rightmost non-terminal first. C) The parser expands the leftmost non-terminal currently on the stack. D) The parser replaces a terminal symbol with a non-terminal. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Leftmost derivation step సమయంలో LL parser లో ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) Parser non-terminals ని పట్టించుకోకుండా terminals ని మాత్రమే match చేస్తుంది. B) Parser మొదట rightmost non-terminal ని expand చేస్తుంది. C) Parser ప్రస్తుతం stack పై ఉన్న leftmost non-terminal ని expand చేస్తుంది. D) Parser ఒక terminal symbol ని non-terminal తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens in an LL parser during a leftmost derivation step? A) The parser ignores non-terminals and only matches terminals. B) The parser expands the rightmost non-terminal first. C) The parser expands the leftmost non-terminal currently on the stack. D) The parser replaces a terminal symbol with a non-terminal. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for introducing bias into a regression estimate through techniques like Lasso or Ridge? A) To eliminate the need for dependent variables. B) To make the computation of the optimal parameter faster. C) To satisfy the assumptions of the Gauss-Markov theorem. D) To reduce the variance of the estimate and prevent overfitting. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Lasso లేదా Ridge వంటి techniques ద్వారా regression estimate లోకి bias ని ప్రవేశపెట్టడానికి ప్రధాన ప్రేరణ ఏమిటి? A) Dependent variables అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి. B) Optimal parameter యొక్క computation ని వేగవంతం చేయడానికి. C) Gauss-Markov theorem యొక్క assumptions ని satisfy చేయడానికి. D) Estimate యొక్క variance ని తగ్గించి overfitting ని నివారించడానికి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for introducing bias into a regression estimate through techniques like Lasso or Ridge? A) To eliminate the need for dependent variables. B) To make the computation of the optimal parameter faster. C) To satisfy the assumptions of the Gauss-Markov theorem. D) To reduce the variance of the estimate and prevent overfitting. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a MAC address required in an Ethernet network? A) To uniquely identify each device's network interface B) To encrypt data transmissions for security C) To manage the physical length of the cable D) To route packets between different subnets ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Ethernet network లో MAC address ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ప్రతి device యొక్క network interface ని ప్రత్యేకంగా గుర్తించడానికి B) Security కోసం data transmissions ని encrypt చేయడానికి C) Cable యొక్క physical length ని నిర్వహించడానికి D) వేర్వేరు subnets మధ్య packets ని route చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a MAC address required in an Ethernet network? A) To uniquely identify each device's network interface B) To encrypt data transmissions for security C) To manage the physical length of the cable D) To route packets between different subnets ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) reduce the overall computation time for binary addition? A) By reducing the total number of logic gates used B) By converting the addition into a subtraction process C) By using analog summing amplifiers instead of digital gates D) By calculating carries for all bit positions in parallel using generate and propagate signals ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) binary addition కోసం మొత్తం computation time ని ఎలా తగ్గిస్తుంది? A) ఉపయోగించే మొత్తం logic gates సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా B) Addition ని subtraction process గా మార్చడం ద్వారా C) Digital gates కి బదులు analog summing amplifiers ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా D) Generate మరియు propagate signals ఉపయోగించి అన్ని bit positions కి carries ని parallel గా లెక్కించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) reduce the overall computation time for binary addition? A) By reducing the total number of logic gates used B) By converting the addition into a subtraction process C) By using analog summing amplifiers instead of digital gates D) By calculating carries for all bit positions in parallel using generate and propagate signals ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental purpose of a band-pass filter in a receiver? A) To change the transmission frequency of incoming data. B) To increase the amplitude of all received signals. C) To block signals outside a specific frequency range to prevent interference. D) To convert digital signals back into analogue voltage levels. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Receiver లో band-pass filter యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశ్యాన్ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) వచ్చే data యొక్క transmission frequency ని మార్చడం. B) అందుకున్న అన్ని signals యొక్క amplitude ని పెంచడం. C) Interference ని నివారించడానికి నిర్దిష్ట frequency range బయట ఉన్న signals ని అడ్డుకోవడం. D) Digital signals ని తిరిగి analogue voltage levels గా మార్చడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental purpose of a band-pass filter in a receiver? A) To change the transmission frequency of incoming data. B) To increase the amplitude of all received signals. C) To block signals outside a specific frequency range to prevent interference. D) To convert digital signals back into analogue voltage levels. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do the values in Boolean algebra differ from those in elementary algebra? A) Boolean algebra uses subtraction, while elementary algebra uses negation. B) There is no difference between the two systems. C) Boolean values are real numbers, while elementary values are bits. D) Boolean values are truth values (0 and 1), while elementary values are numbers. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Boolean algebra లోని values, elementary algebra లోని వాటి నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటాయి? A) Boolean algebra subtraction ఉపయోగిస్తుంది, elementary algebra negation ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) ఈ రెండు systems మధ్య ఎలాంటి తేడా లేదు. C) Boolean values real numbers, elementary values bits. D) Boolean values truth values (0 మరియు 1), elementary values సంఖ్యలు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How do the values in Boolean algebra differ from those in elementary algebra? A) Boolean algebra uses subtraction, while elementary algebra uses negation. B) There is no difference between the two systems. C) Boolean values are real numbers, while elementary values are bits. D) Boolean values are truth values (0 and 1), while elementary values are numbers. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What are the two primary components that constitute a lexical token? A) A regular expression and a state machine B) A token name and an optional value C) A semantic tree and a lexeme D) A character sequence and a probability score ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక lexical token ని ఏర్పరిచే రెండు ప్రధాన components ఏవి? A) ఒక regular expression మరియు ఒక state machine B) ఒక token name మరియు ఒక optional value C) ఒక semantic tree మరియు ఒక lexeme D) ఒక character sequence మరియు ఒక probability score జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What are the two primary components that constitute a lexical token? A) A regular expression and a state machine B) A token name and an optional value C) A semantic tree and a lexeme D) A character sequence and a probability score ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why do the coefficients of a standard Fourier series isolate individual harmonic components during integration over a period? A) Integration converts linear differential operators into algebraic equations B) Higher-order derivatives of sinusoidal functions approach zero exponentially C) Trigonometric basis functions are mutually orthogonal over the fundamental interval D) The period of higher harmonics shrinks, causing higher terms to cancel ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక period పై integration చేసేటప్పుడు standard Fourier series యొక్క coefficients ఒక్కొక్క harmonic component ని ఎందుకు వేరు చేస్తాయి? A) Integration, linear differential operators ని algebraic equations గా మారుస్తుంది B) Sinusoidal functions యొక్క higher-order derivatives exponential గా సున్నాకు చేరుతాయి C) Fundamental interval పై trigonometric basis functions పరస్పరం orthogonal గా ఉంటాయి D) Higher harmonics యొక్క period తగ్గి, ఎక్కువ terms రద్దు అవుతాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why do the coefficients of a standard Fourier series isolate individual harmonic components during integration over a period? A) Integration converts linear differential operators into algebraic equations B) Higher-order derivatives of sinusoidal functions approach zero exponentially C) Trigonometric basis functions are mutually orthogonal over the fundamental interval D) The period of higher harmonics shrinks, causing higher terms to cancel ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If two coherent light waves of equal intensity I₀ interfere constructively at a point, what is the resulting intensity? A) I₀ B) Zero C) 2 I₀ D) 4 I₀ ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: సమాన intensity I₀ ఉన్న రెండు coherent light waves ఒక బిందువు వద్ద constructive గా interfere అయితే, ఫలిత intensity ఎంత? A) I₀ B) సున్నా C) 2 I₀ D) 4 I₀ జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If two coherent light waves of equal intensity I₀ interfere constructively at a point, what is the resulting intensity? A) I₀ B) Zero C) 2 I₀ D) 4 I₀ ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does class imbalance affect the interpretation of the F-score across different datasets? A) It automatically corrects the model bias towards the majority class B) It makes the F-score independent of the class ratio C) It improves the F-score linearly as the negative class grows D) It makes comparing F-scores across different problems with varying class ratios problematic ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: వేర్వేరు datasets లో F-score యొక్క interpretation ని class imbalance ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) అది majority class వైపు model bias ని automatic గా సరిచేస్తుంది B) అది F-score ని class ratio పై ఆధారపడకుండా చేస్తుంది C) Negative class పెరిగేకొద్దీ F-score ని linear గా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది D) వేర్వేరు class ratios ఉన్న వేర్వేరు problems మధ్య F-scores ని పోల్చడం సమస్యాత్మకంగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does class imbalance affect the interpretation of the F-score across different datasets? A) It automatically corrects the model bias towards the majority class B) It makes the F-score independent of the class ratio C) It improves the F-score linearly as the negative class grows D) It makes comparing F-scores across different problems with varying class ratios problematic ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When an interrupt occurs, what does the processor do first? A) Executes the main application loop B) Clears the entire RAM C) Resets the power supply D) Suspends the current instruction sequence ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Interrupt వచ్చినప్పుడు processor మొదట ఏమి చేస్తుంది? A) Main application loop ని execute చేస్తుంది B) మొత్తం RAM ని clear చేస్తుంది C) Power supply ని reset చేస్తుంది D) ప్రస్తుత instruction sequence ని నిలిపివేస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: When an interrupt occurs, what does the processor do first? A) Executes the main application loop B) Clears the entire RAM C) Resets the power supply D) Suspends the current instruction sequence ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In an electric circuit, what does the number of state variables typically correspond to? A) The frequency of the input signal B) The number of energy storage elements like capacitors and inductors C) The number of resistors D) The total voltage ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Electric circuit లో state variables సంఖ్య సాధారణంగా దేనికి అనుగుణంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Input signal యొక్క frequency B) Capacitors మరియు inductors వంటి energy storage elements సంఖ్య C) Resistors సంఖ్య D) Total voltage జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In an electric circuit, what does the number of state variables typically correspond to? A) The frequency of the input signal B) The number of energy storage elements like capacitors and inductors C) The number of resistors D) The total voltage ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition is a material classified as linear? A) When the stress-strain curve is linear for all possible loads B) When the material has a high Poisson's ratio C) When the range of valid Hooke's law is large compared to typical applied stresses D) When the material is isotropic in all directions ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో ఒక material ని linear గా వర్గీకరిస్తారు? A) అన్ని సాధ్యమైన loads కి stress-strain curve linear గా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) Material కి ఎక్కువ Poisson's ratio ఉన్నప్పుడు C) సాధారణంగా ప్రయోగించే stresses తో పోలిస్తే Hooke's law చెల్లుబాటు అయ్యే range పెద్దదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Material అన్ని దిశలలో isotropic గా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Under what condition is a material classified as linear? A) When the stress-strain curve is linear for all possible loads B) When the material has a high Poisson's ratio C) When the range of valid Hooke's law is large compared to typical applied stresses D) When the material is isotropic in all directions ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes spatial locality in the context of caching? A) Accessing memory locations that are physically close to each other B) Accessing memory locations that are far apart in the address space C) Accessing memory locations in a random order D) Reusing the same memory location repeatedly in a short time ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Caching సందర్భంలో spatial locality ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) భౌతికంగా ఒకదానికొకటి దగ్గరగా ఉన్న memory locations ని access చేయడం B) Address space లో చాలా దూరంగా ఉన్న memory locations ని access చేయడం C) Memory locations ని random order లో access చేయడం D) తక్కువ సమయంలో ఒకే memory location ని పదేపదే ఉపయోగించడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes spatial locality in the context of caching? A) Accessing memory locations that are physically close to each other B) Accessing memory locations that are far apart in the address space C) Accessing memory locations in a random order D) Reusing the same memory location repeatedly in a short time ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If a constant net force is applied to an object, what is the relationship between its acceleration and its mass? A) Acceleration is inversely proportional to the mass. B) Acceleration is directly proportional to the square of the mass. C) Acceleration is directly proportional to the mass. D) Acceleration is independent of the mass. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక వస్తువుపై స్థిరమైన net force ప్రయోగిస్తే, దాని acceleration మరియు mass మధ్య సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) Acceleration, mass కి విలోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. B) Acceleration, mass యొక్క square కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. C) Acceleration, mass కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉంటుంది. D) Acceleration, mass పై ఆధారపడదు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If a constant net force is applied to an object, what is the relationship between its acceleration and its mass? A) Acceleration is inversely proportional to the mass. B) Acceleration is directly proportional to the square of the mass. C) Acceleration is directly proportional to the mass. D) Acceleration is independent of the mass. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the current in the neutral conductor of a three-phase star system under a perfectly balanced linear load? A) It cancels out to zero completely B) It equals three times the line current C) It fluctuates at double the system frequency D) It equals the line-to-line voltage divided by root three ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: పూర్తిగా balanced linear load కింద three-phase star system లోని neutral conductor లో current కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది పూర్తిగా రద్దై సున్నా అవుతుంది B) అది line current కి మూడు రెట్లు అవుతుంది C) అది system frequency కి రెట్టింపు frequency తో హెచ్చుతగ్గులకు లోనవుతుంది D) అది line-to-line voltage ని root three తో భాగించినదానికి సమానం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to the current in the neutral conductor of a three-phase star system under a perfectly balanced linear load? A) It cancels out to zero completely B) It equals three times the line current C) It fluctuates at double the system frequency D) It equals the line-to-line voltage divided by root three ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: When is the sift-down operation most likely to be used in a heap? A) When the root element is removed and replaced by a leaf. B) To increase the value of a node in the middle of the heap. C) To find the maximum element in a min-heap. D) Immediately after inserting a new element at the end. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Heap లో sift-down operation ఎప్పుడు ఎక్కువగా ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది? A) Root element తొలగించబడి ఒక leaf తో భర్తీ చేయబడినప్పుడు. B) Heap మధ్యలో ఉన్న ఒక node value ని పెంచడానికి. C) Min-heap లో maximum element ని కనుగొనడానికి. D) చివరలో కొత్త element ని insert చేసిన వెంటనే. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: When is the sift-down operation most likely to be used in a heap? A) When the root element is removed and replaced by a leaf. B) To increase the value of a node in the middle of the heap. C) To find the maximum element in a min-heap. D) Immediately after inserting a new element at the end. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) preferred for long-distance optical fiber communication? A) It lowers the manufacturing cost by replacing glass cores with plastic cores B) It completely eliminates optical attenuation and chromatic dispersion C) It transmits multiple data channels simultaneously over a single fiber using distinct wavelengths D) It converts light signals to electrical signals at regular intervals without repeaters ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: దూర ప్రాంత optical fiber communication కి wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) Glass cores ని plastic cores తో భర్తీ చేయడం ద్వారా manufacturing cost ని తగ్గిస్తుంది B) అది optical attenuation మరియు chromatic dispersion ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది C) వేర్వేరు wavelengths ఉపయోగించి ఒకే fiber ద్వారా అనేక data channels ని ఒకేసారి transmit చేస్తుంది D) Repeaters లేకుండా నిర్దిష్ట వ్యవధులలో light signals ని electrical signals గా మారుస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) preferred for long-distance optical fiber communication? A) It lowers the manufacturing cost by replacing glass cores with plastic cores B) It completely eliminates optical attenuation and chromatic dispersion C) It transmits multiple data channels simultaneously over a single fiber using distinct wavelengths D) It converts light signals to electrical signals at regular intervals without repeaters ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If you take the two's complement of a binary number, what is the mathematical relationship between the original and the result? A) The result is always positive B) The result is the bitwise NOT C) They sum to 2^N D) They sum to 2^N - 1 ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక binary number యొక్క two's complement తీసుకుంటే, అసలు సంఖ్య మరియు ఫలితం మధ్య mathematical సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) ఫలితం ఎల్లప్పుడూ positive B) ఫలితం bitwise NOT C) వాటి మొత్తం 2^N D) వాటి మొత్తం 2^N - 1 జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: If you take the two's complement of a binary number, what is the mathematical relationship between the original and the result? A) The result is always positive B) The result is the bitwise NOT C) They sum to 2^N D) They sum to 2^N - 1 ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a particle with energy E < V0 have a non-zero probability of appearing beyond a rectangular potential barrier of height V0? A) Its wave function decays exponentially within the barrier but remains non-zero at the opposite interface B) Classical collisions with the barrier walls accelerate the particle to surmount the peak C) It temporarily borrows energy from the barrier in violation of energy conservation D) The barrier height dynamically collapses when approached by a moving wave packet ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: E < V0 energy ఉన్న ఒక particle, V0 height ఉన్న rectangular potential barrier కి అవతల కనిపించే non-zero probability ఎందుకు కలిగి ఉంటుంది? A) దాని wave function barrier లోపల exponential గా తగ్గుతుంది కానీ ఎదురు interface వద్ద non-zero గానే ఉంటుంది B) Barrier walls తో classical collisions particle ని peak దాటేలా accelerate చేస్తాయి C) Energy conservation ని ఉల్లంఘిస్తూ అది barrier నుండి తాత్కాలికంగా energy ని అరువు తీసుకుంటుంది D) కదిలే wave packet దగ్గరకు వచ్చినప్పుడు barrier height dynamic గా కూలిపోతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why does a particle with energy E < V0 have a non-zero probability of appearing beyond a rectangular potential barrier of height V0? A) Its wave function decays exponentially within the barrier but remains non-zero at the opposite interface B) Classical collisions with the barrier walls accelerate the particle to surmount the peak C) It temporarily borrows energy from the barrier in violation of energy conservation D) The barrier height dynamically collapses when approached by a moving wave packet ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why did microprocessors effectively replace earlier methods of CPU implementation? A) They removed the need for the fetch-decode-execute cycle B) They integrated the ALU, control unit, and registers onto a single chip C) They were incompatible with memory D) They required less electricity to manufacture ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: CPU implementation యొక్క పాత పద్ధతులను microprocessors ఎందుకు భర్తీ చేశాయి? A) అవి fetch-decode-execute cycle అవసరాన్ని తొలగించాయి B) అవి ALU, control unit మరియు registers ని ఒకే chip పై integrate చేశాయి C) అవి memory తో అనుకూలంగా లేవు D) వాటిని తయారు చేయడానికి తక్కువ విద్యుత్ అవసరమైంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why did microprocessors effectively replace earlier methods of CPU implementation? A) They removed the need for the fetch-decode-execute cycle B) They integrated the ALU, control unit, and registers onto a single chip C) They were incompatible with memory D) They required less electricity to manufacture ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary functional purpose of the forget gate in an LSTM unit? A) To reset the entire network to its initial state B) To generate the final output prediction of the sequence C) To decide which previous information in the cell state is no longer relevant D) To prevent the input from entering the cell state ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: LSTM unit లో forget gate యొక్క ప్రధాన functional ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) మొత్తం network ని దాని initial state కి reset చేయడం B) Sequence యొక్క చివరి output prediction ని generate చేయడం C) Cell state లోని ఏ పాత సమాచారం ఇక సంబంధితం కాదో నిర్ణయించడం D) Input, cell state లోకి ప్రవేశించకుండా నివారించడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary functional purpose of the forget gate in an LSTM unit? A) To reset the entire network to its initial state B) To generate the final output prediction of the sequence C) To decide which previous information in the cell state is no longer relevant D) To prevent the input from entering the cell state ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In a reversed Carnot cycle, what is the primary function of the device? A) To transfer heat from a cold reservoir to a hot reservoir using work. B) To increase the temperature of the hot reservoir using heat. C) To store thermal energy indefinitely without any losses. D) To convert heat directly into work with maximum efficiency. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Reversed Carnot cycle లో device యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) Work ఉపయోగించి cold reservoir నుండి hot reservoir కి heat ని బదిలీ చేయడం. B) Heat ఉపయోగించి hot reservoir యొక్క temperature ని పెంచడం. C) ఎలాంటి నష్టాలు లేకుండా thermal energy ని నిరవధికంగా store చేయడం. D) Maximum efficiency తో heat ని నేరుగా work గా మార్చడం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a reversed Carnot cycle, what is the primary function of the device? A) To transfer heat from a cold reservoir to a hot reservoir using work. B) To increase the temperature of the hot reservoir using heat. C) To store thermal energy indefinitely without any losses. D) To convert heat directly into work with maximum efficiency. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the state-value function estimate about being in a particular state? A) How good it is to be in that given state under a specific policy. B) The total number of possible actions available in that state. C) The probability of transitioning to another state under a random action. D) The immediate reward received after transitioning from that state. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట state లో ఉండటం గురించి state-value function ఏమి అంచనా వేస్తుంది? A) ఒక నిర్దిష్ట policy కింద ఆ state లో ఉండటం ఎంత మంచిదో. B) ఆ state లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్న మొత్తం సాధ్యమైన actions సంఖ్య. C) Random action కింద మరొక state కి మారే probability. D) ఆ state నుండి మారిన వెంటనే లభించే reward. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What does the state-value function estimate about being in a particular state? A) How good it is to be in that given state under a specific policy. B) The total number of possible actions available in that state. C) The probability of transitioning to another state under a random action. D) The immediate reward received after transitioning from that state. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Advanced Encryption Standard considered a block cipher? A) Because it relies on a public/private key pair. B) Because it processes one byte at a time. C) Because it is susceptible to linear cryptanalysis. D) Because it processes data in 128-bit blocks. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Advanced Encryption Standard ని block cipher గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది public/private key pair పై ఆధారపడుతుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒకసారికి ఒక byte ని process చేస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే అది linear cryptanalysis కి లోనవుతుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే అది data ని 128-bit blocks లో process చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the Advanced Encryption Standard considered a block cipher? A) Because it relies on a public/private key pair. B) Because it processes one byte at a time. C) Because it is susceptible to linear cryptanalysis. D) Because it processes data in 128-bit blocks. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what specific condition is a context switch NOT required? A) When a process is added to the ready queue B) When a timer interrupt fires C) When a process requests I/O D) When the CPU transitions between user and kernel mode ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ నిర్దిష్ట పరిస్థితిలో context switch అవసరం లేదు? A) ఒక process ready queue కి చేర్చబడినప్పుడు B) Timer interrupt వచ్చినప్పుడు C) ఒక process I/O కోసం request చేసినప్పుడు D) CPU user మరియు kernel mode మధ్య మారినప్పుడు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what specific condition is a context switch NOT required? A) When a process is added to the ready queue B) When a timer interrupt fires C) When a process requests I/O D) When the CPU transitions between user and kernel mode ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Banker's algorithm rarely implemented in real-world operating systems? A) Processes rarely know their maximum resource requirements in advance. B) It consumes too much CPU power to compute safety checks. C) It only works with a fixed number of processes. D) It causes more deadlocks than it prevents. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Real-world operating systems లో Banker's algorithm ని చాలా అరుదుగా ఎందుకు implement చేస్తారు? A) Processes కి తమ maximum resource requirements ముందుగా తెలియడం చాలా అరుదు. B) Safety checks లెక్కించడానికి అది చాలా ఎక్కువ CPU power ని ఖర్చు చేస్తుంది. C) అది fixed సంఖ్యలో processes తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. D) అది నివారించే వాటి కంటే ఎక్కువ deadlocks ని కలిగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the Banker's algorithm rarely implemented in real-world operating systems? A) Processes rarely know their maximum resource requirements in advance. B) It consumes too much CPU power to compute safety checks. C) It only works with a fixed number of processes. D) It causes more deadlocks than it prevents. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for studying the formal definition of regular expressions using constants and operators? A) To enable the use of non-standard operators like the complement operator by default. B) To prove that all regular expressions are actually context-free languages. C) To provide a standard, minimal framework that precisely defines the class of regular languages. D) To ensure that regex engines ignore literal characters entirely. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Constants మరియు operators ఉపయోగించి regular expressions యొక్క formal definition ని అధ్యయనం చేయడానికి ప్రధాన ప్రేరణ ఏమిటి? A) Complement operator వంటి non-standard operators ని default గా ఉపయోగించడానికి. B) అన్ని regular expressions నిజానికి context-free languages అని నిరూపించడానికి. C) Regular languages class ని కచ్చితంగా నిర్వచించే ప్రామాణిక, కనీస framework ని అందించడానికి. D) Regex engines literal characters ని పూర్తిగా పట్టించుకోకుండా చూడటానికి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for studying the formal definition of regular expressions using constants and operators? A) To enable the use of non-standard operators like the complement operator by default. B) To prove that all regular expressions are actually context-free languages. C) To provide a standard, minimal framework that precisely defines the class of regular languages. D) To ensure that regex engines ignore literal characters entirely. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition is an n-by-n matrix classified as defective? A) It has at least one eigenvalue equal to zero B) Its determinant is equal to zero C) It has non-real complex conjugate eigenvalues D) Its geometric multiplicity is strictly less than its algebraic multiplicity for at least one eigenvalue ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో n-by-n matrix ని defective గా వర్గీకరిస్తారు? A) దానికి కనీసం ఒక eigenvalue సున్నాకు సమానంగా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) దాని determinant సున్నాకు సమానమైనప్పుడు C) దానికి non-real complex conjugate eigenvalues ఉన్నప్పుడు D) కనీసం ఒక eigenvalue కి దాని geometric multiplicity, algebraic multiplicity కంటే కచ్చితంగా తక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition is an n-by-n matrix classified as defective? A) It has at least one eigenvalue equal to zero B) Its determinant is equal to zero C) It has non-real complex conjugate eigenvalues D) Its geometric multiplicity is strictly less than its algebraic multiplicity for at least one eigenvalue ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a primary advantage of Least Absolute Deviation (LAD) over Ordinary Least Squares (OLS)? A) LAD is less sensitive to outliers in the dataset. B) LAD provides a closed-form analytical solution like OLS. C) LAD is always more efficient than OLS regardless of distribution. D) LAD is more computationally efficient for massive datasets. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) కంటే Least Absolute Deviation (LAD) యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) Dataset లోని outliers కి LAD తక్కువ sensitive గా ఉంటుంది. B) OLS లాగా LAD ఒక closed-form analytical solution ని అందిస్తుంది. C) Distribution తో సంబంధం లేకుండా LAD ఎల్లప్పుడూ OLS కంటే efficient. D) భారీ datasets కి LAD computationally ఎక్కువ efficient. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a primary advantage of Least Absolute Deviation (LAD) over Ordinary Least Squares (OLS)? A) LAD is less sensitive to outliers in the dataset. B) LAD provides a closed-form analytical solution like OLS. C) LAD is always more efficient than OLS regardless of distribution. D) LAD is more computationally efficient for massive datasets. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the purpose of the epsilon closure in an NFA-ε? A) It represents the input alphabet for the automaton. B) It determines the final accepting states of the automaton. C) It defines the set of states reachable without consuming any input symbol. D) It limits the number of states in the automaton to prevent infinite loops. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: NFA-ε లో epsilon closure యొక్క ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) అది automaton కోసం input alphabet ని సూచిస్తుంది. B) అది automaton యొక్క final accepting states ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. C) ఏ input symbol నూ consume చేయకుండా చేరుకోగల states యొక్క set ని అది నిర్వచిస్తుంది. D) Infinite loops ని నివారించడానికి automaton లో states సంఖ్యను అది పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the purpose of the epsilon closure in an NFA-ε? A) It represents the input alphabet for the automaton. B) It determines the final accepting states of the automaton. C) It defines the set of states reachable without consuming any input symbol. D) It limits the number of states in the automaton to prevent infinite loops. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a subset of attributes that is currently unique not necessarily a candidate key? A) Because it might not be minimal. B) Because it must always include the primary key. C) Because it might not uniquely identify tuples in the future. D) Because it cannot be a key if other keys exist. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ప్రస్తుతం unique గా ఉన్న attributes subset తప్పనిసరిగా candidate key ఎందుకు కాదు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది minimal కాకపోవచ్చు. B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ primary key ని కలిగి ఉండాలి. C) ఎందుకంటే భవిష్యత్తులో అది tuples ని ప్రత్యేకంగా గుర్తించకపోవచ్చు. D) ఎందుకంటే ఇతర keys ఉంటే అది key కాలేదు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is a subset of attributes that is currently unique not necessarily a candidate key? A) Because it might not be minimal. B) Because it must always include the primary key. C) Because it might not uniquely identify tuples in the future. D) Because it cannot be a key if other keys exist. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of storing the key alongside the value in a hash table? A) To allow sorting of the elements in the table B) To eliminate the need for an associative array structure C) To handle collisions by verifying the correct key during lookup D) To increase the speed of the hashing function ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Hash table లో value తో పాటు key ని store చేయడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Table లోని elements ని sort చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం B) Associative array structure అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడం C) Lookup సమయంలో సరైన key ని verify చేయడం ద్వారా collisions ని handle చేయడం D) Hashing function యొక్క speed ని పెంచడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of storing the key alongside the value in a hash table? A) To allow sorting of the elements in the table B) To eliminate the need for an associative array structure C) To handle collisions by verifying the correct key during lookup D) To increase the speed of the hashing function ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the relationship between the desired signal frequency, the local oscillator frequency, and the image frequency? A) The image frequency is the local oscillator frequency minus the desired signal frequency B) The image frequency is the local oscillator frequency plus the intermediate frequency C) The image frequency is the local oscillator frequency minus the intermediate frequency D) The image frequency is the sum of the desired signal and the local oscillator frequencies ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: కావలసిన signal frequency, local oscillator frequency మరియు image frequency మధ్య సంబంధం ఏమిటి? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a pole in the right-half plane considered unstable? A) Because it causes the system's response to grow exponentially over time. D) ఎందుకంటే అది system response కాలక్రమేణా exponential గా తగ్గేలా చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A

D) Because it causes the system's response to decay exponentially over time. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are direct band gap semiconductors significantly more efficient than indirect band gap semiconductors in light-emitting diodes? A) Indirect materials cannot absorb or emit photons under any circumstances due to quantum selection rules. B) The electronic transport gap equals zero, allowing effortless current flow without electrical resistance. C) Direct band gap materials exhibit a much larger exciton binding energy that accelerates radiative decay. D) Electrons can recombine across the gap purely via photon emission without requiring momentum-conserving phonons. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Light-emitting diodes లో indirect band gap semiconductors కంటే direct band gap semiconductors ఎందుకు చాలా ఎక్కువ efficient గా ఉంటాయి? A) Quantum selection rules వల్ల indirect materials ఏ పరిస్థితిలోనూ photons ని absorb లేదా emit చేయలేవు. B) Electronic transport gap సున్నా, దీనివల్ల electrical resistance లేకుండా current సులభంగా ప్రవహిస్తుంది. C) Direct band gap materials కి చాలా ఎక్కువ exciton binding energy ఉంటుంది, అది radiative decay ని వేగవంతం చేస్తుంది. D) Momentum ని conserve చేసే phonons అవసరం లేకుండా కేవలం photon emission ద్వారానే electrons gap అంతటా recombine కాగలవు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why are direct band gap semiconductors significantly more efficient than indirect band gap semiconductors in light-emitting diodes? A) Indirect materials cannot absorb or emit photons under any circumstances due to quantum selection rules. B) The electronic transport gap equals zero, allowing effortless current flow without electrical resistance. C) Direct band gap materials exhibit a much larger exciton binding energy that accelerates radiative decay. D) Electrons can recombine across the gap purely via photon emission without requiring momentum-conserving phonons. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² of a system in a pure stationary state over time? A) It grows exponentially because of the imaginary unit in the time exponent. B) It remains strictly independent of time despite the complex phase factor oscillating. C) It rapidly disperses across all space due to destructive wave packet interference. D) It oscillates periodically with an angular frequency proportional to the system's kinetic energy. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Pure stationary state లో ఉన్న system యొక్క probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² కాలక్రమేణా ఏమవుతుంది? A) Time exponent లోని imaginary unit వల్ల అది exponential గా పెరుగుతుంది. B) Complex phase factor oscillate అవుతున్నప్పటికీ అది time పై కచ్చితంగా ఆధారపడకుండా ఉంటుంది. C) Destructive wave packet interference వల్ల అది వేగంగా అంతటా వ్యాపిస్తుంది. D) System యొక్క kinetic energy కి అనులోమానుపాతంలో ఉన్న angular frequency తో అది periodic గా oscillate అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the probability density P(x, t) = |Ψ(x, t)|² of a system in a pure stationary state over time? A) It grows exponentially because of the imaginary unit in the time exponent. B) It remains strictly independent of time despite the complex phase factor oscillating. C) It rapidly disperses across all space due to destructive wave packet interference. D) It oscillates periodically with an angular frequency proportional to the system's kinetic energy. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does total internal reflection occur at the core-cladding boundary of an optical fiber? A) The refractive index of the cladding is strictly greater than that of the core B) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle less than the critical angle C) Light travels from lower to higher refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle D) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Optical fiber యొక్క core-cladding సరిహద్దు వద్ద total internal reflection ఏ పరిస్థితిలో జరుగుతుంది? A) Cladding యొక్క refractive index, core కంటే కచ్చితంగా ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు B) కాంతి ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే తక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు C) కాంతి తక్కువ నుండి ఎక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే ఎక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు D) కాంతి ఎక్కువ నుండి తక్కువ refractive index కి critical angle కంటే ఎక్కువ angle లో ప్రయాణించినప్పుడు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Under what condition does total internal reflection occur at the core-cladding boundary of an optical fiber? A) The refractive index of the cladding is strictly greater than that of the core B) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle less than the critical angle C) Light travels from lower to higher refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle D) Light travels from higher to lower refractive index at an angle greater than the critical angle ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following describes the behavior of a top-down parser? A) It executes code simultaneously with the parsing process B) It starts with the input symbols and tries to reduce them to the start symbol C) It builds the parse tree by deriving tokens from the start symbol D) It only handles non-ambiguous context-free grammars ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది top-down parser ప్రవర్తనను వివరిస్తుంది? A) అది parsing process తో పాటు ఏకకాలంలో code ని execute చేస్తుంది B) అది input symbols తో మొదలుపెట్టి వాటిని start symbol కి reduce చేయడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది C) అది start symbol నుండి tokens ని derive చేయడం ద్వారా parse tree ని నిర్మిస్తుంది D) అది non-ambiguous context-free grammars ని మాత్రమే handle చేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following describes the behavior of a top-down parser? A) It executes code simultaneously with the parsing process B) It starts with the input symbols and tries to reduce them to the start symbol C) It builds the parse tree by deriving tokens from the start symbol D) It only handles non-ambiguous context-free grammars ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary consequence of performing decimation without first applying an anti-aliasing filter? A) The signal amplitude increases significantly B) High-frequency components overlap into lower frequency bands C) The signal becomes a pure sine wave D) The sampling rate increases exponentially ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ముందుగా anti-aliasing filter ని apply చేయకుండా decimation చేస్తే ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Signal amplitude గణనీయంగా పెరుగుతుంది B) High-frequency components తక్కువ frequency bands లోకి overlap అవుతాయి C) Signal ఒక pure sine wave అవుతుంది D) Sampling rate exponential గా పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary consequence of performing decimation without first applying an anti-aliasing filter? A) The signal amplitude increases significantly B) High-frequency components overlap into lower frequency bands C) The signal becomes a pure sine wave D) The sampling rate increases exponentially ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a microprogram in a processor? A) To manage the computer's power supply B) To store user application data C) To translate machine instructions into sequences of hardware-level operations D) To handle input/output operations directly ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Processor లో microprogram యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) Computer యొక్క power supply ని నిర్వహించడం B) User application data ని store చేయడం C) Machine instructions ని hardware-level operations శ్రేణులుగా translate చేయడం D) Input/output operations ని నేరుగా handle చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a microprogram in a processor? A) To manage the computer's power supply B) To store user application data C) To translate machine instructions into sequences of hardware-level operations D) To handle input/output operations directly ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a reconstruction filter necessary after a digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in a PCM system? A) To increase the bit depth of the signal. B) To perform time-division multiplexing on the output stream. C) To remove high-frequency imaging effects caused by discrete step transitions. D) To convert the binary code into a linear scale. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: PCM system లో digital-to-analog converter (DAC) తర్వాత reconstruction filter ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) Signal యొక్క bit depth ని పెంచడానికి. B) Output stream పై time-division multiplexing చేయడానికి. C) Discrete step transitions వల్ల కలిగే high-frequency imaging effects ని తొలగించడానికి. D) Binary code ని linear scale గా మార్చడానికి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is a reconstruction filter necessary after a digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in a PCM system? A) To increase the bit depth of the signal. B) To perform time-division multiplexing on the output stream. C) To remove high-frequency imaging effects caused by discrete step transitions. D) To convert the binary code into a linear scale. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is IP described as a connectionless protocol? A) It only operates at the transport layer of the network model. B) It requires a dedicated path to be established before data transmission. C) It guarantees in-order delivery and error-free transmission. D) It provides best-effort delivery without maintaining state for individual packets. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: IP ని connectionless protocol అని ఎందుకు అంటారు? A) అది network model యొక్క transport layer వద్ద మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. B) Data transmission కి ముందు ఒక dedicated path ఏర్పాటు చేయాలి. C) అది in-order delivery మరియు error-free transmission కి హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) ఒక్కొక్క packet కి state ని నిర్వహించకుండా అది best-effort delivery ని అందిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is IP described as a connectionless protocol? A) It only operates at the transport layer of the network model. B) It requires a dedicated path to be established before data transmission. C) It guarantees in-order delivery and error-free transmission. D) It provides best-effort delivery without maintaining state for individual packets. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of the diode in a step-up chopper circuit? A) To provide a path for inductor current when the chopper switch is open B) To block the output voltage from flowing back to the source C) To regulate the switching frequency D) To measure the average inductor voltage ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Step-up chopper circuit లో diode యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) Chopper switch open గా ఉన్నప్పుడు inductor current కి ఒక path ని అందించడం B) Output voltage తిరిగి source కి ప్రవహించకుండా అడ్డుకోవడం C) Switching frequency ని regulate చేయడం D) Average inductor voltage ని కొలవడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of the diode in a step-up chopper circuit? A) To provide a path for inductor current when the chopper switch is open B) To block the output voltage from flowing back to the source C) To regulate the switching frequency D) To measure the average inductor voltage ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is image padding performed before Fourier domain filtering? A) To increase the image size for better quality B) To convert the image to grayscale C) To apply convolution directly in the spatial domain D) To prevent artificial edge artifacts caused by the Fourier transform ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Fourier domain filtering కి ముందు image padding ఎందుకు చేస్తారు? A) మెరుగైన quality కోసం image size ని పెంచడానికి B) Image ని grayscale గా మార్చడానికి C) Spatial domain లో నేరుగా convolution ని apply చేయడానికి D) Fourier transform వల్ల కలిగే కృత్రిమ edge artifacts ని నివారించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is image padding performed before Fourier domain filtering? A) To increase the image size for better quality B) To convert the image to grayscale C) To apply convolution directly in the spatial domain D) To prevent artificial edge artifacts caused by the Fourier transform ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the rho-theta parametrization preferred over the slope-intercept form for line detection? A) It is computationally faster to calculate. B) It requires less memory for the accumulator space. C) It is only applicable to circular shapes. D) It avoids unbounded parameter values for vertical lines. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Line detection కోసం slope-intercept form కంటే rho-theta parametrization ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) దాన్ని లెక్కించడం computationally వేగంగా ఉంటుంది. B) Accumulator space కి దానికి తక్కువ memory అవసరం. C) అది circular shapes కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది. D) Vertical lines కి unbounded parameter values రాకుండా అది తప్పిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the rho-theta parametrization preferred over the slope-intercept form for line detection? A) It is computationally faster to calculate. B) It requires less memory for the accumulator space. C) It is only applicable to circular shapes. D) It avoids unbounded parameter values for vertical lines. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary consequence of a programming language being Turing-complete? A) It means the halting problem is decidable for that language. B) It restricts the language to only linear bounded automata. C) It implies the language can compute any computable function but also has undecidable problems. D) It guarantees all programs will halt. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక programming language Turing-complete కావడం వల్ల ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) ఆ language కి halting problem decidable అని అర్థం. B) అది language ని linear bounded automata కి మాత్రమే పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. C) ఆ language ఏ computable function నైనా compute చేయగలదు కానీ దానికి undecidable problems కూడా ఉంటాయని సూచిస్తుంది. D) అన్ని programs halt అవుతాయని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary consequence of a programming language being Turing-complete? A) It means the halting problem is decidable for that language. B) It restricts the language to only linear bounded automata. C) It implies the language can compute any computable function but also has undecidable problems. D) It guarantees all programs will halt. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a Zener diode preferred over a standard forward-biased diode for high-voltage regulation applications? A) It operates only in the forward-bias region. B) It has a higher current-carrying capacity. C) It functions as a simple resistor in series. D) It utilizes a fixed reverse breakdown voltage to maintain stability. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: High-voltage regulation applications కోసం standard forward-biased diode కంటే Zener diode ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) అది forward-bias region లో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. B) దానికి ఎక్కువ current-carrying capacity ఉంటుంది. C) అది series లో ఒక సాధారణ resistor లా పనిచేస్తుంది. D) Stability ని నిలుపుకోవడానికి అది fixed reverse breakdown voltage ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is a Zener diode preferred over a standard forward-biased diode for high-voltage regulation applications? A) It operates only in the forward-bias region. B) It has a higher current-carrying capacity. C) It functions as a simple resistor in series. D) It utilizes a fixed reverse breakdown voltage to maintain stability. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If an ECG shows a sequence of ventricular beats where the QRS morphology is inconsistent and changes from complex to complex, how is this best described? A) Poor R wave progression B) Monomorphic C) Cardiac aberrancy D) Polymorphic ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక ECG లో QRS morphology అస్థిరంగా ఉండి ఒక complex నుండి మరొక complex కి మారే ventricular beats శ్రేణి కనిపిస్తే, దాన్ని ఎలా ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తారు? A) Poor R wave progression B) Monomorphic C) Cardiac aberrancy D) Polymorphic జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If an ECG shows a sequence of ventricular beats where the QRS morphology is inconsistent and changes from complex to complex, how is this best described? A) Poor R wave progression B) Monomorphic C) Cardiac aberrancy D) Polymorphic ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an IIR filter have a non-trivial denominator in its transfer function? A) Because it contains feedback terms B) Because it uses only feedforward coefficients C) Because it is implemented in the s-domain D) Because it is always causal ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: IIR filter యొక్క transfer function లో non-trivial denominator ఎందుకు ఉంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే దానిలో feedback terms ఉంటాయి B) ఎందుకంటే అది feedforward coefficients ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే అది s-domain లో implement చేయబడుతుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ causal జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why does an IIR filter have a non-trivial denominator in its transfer function? A) Because it contains feedback terms B) Because it uses only feedforward coefficients C) Because it is implemented in the s-domain D) Because it is always causal ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is UDP referred to as an unreliable protocol? A) It does not guarantee message delivery, ordering, or duplicate protection. B) It requires a connection to be established before sending data. C) It does not provide checksums for data integrity. D) It only operates over IPv6 networks. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: UDP ని unreliable protocol అని ఎందుకు అంటారు? A) అది message delivery, ordering లేదా duplicate protection కి హామీ ఇవ్వదు. B) Data పంపే ముందు connection ఏర్పాటు చేయాలి. C) Data integrity కోసం అది checksums ని అందించదు. D) అది IPv6 networks పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is UDP referred to as an unreliable protocol? A) It does not guarantee message delivery, ordering, or duplicate protection. B) It requires a connection to be established before sending data. C) It does not provide checksums for data integrity. D) It only operates over IPv6 networks. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of the 'latent space' in the generator network? A) It stores the final high-resolution images after training is complete. B) It is the memory component where the discriminator saves successful fake images. C) It represents the physical hard drive space where the model weights are stored. D) It acts as a compressed source of randomness that the generator transforms into synthetic data. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Generator network లో 'latent space' యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Training పూర్తయిన తర్వాత చివరి high-resolution images ని అది store చేస్తుంది. B) Discriminator విజయవంతమైన fake images ని save చేసే memory component అది. C) Model weights store చేయబడే భౌతిక hard drive space ని అది సూచిస్తుంది. D) Generator synthetic data గా మార్చే compressed randomness source గా అది పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of the 'latent space' in the generator network? A) It stores the final high-resolution images after training is complete. B) It is the memory component where the discriminator saves successful fake images. C) It represents the physical hard drive space where the model weights are stored. D) It acts as a compressed source of randomness that the generator transforms into synthetic data. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When analyzing a digital filtering system using the additive noise model, what is a key assumption about the quantization error? A) It behaves like white noise with a flat power spectral density. B) It increases linearly as the bit rate increases. C) It is only present in mid-riser quantizers. D) It is perfectly correlated with the input signal. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Additive noise model ఉపయోగించి digital filtering system ని analyze చేసేటప్పుడు quantization error గురించి ముఖ్య assumption ఏమిటి? A) అది flat power spectral density ఉన్న white noise లా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది. B) Bit rate పెరిగేకొద్దీ అది linear గా పెరుగుతుంది. C) అది mid-riser quantizers లో మాత్రమే ఉంటుంది. D) అది input signal తో పూర్తిగా correlated గా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: When analyzing a digital filtering system using the additive noise model, what is a key assumption about the quantization error? A) It behaves like white noise with a flat power spectral density. B) It increases linearly as the bit rate increases. C) It is only present in mid-riser quantizers. D) It is perfectly correlated with the input signal. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FFT considered more 'practical' than the naïve DFT calculation for large datasets? A) It eliminates the need for complex numbers entirely. B) It allows the DFT to be computed using only real numbers. C) It reduces the arithmetic complexity from O(n²) to O(n log n). D) It changes the output values of the transformation. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: పెద్ద datasets కోసం naïve DFT calculation కంటే FFT ని ఎందుకు ఎక్కువ 'practical' గా పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది complex numbers అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. B) Real numbers ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించి DFT ని compute చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. C) అది arithmetic complexity ని O(n²) నుండి O(n log n) కి తగ్గిస్తుంది. D) అది transformation యొక్క output values ని మారుస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the FFT considered more 'practical' than the naïve DFT calculation for large datasets? A) It eliminates the need for complex numbers entirely. B) It allows the DFT to be computed using only real numbers. C) It reduces the arithmetic complexity from O(n²) to O(n log n). D) It changes the output values of the transformation. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does slack space typically occur? A) When a disk is full B) When file size is smaller than the allocation unit size C) When file metadata is deleted D) When directories are nested ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Slack space సాధారణంగా ఎలా ఏర్పడుతుంది? A) Disk నిండినప్పుడు B) File size, allocation unit size కంటే చిన్నదిగా ఉన్నప్పుడు C) File metadata తొలగించబడినప్పుడు D) Directories nested గా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does slack space typically occur? A) When a disk is full B) When file size is smaller than the allocation unit size C) When file metadata is deleted D) When directories are nested ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary implication of the Shannon-Hartley theorem for designing a communication system? A) It determines the minimum signal power required to overcome noise. B) It sets the theoretical maximum error-free data rate for a given bandwidth and SNR. C) It specifies the exact type of error-correcting code to be used. D) It measures the physical length of the communication channel. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Communication system ని design చేయడంలో Shannon-Hartley theorem యొక్క ప్రధాన implication ఏమిటి? A) Noise ని అధిగమించడానికి అవసరమైన కనీస signal power ని అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. B) ఇచ్చిన bandwidth మరియు SNR కి theoretical maximum error-free data rate ని అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. C) ఉపయోగించాల్సిన error-correcting code యొక్క కచ్చితమైన రకాన్ని అది నిర్దేశిస్తుంది. D) Communication channel యొక్క భౌతిక length ని అది కొలుస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary implication of the Shannon-Hartley theorem for designing a communication system? A) It determines the minimum signal power required to overcome noise. B) It sets the theoretical maximum error-free data rate for a given bandwidth and SNR. C) It specifies the exact type of error-correcting code to be used. D) It measures the physical length of the communication channel. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens when the transition function is undefined for the current state and symbol? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary goal of using a prefetch input queue in a cache? A) To simplify cache replacement policies by reducing the number of entries B) To improve hit rate by loading data before it is explicitly requested C) To reduce cache write latency by batching writes D) To increase cache capacity by evicting unused data ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Cache లో prefetch input queue ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి? A) Entries సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం ద్వారా cache replacement policies ని సరళీకరించడం B) Data ని స్పష్టంగా request చేయకముందే load చేయడం ద్వారా hit rate ని మెరుగుపరచడం C) Writes ని batch చేయడం ద్వారా cache write latency ని తగ్గించడం D) ఉపయోగించని data ని evict చేయడం ద్వారా cache capacity ని పెంచడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary goal of using a prefetch input queue in a cache? A) To simplify cache replacement policies by reducing the number of entries B) To improve hit rate by loading data before it is explicitly requested C) To reduce cache write latency by batching writes D) To increase cache capacity by evicting unused data ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the spectral energy density of a continuous-time signal calculated? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a queue considered a first-in-first-out (FIFO) data structure? A) Because the first element added is always the first one removed. D) ఎందుకంటే elements ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒకే చివర నుండి చేర్చబడతాయి మరియు తొలగించబడతాయి. జవాబు: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What condition guarantees that a function f(x) is exactly equal to its Taylor series at a point x? input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is the primary distinction between fluid statics and fluid dynamics? A) Fluid statics only applies to gases, while fluid dynamics applies only to liquids. B) Fluid statics నిశ్చలంగా ఉన్న fluids ని అధ్యయనం చేస్తుంది, fluid dynamics fluid motion పై forces ప్రభావాన్ని అధ్యయనం చేస్తుంది. C) Fluid statics physics లో ఒక శాఖ, కానీ fluid dynamics కేవలం engineering. D) Fluid statics density ని పట్టించుకోదు, fluid dynamics దాన్ని చేర్చుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is the primary distinction between fluid statics and fluid dynamics? A) Fluid statics only applies to gases, while fluid dynamics applies only to liquids. input: to Telugu: Q: How does statistical multiplexing improve efficiency compared to fixed time-division multiplexing for variable bit rate streams? A) It requires all streams to have the same peak bit rate. B) It dynamically allocates time slots based on real-time demand, reducing idle capacity. C) It assigns dedicated time slots to each stream regardless of activity. D) It uses different frequency ranges for each stream. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Variable bit rate streams కోసం fixed time-division multiplexing తో పోలిస్తే statistical multiplexing efficiency ని ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) అన్ని streams కి ఒకే peak bit rate ఉండాలి. B) Real-time demand ఆధారంగా time slots ని dynamic గా కేటాయించి idle capacity ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Activity తో సంబంధం లేకుండా ప్రతి stream కి dedicated time slots ని కేటాయిస్తుంది. D) ప్రతి stream కి వేర్వేరు frequency ranges ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does statistical multiplexing improve efficiency compared to fixed time-division multiplexing for variable bit rate streams? A) It requires all streams to have the same peak bit rate. B) It dynamically allocates time slots based on real-time demand, reducing idle capacity. C) It assigns dedicated time slots to each stream regardless of activity. D) It uses different frequency ranges for each stream. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary benefit of applying Heath theorem to a relation with an FD X → Y? A) It eliminates all anomalies B) It ensures the decomposition is lossless C) It reduces the number of attributes in X D) It always creates a primary key ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: What is the primary benefit of applying Heath theorem to a relation with an FD X → Y? A) It eliminates all anomalies B) It ensures the decomposition is lossless C) It reduces the number of attributes in X D) It always creates a primary key ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the goal when using variational inference in the context of DDPM? A) To find the exact posterior distribution B) To minimize the ELBO loss function C) To minimize the KL divergence between the model and data distributions D) To maximize the likelihood of the observed data ANSWER: B

A) కచ్చితమైన posterior distribution ని కనుగొనడం B) ELBO loss function ని minimize చేయడం C) Model మరియు data distributions మధ్య KL divergence ని minimize చేయడం D) Observed data యొక్క likelihood ని maximize చేయడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the goal when using variational inference in the context of DDPM? A) To find the exact posterior distribution B) To minimize the ELBO loss function C) To minimize the KL divergence between the model and data distributions D) To maximize the likelihood of the observed data ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the non-recursive implementation of DFS typically differ from the recursive version in terms of neighbor visitation? A) It visits neighbors in the opposite order relative to the adjacency list B) It uses queues instead of stacks C) It is always faster by a constant factor D) It cannot traverse all vertices in a connected graph ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Neighbor visitation విషయంలో DFS యొక్క non-recursive implementation సాధారణంగా recursive version నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Adjacency list కి సంబంధించి అది neighbors ని వ్యతిరేక క్రమంలో visit చేస్తుంది B) అది stacks కి బదులు queues ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒక constant factor తో వేగంగా ఉంటుంది D) Connected graph లోని అన్ని vertices ని అది traverse చేయలేదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does the non-recursive implementation of DFS typically differ from the recursive version in terms of neighbor visitation? A) It visits neighbors in the opposite order relative to the adjacency list B) It uses queues instead of stacks C) It is always faster by a constant factor D) It cannot traverse all vertices in a connected graph ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What exact relationship connects the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of an N-point sequence to its discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT)? A) The DFT is the continuous envelope connecting the discrete peaks of the DTFT. B) The DFT doubles the periodic repetition rate of the continuous DTFT spectrum. C) The DFT consists of N equally spaced frequency samples of one DTFT period. D) The DFT represents an infinite integration over the continuous DTFT spectrum. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: N-point sequence యొక్క discrete Fourier transform (DFT) ని దాని discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT) తో కలిపే కచ్చితమైన సంబంధం ఏమిటి? A) DFT అనేది DTFT యొక్క discrete peaks ని కలిపే continuous envelope. B) DFT continuous DTFT spectrum యొక్క periodic repetition rate ని రెట్టింపు చేస్తుంది. C) DFT ఒక DTFT period యొక్క N సమాన దూరంలో ఉన్న frequency samples ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది. D) DFT continuous DTFT spectrum పై infinite integration ని సూచిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What exact relationship connects the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of an N-point sequence to its discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT)? A) The DFT is the continuous envelope connecting the discrete peaks of the DTFT. B) The DFT doubles the periodic repetition rate of the continuous DTFT spectrum. C) The DFT consists of N equally spaced frequency samples of one DTFT period. D) The DFT represents an infinite integration over the continuous DTFT spectrum. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of using inter-process communication for data sharing? A) It prevents modularity in applications. target: ప్రశ్న: Data sharing కోసం inter-process communication ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రతికూలత ఏమిటి? A) అది applications లో modularity ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది. B) Overheads వల్ల అది గణనీయంగా ఎక్కువ processing costs ని కలిగించవచ్చు. C) అది synchronous primitives తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. D) దానికి ఎల్లప్పుడూ network bandwidth అవసరం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a primary disadvantage of using inter-process communication for data sharing? A) It prevents modularity in applications. B) It can incur significantly higher processing costs due to overheads. C) It only works with synchronous primitives. D) It always requires network bandwidth. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes why quantization is considered an irreversible process? A) It creates a linear relationship between input and output. B) Multiple distinct input values map to the same discrete output value. C) It only occurs in analog-to-digital converters. D) It uses infinite precision arithmetic. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Quantization ని irreversible process గా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారో ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) అది input మరియు output మధ్య linear సంబంధాన్ని సృష్టిస్తుంది. B) అనేక వేర్వేరు input values ఒకే discrete output value కి map అవుతాయి. C) అది analog-to-digital converters లో మాత్రమే జరుగుతుంది. D) అది infinite precision arithmetic ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes why quantization is considered an irreversible process? A) It creates a linear relationship between input and output. B) Multiple distinct input values map to the same discrete output value. C) It only occurs in analog-to-digital converters. D) It uses infinite precision arithmetic. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key limitation of white-box testing? A) It is always performed at the system level B) It does not require programming skills C) It cannot be used at the unit level D) It cannot detect unimplemented parts of the specification ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: White-box testing యొక్క ముఖ్య పరిమితి ఏమిటి? A) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ system level లో జరుగుతుంది B) దానికి programming skills అవసరం లేదు C) దాన్ని unit level లో ఉపయోగించలేము D) Specification లో implement చేయని భాగాలను అది గుర్తించలేదు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key limitation of white-box testing? A) It is always performed at the system level B) It does not require programming skills C) It cannot be used at the unit level D) It cannot detect unimplemented parts of the specification ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a garden-path sentence significant in the study of parsing? A) It shows that human parsing relies on working memory and predictive interpretation B) It serves as a model for creating unambiguous compiler grammars C) It demonstrates the efficiency of linear parsing algorithms D) It proves that natural languages are context-free ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Parsing అధ్యయనంలో garden-path sentence ఎందుకు ముఖ్యమైనది? A) మనిషి parsing working memory మరియు predictive interpretation పై ఆధారపడుతుందని అది చూపిస్తుంది B) Unambiguous compiler grammars సృష్టించడానికి అది ఒక model గా పనిచేస్తుంది C) Linear parsing algorithms యొక్క efficiency ని అది ప్రదర్శిస్తుంది D) Natural languages context-free అని అది నిరూపిస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is a garden-path sentence significant in the study of parsing? A) It shows that human parsing relies on working memory and predictive interpretation B) It serves as a model for creating unambiguous compiler grammars C) It demonstrates the efficiency of linear parsing algorithms D) It proves that natural languages are context-free ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which property of three-phase power allows AC electric motors to start reliably without additional auxiliary starting circuits? A) Generation of a smooth rotating magnetic field B) Elimination of line-to-neutral short circuits C) Pulsating single-phase magnetic flux D) Higher voltage amplitude compared to direct current ANSWER: A

A) సున్నితమైన rotating magnetic field ని generate చేయడం B) Line-to-neutral short circuits ని తొలగించడం C) Pulsating single-phase magnetic flux D) Direct current తో పోలిస్తే ఎక్కువ voltage amplitude జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which property of three-phase power allows AC electric motors to start reliably without additional auxiliary starting circuits? A) Generation of a smooth rotating magnetic field B) Elimination of line-to-neutral short circuits C) Pulsating single-phase magnetic flux D) Higher voltage amplitude compared to direct current ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for developing multi-sense embeddings? A) To ensure that all words in a dictionary are represented by a single vector. B) To allow words to be represented by multiple vectors to account for polysemy. C) To prevent bias from appearing in the training dataset. D) To reduce the computational cost of training neural networks. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Multi-sense embeddings ని అభివృద్ధి చేయడానికి ప్రధాన ప్రేరణ ఏమిటి? A) Dictionary లోని అన్ని words ఒకే vector తో సూచించబడేలా చూడటం. B) Polysemy ని పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోవడానికి words ని అనేక vectors తో సూచించడానికి అనుమతించడం. C) Training dataset లో bias కనిపించకుండా నివారించడం. D) Neural networks ని train చేసే computational cost ని తగ్గించడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for developing multi-sense embeddings? A) To ensure that all words in a dictionary are represented by a single vector. B) To allow words to be represented by multiple vectors to account for polysemy. C) To prevent bias from appearing in the training dataset. D) To reduce the computational cost of training neural networks. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: Which algorithm is generally used to determine the shortest path from a node to every other node in the network? A) A* search algorithm B) Dijkstra's algorithm C) Bellman-Ford algorithm D) Floyd-Warshall algorithm ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of soft decision decoding over hard decision decoding for convolutional codes? A) It eliminates the need for a trellis diagram B) It is only applicable to block codes C) It requires less computational complexity D) It utilizes the confidence level of received bits for better accuracy ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Convolutional codes కోసం hard decision decoding కంటే soft decision decoding యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది trellis diagram అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది B) అది block codes కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది C) దానికి తక్కువ computational complexity అవసరం D) మెరుగైన accuracy కోసం అది అందుకున్న bits యొక్క confidence level ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of soft decision decoding over hard decision decoding for convolutional codes? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a commutator essential for a traditional brushed DC motor? A) It increases the input voltage to produce higher starting torque B) It replaces the need for permanent magnets in the stator C) It converts AC to DC within the rotor to maintain unidirectional torque D) It acts as a sensor for the motor controller to detect rotor position ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: సాంప్రదాయ brushed DC motor కి commutator ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఎక్కువ starting torque ఉత్పత్తి చేయడానికి అది input voltage ని పెంచుతుంది B) అది stator లో permanent magnets అవసరాన్ని భర్తీ చేస్తుంది C) Unidirectional torque ని నిలుపుకోవడానికి అది rotor లోపల AC ని DC గా మారుస్తుంది D) Rotor position ని గుర్తించడానికి motor controller కి sensor గా పనిచేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is a commutator essential for a traditional brushed DC motor? A) It increases the input voltage to produce higher starting torque B) It replaces the need for permanent magnets in the stator C) It converts AC to DC within the rotor to maintain unidirectional torque D) It acts as a sensor for the motor controller to detect rotor position ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why must a database transaction that subtracts 10 from column A without changing column B be canceled, assuming the invariant is A + B = 100? A) Because atomicity would be violated. B) Because durability would fail. C) Because isolation would be compromised. D) Because the database would enter an inconsistent state. ANSWER: D

B) ఎందుకంటే durability fail అవుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే isolation దెబ్బతింటుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే database ఒక inconsistent state లోకి ప్రవేశిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why must a database transaction that subtracts 10 from column A without changing column B be canceled, assuming the invariant is A + B = 100? A) Because atomicity would be violated. B) Because durability would fail. C) Because isolation would be compromised. D) Because the database would enter an inconsistent state. ANSWER: D

B) It quantifies the dispersal of energy and the number of accessible microstates. C) It defines the temperature of the system at equilibrium. D) It measures the total internal energy available for work. ANSWER: B

B) అది energy యొక్క వ్యాప్తిని మరియు అందుబాటులో ఉన్న microstates సంఖ్యను కొలుస్తుంది. C) అది equilibrium వద్ద system యొక్క temperature ని నిర్వచిస్తుంది. D) Work కి అందుబాటులో ఉన్న మొత్తం internal energy ని అది కొలుస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary physical significance of entropy in an isolated system according to the second law? A) It represents the rate of heat transfer between reservoirs. B) It quantifies the dispersal of energy and the number of accessible microstates. C) It defines the temperature of the system at equilibrium. D) It measures the total internal energy available for work. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary effect of adding a lag compensator to a control system? A) It eliminates all resonant peaks in the frequency response B) It increases the system's bandwidth and speed C) It reduces the steady-state error for low-frequency inputs D) It increases the system's stability margin significantly ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Control system కి lag compensator ని చేర్చడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రభావం ఏమిటి? A) Frequency response లోని అన్ని resonant peaks ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది B) అది system యొక్క bandwidth మరియు speed ని పెంచుతుంది C) Low-frequency inputs కి steady-state error ని అది తగ్గిస్తుంది D) అది system యొక్క stability margin ని గణనీయంగా పెంచుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary effect of adding a lag compensator to a control system?
