input: to Telugu: Q: In a control system, how is the error signal mathematically derived? A) By multiplying the set point by the system gain. B) By summing the output signal and the disturbance signal. C) By calculating the difference between the target set point and the measured output. D) By integrating the feedback signal over a specific time interval. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Control system లో error signal mathematical గా ఎలా పొందబడుతుంది? A) Set point ని system gain తో గుణించడం ద్వారా. B) Output signal మరియు disturbance signal ని కలపడం ద్వారా. C) Target set point మరియు కొలిచిన output మధ్య తేడాను లెక్కించడం ద్వారా. D) ఒక నిర్దిష్ట time interval పై feedback signal ని integrate చేయడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In a control system, how is the error signal mathematically derived? A) By multiplying the set point by the system gain. B) By summing the output signal and the disturbance signal. C) By calculating the difference between the target set point and the measured output. D) By integrating the feedback signal over a specific time interval. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why would a designer use a Non-Maskable Interrupt instead of a maskable interrupt? A) To allow the processor to ignore the signal during high-load periods B) To reduce the overhead of context switching during instruction execution C) To ensure that critical, time-sensitive events are handled immediately regardless of current masking settings D) To enable the use of polling loops instead of interrupt-driven logic ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Designer maskable interrupt కి బదులు Non-Maskable Interrupt ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) ఎక్కువ load ఉన్న సమయాల్లో processor ఆ signal ని పట్టించుకోకుండా ఉండటానికి B) Instruction execution సమయంలో context switching overhead ని తగ్గించడానికి C) ప్రస్తుత masking settings తో సంబంధం లేకుండా కీలకమైన, time-sensitive events వెంటనే handle చేయబడేలా చూడటానికి D) Interrupt-driven logic కి బదులు polling loops ఉపయోగించడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why would a designer use a Non-Maskable Interrupt instead of a maskable interrupt? A) To allow the processor to ignore the signal during high-load periods B) To reduce the overhead of context switching during instruction execution C) To ensure that critical, time-sensitive events are handled immediately regardless of current masking settings D) To enable the use of polling loops instead of interrupt-driven logic ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In a formal automaton, the transition function maps which of the following to the next state? A) The input word and the final state. input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a strict requirement for using Dijkstra's Algorithm to find the shortest path? target: ప్రశ్న: Shortest path కనుగొనడానికి Dijkstra's Algorithm ఉపయోగించడానికి కచ్చితమైన requirement ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) Graph acyclic గా ఉండాలి B) Graph undirected గా ఉండాలి C) Graph లో negative weights ఉన్న edges ఉండకూడదు D) Graph adjacency matrix గా సూచించబడాలి జవాబు: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary responsibility of a Proposer in the Paxos protocol? A) To ensure the network delivers messages without corruption or duplication. B) To receive and store the final chosen value from the Acceptors. C) To act as a stable storage for rejoining processors after a crash. D) To initiate the consensus process by sending a Prepare message to Acceptors. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Paxos protocol లో Proposer యొక్క ప్రధాన బాధ్యత ఏమిటి? A) Network messages ని corruption లేదా duplication లేకుండా deliver చేసేలా చూడటం. B) Acceptors నుండి చివరగా ఎంచుకున్న value ని అందుకుని store చేయడం. C) Crash తర్వాత తిరిగి చేరే processors కి stable storage గా పనిచేయడం. D) Acceptors కి Prepare message పంపడం ద్వారా consensus process ని ప్రారంభించడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary responsibility of a Proposer in the Paxos protocol? A) To ensure the network delivers messages without corruption or duplication. D) To initiate the consensus process by sending a Prepare message to Acceptors. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does using an FIR filter in an interpolation application improve computational efficiency? A) Zero-valued samples introduced during expansion can be skipped in dot product calculations B) FIR filters automatically increase the sampling rate without needing expansion C) FIR filters are inherently faster than IIR filters due to their feedback loops D) FIR filters operate only on the inserted zero values ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Interpolation application లో FIR filter ఉపయోగించడం computational efficiency ని ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) Expansion సమయంలో చేర్చిన zero-valued samples ని dot product లెక్కింపులలో skip చేయవచ్చు B) FIR filters expansion అవసరం లేకుండా sampling rate ని automatic గా పెంచుతాయి C) Feedback loops వల్ల FIR filters సహజంగానే IIR filters కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయి D) FIR filters చేర్చిన zero values పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does using an FIR filter in an interpolation application improve computational efficiency? A) Zero-valued samples introduced during expansion can be skipped in dot product calculations B) FIR filters automatically increase the sampling rate without needing expansion C) FIR filters are inherently faster than IIR filters due to their feedback loops D) FIR filters operate only on the inserted zero values ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the group delay ripple in a Chebyshev filter imply? target_en: Q: What does the group delay ripple in a Chebyshev filter imply? input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a distance-vector protocol require periodic updates between neighbouring routers? A) To establish physical connections between routers that were previously disconnected. D) To propagate routing table changes and inform neighbours of local link status updates. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Distance-vector protocol కి పొరుగు routers మధ్య periodic updates ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఇంతకుముందు disconnect అయిన routers మధ్య physical connections ఏర్పాటు చేయడానికి. B) Routers మధ్య links యొక్క bandwidth ని పెంచడానికి. C) ప్రతి router పై మొత్తం global network topology map ని update చేయడానికి. D) Routing table మార్పులను వ్యాప్తి చేసి, local link status updates గురించి neighbours కి తెలియజేయడానికి. జవాబు: D

D) To propagate routing table changes and inform neighbours of local link status updates. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes the appropriate use of a parameterized test? target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes the appropriate use of a parameterized test? input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary constraint imposed on the cross-correlation function of jointly wide-sense stationary processes? A) It becomes a function only of the time lag rather than absolute time B) It must be equal to zero for all time lags C) It must result in a value of exactly one D) It is independent of the mean of the processes ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Jointly wide-sense stationary processes యొక్క cross-correlation function పై విధించే ప్రధాన constraint ఏమిటి? A) అది absolute time కి బదులు time lag కి మాత్రమే function అవుతుంది B) అన్ని time lags కి అది సున్నాకు సమానంగా ఉండాలి C) దాని value కచ్చితంగా ఒకటి కావాలి D) అది processes యొక్క mean పై ఆధారపడదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary constraint imposed on the cross-correlation function of jointly wide-sense stationary processes? A) It becomes a function only of the time lag rather than absolute time B) It must be equal to zero for all time lags C) It must result in a value of exactly one D) It is independent of the mean of the processes ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might self-training be preferred over pre-training in certain transfer learning scenarios? A) Because it requires no labeled data at all B) Because it eliminates the need for a source domain C) Because it is only applicable to neural networks D) Because pre-training can sometimes hurt accuracy on the target task ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: కొన్ని transfer learning సందర్భాల్లో pre-training కంటే self-training ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడవచ్చు? target_en: Q: Why might self-training be preferred over pre-training in certain transfer learning scenarios? input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the starting vertex chosen arbitrarily in Prim's algorithm? A) Because the graph must be disconnected to run the algorithm. B) Because the algorithm only works on directed graphs. C) Because the algorithm's greedy choice ensures the final tree is minimum regardless of the start. D) Because the starting vertex determines the final minimum spanning tree. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Prim's algorithm లో starting vertex ని ఎందుకు ఏదైనా ఒకటిగా ఎంచుకుంటారు? A) ఎందుకంటే algorithm run చేయడానికి graph disconnected గా ఉండాలి. B) ఎందుకంటే algorithm directed graphs పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే algorithm యొక్క greedy choice, start ఏదైనా చివరి tree minimum గా ఉండేలా చూస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే starting vertex చివరి minimum spanning tree ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the starting vertex chosen arbitrarily in Prim's algorithm? A) Because the graph must be disconnected to run the algorithm. D) Because the starting vertex determines the final minimum spanning tree. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes a cache hit during a processor memory access operation? A) The cache evicts an old entry to make room for new data. B) The CPU fetches data from the main memory after a stall. C) The CPU finds the requested data address already stored in the cache memory. D) The CPU successfully writes new data to the main memory via the cache. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Processor memory access operation సమయంలో cache hit ని ఏ సందర్భం ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) కొత్త data కి చోటు కల్పించడానికి cache ఒక పాత entry ని evict చేస్తుంది. B) Stall తర్వాత CPU main memory నుండి data ని fetch చేస్తుంది. C) Request చేసిన data address ఇప్పటికే cache memory లో store చేయబడి ఉన్నట్లు CPU కనుగొంటుంది. D) CPU cache ద్వారా main memory కి కొత్త data ని విజయవంతంగా write చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes a cache hit during a processor memory access operation? A) The cache evicts an old entry to make room for new data. B) The CPU fetches data from the main memory after a stall. C) The CPU finds the requested data address already stored in the cache memory. D) The CPU successfully writes new data to the main memory via the cache. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: For a standard unilateral Laplace transform of a causal signal of exponential order, what geometric shape does the Region of Convergence (ROC) typically take in the s-plane? A) రెండు imaginary axes మధ్య పరిమితమైన vertical strip B) Origin వద్ద కేంద్రం ఉన్న circular disc C) Re(s) > a తో నిర్వచించబడిన right-half plane D) Real line పై discrete poles యొక్క విడి set జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: For a standard unilateral Laplace transform of a causal signal of exponential order, what geometric shape does the Region of Convergence (ROC) typically take in the s-plane? input: to Telugu: Q: What occurs if the sampling frequency is less than the Nyquist rate? A) Aliasing occurs B) The signal becomes a DC component C) The signal bandwidth increases D) The signal is perfectly reconstructed ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: What occurs if the sampling frequency is less than the Nyquist rate? A) Aliasing occurs B) The signal becomes a DC component C) The signal bandwidth increases D) The signal is perfectly reconstructed ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does a reflection coefficient of zero signify about a transmission line termination? A) The line is short-circuited B) The line is perfectly matched to its load C) The line has high losses D) The line is open-circuited ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Reflection coefficient సున్నా అయితే అది transmission line termination గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Line short-circuit అయింది B) Line తన load కి పూర్తిగా match అయింది C) Line కి ఎక్కువ losses ఉన్నాయి D) Line open-circuit అయింది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What does a reflection coefficient of zero signify about a transmission line termination? A) The line is short-circuited B) The line is perfectly matched to its load C) The line has high losses D) The line is open-circuited ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a digital signature considered mathematically bound to the message content? A) Because the public key is unique to the message B) Because it is stored on a physical medium C) Because it uses a specific hash function D) Because the signature is generated using the message's content and the private key ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Digital signature ని message content కి mathematical గా బంధించబడినదిగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే public key ఆ message కి ప్రత్యేకమైనది B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒక physical medium పై store చేయబడుతుంది C) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒక నిర్దిష్ట hash function ఉపయోగిస్తుంది D) ఎందుకంటే signature message content మరియు private key ఉపయోగించి generate చేయబడుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is a digital signature considered mathematically bound to the message content? A) Because the public key is unique to the message B) Because it is stored on a physical medium C) Because it uses a specific hash function D) Because the signature is generated using the message's content and the private key ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary challenge that speaker independence addresses in speech recognition systems? A) Increasing the processing speed of the system B) Reducing the vocabulary size required for recognition C) Differentiating between speech and non-speech signals D) Accurately recognizing speech from speakers the system was not specifically trained on ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Speech recognition systems లో speaker independence పరిష్కరించే ప్రధాన సవాలు ఏమిటి? A) System యొక్క processing speed ని పెంచడం B) Recognition కి అవసరమైన vocabulary size ని తగ్గించడం C) Speech మరియు non-speech signals మధ్య తేడాను గుర్తించడం D) System ప్రత్యేకంగా train చేయబడని speakers యొక్క speech ని కచ్చితంగా గుర్తించడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary challenge that speaker independence addresses in speech recognition systems? A) Increasing the processing speed of the system B) Reducing the vocabulary size required for recognition C) Differentiating between speech and non-speech signals D) Accurately recognizing speech from speakers the system was not specifically trained on ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason a ripple-carry adder is relatively slow compared to a carry-lookahead adder? A) Each full adder must wait for the carry bit from the previous stage B) It cannot handle signed numbers in two's complement C) The layout of the circuit is too complex for fast signals D) It requires more XOR gates per bit ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Carry-lookahead adder తో పోలిస్తే ripple-carry adder సాపేక్షంగా నెమ్మదిగా ఉండటానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) ప్రతి full adder మునుపటి stage నుండి carry bit కోసం వేచి ఉండాలి B) అది two's complement లో signed numbers ని handle చేయలేదు C) వేగవంతమైన signals కి circuit layout చాలా సంక్లిష్టంగా ఉంటుంది D) దానికి ప్రతి bit కి ఎక్కువ XOR gates అవసరం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason a ripple-carry adder is relatively slow compared to a carry-lookahead adder? A) Each full adder must wait for the carry bit from the previous stage B) It cannot handle signed numbers in two's complement C) The layout of the circuit is too complex for fast signals D) It requires more XOR gates per bit ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is symmetric-key cryptography considered less practical for secure communication over public networks compared to asymmetric systems? A) Symmetric algorithms are always slower than public-key algorithms. B) Symmetric keys are too short to provide adequate security. C) The same key must be securely shared between all communicating parties beforehand. D) Symmetric ciphers cannot encrypt large blocks of data efficiently. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Asymmetric systems తో పోలిస్తే public networks పై secure communication కి symmetric-key cryptography ఎందుకు తక్కువ practical గా పరిగణించబడుతుంది? A) Symmetric algorithms ఎల్లప్పుడూ public-key algorithms కంటే నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటాయి. B) తగిన security ఇవ్వడానికి symmetric keys చాలా చిన్నవి. C) Communicate చేసే అన్ని parties మధ్య ఒకే key ని ముందుగానే సురక్షితంగా share చేయాలి. D) Symmetric ciphers పెద్ద data blocks ని సమర్థవంతంగా encrypt చేయలేవు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is symmetric-key cryptography considered less practical for secure communication over public networks compared to asymmetric systems? A) Symmetric algorithms are always slower than public-key algorithms. B) Symmetric keys are too short to provide adequate security. C) The same key must be securely shared between all communicating parties beforehand. D) Symmetric ciphers cannot encrypt large blocks of data efficiently. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: When calculating the shortest path in an unweighted graph, why is BFS preferred over DFS? A) BFS guarantees finding the path with the minimum number of edges, while DFS does not. B) BFS uses less memory than DFS in all cases. C) DFS cannot handle graphs with cycles. D) DFS requires an adjacency matrix, whereas BFS works only with lists. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Unweighted graph లో shortest path లెక్కించేటప్పుడు DFS కంటే BFS ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) BFS కనీస edges ఉన్న path ని కనుగొంటుందని హామీ ఇస్తుంది, DFS ఇవ్వదు. B) అన్ని సందర్భాల్లో BFS, DFS కంటే తక్కువ memory ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. C) DFS cycles ఉన్న graphs ని handle చేయలేదు. D) DFS కి adjacency matrix అవసరం, BFS lists తో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: When calculating the shortest path in an unweighted graph, why is BFS preferred over DFS? A) BFS guarantees finding the path with the minimum number of edges, while DFS does not. B) BFS uses less memory than DFS in all cases. C) DFS cannot handle graphs with cycles. D) DFS requires an adjacency matrix, whereas BFS works only with lists. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What was the fundamental limitation of 'fixed-program' computers that 'stored-program' computers solved? A) They were too fast to be reliable B) They could not perform arithmetic operations C) They required physical rewiring to change tasks D) They lacked a control unit ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: 'Stored-program' computers పరిష్కరించిన 'fixed-program' computers యొక్క ప్రాథమిక పరిమితి ఏమిటి? A) అవి విశ్వసనీయంగా ఉండటానికి చాలా వేగంగా ఉండేవి B) అవి arithmetic operations చేయలేకపోయేవి C) Tasks మార్చడానికి వాటికి physical rewiring అవసరమయ్యేది D) వాటికి control unit ఉండేది కాదు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What was the fundamental limitation of 'fixed-program' computers that 'stored-program' computers solved? A) They were too fast to be reliable B) They could not perform arithmetic operations C) They required physical rewiring to change tasks D) They lacked a control unit ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the main benefit of a database being in domain/key normal form? A) It requires the least amount of storage space. B) It simplifies the process of creating indexes. C) It allows for the fastest query performance. D) It eliminates all types of modification anomalies. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Database domain/key normal form లో ఉండటం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) దానికి అతి తక్కువ storage space అవసరం. B) అది indexes సృష్టించే process ని సరళీకరిస్తుంది. C) అది అత్యంత వేగవంతమైన query performance ని అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) అది అన్ని రకాల modification anomalies ని తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the main benefit of a database being in domain/key normal form? A) It requires the least amount of storage space. B) It simplifies the process of creating indexes. C) It allows for the fastest query performance. D) It eliminates all types of modification anomalies. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a series clipper lose effectiveness at very high frequencies? A) The diode becomes a short circuit B) The diode capacitance allows high-frequency current to pass through without being blocked C) The series resistor acts as an open circuit D) The reference voltage becomes unstable ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: చాలా ఎక్కువ frequencies వద్ద series clipper ఎందుకు ప్రభావాన్ని కోల్పోతుంది? A) Diode ఒక short circuit అవుతుంది B) Diode capacitance వల్ల high-frequency current అడ్డుకోబడకుండా దాటిపోతుంది C) Series resistor ఒక open circuit లా పనిచేస్తుంది D) Reference voltage అస్థిరంగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a series clipper lose effectiveness at very high frequencies? A) The diode becomes a short circuit B) The diode capacitance allows high-frequency current to pass through without being blocked C) The series resistor acts as an open circuit D) The reference voltage becomes unstable ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Wi-Fi Alliance in the context of network technology? A) To manufacture the hardware components for wireless routers B) To develop the underlying IEEE 802.11 standards C) To manage the Wi-Fi trademark and certify equipment interoperability D) To regulate the global radio frequency spectrum ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Network technology సందర్భంలో Wi-Fi Alliance యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Wireless routers కి hardware components ని తయారు చేయడం B) మూలమైన IEEE 802.11 standards ని అభివృద్ధి చేయడం C) Wi-Fi trademark ని నిర్వహించడం మరియు equipment interoperability ని certify చేయడం D) Global radio frequency spectrum ని నియంత్రించడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Wi-Fi Alliance in the context of network technology? A) To manufacture the hardware components for wireless routers B) To develop the underlying IEEE 802.11 standards C) To manage the Wi-Fi trademark and certify equipment interoperability D) To regulate the global radio frequency spectrum ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which best describes the primary purpose of layering in the Internet protocol suite? A) To eliminate the need for routers in network communication B) To ensure every protocol can communicate with every hardware device C) To increase the speed of physical data transmission D) To allow protocols at different levels to operate independently through abstraction ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Internet protocol suite లో layering యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యాన్ని ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Network communication లో routers అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడం B) ప్రతి protocol ప్రతి hardware device తో communicate చేయగలిగేలా చూడటం C) Physical data transmission speed ని పెంచడం D) Abstraction ద్వారా వేర్వేరు levels లోని protocols స్వతంత్రంగా పనిచేయడానికి అనుమతించడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which best describes the primary purpose of layering in the Internet protocol suite? A) To eliminate the need for routers in network communication B) To ensure every protocol can communicate with every hardware device C) To increase the speed of physical data transmission D) To allow protocols at different levels to operate independently through abstraction ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In the Hough transform, how does maximum likelihood estimation handle partially occluded shapes? A) By increasing the threshold for local maxima. B) By requiring all pixels on the shape to be detected. C) By using a uniform prior on the shape space. D) By ignoring negative evidence and only considering positive evidence. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hough transform లో maximum likelihood estimation పాక్షికంగా కప్పబడిన (occluded) shapes ని ఎలా handle చేస్తుంది? A) Local maxima కోసం threshold ని పెంచడం ద్వారా. B) Shape పై ఉన్న అన్ని pixels గుర్తించబడాలని కోరడం ద్వారా. C) Shape space పై uniform prior ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా. D) Negative evidence ని పట్టించుకోకుండా positive evidence ని మాత్రమే పరిగణించడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the Hough transform, how does maximum likelihood estimation handle partially occluded shapes? A) By increasing the threshold for local maxima. B) By requiring all pixels on the shape to be detected. C) By using a uniform prior on the shape space. D) By ignoring negative evidence and only considering positive evidence. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary effect of setting a bit in an interrupt mask register? A) The software interrupt is converted into a hardware interrupt B) The specific interrupt signal is either ignored or deferred by the processor C) The processor immediately executes the corresponding ISR D) The hardware device is physically disconnected from the IRQ line ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Interrupt mask register లో ఒక bit ని set చేయడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రభావం ఏమిటి? A) Software interrupt ఒక hardware interrupt గా మారుతుంది B) ఆ నిర్దిష్ట interrupt signal ని processor పట్టించుకోదు లేదా వాయిదా వేస్తుంది C) Processor వెంటనే సంబంధిత ISR ని execute చేస్తుంది D) Hardware device IRQ line నుండి భౌతికంగా disconnect అవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary effect of setting a bit in an interrupt mask register? A) The software interrupt is converted into a hardware interrupt B) The specific interrupt signal is either ignored or deferred by the processor C) The processor immediately executes the corresponding ISR D) The hardware device is physically disconnected from the IRQ line ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How is a complete binary tree structured regarding its last level? A) Filled from left to right B) Randomly placed C) Completely empty D) Filled from right to left ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Complete binary tree దాని చివరి level విషయంలో ఎలా నిర్మించబడుతుంది? A) ఎడమ నుండి కుడికి నింపబడుతుంది B) Random గా ఉంచబడుతుంది C) పూర్తిగా ఖాళీగా ఉంటుంది D) కుడి నుండి ఎడమకు నింపబడుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How is a complete binary tree structured regarding its last level? A) Filled from left to right B) Randomly placed C) Completely empty D) Filled from right to left ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a software design pattern be considered a sign of a missing feature in a programming language? A) It suggests the pattern is not reusable across different platforms. B) It indicates the language lacks sufficient built-in support for the problem it solves. C) It shows the programmer is using outdated coding practices. D) It means the pattern is too complex for the language's syntax. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక software design pattern ని programming language లో లేని feature కి సంకేతంగా ఎందుకు పరిగణించవచ్చు? A) ఆ pattern వేర్వేరు platforms లో reusable కాదని అది సూచిస్తుంది. B) అది పరిష్కరించే సమస్యకు language లో తగిన built-in support లేదని అది సూచిస్తుంది. C) Programmer పాతబడిన coding practices ఉపయోగిస్తున్నాడని అది చూపిస్తుంది. D) Language syntax కి ఆ pattern చాలా సంక్లిష్టమైనదని అర్థం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why might a software design pattern be considered a sign of a missing feature in a programming language? A) It suggests the pattern is not reusable across different platforms. B) It indicates the language lacks sufficient built-in support for the problem it solves. C) It shows the programmer is using outdated coding practices. D) It means the pattern is too complex for the language's syntax. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of purely functional queues, what does 'real-time' guarantee? A) That the queue can only be used in real-time operating systems. B) That every operation will complete in constant worst-case time. C) That the queue will never run out of memory. D) That the queue will always have the fastest performance. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Purely functional queues సందర్భంలో 'real-time' దేనికి హామీ ఇస్తుంది? A) Queue ని real-time operating systems లో మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించవచ్చని. B) ప్రతి operation constant worst-case time లో పూర్తవుతుందని. C) Queue కి ఎప్పుడూ memory అయిపోదని. D) Queue కి ఎల్లప్పుడూ అత్యంత వేగవంతమైన performance ఉంటుందని. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of purely functional queues, what does 'real-time' guarantee? A) That the queue can only be used in real-time operating systems. B) That every operation will complete in constant worst-case time. C) That the queue will never run out of memory. D) That the queue will always have the fastest performance. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is true about the difference between optical flow and motion estimation? A) Optical flow is only valid for static cameras. B) Optical flow is purely for video compression, while motion estimation is for robotics. C) Optical flow specifically requires machine learning, whereas motion estimation does not. D) Optical flow estimates the 3D structure and scene movement, while motion estimation is a broader field of determining movement. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Optical flow మరియు motion estimation మధ్య తేడా గురించి ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది నిజం? A) Optical flow static cameras కి మాత్రమే చెల్లుతుంది. B) Optical flow కేవలం video compression కోసం, motion estimation robotics కోసం. C) Optical flow కి ప్రత్యేకంగా machine learning అవసరం, motion estimation కి అవసరం లేదు. D) Optical flow 3D structure మరియు scene movement ని అంచనా వేస్తుంది, motion estimation కదలికను నిర్ణయించే విస్తృత రంగం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following is true about the difference between optical flow and motion estimation? A) Optical flow is only valid for static cameras. B) Optical flow is purely for video compression, while motion estimation is for robotics. C) Optical flow specifically requires machine learning, whereas motion estimation does not. D) Optical flow estimates the 3D structure and scene movement, while motion estimation is a broader field of determining movement. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In which condition does a buck converter enter continuous conduction mode? A) When the inductor current never falls to zero during the cycle B) When the output voltage equals the input voltage C) When the duty cycle is exactly zero D) When the inductor current reaches zero every cycle ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో buck converter continuous conduction mode లోకి ప్రవేశిస్తుంది? A) Cycle సమయంలో inductor current ఎప్పుడూ సున్నాకు పడిపోనప్పుడు B) Output voltage, input voltage కి సమానమైనప్పుడు C) Duty cycle కచ్చితంగా సున్నా అయినప్పుడు D) ప్రతి cycle లో inductor current సున్నాకు చేరినప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In which condition does a buck converter enter continuous conduction mode? A) When the inductor current never falls to zero during the cycle B) When the output voltage equals the input voltage C) When the duty cycle is exactly zero D) When the inductor current reaches zero every cycle ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of using a weight function in an Enriched Random Forest? A) To reduce the total number of trees in the forest B) To assign higher selection probability to features that appear more informative C) To ensure all features have an equal probability of being selected D) To eliminate the need for bootstrap sampling ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Enriched Random Forest లో weight function ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Forest లోని మొత్తం trees సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం B) ఎక్కువ informative గా కనిపించే features కి ఎక్కువ selection probability ని కేటాయించడం C) అన్ని features ఎంపికయ్యే probability సమానంగా ఉండేలా చూడటం D) Bootstrap sampling అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of using a weight function in an Enriched Random Forest? A) To reduce the total number of trees in the forest B) To assign higher selection probability to features that appear more informative C) To ensure all features have an equal probability of being selected D) To eliminate the need for bootstrap sampling ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a primary purpose of using a retrieval model? A) To physically print the documents found. B) To transform documents and queries into a representation suitable for calculating relevance. C) To generate new content from scratch. D) To delete irrelevant files from the server. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Retrieval model ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) కనుగొన్న documents ని భౌతికంగా print చేయడం. B) Relevance లెక్కించడానికి అనువైన representation గా documents మరియు queries ని మార్చడం. C) మొదటి నుండి కొత్త content ని generate చేయడం. D) Server నుండి సంబంధం లేని files ని తొలగించడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a primary purpose of using a retrieval model? A) To physically print the documents found. B) To transform documents and queries into a representation suitable for calculating relevance. C) To generate new content from scratch. D) To delete irrelevant files from the server. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the shuffle operation critical for the correctness of a MapReduce job? A) It validates the data types of the input records B) It compresses the intermediate data to reduce network bandwidth C) It assigns new keys to the output pairs for sorting D) It ensures that all data for a specific key is sent to the same reducer ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: MapReduce job సరిగ్గా పనిచేయడానికి shuffle operation ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) అది input records యొక్క data types ని validate చేస్తుంది B) Network bandwidth తగ్గించడానికి అది intermediate data ని compress చేస్తుంది C) Sorting కోసం output pairs కి కొత్త keys ని కేటాయిస్తుంది D) ఒక నిర్దిష్ట key కి సంబంధించిన మొత్తం data ఒకే reducer కి పంపబడేలా అది చూస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the shuffle operation critical for the correctness of a MapReduce job? A) It validates the data types of the input records B) It compresses the intermediate data to reduce network bandwidth C) It assigns new keys to the output pairs for sorting D) It ensures that all data for a specific key is sent to the same reducer ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the insertion order of nodes critical for a standard binary search tree? A) It changes the binary property of the tree nodes. B) It defines whether the tree can support recursive search algorithms. C) It dictates the final tree height, which determines search performance efficiency. D) It determines the memory address of every node in the heap. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard binary search tree కి nodes insertion order ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) అది tree nodes యొక్క binary property ని మారుస్తుంది. B) Tree recursive search algorithms ని support చేయగలదా లేదా అని అది నిర్వచిస్తుంది. C) అది చివరి tree height ని నిర్దేశిస్తుంది, అదే search performance efficiency ని నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. D) Heap లోని ప్రతి node యొక్క memory address ని అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the insertion order of nodes critical for a standard binary search tree? A) It changes the binary property of the tree nodes. B) It defines whether the tree can support recursive search algorithms. C) It dictates the final tree height, which determines search performance efficiency. D) It determines the memory address of every node in the heap. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does an RNN fundamentally differ from a feedforward neural network? A) Feedforward networks are designed for sequential data only. B) RNNs process inputs sequentially with feedback connections. C) RNNs use hidden vectors while feedforward networks do not. D) RNNs cannot learn temporal dependencies. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: RNN ప్రాథమికంగా feedforward neural network నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Feedforward networks sequential data కోసం మాత్రమే రూపొందించబడ్డాయి. B) RNNs feedback connections తో inputs ని sequential గా process చేస్తాయి. C) RNNs hidden vectors ఉపయోగిస్తాయి, feedforward networks ఉపయోగించవు. D) RNNs temporal dependencies ని నేర్చుకోలేవు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does an RNN fundamentally differ from a feedforward neural network? A) Feedforward networks are designed for sequential data only. B) RNNs process inputs sequentially with feedback connections. C) RNNs use hidden vectors while feedforward networks do not. D) RNNs cannot learn temporal dependencies. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary risk associated with a centralized version control system when multiple developers edit the same file simultaneously? A) The system will automatically delete the file to prevent corruption. B) The server will require more electricity to process the changes. C) Developers may inadvertently overwrite each other's work without proper locking or merging. D) The file system will switch from a DAG structure to a tree structure. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: అనేక developers ఒకే file ని ఒకేసారి edit చేసినప్పుడు centralized version control system తో ముడిపడిన ప్రధాన risk ఏమిటి? A) Corruption ని నివారించడానికి system automatic గా file ని తొలగిస్తుంది. B) మార్పులను process చేయడానికి server కి ఎక్కువ విద్యుత్ అవసరమవుతుంది. C) సరైన locking లేదా merging లేకుండా developers అనుకోకుండా ఒకరి పనిని మరొకరు overwrite చేయవచ్చు. D) File system ఒక DAG structure నుండి tree structure కి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary risk associated with a centralized version control system when multiple developers edit the same file simultaneously? A) The system will automatically delete the file to prevent corruption. B) The server will require more electricity to process the changes. C) Developers may inadvertently overwrite each other's work without proper locking or merging. D) The file system will switch from a DAG structure to a tree structure. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is subnetting performed in a network? A) To enable IPv4 to directly communicate with IPv6 B) To increase the total number of available IP addresses C) To divide a large network into smaller, manageable sub-networks D) To change the physical cabling between network devices ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Network లో subnetting ఎందుకు చేస్తారు? A) IPv4 నేరుగా IPv6 తో communicate చేయడానికి B) అందుబాటులో ఉన్న మొత్తం IP addresses సంఖ్యను పెంచడానికి C) పెద్ద network ని చిన్న, నిర్వహించదగిన sub-networks గా విభజించడానికి D) Network devices మధ్య physical cabling ని మార్చడానికి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is subnetting performed in a network? A) To enable IPv4 to directly communicate with IPv6 B) To increase the total number of available IP addresses C) To divide a large network into smaller, manageable sub-networks D) To change the physical cabling between network devices ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which condition is required for an enhancement-mode n-channel MOSFET to begin conducting current? A) Gate-to-source voltage must be greater than threshold voltage B) Drain voltage must be zero C) Gate-to-source voltage must be less than threshold voltage D) Gate voltage must be zero ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Enhancement-mode n-channel MOSFET current ని conduct చేయడం ప్రారంభించడానికి ఏ condition అవసరం? A) Gate-to-source voltage, threshold voltage కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండాలి B) Drain voltage సున్నాగా ఉండాలి C) Gate-to-source voltage, threshold voltage కంటే తక్కువగా ఉండాలి D) Gate voltage సున్నాగా ఉండాలి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which condition is required for an enhancement-mode n-channel MOSFET to begin conducting current? A) Gate-to-source voltage must be greater than threshold voltage B) Drain voltage must be zero C) Gate-to-source voltage must be less than threshold voltage D) Gate voltage must be zero ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is address multiplexing used in the Intel 8085? A) To eliminate the need for a clock generator B) To reduce the total number of pins required on the IC package C) To increase the speed of the data bus D) To allow for more interrupt pins ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Intel 8085 లో address multiplexing ఎందుకు ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది? A) Clock generator అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడానికి B) IC package పై అవసరమైన మొత్తం pins సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడానికి C) Data bus యొక్క speed ని పెంచడానికి D) ఎక్కువ interrupt pins కి అనుమతించడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is address multiplexing used in the Intel 8085? A) To eliminate the need for a clock generator B) To reduce the total number of pins required on the IC package C) To increase the speed of the data bus D) To allow for more interrupt pins ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are CNNs preferred over fully connected networks for processing high-resolution images? A) They use backpropagation, which FC networks do not. B) They require more neurons, which increases accuracy. C) They drastically reduce the number of parameters through shared weights and local connections. D) They only process text, making them more efficient for images. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: High-resolution images ని process చేయడానికి fully connected networks కంటే CNNs ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) అవి backpropagation ఉపయోగిస్తాయి, FC networks ఉపయోగించవు. B) వాటికి ఎక్కువ neurons అవసరం, ఇది accuracy ని పెంచుతుంది. C) Shared weights మరియు local connections ద్వారా అవి parameters సంఖ్యను భారీగా తగ్గిస్తాయి. D) అవి text ని మాత్రమే process చేస్తాయి, దీనివల్ల images కి మరింత efficient. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why are CNNs preferred over fully connected networks for processing high-resolution images? A) They use backpropagation, which FC networks do not. B) They require more neurons, which increases accuracy. C) They drastically reduce the number of parameters through shared weights and local connections. D) They only process text, making them more efficient for images. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the master theorem fail for recurrences where the number of subproblems is not constant? A) Because the theorem only applies to algorithms with a single subproblem B) Because the theorem's parameters assume a fixed number of subproblems C) Because the combination time becomes negative D) Because the recurrence relation becomes too complex to solve ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Subproblems సంఖ్య constant కాని recurrences కి master theorem ఎందుకు విఫలమవుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే theorem ఒకే subproblem ఉన్న algorithms కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే theorem యొక్క parameters fixed సంఖ్యలో subproblems ని ఊహిస్తాయి C) ఎందుకంటే combination time negative అవుతుంది D) ఎందుకంటే recurrence relation solve చేయడానికి చాలా సంక్లిష్టంగా మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the master theorem fail for recurrences where the number of subproblems is not constant? A) Because the theorem only applies to algorithms with a single subproblem B) Because the theorem's parameters assume a fixed number of subproblems C) Because the combination time becomes negative D) Because the recurrence relation becomes too complex to solve ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the collector current in a BJT primarily driven by minority carriers in the base? A) Because minority carriers have higher conductivity than majority carriers B) Because the base is always reverse-biased to attract majority carriers C) Because minority carriers diffuse across the thin base region D) Because majority carriers are blocked by the depletion layer ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: BJT లో collector current ప్రధానంగా base లోని minority carriers ద్వారా ఎందుకు నడపబడుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే minority carriers కి majority carriers కంటే ఎక్కువ conductivity ఉంటుంది B) ఎందుకంటే majority carriers ని ఆకర్షించడానికి base ఎల్లప్పుడూ reverse-biased గా ఉంటుంది C) ఎందుకంటే minority carriers పలుచని base region అంతటా diffuse అవుతాయి D) ఎందుకంటే majority carriers depletion layer ద్వారా అడ్డుకోబడతాయి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the collector current in a BJT primarily driven by minority carriers in the base? A) Because minority carriers have higher conductivity than majority carriers B) Because the base is always reverse-biased to attract majority carriers C) Because minority carriers diffuse across the thin base region D) Because majority carriers are blocked by the depletion layer ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do block ciphers process plaintext compared to stream ciphers? A) They are inherently faster than stream ciphers for all data types. B) They do not require any key to function, unlike stream ciphers. C) They encrypt characters one by one in a continuous stream. D) They require the plaintext to be a multiple of the block size, processing multiple bits as a single unit. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Stream ciphers తో పోలిస్తే block ciphers plaintext ని ఎలా process చేస్తాయి? A) అన్ని data types కి అవి సహజంగానే stream ciphers కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయి. B) Stream ciphers లా కాకుండా, వాటికి పనిచేయడానికి ఏ key అవసరం లేదు. C) అవి characters ని ఒక్కొక్కటిగా continuous stream లో encrypt చేస్తాయి. D) Plaintext block size యొక్క multiple గా ఉండాలి, అనేక bits ని ఒకే unit గా process చేస్తాయి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How do block ciphers process plaintext compared to stream ciphers? A) They are inherently faster than stream ciphers for all data types. B) They do not require any key to function, unlike stream ciphers. C) They encrypt characters one by one in a continuous stream. D) They require the plaintext to be a multiple of the block size, processing multiple bits as a single unit. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the moment of a force about a specific axis calculated? A) By multiplying the force magnitude by the perpendicular distance from the axis B) By taking the cross product of the force vector and the position vector, then projecting onto the axis C) By taking the dot product of the force vector and the position vector D) By integrating the force over the entire length of the object ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట axis చుట్టూ force యొక్క moment ఎలా లెక్కించబడుతుంది? A) Force magnitude ని axis నుండి perpendicular distance తో గుణించడం ద్వారా B) Force vector మరియు position vector యొక్క cross product తీసుకుని, ఆపై దాన్ని axis పై project చేయడం ద్వారా C) Force vector మరియు position vector యొక్క dot product తీసుకోవడం ద్వారా D) వస్తువు యొక్క మొత్తం length పై force ని integrate చేయడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How is the moment of a force about a specific axis calculated? A) By multiplying the force magnitude by the perpendicular distance from the axis B) By taking the cross product of the force vector and the position vector, then projecting onto the axis C) By taking the dot product of the force vector and the position vector D) By integrating the force over the entire length of the object ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is a direct consequence of a domain gap in object detection? A) The model's performance degrades when tested on images from a different distribution than training. B) The model requires more convolutional layers to function. C) The model fails to detect objects that are partially occluded. D) The model cannot generate bounding boxes at all. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Object detection లో domain gap యొక్క ప్రత్యక్ష పరిణామం ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) Training కంటే వేరే distribution నుండి వచ్చిన images పై test చేసినప్పుడు model performance తగ్గుతుంది. B) Model పనిచేయడానికి ఎక్కువ convolutional layers అవసరం. C) పాక్షికంగా కప్పబడిన objects ని model గుర్తించలేదు. D) Model అసలు bounding boxes ని generate చేయలేదు. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which of the following is a direct consequence of a domain gap in object detection? A) The model's performance degrades when tested on images from a different distribution than training. B) The model requires more convolutional layers to function. C) The model fails to detect objects that are partially occluded. D) The model cannot generate bounding boxes at all. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: If the frequency of an AC signal increases, what happens to the skin depth in a copper wire? A) It remains constant B) It decreases C) It becomes zero D) It increases ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: AC signal యొక్క frequency పెరిగితే, copper wire లో skin depth కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది B) అది తగ్గుతుంది C) అది సున్నా అవుతుంది D) అది పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If the frequency of an AC signal increases, what happens to the skin depth in a copper wire? A) It remains constant B) It decreases C) It becomes zero D) It increases ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary trade-off made when applying negative feedback to an amplifier? A) Increased gain for increased stability B) Increased bandwidth for increased distortion C) Decreased gain for increased linearity D) Decreased power consumption for increased gain ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Amplifier కి negative feedback ని apply చేసేటప్పుడు జరిగే ప్రధాన trade-off ఏమిటి? A) పెరిగిన stability కోసం పెరిగిన gain B) పెరిగిన distortion కోసం పెరిగిన bandwidth C) పెరిగిన linearity కోసం తగ్గిన gain D) పెరిగిన gain కోసం తగ్గిన power consumption జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary trade-off made when applying negative feedback to an amplifier? A) Increased gain for increased stability B) Increased bandwidth for increased distortion C) Decreased gain for increased linearity D) Decreased power consumption for increased gain ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the relational model strictly enforce that all information is in tuples? A) To ensure data is stored in a tabular format. B) To maintain a clear separation between data and metadata. C) To prevent data redundancy and anomalies. D) To allow the database to infer information from metadata. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: మొత్తం సమాచారం tuples లోనే ఉండాలని relational model ఎందుకు కచ్చితంగా అమలు చేస్తుంది? A) Data tabular format లో store చేయబడేలా చూడటానికి. B) Data మరియు metadata మధ్య స్పష్టమైన విభజనను నిలుపుకోవడానికి. C) Data redundancy మరియు anomalies ని నివారించడానికి. D) Metadata నుండి database సమాచారాన్ని infer చేయడానికి అనుమతించడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the relational model strictly enforce that all information is in tuples? A) To ensure data is stored in a tabular format. B) To maintain a clear separation between data and metadata. C) To prevent data redundancy and anomalies. D) To allow the database to infer information from metadata. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a trie not suffer from hash collisions like a hash table? A) A trie uses a different hashing algorithm. B) A trie automatically resolves collisions by chaining. C) Tries are only used for short strings. D) Keys are stored directly in a tree structure, eliminating the need for a hash function. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Hash table లాగా trie కి hash collisions ఎందుకు రావు? A) Trie వేరే hashing algorithm ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) Trie chaining ద్వారా collisions ని automatic గా పరిష్కరిస్తుంది. C) Tries చిన్న strings కి మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. D) Keys నేరుగా tree structure లో store చేయబడతాయి, దీనివల్ల hash function అవసరం ఉండదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does a trie not suffer from hash collisions like a hash table? A) A trie uses a different hashing algorithm. B) A trie automatically resolves collisions by chaining. C) Tries are only used for short strings. D) Keys are stored directly in a tree structure, eliminating the need for a hash function. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: If Kruskal's algorithm is applied to a graph that is already disconnected, what is the result? A) It creates a single cycle including all nodes B) It forms a minimum spanning forest C) The algorithm fails and returns an error D) It returns only the edges with the minimum possible weight globally ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఇప్పటికే disconnected గా ఉన్న graph కి Kruskal's algorithm ని apply చేస్తే ఫలితం ఏమిటి? A) అది అన్ని nodes ని కలిగి ఉన్న ఒకే cycle ని సృష్టిస్తుంది B) అది ఒక minimum spanning forest ని ఏర్పరుస్తుంది C) Algorithm విఫలమై error ని return చేస్తుంది D) అది globally కనీస సాధ్యమైన weight ఉన్న edges ని మాత్రమే return చేస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If Kruskal's algorithm is applied to a graph that is already disconnected, what is the result? A) It creates a single cycle including all nodes B) It forms a minimum spanning forest C) The algorithm fails and returns an error D) It returns only the edges with the minimum possible weight globally ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a race condition in a logic gate potentially cause a permanent glitch in a digital system? A) Because the system is not using enough redundancy in its design. B) Because a temporary glitch can propagate if it acts as a clock signal for memory elements. C) Because the Boolean algebra of the gate is incorrect. D) Because logic gates are inherently unreliable and often fail. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Logic gate లోని race condition digital system లో శాశ్వత glitch ని ఎందుకు కలిగించవచ్చు? A) ఎందుకంటే system తన design లో తగినంత redundancy ని ఉపయోగించడం లేదు. B) ఎందుకంటే తాత్కాలిక glitch memory elements కి clock signal గా పనిచేస్తే అది propagate అవుతుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే gate యొక్క Boolean algebra తప్పు. D) ఎందుకంటే logic gates సహజంగానే నమ్మదగినవి కావు మరియు తరచుగా విఫలమవుతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a race condition in a logic gate potentially cause a permanent glitch in a digital system? A) Because the system is not using enough redundancy in its design. B) Because a temporary glitch can propagate if it acts as a clock signal for memory elements. C) Because the Boolean algebra of the gate is incorrect. D) Because logic gates are inherently unreliable and often fail. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: A rare disease affects 0.1% of a population. A test has a 99% true positive rate and a 2% false positive rate. If a person tests positive, why is the posterior probability of having the disease still relatively low? A) The true positive rate is insufficiently high to confirm rare diseases. B) The conditional probability of testing positive given the disease equals zero. C) The law of total probability cannot be applied to rare events. D) The small prior probability makes false positives vastly outnumber true positives. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక అరుదైన వ్యాధి జనాభాలో 0.1% మందిని ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది. ఒక test కి 99% true positive rate మరియు 2% false positive rate ఉన్నాయి. ఒక వ్యక్తికి positive వస్తే, వ్యాధి ఉండే posterior probability ఇంకా ఎందుకు సాపేక్షంగా తక్కువగా ఉంటుంది? A) అరుదైన వ్యాధులను నిర్ధారించడానికి true positive rate తగినంత ఎక్కువగా లేదు. B) వ్యాధి ఉన్నప్పుడు positive వచ్చే conditional probability సున్నాకు సమానం. C) అరుదైన events కి law of total probability ని apply చేయలేము. D) చిన్న prior probability వల్ల false positives సంఖ్య true positives కంటే చాలా ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: A rare disease affects 0.1% of a population. A test has a 99% true positive rate and a 2% false positive rate. If a person tests positive, why is the posterior probability of having the disease still relatively low? A) The true positive rate is insufficiently high to confirm rare diseases. B) The conditional probability of testing positive given the disease equals zero. C) The law of total probability cannot be applied to rare events. D) The small prior probability makes false positives vastly outnumber true positives. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why might a developer choose a non-convex boosting algorithm over a convex one like AdaBoost? A) To guarantee that the training error will always be exactly zero. B) To avoid the vulnerability of convex algorithms to random noise that can prevent learning basic hypotheses. C) To ensure the model is always trained on the entire dataset without any noise. D) To simplify the mathematical formulation of the optimization problem. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: AdaBoost వంటి convex boosting algorithm కంటే non-convex boosting algorithm ని developer ఎందుకు ఎంచుకోవచ్చు? A) Training error ఎల్లప్పుడూ కచ్చితంగా సున్నా అని హామీ ఇవ్వడానికి. B) ప్రాథమిక hypotheses ని నేర్చుకోకుండా అడ్డుకోగల random noise కి convex algorithms లోనయ్యే బలహీనతను తప్పించడానికి. C) Model ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఎలాంటి noise లేకుండా మొత్తం dataset పై train అయ్యేలా చూడటానికి. D) Optimization problem యొక్క mathematical formulation ని సరళీకరించడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why might a developer choose a non-convex boosting algorithm over a convex one like AdaBoost? A) To guarantee that the training error will always be exactly zero. B) To avoid the vulnerability of convex algorithms to random noise that can prevent learning basic hypotheses. C) To ensure the model is always trained on the entire dataset without any noise. D) To simplify the mathematical formulation of the optimization problem. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the carrier signal's characteristics during phase modulation when the message signal changes? A) The frequency and phase change while the amplitude remains constant. B) The amplitude and phase change while the frequency remains constant. C) The amplitude and frequency remain constant while the phase changes. D) Only the frequency of the carrier changes proportionally. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Phase modulation సమయంలో message signal మారినప్పుడు carrier signal లక్షణాలకు ఏమవుతుంది? A) Amplitude స్థిరంగా ఉండగా frequency మరియు phase మారతాయి. B) Frequency స్థిరంగా ఉండగా amplitude మరియు phase మారతాయి. C) Phase మారుతుండగా amplitude మరియు frequency స్థిరంగా ఉంటాయి. D) Carrier యొక్క frequency మాత్రమే అనుపాతంగా మారుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens to the carrier signal's characteristics during phase modulation when the message signal changes? A) The frequency and phase change while the amplitude remains constant. B) The amplitude and phase change while the frequency remains constant. C) The amplitude and frequency remain constant while the phase changes. D) Only the frequency of the carrier changes proportionally. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the total electric field calculated when multiple stationary point charges are present? A) By taking the vector sum of the fields from each individual charge B) By integrating the charge densities over all space C) By averaging the directions of the individual fields D) By multiplying the magnitudes of the individual fields ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: అనేక stationary point charges ఉన్నప్పుడు total electric field ఎలా లెక్కించబడుతుంది? A) ప్రతి ఒక్క charge నుండి వచ్చే fields యొక్క vector sum తీసుకోవడం ద్వారా B) అంతటా charge densities ని integrate చేయడం ద్వారా C) ఒక్కొక్క fields యొక్క దిశలను average చేయడం ద్వారా D) ఒక్కొక్క fields యొక్క magnitudes ని గుణించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How is the total electric field calculated when multiple stationary point charges are present? A) By taking the vector sum of the fields from each individual charge B) By integrating the charge densities over all space C) By averaging the directions of the individual fields D) By multiplying the magnitudes of the individual fields ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How are nodes in the search tree related to each other in a backtracking algorithm? A) Each node is a child of the root node only B) Each node is a parent of candidates that differ by a single extension step C) Nodes are connected by edges representing valid solutions D) Nodes are arranged in a breadth-first order ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Backtracking algorithm లో search tree లోని nodes ఒకదానితో ఒకటి ఎలా సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంటాయి? A) ప్రతి node కేవలం root node యొక్క child మాత్రమే B) ప్రతి node ఒకే extension step తో భిన్నమైన candidates కి parent C) Valid solutions ని సూచించే edges ద్వారా nodes కలపబడతాయి D) Nodes breadth-first order లో అమర్చబడతాయి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How are nodes in the search tree related to each other in a backtracking algorithm? A) Each node is a child of the root node only B) Each node is a parent of candidates that differ by a single extension step C) Nodes are connected by edges representing valid solutions D) Nodes are arranged in a breadth-first order ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the defining characteristic of an isotropic oscillator compared to an anisotropic one? A) The frequency changes based on the initial displacement. B) It only oscillates in a single dimension. C) The restoring force constant is the same in all directions. D) It has no restoring force. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Anisotropic oscillator తో పోలిస్తే isotropic oscillator యొక్క నిర్వచనాత్మక లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) ప్రారంభ displacement ఆధారంగా frequency మారుతుంది. B) అది ఒకే dimension లో మాత్రమే oscillate అవుతుంది. C) Restoring force constant అన్ని దిశలలో ఒకేలా ఉంటుంది. D) దానికి restoring force ఉండదు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the defining characteristic of an isotropic oscillator compared to an anisotropic one? A) The frequency changes based on the initial displacement. B) It only oscillates in a single dimension. C) The restoring force constant is the same in all directions. D) It has no restoring force. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of an SQL statement? A) Database యొక్క physical storage layout ని నిర్వచించడం B) Database data మరియు schemas ని retrieve, manipulate లేదా define చేయడం C) Database కి network connection ఏర్పాటు చేయడం D) Database management system software ని compile చేయడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of an SQL statement? A) To define the physical storage layout of a database B) To retrieve, manipulate, or define database data and schemas C) To establish a network connection to a database D) To compile the database management system software ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is NOT an elementary row operation used in Gaussian elimination? A) Adding a scalar multiple of one row to another row. B) Adding a non-zero scalar constant to every entry of a single row. C) Multiplying all entries of a row by a non-zero constant. D) Interchanging two rows of the matrix. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Gaussian elimination లో ఉపయోగించే elementary row operation కానిది ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) ఒక row యొక్క scalar multiple ని మరొక row కి కలపడం. B) ఒకే row లోని ప్రతి entry కి non-zero scalar constant ని కలపడం. C) ఒక row లోని అన్ని entries ని non-zero constant తో గుణించడం. D) Matrix లోని రెండు rows ని పరస్పరం మార్చడం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is NOT an elementary row operation used in Gaussian elimination? A) Adding a scalar multiple of one row to another row. B) Adding a non-zero scalar constant to every entry of a single row. C) Multiplying all entries of a row by a non-zero constant. D) Interchanging two rows of the matrix. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary trade-off of increasing the number of pipeline stages? A) Increases latency and may increase throughput B) Decreases latency and decreases throughput C) Increases latency but decreases throughput D) Decreases latency and increases throughput ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Pipeline stages సంఖ్యను పెంచడంలో ప్రధాన trade-off ఏమిటి? A) Latency పెరుగుతుంది మరియు throughput పెరగవచ్చు B) Latency తగ్గుతుంది మరియు throughput తగ్గుతుంది C) Latency పెరుగుతుంది కానీ throughput తగ్గుతుంది D) Latency తగ్గుతుంది మరియు throughput పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary trade-off of increasing the number of pipeline stages? A) Increases latency and may increase throughput B) Decreases latency and decreases throughput C) Increases latency but decreases throughput D) Decreases latency and increases throughput ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an applied external electric field decrease in magnitude inside a dielectric medium? A) Conduction electrons rapidly absorb and neutralize the incident field energy B) Free electrons migrate to the boundaries, shorting out the potential difference C) The relative permittivity of the material drops to zero under field exposure D) Displaced charges create an internal electric field that opposes the external field ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Dielectric medium లోపల ప్రయోగించిన external electric field magnitude ఎందుకు తగ్గుతుంది? A) Conduction electrons వచ్చే field energy ని వేగంగా absorb చేసి neutralize చేస్తాయి B) Free electrons సరిహద్దులకు వలస వెళ్ళి potential difference ని short చేస్తాయి C) Field కి గురైనప్పుడు material యొక్క relative permittivity సున్నాకు పడిపోతుంది D) స్థానభ్రంశం చెందిన charges external field ని వ్యతిరేకించే internal electric field ని సృష్టిస్తాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does an applied external electric field decrease in magnitude inside a dielectric medium? A) Conduction electrons rapidly absorb and neutralize the incident field energy B) Free electrons migrate to the boundaries, shorting out the potential difference C) The relative permittivity of the material drops to zero under field exposure D) Displaced charges create an internal electric field that opposes the external field ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key benefit of using iterative deepening with alpha-beta pruning? A) It provides move-ordering hints from shallower searches for deeper ones. B) It eliminates the need for heuristic evaluation functions. C) It guarantees finding the optimal move in fewer nodes. D) It reduces the space complexity of the search. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Alpha-beta pruning తో iterative deepening ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ముఖ్య ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) తక్కువ లోతు searches నుండి లోతైన searches కి move-ordering సూచనలను అది అందిస్తుంది. B) అది heuristic evaluation functions అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. C) తక్కువ nodes లో optimal move ని కనుగొంటుందని అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. D) అది search యొక్క space complexity ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is a key benefit of using iterative deepening with alpha-beta pruning? A) It provides move-ordering hints from shallower searches for deeper ones. B) It eliminates the need for heuristic evaluation functions. C) It guarantees finding the optimal move in fewer nodes. D) It reduces the space complexity of the search. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Under which condition does Cramer's rule fail to provide a unique solution for a linear system Ax = b? A) When the determinant of matrix A equals zero B) When the matrix A is symmetric C) When the vector b consists entirely of non-zero numbers D) When the number of equations equals the number of unknowns ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ పరిస్థితిలో linear system Ax = b కి Cramer's rule unique solution ఇవ్వడంలో విఫలమవుతుంది? A) Matrix A యొక్క determinant సున్నాకు సమానమైనప్పుడు B) Matrix A symmetric అయినప్పుడు C) Vector b పూర్తిగా non-zero సంఖ్యలతో ఉన్నప్పుడు D) Equations సంఖ్య unknowns సంఖ్యకు సమానమైనప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Under which condition does Cramer's rule fail to provide a unique solution for a linear system Ax = b? A) When the determinant of matrix A equals zero B) When the matrix A is symmetric C) When the vector b consists entirely of non-zero numbers D) When the number of equations equals the number of unknowns ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key property of a perfect binary tree regarding its levels? A) Only interior nodes have children B) All levels are completely filled C) Levels are filled from right to left D) Only the last level is completely filled ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Levels విషయంలో perfect binary tree యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Interior nodes కి మాత్రమే children ఉంటారు B) అన్ని levels పూర్తిగా నిండి ఉంటాయి C) Levels కుడి నుండి ఎడమకు నింపబడతాయి D) చివరి level మాత్రమే పూర్తిగా నిండి ఉంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a key property of a perfect binary tree regarding its levels? A) Only interior nodes have children B) All levels are completely filled C) Levels are filled from right to left D) Only the last level is completely filled ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the relationship of classes in inheritance often described as a directed acyclic graph (DAG)? A) Because classes can inherit from multiple sources creating cycles B) Because it represents a single, linear line of development C) Because subclasses cannot inherit from their own descendants, preventing infinite loops D) Because it is required to optimize dynamic dispatch tables ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Inheritance లో classes సంబంధాన్ని తరచుగా directed acyclic graph (DAG) గా ఎందుకు వివరిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే classes అనేక sources నుండి inherit చేసుకుని cycles ని సృష్టించగలవు B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒకే, linear అభివృద్ధి రేఖను సూచిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే subclasses తమ స్వంత descendants నుండి inherit చేసుకోలేవు, దీనివల్ల infinite loops నివారించబడతాయి D) ఎందుకంటే dynamic dispatch tables ని optimize చేయడానికి అది అవసరం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the relationship of classes in inheritance often described as a directed acyclic graph (DAG)? A) Because classes can inherit from multiple sources creating cycles B) Because it represents a single, linear line of development C) Because subclasses cannot inherit from their own descendants, preventing infinite loops D) Because it is required to optimize dynamic dispatch tables ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: When is a glue record necessary in the DNS? A) When the parent domain server cannot find the IP address of the child domain's name server. B) When a TLD server needs to define a new root server. C) When a user wants to cache the IP address of a website for faster browsing. D) When the authoritative name server for a subdomain is itself located within that subdomain. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: DNS లో glue record ఎప్పుడు అవసరం? A) Parent domain server, child domain యొక్క name server IP address ని కనుగొనలేనప్పుడు. B) TLD server ఒక కొత్త root server ని నిర్వచించాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు. C) వేగవంతమైన browsing కోసం user ఒక website యొక్క IP address ని cache చేయాలనుకున్నప్పుడు. D) ఒక subdomain కి authoritative name server స్వయంగా ఆ subdomain లోనే ఉన్నప్పుడు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: When is a glue record necessary in the DNS? A) When the parent domain server cannot find the IP address of the child domain's name server. B) When a TLD server needs to define a new root server. C) When a user wants to cache the IP address of a website for faster browsing. D) When the authoritative name server for a subdomain is itself located within that subdomain. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a negative feedback voltage regulator, what is the effect of increasing the open-loop gain? A) It decreases the regulation accuracy. B) It converts DC voltage to AC voltage. C) It increases the regulation accuracy but may reduce stability. D) It eliminates the need for a reference voltage. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Negative feedback voltage regulator లో open-loop gain ని పెంచడం వల్ల ప్రభావం ఏమిటి? A) అది regulation accuracy ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. B) అది DC voltage ని AC voltage గా మారుస్తుంది. C) అది regulation accuracy ని పెంచుతుంది కానీ stability ని తగ్గించవచ్చు. D) అది reference voltage అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In a negative feedback voltage regulator, what is the effect of increasing the open-loop gain? A) It decreases the regulation accuracy. B) It converts DC voltage to AC voltage. C) It increases the regulation accuracy but may reduce stability. D) It eliminates the need for a reference voltage. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If the width of a rectangular potential barrier is doubled, what happens to the transmission probability for an incident electron? A) It drops by exactly a factor of four B) It remains unaffected if the barrier height is constant C) It decreases linearly by half D) It decreases exponentially ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Rectangular potential barrier యొక్క width రెట్టింపు చేస్తే, వచ్చే electron యొక్క transmission probability కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది కచ్చితంగా నాలుగు రెట్లు తగ్గుతుంది B) Barrier height స్థిరంగా ఉంటే అది ప్రభావితం కాదు C) అది linear గా సగానికి తగ్గుతుంది D) అది exponential గా తగ్గుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: If the width of a rectangular potential barrier is doubled, what happens to the transmission probability for an incident electron? A) It drops by exactly a factor of four B) It remains unaffected if the barrier height is constant C) It decreases linearly by half D) It decreases exponentially ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the superposition principle necessary to derive Gauss's law from Coulomb's law? A) Because it allows the total field from a distributed charge to be the sum of individual fields. B) Because Gauss's law requires knowledge of the curl of the electric field. C) Because it ensures the electric field is spherically symmetric. D) Because Coulomb's law only gives the field from a single point charge. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Coulomb's law నుండి Gauss's law ని derive చేయడానికి superposition principle ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఎందుకంటే distributed charge నుండి వచ్చే total field ఒక్కొక్క fields యొక్క మొత్తంగా ఉండటానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే Gauss's law కి electric field యొక్క curl గురించిన జ్ఞానం అవసరం. C) ఎందుకంటే electric field spherically symmetric గా ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే Coulomb's law ఒకే point charge నుండి వచ్చే field ని మాత్రమే ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the superposition principle necessary to derive Gauss's law from Coulomb's law? A) Because it allows the total field from a distributed charge to be the sum of individual fields. B) Because Gauss's law requires knowledge of the curl of the electric field. C) Because it ensures the electric field is spherically symmetric. D) Because Coulomb's law only gives the field from a single point charge. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of regular expression syntax, what distinguishes a literal character from a metacharacter? A) Literal characters are defined by the POSIX standard, while metacharacters are proprietary. B) Literal characters have no special meaning and match themselves, while metacharacters trigger special matching logic. C) Literal characters are used for replacement, and metacharacters are used for searching. D) Metacharacters are only used in basic syntax, while literals are used in extended syntax. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Regular expression syntax సందర్భంలో literal character ని metacharacter నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Literal characters POSIX standard ద్వారా నిర్వచించబడతాయి, metacharacters proprietary. B) Literal characters కి ప్రత్యేక అర్థం లేదు మరియు తమను తామే match చేస్తాయి, metacharacters ప్రత్యేక matching logic ని ప్రేరేపిస్తాయి. C) Literal characters replacement కి ఉపయోగించబడతాయి, metacharacters searching కి ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. D) Metacharacters basic syntax లో మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడతాయి, literals extended syntax లో ఉపయోగించబడతాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of regular expression syntax, what distinguishes a literal character from a metacharacter? A) Literal characters are defined by the POSIX standard, while metacharacters are proprietary. B) Literal characters have no special meaning and match themselves, while metacharacters trigger special matching logic. C) Literal characters are used for replacement, and metacharacters are used for searching. D) Metacharacters are only used in basic syntax, while literals are used in extended syntax. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is thermal noise approximated as additive white Gaussian noise in communication models? A) Because it is generated exclusively by vacuum tubes B) Because it can be completely eliminated with shielding C) Because it only affects analog signals and not digital ones D) Because its power is equal across all frequencies and its amplitude follows a Gaussian distribution ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Communication models లో thermal noise ని additive white Gaussian noise గా ఎందుకు approximate చేస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది కేవలం vacuum tubes ద్వారా మాత్రమే generate అవుతుంది B) ఎందుకంటే shielding తో దాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగించవచ్చు C) ఎందుకంటే అది analog signals ని మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది, digital వాటిని కాదు D) ఎందుకంటే దాని power అన్ని frequencies లో సమానంగా ఉంటుంది మరియు దాని amplitude Gaussian distribution ని అనుసరిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is thermal noise approximated as additive white Gaussian noise in communication models? A) Because it is generated exclusively by vacuum tubes B) Because it can be completely eliminated with shielding C) Because it only affects analog signals and not digital ones D) Because its power is equal across all frequencies and its amplitude follows a Gaussian distribution ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary factor that determines the computational complexity of Kruskal's algorithm in a standard implementation? A) The number of vertices in the graph B) The time required to sort all graph edges by weight C) The time taken to perform breadth-first search D) The number of recursive calls made by the union operation ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard implementation లో Kruskal's algorithm యొక్క computational complexity ని నిర్ణయించే ప్రధాన అంశం ఏమిటి? A) Graph లోని vertices సంఖ్య B) అన్ని graph edges ని weight ప్రకారం sort చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం C) Breadth-first search చేయడానికి పట్టే సమయం D) Union operation చేసే recursive calls సంఖ్య జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary factor that determines the computational complexity of Kruskal's algorithm in a standard implementation? A) The number of vertices in the graph B) The time required to sort all graph edges by weight C) The time taken to perform breadth-first search D) The number of recursive calls made by the union operation ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are the internal layers of an MLP referred to as 'hidden'? A) They are located between the input and output layers. B) They only use linear activation functions. C) They are not used during the forward pass. D) Their values are not directly observed in the training data, unlike inputs and outputs. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: MLP లోని internal layers ని 'hidden' అని ఎందుకు అంటారు? A) అవి input మరియు output layers మధ్య ఉంటాయి. B) అవి linear activation functions ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగిస్తాయి. C) Forward pass సమయంలో అవి ఉపయోగించబడవు. D) Inputs మరియు outputs లా కాకుండా, వాటి values training data లో నేరుగా కనిపించవు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why are the internal layers of an MLP referred to as 'hidden'? A) They are located between the input and output layers. B) They only use linear activation functions. C) They are not used during the forward pass. D) Their values are not directly observed in the training data, unlike inputs and outputs. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the Gale-Shapley algorithm not considered a greedy algorithm according to the article? A) It does not provide an approximate solution. B) It modifies existing solutions, undoing past choices. C) It does not use locally optimal choices at each step. D) It is not used for combinatorial optimization problems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Article ప్రకారం Gale-Shapley algorithm ని greedy algorithm గా ఎందుకు పరిగణించరు? A) అది approximate solution ని అందించదు. B) అది ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న solutions ని modify చేస్తుంది, గత ఎంపికలను రద్దు చేస్తుంది. C) అది ప్రతి step లో locally optimal choices ని ఉపయోగించదు. D) అది combinatorial optimization problems కి ఉపయోగించబడదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the Gale-Shapley algorithm not considered a greedy algorithm according to the article? A) It does not provide an approximate solution. B) It modifies existing solutions, undoing past choices. C) It does not use locally optimal choices at each step. D) It is not used for combinatorial optimization problems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What characterizes a BJT compared to a unipolar transistor like a FET? A) It uses only electrons as charge carriers B) It uses both electrons and holes as charge carriers C) It operates only in a single p-type region D) It does not require doping ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: FET వంటి unipolar transistor తో పోలిస్తే BJT ని ఏది వర్ణిస్తుంది? A) అది charge carriers గా electrons ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగిస్తుంది B) అది charge carriers గా electrons మరియు holes రెండింటినీ ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) అది ఒకే p-type region లో మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది D) దానికి doping అవసరం లేదు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What characterizes a BJT compared to a unipolar transistor like a FET? A) It uses only electrons as charge carriers B) It uses both electrons and holes as charge carriers C) It operates only in a single p-type region D) It does not require doping ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: If a material has a tensile strength of 800 MPa and a shear-to-tensile factor of 0.6, how is the shear strength generally approximated? A) By dividing the tensile strength by 0.6. B) By multiplying the tensile strength by the factor 0.6. C) By adding 0.6 to the tensile strength. D) It is unrelated to the tensile strength. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక material కి 800 MPa tensile strength మరియు 0.6 shear-to-tensile factor ఉంటే, shear strength సాధారణంగా ఎలా approximate చేయబడుతుంది? A) Tensile strength ని 0.6 తో భాగించడం ద్వారా. B) Tensile strength ని 0.6 factor తో గుణించడం ద్వారా. C) Tensile strength కి 0.6 కలపడం ద్వారా. D) దానికి tensile strength తో సంబంధం లేదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a material has a tensile strength of 800 MPa and a shear-to-tensile factor of 0.6, how is the shear strength generally approximated? A) By dividing the tensile strength by 0.6. B) By multiplying the tensile strength by the factor 0.6. C) By adding 0.6 to the tensile strength. D) It is unrelated to the tensile strength. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: For a function f(z) = u(x, y) + i v(x, y) to be complex differentiable at a point, which pair of Cauchy–Riemann equations must be satisfied?
