A) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂x and ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂y B) ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y = 0 and ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x = 0 C) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = -∂v/∂x D) ∂u/∂x = -∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂x ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Function f(z) = u(x, y) + i v(x, y) ఒక బిందువు వద్ద complex differentiable కావాలంటే, ఏ Cauchy–Riemann equations జత satisfy కావాలి? A) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂x మరియు ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂y B) ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y = 0 మరియు ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x = 0 C) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂y మరియు ∂u/∂y = -∂v/∂x D) ∂u/∂x = -∂v/∂y మరియు ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂x జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: For a function f(z) = u(x, y) + i v(x, y) to be complex differentiable at a point, which pair of Cauchy–Riemann equations must be satisfied? A) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂x and ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂y B) ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y = 0 and ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x = 0 C) ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = -∂v/∂x D) ∂u/∂x = -∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = ∂v/∂x ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is timely certificate revocation critical for security? A) It prevents unauthorized access to the CA's private key B) It encrypts the certificate's public key automatically C) It ensures new certificates are issued faster D) It limits the window an attacker can exploit a compromised certificate ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Security కి సకాలంలో certificate revocation ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) CA యొక్క private key కి అనధికార access ని అది నివారిస్తుంది B) అది certificate యొక్క public key ని automatic గా encrypt చేస్తుంది C) కొత్త certificates వేగంగా జారీ అయ్యేలా అది చూస్తుంది D) Compromise అయిన certificate ని attacker దుర్వినియోగం చేయగల సమయాన్ని అది పరిమితం చేస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is timely certificate revocation critical for security? A) It prevents unauthorized access to the CA's private key B) It encrypts the certificate's public key automatically C) It ensures new certificates are issued faster D) It limits the window an attacker can exploit a compromised certificate ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Big O notation used in computer science when analyzing algorithms? A) To determine the specific hardware requirements for running an algorithm. B) To describe how the run time or space requirements grow as input size increases. C) To calculate the exact number of CPU cycles an algorithm requires. D) To convert an algorithm into a power series approximation. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Algorithms ని analyze చేసేటప్పుడు computer science లో Big O notation ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) ఒక algorithm ని run చేయడానికి అవసరమైన నిర్దిష్ట hardware requirements ని నిర్ణయించడానికి. B) Input size పెరిగేకొద్దీ run time లేదా space requirements ఎలా పెరుగుతాయో వివరించడానికి. C) ఒక algorithm కి అవసరమైన కచ్చితమైన CPU cycles సంఖ్యను లెక్కించడానికి. D) ఒక algorithm ని power series approximation గా మార్చడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Big O notation used in computer science when analyzing algorithms? A) To determine the specific hardware requirements for running an algorithm. B) To describe how the run time or space requirements grow as input size increases. C) To calculate the exact number of CPU cycles an algorithm requires. D) To convert an algorithm into a power series approximation. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the concept of a 'left child' necessary in a binary tree? A) To represent leaf nodes B) To count total nodes C) To define the tree's height D) To distinguish between two children of a parent ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Binary tree లో 'left child' అనే భావన ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) Leaf nodes ని సూచించడానికి B) మొత్తం nodes ని లెక్కించడానికి C) Tree యొక్క height ని నిర్వచించడానికి D) ఒక parent యొక్క ఇద్దరు children మధ్య తేడాను గుర్తించడానికి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the concept of a 'left child' necessary in a binary tree? A) To represent leaf nodes B) To count total nodes C) To define the tree's height D) To distinguish between two children of a parent ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When two length-N sequences are multiplied point-by-point in the discrete frequency domain, what happens in the time domain? A) Their non-periodic linear convolution of length 2N-1 is computed directly. B) Their cross-correlation without any periodic boundary wrap-around is obtained. C) Their N-point circular convolution is computed. D) Their direct sum is generated without aliasing. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Discrete frequency domain లో రెండు length-N sequences ని point-by-point గా గుణిస్తే, time domain లో ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? A) వాటి length 2N-1 ఉన్న non-periodic linear convolution నేరుగా లెక్కించబడుతుంది. B) ఎలాంటి periodic boundary wrap-around లేకుండా వాటి cross-correlation లభిస్తుంది. C) వాటి N-point circular convolution లెక్కించబడుతుంది. D) Aliasing లేకుండా వాటి direct sum generate అవుతుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: When two length-N sequences are multiplied point-by-point in the discrete frequency domain, what happens in the time domain? A) Their non-periodic linear convolution of length 2N-1 is computed directly. B) Their cross-correlation without any periodic boundary wrap-around is obtained. C) Their N-point circular convolution is computed. D) Their direct sum is generated without aliasing. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary application of scalability in image compression schemes? A) To prevent any loss of image data. B) To enable previewing images while downloading them. C) To convert images to grayscale only. D) To ensure all images are stored at maximum resolution. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Image compression schemes లో scalability యొక్క ప్రధాన application ఏమిటి? A) Image data ఏ మాత్రం కోల్పోకుండా నివారించడం. B) Images ని download చేస్తున్నప్పుడే preview చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం. C) Images ని grayscale కి మాత్రమే మార్చడం. D) అన్ని images maximum resolution లో store చేయబడేలా చూడటం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is a primary application of scalability in image compression schemes? A) To prevent any loss of image data. B) To enable previewing images while downloading them. C) To convert images to grayscale only. D) To ensure all images are stored at maximum resolution. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to a process when it executes a P operation on a semaphore with a value of zero? A) It is blocked and added to the semaphore's queue B) It is terminated by the scheduler C) It crashes the entire operating system D) It immediately increments the semaphore and continues execution ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Value సున్నా ఉన్న semaphore పై ఒక process P operation ని execute చేసినప్పుడు దానికి ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది block చేయబడి semaphore యొక్క queue కి చేర్చబడుతుంది B) Scheduler దాన్ని terminate చేస్తుంది C) అది మొత్తం operating system ని crash చేస్తుంది D) అది వెంటనే semaphore ని increment చేసి execution కొనసాగిస్తుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to a process when it executes a P operation on a semaphore with a value of zero? A) It is blocked and added to the semaphore's queue B) It is terminated by the scheduler C) It crashes the entire operating system D) It immediately increments the semaphore and continues execution ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: When electrons pass through a double slit one at a time over a long duration, what is observed on the detector screen? A) Only two sharp lines directly aligned behind the two slits are formed. B) A uniformly smeared background with no observable structure. C) Individual localized hits gradually accumulate into a wave interference pattern. D) A single concentrated central maximum with no alternating dark fringes. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఎక్కువ కాలం పాటు electrons ఒక్కొక్కటిగా double slit గుండా వెళ్ళినప్పుడు, detector screen పై ఏమి కనిపిస్తుంది? A) రెండు slits వెనుక నేరుగా రెండు పదునైన గీతలు మాత్రమే ఏర్పడతాయి. B) ఎలాంటి గమనించదగిన structure లేని ఒకే విధంగా పరచుకున్న background. C) ఒక్కొక్క localized hits క్రమంగా పేరుకుపోయి wave interference pattern గా ఏర్పడతాయి. D) ఒకదాని తర్వాత ఒకటి వచ్చే dark fringes లేని ఒకే కేంద్రీకృత central maximum. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: When electrons pass through a double slit one at a time over a long duration, what is observed on the detector screen? A) Only two sharp lines directly aligned behind the two slits are formed. B) A uniformly smeared background with no observable structure. C) Individual localized hits gradually accumulate into a wave interference pattern. D) A single concentrated central maximum with no alternating dark fringes. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Dijkstra's algorithm guaranteed to find the shortest path in graphs with non-negative edge weights? A) Because it only considers direct connections between nodes B) Because it uses a priority queue to always expand the node with the smallest known distance C) Because it explores all possible paths exhaustively D) Because it randomly selects nodes to visit ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Non-negative edge weights ఉన్న graphs లో Dijkstra's algorithm shortest path ని కనుగొంటుందని ఎందుకు హామీ ఉంది? A) ఎందుకంటే అది nodes మధ్య ప్రత్యక్ష connections ని మాత్రమే పరిగణిస్తుంది B) ఎందుకంటే అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ తెలిసిన అతి చిన్న distance ఉన్న node ని expand చేయడానికి priority queue ఉపయోగిస్తుంది C) ఎందుకంటే అది అన్ని సాధ్యమైన paths ని సమగ్రంగా అన్వేషిస్తుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అది visit చేయాల్సిన nodes ని random గా ఎంచుకుంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is Dijkstra's algorithm guaranteed to find the shortest path in graphs with non-negative edge weights? A) Because it only considers direct connections between nodes B) Because it uses a priority queue to always expand the node with the smallest known distance C) Because it explores all possible paths exhaustively D) Because it randomly selects nodes to visit ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the rank of the controllability matrix critical in assessing an LTI system? A) It must equal the number of states for the system to be controllable. B) It determines the number of control inputs required. C) It indicates the system's stability margin. D) It calculates the state-transition matrix. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: LTI system ని అంచనా వేయడంలో controllability matrix యొక్క rank ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) System controllable కావాలంటే అది states సంఖ్యకు సమానంగా ఉండాలి. B) అవసరమైన control inputs సంఖ్యను అది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది. C) అది system యొక్క stability margin ని సూచిస్తుంది. D) అది state-transition matrix ని లెక్కిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the rank of the controllability matrix critical in assessing an LTI system? A) It must equal the number of states for the system to be controllable. B) It determines the number of control inputs required. C) It indicates the system's stability margin. D) It calculates the state-transition matrix. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the expected value of rolling a fair six-sided die equal to 3.5 even though 3.5 cannot be rolled? A) The probabilities of the individual faces shift toward the median value during trials B) It accounts for variance and higher statistical moments inherent to fair dice C) Discrete random variables round upward to the nearest half-integer D) It represents the long-run average outcome rather than an achievable individual event ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: 3.5 అనేది dice పై రాదు అయినప్పటికీ, ఒక fair six-sided die ని వేసినప్పుడు expected value 3.5 కి ఎందుకు సమానం? A) Trials సమయంలో ఒక్కొక్క face యొక్క probabilities median value వైపు మారతాయి B) Fair dice కి సహజమైన variance మరియు higher statistical moments ని అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకుంటుంది C) Discrete random variables సమీప half-integer కి పైకి round అవుతాయి D) అది సాధించగల ఒక్క event ని కాకుండా దీర్ఘకాల సగటు ఫలితాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the expected value of rolling a fair six-sided die equal to 3.5 even though 3.5 cannot be rolled? A) The probabilities of the individual faces shift toward the median value during trials B) It accounts for variance and higher statistical moments inherent to fair dice C) Discrete random variables round upward to the nearest half-integer D) It represents the long-run average outcome rather than an achievable individual event ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In the architecture of a PLA, what is the primary functional purpose of the AND gate planes? A) To sum the outputs of the OR gates B) To provide fixed memory storage C) To generate individual product terms D) To invert the input signals ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: PLA architecture లో AND gate planes యొక్క ప్రధాన functional ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) OR gates యొక్క outputs ని కలపడం B) Fixed memory storage ని అందించడం C) ఒక్కొక్క product terms ని generate చేయడం D) Input signals ని invert చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In the architecture of a PLA, what is the primary functional purpose of the AND gate planes? A) To sum the outputs of the OR gates B) To provide fixed memory storage C) To generate individual product terms D) To invert the input signals ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do object-oriented design patterns typically differ from functional programming paradigms? A) They cannot be used with immutable data structures. B) They focus on class relationships rather than functions. C) They are unsuited for functional languages because they imply mutable state. D) They are simpler to implement in functional languages. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Object-oriented design patterns సాధారణంగా functional programming paradigms నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటాయి? A) వాటిని immutable data structures తో ఉపయోగించలేము. B) అవి functions కంటే class సంబంధాలపై దృష్టి పెడతాయి. C) అవి mutable state ని సూచిస్తాయి కాబట్టి functional languages కి సరిపోవు. D) Functional languages లో వాటిని implement చేయడం సులభం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How do object-oriented design patterns typically differ from functional programming paradigms? A) They cannot be used with immutable data structures. B) They focus on class relationships rather than functions. C) They are unsuited for functional languages because they imply mutable state. D) They are simpler to implement in functional languages. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is PWA considered a prevalent approach for cuffless blood pressure estimation using wrist-based PPG signals? A) It uses pulse transit time which is difficult to measure on the wrist B) It relies on the DC component of the PPG signal C) It requires two devices to measure parameters at a certain distance apart D) It extracts features from the PPG waveform and uses machine learning ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Wrist-based PPG signals ఉపయోగించి cuffless blood pressure estimation కి PWA ని ఎందుకు ప్రబలమైన విధానంగా పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది wrist పై కొలవడం కష్టమైన pulse transit time ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది B) అది PPG signal యొక్క DC component పై ఆధారపడుతుంది C) కొంత దూరంలో parameters ని కొలవడానికి దానికి రెండు devices అవసరం D) అది PPG waveform నుండి features ని extract చేసి machine learning ఉపయోగిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is PWA considered a prevalent approach for cuffless blood pressure estimation using wrist-based PPG signals? A) It uses pulse transit time which is difficult to measure on the wrist B) It relies on the DC component of the PPG signal C) It requires two devices to measure parameters at a certain distance apart D) It extracts features from the PPG waveform and uses machine learning ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary technical requirement for a set of attributes to qualify as a primary key? A) It must be an auto-incrementing integer B) It must be defined as a string data type C) It must be comprised of multiple columns D) It must uniquely identify every single tuple in the relation ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Attributes set ఒక primary key గా అర్హత పొందడానికి ప్రధాన technical requirement ఏమిటి? A) అది auto-incrementing integer అయి ఉండాలి B) అది string data type గా నిర్వచించబడాలి C) అది అనేక columns తో కూడి ఉండాలి D) అది relation లోని ప్రతి ఒక్క tuple ని ప్రత్యేకంగా గుర్తించాలి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary technical requirement for a set of attributes to qualify as a primary key? A) It must be an auto-incrementing integer B) It must be defined as a string data type C) It must be comprised of multiple columns D) It must uniquely identify every single tuple in the relation ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: According to Babinet's principle, how does the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern of a thin wire compare to that of a slit of the same width? A) The wire produces no diffraction pattern at all B) The intensity distributions outside the direct beam are identical C) The slit produces twice as many diffraction fringes D) The wire produces completely inverted intensity peaks ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Babinet's principle ప్రకారం, ఒక సన్నని wire యొక్క Fraunhofer diffraction pattern అదే width ఉన్న slit దానితో ఎలా పోలుస్తుంది? A) Wire అసలు ఏ diffraction pattern నూ ఉత్పత్తి చేయదు B) Direct beam బయట intensity distributions ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి C) Slit రెట్టింపు diffraction fringes ని ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది D) Wire పూర్తిగా తలక్రిందులైన intensity peaks ని ఉత్పత్తి చేస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to Babinet's principle, how does the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern of a thin wire compare to that of a slit of the same width? A) The wire produces no diffraction pattern at all B) The intensity distributions outside the direct beam are identical C) The slit produces twice as many diffraction fringes D) The wire produces completely inverted intensity peaks ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does Richardson extrapolation improve the precision of a composite integration rule? A) By projecting the integrand into a multi-dimensional cubature domain B) By combining approximations from different grid step sizes to cancel dominant error terms C) By replacing polynomial interpolants with trigonometric basis functions D) By evaluating the function solely at the midpoint of the interval ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Richardson extrapolation composite integration rule యొక్క precision ని ఎలా మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది? A) Integrand ని multi-dimensional cubature domain లోకి project చేయడం ద్వారా B) ప్రధాన error terms ని రద్దు చేయడానికి వేర్వేరు grid step sizes నుండి వచ్చిన approximations ని కలపడం ద్వారా C) Polynomial interpolants ని trigonometric basis functions తో భర్తీ చేయడం ద్వారా D) Interval యొక్క midpoint వద్ద మాత్రమే function ని evaluate చేయడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does Richardson extrapolation improve the precision of a composite integration rule? A) By projecting the integrand into a multi-dimensional cubature domain B) By combining approximations from different grid step sizes to cancel dominant error terms C) By replacing polynomial interpolants with trigonometric basis functions D) By evaluating the function solely at the midpoint of the interval ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the DC power-flow model used instead of the AC power-flow model for large networks? A) It is required for transient stability studies. B) It includes detailed reactive power and voltage magnitude analysis. C) It provides higher accuracy for radial distribution networks. D) It linearizes the equations to reduce computational complexity. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: పెద్ద networks కోసం AC power-flow model కి బదులు DC power-flow model ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు? A) Transient stability studies కి అది అవసరం. B) అది వివరణాత్మక reactive power మరియు voltage magnitude analysis ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది. C) Radial distribution networks కి అది ఎక్కువ accuracy ని అందిస్తుంది. D) Computational complexity ని తగ్గించడానికి అది equations ని linearize చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the DC power-flow model used instead of the AC power-flow model for large networks? A) It is required for transient stability studies. B) It includes detailed reactive power and voltage magnitude analysis. C) It provides higher accuracy for radial distribution networks. D) It linearizes the equations to reduce computational complexity. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Jacobian matrix in the Newton-Raphson power-flow solution? A) To store the voltage magnitude and angle variables. B) To define the stopping condition for convergence. C) To directly calculate the system total losses. D) To linearize the nonlinear power-balance equations at each iteration. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Newton-Raphson power-flow solution లో Jacobian matrix యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Voltage magnitude మరియు angle variables ని store చేయడం. B) Convergence కోసం stopping condition ని నిర్వచించడం. C) System మొత్తం losses ని నేరుగా లెక్కించడం. D) ప్రతి iteration లో nonlinear power-balance equations ని linearize చేయడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Jacobian matrix in the Newton-Raphson power-flow solution? A) To store the voltage magnitude and angle variables. B) To define the stopping condition for convergence. C) To directly calculate the system total losses. D) To linearize the nonlinear power-balance equations at each iteration. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the main advantage of using a state-space representation for system analysis? A) It cannot represent nonlinear dynamics. B) It only works for SISO systems. C) It simplifies the analysis of complex, multi-variable systems. D) It replaces all differential equations with algebraic equations. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: System analysis కోసం state-space representation ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) అది nonlinear dynamics ని సూచించలేదు. B) అది SISO systems కి మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తుంది. C) అది సంక్లిష్టమైన, multi-variable systems యొక్క analysis ని సరళీకరిస్తుంది. D) అది అన్ని differential equations ని algebraic equations తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the main advantage of using a state-space representation for system analysis? A) It cannot represent nonlinear dynamics. B) It only works for SISO systems. C) It simplifies the analysis of complex, multi-variable systems. D) It replaces all differential equations with algebraic equations. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In a synchronous sequential circuit, when does a flip-flop typically update its output? A) At random intervals B) Only when the propagation delay reaches zero C) Immediately upon any input change D) Only when triggered by a clock pulse ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Synchronous sequential circuit లో flip-flop సాధారణంగా తన output ని ఎప్పుడు update చేస్తుంది? A) Random వ్యవధులలో B) Propagation delay సున్నాకు చేరినప్పుడు మాత్రమే C) ఏదైనా input మారిన వెంటనే D) Clock pulse ద్వారా trigger చేయబడినప్పుడు మాత్రమే జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In a synchronous sequential circuit, when does a flip-flop typically update its output? A) At random intervals B) Only when the propagation delay reaches zero C) Immediately upon any input change D) Only when triggered by a clock pulse ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary motivation for using an 'integer DCT' in modern video standards like HEVC? A) To increase the bit-depth of the original image beyond 16 bits. B) To ensure identical results across different hardware architectures by avoiding rounding errors. C) To automatically double the compression ratio compared to the standard DCT. D) To allow for floating-point arithmetic to be processed at infinite precision. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: HEVC వంటి ఆధునిక video standards లో 'integer DCT' ఉపయోగించడానికి ప్రధాన ప్రేరణ ఏమిటి? A) అసలు image యొక్క bit-depth ని 16 bits కంటే ఎక్కువకు పెంచడానికి. B) Rounding errors ని తప్పించడం ద్వారా వేర్వేరు hardware architectures లో ఒకే ఫలితాలు వచ్చేలా చూడటానికి. C) Standard DCT తో పోలిస్తే compression ratio ని automatic గా రెట్టింపు చేయడానికి. D) Floating-point arithmetic ని infinite precision తో process చేయడానికి అనుమతించడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary motivation for using an 'integer DCT' in modern video standards like HEVC? A) To increase the bit-depth of the original image beyond 16 bits. B) To ensure identical results across different hardware architectures by avoiding rounding errors. C) To automatically double the compression ratio compared to the standard DCT. D) To allow for floating-point arithmetic to be processed at infinite precision. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of silicon-gate MOS technology over earlier metal-gate MOS? A) It allows for the integration of analog components on the same chip. B) It completely eliminates the need for an insulating oxide layer in the transistor structure. C) It enables higher transistor density and better reliability by using a silicon gate electrode. D) It reduces the word size of the processor to improve power efficiency. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: పాత metal-gate MOS కంటే silicon-gate MOS technology యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) ఒకే chip పై analog components ని integrate చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. B) Transistor structure లో insulating oxide layer అవసరాన్ని అది పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. C) Silicon gate electrode ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా అది ఎక్కువ transistor density మరియు మెరుగైన reliability ని సాధ్యం చేస్తుంది. D) Power efficiency మెరుగుపరచడానికి అది processor యొక్క word size ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of silicon-gate MOS technology over earlier metal-gate MOS? A) It allows for the integration of analog components on the same chip. B) It completely eliminates the need for an insulating oxide layer in the transistor structure. C) It enables higher transistor density and better reliability by using a silicon gate electrode. D) It reduces the word size of the processor to improve power efficiency. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the H-field defined as a useful concept even though the B-field causes the actual magnetic forces? A) Because H-field is always equal to B-field in a vacuum B) Because H is easier to calculate from free currents C) Because H is the only field that can be measured directly D) Because H-field is measured in teslas, the SI unit ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: అసలు magnetic forces కి B-field కారణమైనప్పటికీ, H-field ని ఉపయోగకరమైన భావనగా ఎందుకు నిర్వచిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే vacuum లో H-field ఎల్లప్పుడూ B-field కి సమానం B) ఎందుకంటే free currents నుండి H ని లెక్కించడం సులభం C) ఎందుకంటే నేరుగా కొలవగల ఏకైక field H D) ఎందుకంటే H-field SI unit అయిన teslas లో కొలవబడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the H-field defined as a useful concept even though the B-field causes the actual magnetic forces? A) Because H-field is always equal to B-field in a vacuum B) Because H is easier to calculate from free currents C) Because H is the only field that can be measured directly D) Because H-field is measured in teslas, the SI unit ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is DCT preferred over generic data compression methods for natural images like photographs? A) It was invented specifically for medical imaging. B) It exploits visual perception and statistical properties of images. C) It requires no bit rate for storage. D) It is the only lossless compression method available. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Photographs వంటి natural images కోసం సాధారణ data compression methods కంటే DCT ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) అది ప్రత్యేకంగా medical imaging కోసం కనుగొనబడింది. B) అది visual perception మరియు images యొక్క statistical properties ని ఉపయోగించుకుంటుంది. C) Storage కి దానికి ఏ bit rate అవసరం లేదు. D) అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఏకైక lossless compression method అదే. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is DCT preferred over generic data compression methods for natural images like photographs? A) It was invented specifically for medical imaging. B) It exploits visual perception and statistical properties of images. C) It requires no bit rate for storage. D) It is the only lossless compression method available. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the core philosophy of Scrum regarding team structure? A) A hierarchical structure with a project manager directing daily tasks B) A group of developers reporting directly to the Product Owner for assignments C) A self-organizing, cross-functional team that manages its own work D) A siloed structure where developers and designers work in separate phases ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Team structure విషయంలో Scrum యొక్క ముఖ్య తత్వాన్ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) రోజువారీ tasks ని project manager నిర్దేశించే hierarchical structure B) Assignments కోసం నేరుగా Product Owner కి report చేసే developers సమూహం C) తన పనిని తానే నిర్వహించుకునే self-organizing, cross-functional team D) Developers మరియు designers వేర్వేరు phases లో పనిచేసే siloed structure జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the core philosophy of Scrum regarding team structure? A) A hierarchical structure with a project manager directing daily tasks B) A group of developers reporting directly to the Product Owner for assignments C) A self-organizing, cross-functional team that manages its own work D) A siloed structure where developers and designers work in separate phases ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the vector representation crucial in the context of word embeddings? A) It removes the need for grammatical parsing in all NLP tasks. B) It converts words into a unique binary hash for faster encryption. C) It maps semantic meanings to a mathematical space where proximity indicates similar meaning. D) It compresses text to save storage space on a hard drive. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Word embeddings సందర్భంలో vector representation ఎందుకు కీలకం? A) అన్ని NLP tasks లో grammatical parsing అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. B) వేగవంతమైన encryption కోసం words ని unique binary hash గా మారుస్తుంది. C) Semantic అర్థాలను ఒక mathematical space కి map చేస్తుంది, అక్కడ దగ్గరగా ఉండటం సారూప్య అర్థాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది. D) Hard drive పై storage space ఆదా చేయడానికి text ని compress చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is the vector representation crucial in the context of word embeddings? A) It removes the need for grammatical parsing in all NLP tasks. B) It converts words into a unique binary hash for faster encryption. C) It maps semantic meanings to a mathematical space where proximity indicates similar meaning. D) It compresses text to save storage space on a hard drive. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which limitation of the standard Sobel operator does the Scharr operator attempt to improve upon? A) It reduces the size of the kernel. B) It increases the computational complexity. C) It eliminates the need for convolution. D) It improves the rotational symmetry of the gradient approximation. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard Sobel operator యొక్క ఏ పరిమితిని Scharr operator మెరుగుపరచడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది? A) అది kernel size ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. B) అది computational complexity ని పెంచుతుంది. C) అది convolution అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది. D) అది gradient approximation యొక్క rotational symmetry ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which limitation of the standard Sobel operator does the Scharr operator attempt to improve upon? A) It reduces the size of the kernel. B) It increases the computational complexity. C) It eliminates the need for convolution. D) It improves the rotational symmetry of the gradient approximation. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: When defining a primary key constraint in SQL, what happens to the columns participating in that key? A) They are automatically encrypted by the database B) They are implicitly restricted from having NULL values C) They must be converted to an integer data type D) They can no longer be used in foreign key relationships ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: SQL లో primary key constraint ని నిర్వచించేటప్పుడు, ఆ key లో పాల్గొనే columns కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Database వాటిని automatic గా encrypt చేస్తుంది B) వాటికి NULL values ఉండకుండా పరోక్షంగా పరిమితం చేయబడతాయి C) వాటిని integer data type కి మార్చాలి D) వాటిని ఇక foreign key relationships లో ఉపయోగించలేము జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: When defining a primary key constraint in SQL, what happens to the columns participating in that key? A) They are automatically encrypted by the database B) They are implicitly restricted from having NULL values C) They must be converted to an integer data type D) They can no longer be used in foreign key relationships ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How is a principal submatrix constructed from an n × n square matrix? A) By selecting only the entries that reside strictly above the main diagonal. B) By deleting the exact same set of row and column indices from the original matrix. C) By deleting arbitrary rows while keeping all original columns intact. D) By computing the transpose and setting off-diagonal elements to zero. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: n × n square matrix నుండి principal submatrix ఎలా నిర్మించబడుతుంది? A) Main diagonal కి కచ్చితంగా పైన ఉన్న entries ని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకోవడం ద్వారా. B) అసలు matrix నుండి ఒకే set row మరియు column indices ని తొలగించడం ద్వారా. C) అన్ని అసలు columns ని అలాగే ఉంచి ఏవైనా rows ని తొలగించడం ద్వారా. D) Transpose లెక్కించి off-diagonal elements ని సున్నాగా పెట్టడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How is a principal submatrix constructed from an n × n square matrix? A) By selecting only the entries that reside strictly above the main diagonal. B) By deleting the exact same set of row and column indices from the original matrix. C) By deleting arbitrary rows while keeping all original columns intact. D) By computing the transpose and setting off-diagonal elements to zero. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is cycle stealing mode preferred over burst mode in certain systems? A) It requires fewer hardware registers in the DMA controller. B) It is simpler to implement in software without any special hardware. C) It allows the CPU to perform work between small data transfers. D) It transfers data faster by using the entire bus continuously. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: కొన్ని systems లో burst mode కంటే cycle stealing mode ని ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) DMA controller లో దానికి తక్కువ hardware registers అవసరం. B) ఎలాంటి ప్రత్యేక hardware లేకుండా software లో దాన్ని implement చేయడం సులభం. C) చిన్న data transfers మధ్య CPU పని చేయడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. D) మొత్తం bus ని నిరంతరం ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా అది data ని వేగంగా transfer చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is cycle stealing mode preferred over burst mode in certain systems? A) It requires fewer hardware registers in the DMA controller. B) It is simpler to implement in software without any special hardware. C) It allows the CPU to perform work between small data transfers. D) It transfers data faster by using the entire bus continuously. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: According to the end-to-end principle, where should complexity and reliability features be placed in a network? A) In the end hosts and application layers. B) In the central monitoring facility. C) In the physical transmission medium. D) In the network infrastructure and routers. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: End-to-end principle ప్రకారం network లో complexity మరియు reliability features ఎక్కడ ఉంచాలి? A) End hosts మరియు application layers లో. B) Central monitoring facility లో. C) Physical transmission medium లో. D) Network infrastructure మరియు routers లో. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: According to the end-to-end principle, where should complexity and reliability features be placed in a network? A) In the end hosts and application layers. B) In the central monitoring facility. C) In the physical transmission medium. D) In the network infrastructure and routers. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) fails to hold strictly across a node under which of the following physical conditions? A) The ambient temperature of the conducting wire increases during operation B) The circuit contains non-linear passive elements such as diodes C) Multiple independent voltage sources are present in the surrounding loops D) Significant charge accumulation occurs due to high-frequency capacitive coupling ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఈ క్రింది ఏ భౌతిక పరిస్థితిలో ఒక node వద్ద Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) కచ్చితంగా వర్తించదు? A) Operation సమయంలో conducting wire యొక్క పరిసర temperature పెరిగినప్పుడు B) Circuit లో diodes వంటి non-linear passive elements ఉన్నప్పుడు C) చుట్టూ ఉన్న loops లో అనేక independent voltage sources ఉన్నప్పుడు D) High-frequency capacitive coupling వల్ల గణనీయమైన charge accumulation జరిగినప్పుడు జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL) fails to hold strictly across a node under which of the following physical conditions? A) The ambient temperature of the conducting wire increases during operation B) The circuit contains non-linear passive elements such as diodes C) Multiple independent voltage sources are present in the surrounding loops D) Significant charge accumulation occurs due to high-frequency capacitive coupling ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the 2.4 GHz frequency band prone to interference in a typical home network environment? A) Because it requires a high-power license from the FCC B) Because it is exclusively reserved for Wi-Fi traffic only C) Because radio waves cannot travel through walls at this frequency D) Because it is an unlicensed band shared by other appliances like microwave ovens ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: సాధారణ home network వాతావరణంలో 2.4 GHz frequency band interference కి ఎందుకు లోనవుతుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే దానికి FCC నుండి high-power license అవసరం B) ఎందుకంటే అది కేవలం Wi-Fi traffic కి మాత్రమే కేటాయించబడింది C) ఎందుకంటే ఈ frequency వద్ద radio waves గోడల గుండా ప్రయాణించలేవు D) ఎందుకంటే అది microwave ovens వంటి ఇతర ఉపకరణాలతో పంచుకునే unlicensed band జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is the 2.4 GHz frequency band prone to interference in a typical home network environment? A) Because it requires a high-power license from the FCC B) Because it is exclusively reserved for Wi-Fi traffic only C) Because radio waves cannot travel through walls at this frequency D) Because it is an unlicensed band shared by other appliances like microwave ovens ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How do channels provide an alternative to explicit naming in the producer-consumer problem? A) By requiring each process to have a unique identifier for every communication instance. B) By eliminating the need for any synchronization mechanisms between processes. C) By allowing processes to communicate through a named port without specifying the exact source or destination. D) By using global variables to store data instead of named ports. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Producer-consumer problem లో explicit naming కి channels ఎలా ప్రత్యామ్నాయాన్ని అందిస్తాయి? A) ప్రతి communication instance కి ప్రతి process కి unique identifier ఉండాలని కోరడం ద్వారా. B) Processes మధ్య ఎలాంటి synchronization mechanisms అవసరం లేకుండా చేయడం ద్వారా. C) కచ్చితమైన source లేదా destination ని పేర్కొనకుండా named port ద్వారా processes communicate చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం ద్వారా. D) Named ports కి బదులు data ని store చేయడానికి global variables ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How do channels provide an alternative to explicit naming in the producer-consumer problem? A) By requiring each process to have a unique identifier for every communication instance. B) By eliminating the need for any synchronization mechanisms between processes. C) By allowing processes to communicate through a named port without specifying the exact source or destination. D) By using global variables to store data instead of named ports. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of splitting a node in a B-tree during insertion? A) To delete a key from the tree. B) To increase the number of leaf nodes. C) To maintain the tree's balance and ensure all nodes stay within the allowed key range. D) To reduce the number of keys in the tree. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Insertion సమయంలో B-tree లో node ని split చేయడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Tree నుండి ఒక key ని తొలగించడం. B) Leaf nodes సంఖ్యను పెంచడం. C) Tree balance ని నిలుపుకుని, అన్ని nodes అనుమతించబడిన key range లో ఉండేలా చూడటం. D) Tree లోని keys సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of splitting a node in a B-tree during insertion? A) To delete a key from the tree. B) To increase the number of leaf nodes. C) To maintain the tree's balance and ensure all nodes stay within the allowed key range. D) To reduce the number of keys in the tree. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the FLP impossibility result considered fundamental in distributed systems? A) It proves that shared memory systems are always faster than message-passing systems. B) It demonstrates that deterministic consensus is impossible in asynchronous systems with even one crash failure. C) It proves that no consensus algorithm can handle Byzantine failures in any system. D) It mandates that synchronous systems must use randomized algorithms to function. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Distributed systems లో FLP impossibility result ని ప్రాథమికమైనదిగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) Shared memory systems ఎల్లప్పుడూ message-passing systems కంటే వేగంగా ఉంటాయని అది నిరూపిస్తుంది. B) ఒక్క crash failure ఉన్నా asynchronous systems లో deterministic consensus అసాధ్యమని అది చూపిస్తుంది. C) ఏ system లోనూ ఏ consensus algorithm కూడా Byzantine failures ని handle చేయలేదని అది నిరూపిస్తుంది. D) Synchronous systems పనిచేయడానికి randomized algorithms ఉపయోగించాలని అది నిర్దేశిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the FLP impossibility result considered fundamental in distributed systems? A) It proves that shared memory systems are always faster than message-passing systems. B) It demonstrates that deterministic consensus is impossible in asynchronous systems with even one crash failure. C) It proves that no consensus algorithm can handle Byzantine failures in any system. D) It mandates that synchronous systems must use randomized algorithms to function. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between the modulation index and the carrier frequency deviation in sinusoidal modulation? A) The index is the difference between center frequency and instantaneous frequency B) The index is the product of the carrier frequency and deviation C) The index is independent of the modulating frequency D) The index is the ratio of peak frequency deviation to the modulating frequency ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Sinusoidal modulation లో modulation index మరియు carrier frequency deviation మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని ఏ statement సరిగ్గా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Index అనేది center frequency మరియు instantaneous frequency మధ్య తేడా B) Index అనేది carrier frequency మరియు deviation యొక్క product C) Index, modulating frequency పై ఆధారపడదు D) Index అనేది peak frequency deviation కి modulating frequency కి ఉన్న ratio జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between the modulation index and the carrier frequency deviation in sinusoidal modulation? A) The index is the difference between center frequency and instantaneous frequency B) The index is the product of the carrier frequency and deviation C) The index is independent of the modulating frequency D) The index is the ratio of peak frequency deviation to the modulating frequency ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a significant disadvantage of OFDM resulting in the need for linear transmitter circuitry? A) High sensitivity to Doppler shift B) High intersymbol interference C) Low spectral efficiency D) High peak-to-average-power ratio ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Linear transmitter circuitry అవసరానికి దారితీసే OFDM యొక్క ముఖ్యమైన ప్రతికూలత ఏమిటి? A) Doppler shift కి ఎక్కువ sensitivity B) ఎక్కువ intersymbol interference C) తక్కువ spectral efficiency D) ఎక్కువ peak-to-average-power ratio జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a significant disadvantage of OFDM resulting in the need for linear transmitter circuitry? A) High sensitivity to Doppler shift B) High intersymbol interference C) Low spectral efficiency D) High peak-to-average-power ratio ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary risk if a hash function lacks collision resistance? A) An attacker could easily derive the secret key. B) An attacker could find two different inputs that produce the same hash, compromising integrity. C) The system would become vulnerable to replay attacks. D) The hash function would produce variable-length outputs. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Hash function కి collision resistance లేకపోతే ప్రధాన risk ఏమిటి? A) Attacker secret key ని సులభంగా derive చేయగలడు. B) ఒకే hash ని ఇచ్చే రెండు వేర్వేరు inputs ని attacker కనుగొనగలడు, దీనివల్ల integrity దెబ్బతింటుంది. C) System replay attacks కి లోనవుతుంది. D) Hash function variable-length outputs ని ఇస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary risk if a hash function lacks collision resistance? A) An attacker could easily derive the secret key. B) An attacker could find two different inputs that produce the same hash, compromising integrity. C) The system would become vulnerable to replay attacks. D) The hash function would produce variable-length outputs. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In game theory, a deadlock often refers to a situation where: A) The mutually beneficial action is also dominant B) The game has no equilibrium C) Players cannot communicate D) One player has a dominant strategy ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Game theory లో deadlock సాధారణంగా ఏ పరిస్థితిని సూచిస్తుంది: A) పరస్పరం ప్రయోజనకరమైన action dominant కూడా అయినప్పుడు B) Game కి equilibrium లేనప్పుడు C) Players communicate చేయలేనప్పుడు D) ఒక player కి dominant strategy ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In game theory, a deadlock often refers to a situation where: A) The mutually beneficial action is also dominant B) The game has no equilibrium C) Players cannot communicate D) One player has a dominant strategy ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In an equalized image, what does a 'flat' histogram generally indicate about the image's visual properties? A) The image has high contrast, utilizing the full range of available intensities B) The image has very low contrast and appears washed out C) The image is strictly binary (only black and white pixels) D) The image has been converted to a 3D color space ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Equalized image లో 'flat' histogram సాధారణంగా image యొక్క visual properties గురించి ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Image కి ఎక్కువ contrast ఉంది, అందుబాటులో ఉన్న intensities పూర్తి range ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది B) Image కి చాలా తక్కువ contrast ఉంది మరియు వెలిసిపోయినట్లు కనిపిస్తుంది C) Image కచ్చితంగా binary (నలుపు మరియు తెలుపు pixels మాత్రమే) D) Image ఒక 3D color space కి మార్చబడింది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In an equalized image, what does a 'flat' histogram generally indicate about the image's visual properties? A) The image has high contrast, utilizing the full range of available intensities B) The image has very low contrast and appears washed out C) The image is strictly binary (only black and white pixels) D) The image has been converted to a 3D color space ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary benefit of using a high-level assembler over a traditional one? A) It directly generates machine code without any translation step B) It requires no knowledge of the underlying machine architecture C) It eliminates the need for an assembler program entirely D) It allows for the use of advanced programming constructs like functions and control structures ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: సాంప్రదాయ assembler కంటే high-level assembler ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) ఎలాంటి translation step లేకుండా అది నేరుగా machine code ని generate చేస్తుంది B) దానికి అంతర్లీన machine architecture గురించి ఎలాంటి జ్ఞానం అవసరం లేదు C) అది assembler program అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది D) Functions మరియు control structures వంటి advanced programming constructs ని ఉపయోగించడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a primary benefit of using a high-level assembler over a traditional one? A) It directly generates machine code without any translation step B) It requires no knowledge of the underlying machine architecture C) It eliminates the need for an assembler program entirely D) It allows for the use of advanced programming constructs like functions and control structures ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why are end-to-end models considered a significant advancement over traditional HMM-based systems in speech recognition? A) They require less computational power to train B) They only work for single-speaker recognition C) They do not use any form of neural network D) They eliminate the need for separate acoustic and language modeling stages ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Speech recognition లో సాంప్రదాయ HMM-based systems కంటే end-to-end models ని ఎందుకు గణనీయమైన ముందడుగుగా పరిగణిస్తారు? A) వాటిని train చేయడానికి తక్కువ computational power అవసరం B) అవి single-speaker recognition కి మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి C) అవి ఏ రకమైన neural network నూ ఉపయోగించవు D) అవి విడివిడి acoustic మరియు language modeling stages అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why are end-to-end models considered a significant advancement over traditional HMM-based systems in speech recognition? A) They require less computational power to train B) They only work for single-speaker recognition C) They do not use any form of neural network D) They eliminate the need for separate acoustic and language modeling stages ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to a causal discrete-time system if its largest pole lies outside the unit circle? A) The system becomes a continuous-time system B) The ROC expands to cover the entire z-plane C) The system remains BIBO stable D) The ROC cannot include the unit circle, making it unstable ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Causal discrete-time system యొక్క అతి పెద్ద pole unit circle బయట ఉంటే దానికి ఏమవుతుంది? A) System ఒక continuous-time system అవుతుంది B) ROC మొత్తం z-plane ని కవర్ చేసేలా విస్తరిస్తుంది C) System BIBO stable గానే ఉంటుంది D) ROC unit circle ని చేర్చుకోలేదు, దీనివల్ల అది unstable అవుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What happens to a causal discrete-time system if its largest pole lies outside the unit circle? A) The system becomes a continuous-time system B) The ROC expands to cover the entire z-plane C) The system remains BIBO stable D) The ROC cannot include the unit circle, making it unstable ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is message passing a key design element in GNNs for molecular drug design? A) It reduces the computational cost of processing large graphs. B) It ensures the model is invariant to the ordering of atoms in the molecule. C) It directly predicts the efficacy of a molecule without intermediate representations. D) It allows nodes to update representations based on local chemical properties of neighboring atoms. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Molecular drug design కోసం GNNs లో message passing ఎందుకు ముఖ్య design element? A) పెద్ద graphs ని process చేసే computational cost ని అది తగ్గిస్తుంది. B) Molecule లోని atoms ordering కి model invariant గా ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. C) Intermediate representations లేకుండా molecule యొక్క efficacy ని అది నేరుగా predict చేస్తుంది. D) పొరుగు atoms యొక్క local chemical properties ఆధారంగా nodes తమ representations ని update చేసుకోవడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is message passing a key design element in GNNs for molecular drug design? A) It reduces the computational cost of processing large graphs. B) It ensures the model is invariant to the ordering of atoms in the molecule. C) It directly predicts the efficacy of a molecule without intermediate representations. D) It allows nodes to update representations based on local chemical properties of neighboring atoms. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How is the direction of the vector area dS determined in relation to the line integral in Ampère's law? A) By pointing the thumb along the area vector and the index finger along the line integral direction B) By aligning the palm with the area and the index finger along the line integral direction C) By pointing the thumb along the line integral and the fingers along the area vector D) By pointing the thumb along the current and the fingers along the loop ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Ampère's law లో line integral కి సంబంధించి vector area dS దిశ ఎలా నిర్ణయించబడుతుంది? A) బొటనవేలిని area vector వెంట, చూపుడువేలిని line integral దిశ వెంట చూపడం ద్వారా B) అరచేతిని area తో align చేసి, చూపుడువేలిని line integral దిశ వెంట ఉంచడం ద్వారా C) బొటనవేలిని line integral వెంట, వేళ్ళను area vector వెంట చూపడం ద్వారా D) బొటనవేలిని current వెంట, వేళ్ళను loop వెంట చూపడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How is the direction of the vector area dS determined in relation to the line integral in Ampère's law? A) By pointing the thumb along the area vector and the index finger along the line integral direction B) By aligning the palm with the area and the index finger along the line integral direction C) By pointing the thumb along the line integral and the fingers along the area vector D) By pointing the thumb along the current and the fingers along the loop ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which condition regarding the poles of a transfer function is required for system stability? A) The poles must have negative real parts to ensure the transient response decays over time. B) The poles must be strictly imaginary. C) All poles must have positive real parts. D) The poles must be zero. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: System stability కి transfer function యొక్క poles కి సంబంధించి ఏ condition అవసరం? A) Transient response కాలక్రమేణా తగ్గేలా poles కి negative real parts ఉండాలి. B) Poles కచ్చితంగా imaginary గా ఉండాలి. C) అన్ని poles కి positive real parts ఉండాలి. D) Poles సున్నాగా ఉండాలి. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Which condition regarding the poles of a transfer function is required for system stability? A) The poles must have negative real parts to ensure the transient response decays over time. B) The poles must be strictly imaginary. C) All poles must have positive real parts. D) The poles must be zero. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What geometric feature corresponds to the next iterate x_{n+1} in Newton's method? A) The midpoint between x_n and the true root B) The x-intercept of the tangent line to f(x) at x_n C) The local extremum of the secant line between x_{n-1} and x_n D) The y-intercept of the normal line evaluated at x_n ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Newton's method లో తదుపరి iterate x_{n+1} కి ఏ geometric లక్షణం అనుగుణంగా ఉంటుంది? A) x_n మరియు నిజమైన root మధ్య midpoint B) x_n వద్ద f(x) కి tangent line యొక్క x-intercept C) x_{n-1} మరియు x_n మధ్య secant line యొక్క local extremum D) x_n వద్ద evaluate చేసిన normal line యొక్క y-intercept జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What geometric feature corresponds to the next iterate x_{n+1} in Newton's method? A) The midpoint between x_n and the true root B) The x-intercept of the tangent line to f(x) at x_n C) The local extremum of the secant line between x_{n-1} and x_n D) The y-intercept of the normal line evaluated at x_n ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes Byzantine failures from the failures assumed in basic Paxos? A) Byzantine failures are temporary, while crash failures are permanent. B) Byzantine failures involve arbitrary or malicious behavior, whereas basic Paxos assumes crash failures. C) Byzantine failures only affect the network, while crash failures affect processors. D) Byzantine failures are handled by a quorum of acceptors, while crash failures are not. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Basic Paxos లో ఊహించే failures నుండి Byzantine failures ని ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Byzantine failures తాత్కాలికమైనవి, crash failures శాశ్వతమైనవి. B) Byzantine failures లో ఏకపక్ష లేదా హానికరమైన ప్రవర్తన ఉంటుంది, basic Paxos crash failures ని ఊహిస్తుంది. C) Byzantine failures network ని మాత్రమే ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి, crash failures processors ని ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. D) Byzantine failures acceptors quorum ద్వారా handle చేయబడతాయి, crash failures అలా కాదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What distinguishes Byzantine failures from the failures assumed in basic Paxos? A) Byzantine failures are temporary, while crash failures are permanent. B) Byzantine failures involve arbitrary or malicious behavior, whereas basic Paxos assumes crash failures. C) Byzantine failures only affect the network, while crash failures affect processors. D) Byzantine failures are handled by a quorum of acceptors, while crash failures are not. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a deterministic signal differ from a random signal? A) Its values can be calculated using a mathematical equation B) It cannot carry information C) It is always periodic D) It can only exist in continuous time ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Deterministic signal, random signal నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) దాని values ని ఒక mathematical equation ఉపయోగించి లెక్కించవచ్చు B) అది సమాచారాన్ని మోయలేదు C) అది ఎల్లప్పుడూ periodic D) అది continuous time లో మాత్రమే ఉండగలదు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does a deterministic signal differ from a random signal? A) Its values can be calculated using a mathematical equation B) It cannot carry information C) It is always periodic D) It can only exist in continuous time ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does the line integral of the H-field around a closed curve equal according to the original circuital law? A) The magnetic flux through the surface B) The total current, including bound current C) The free current passing through the enclosed surface D) The displacement current in the region ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: అసలు circuital law ప్రకారం ఒక closed curve చుట్టూ H-field యొక్క line integral దేనికి సమానం? A) Surface ద్వారా వెళ్ళే magnetic flux B) Bound current తో సహా మొత్తం current C) పరివేష్టిత surface గుండా వెళ్ళే free current D) ఆ region లోని displacement current జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What does the line integral of the H-field around a closed curve equal according to the original circuital law? A) The magnetic flux through the surface B) The total current, including bound current C) The free current passing through the enclosed surface D) The displacement current in the region ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does automata theory differ from earlier systems theory mentioned in the text? A) It requires the use of analog data exclusively. B) It primarily uses abstract algebra to describe information systems. C) It focuses on continuous differential calculus. D) It ignores the concept of 'states' entirely. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Text లో పేర్కొన్న పాత systems theory నుండి automata theory ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) దానికి కేవలం analog data ఉపయోగించడం అవసరం. B) Information systems ని వివరించడానికి అది ప్రధానంగా abstract algebra ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. C) అది continuous differential calculus పై దృష్టి పెడుతుంది. D) అది 'states' అనే భావనను పూర్తిగా పట్టించుకోదు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does automata theory differ from earlier systems theory mentioned in the text? A) It requires the use of analog data exclusively. B) It primarily uses abstract algebra to describe information systems. C) It focuses on continuous differential calculus. D) It ignores the concept of 'states' entirely. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key characteristic of an eigenfunction when processed by an LTI system? A) The output undergoes a change in frequency B) The output becomes a random noise signal C) The output is always zero D) The output maintains its original form but is scaled ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: LTI system ద్వారా process చేయబడినప్పుడు eigenfunction యొక్క ముఖ్య లక్షణం ఏమిటి? A) Output లో frequency మార్పు జరుగుతుంది B) Output ఒక random noise signal అవుతుంది C) Output ఎల్లప్పుడూ సున్నా D) Output తన అసలు రూపాన్ని నిలుపుకుంటుంది కానీ scale అవుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key characteristic of an eigenfunction when processed by an LTI system? A) The output undergoes a change in frequency B) The output becomes a random noise signal C) The output is always zero D) The output maintains its original form but is scaled ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which condition most likely triggers an avalanche breakdown rather than the Zener effect? A) Operation at extremely low voltages. B) A very thin depletion region. C) Extremely heavy doping in the junction. D) A more lightly doped junction with higher breakdown voltage. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Zener effect కంటే avalanche breakdown ని ఏ condition ఎక్కువగా ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది? A) చాలా తక్కువ voltages వద్ద operation. B) చాలా పలుచని depletion region. C) Junction లో చాలా ఎక్కువ doping. D) ఎక్కువ breakdown voltage ఉన్న తక్కువగా dope చేయబడిన junction. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which condition most likely triggers an avalanche breakdown rather than the Zener effect? A) Operation at extremely low voltages. B) A very thin depletion region. C) Extremely heavy doping in the junction. D) A more lightly doped junction with higher breakdown voltage. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason an organization might choose to keep certain workloads on-premises rather than migrating them to a public cloud? A) Public cloud services always have lower performance than local servers. B) Strict regulatory requirements or the need to maintain deep integration with legacy systems. C) Public cloud providers refuse to host legacy enterprise software. D) Public cloud platforms do not support artificial intelligence or machine learning. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక organization కొన్ని workloads ని public cloud కి migrate చేయకుండా on-premises లో ఉంచాలని ఎంచుకోవడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Public cloud services ఎల్లప్పుడూ local servers కంటే తక్కువ performance కలిగి ఉంటాయి. B) కఠినమైన regulatory requirements లేదా legacy systems తో లోతైన integration ని నిలుపుకోవాల్సిన అవసరం. C) Public cloud providers legacy enterprise software ని host చేయడానికి నిరాకరిస్తారు. D) Public cloud platforms artificial intelligence లేదా machine learning ని support చేయవు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason an organization might choose to keep certain workloads on-premises rather than migrating them to a public cloud? A) Public cloud services always have lower performance than local servers. B) Strict regulatory requirements or the need to maintain deep integration with legacy systems. C) Public cloud providers refuse to host legacy enterprise software. D) Public cloud platforms do not support artificial intelligence or machine learning. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a negative feedback loop in a control system? A) To amplify input signals to their maximum potential. B) To ensure the system enters a state of chaos to explore the phase space. C) To remove the need for a set point in the control architecture. D) To minimize the error signal by acting in opposition to current deviations. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Control system లో negative feedback loop యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) Input signals ని వాటి గరిష్ట సామర్థ్యానికి amplify చేయడం. B) Phase space ని అన్వేషించడానికి system chaos స్థితిలోకి ప్రవేశించేలా చూడటం. C) Control architecture లో set point అవసరాన్ని తొలగించడం. D) ప్రస్తుత deviations కి వ్యతిరేకంగా పనిచేయడం ద్వారా error signal ని minimize చేయడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a negative feedback loop in a control system? A) To amplify input signals to their maximum potential. B) To ensure the system enters a state of chaos to explore the phase space. C) To remove the need for a set point in the control architecture. D) To minimize the error signal by acting in opposition to current deviations. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why should an engineer be cautious when applying an 'ideal' filter to economic time series data? A) It can create artifacts like false cycles that do not exist in the real data. B) Economic data always has a higher sampling rate than electrical signals. C) Ideal filters only work on mechanical beam-mass systems. D) Ideal filters are too expensive to implement in software. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Economic time series data కి 'ideal' filter ని apply చేసేటప్పుడు engineer ఎందుకు జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండాలి? A) అసలు data లో లేని false cycles వంటి artifacts ని అది సృష్టించవచ్చు. B) Economic data కి ఎల్లప్పుడూ electrical signals కంటే ఎక్కువ sampling rate ఉంటుంది. C) Ideal filters mechanical beam-mass systems పై మాత్రమే పనిచేస్తాయి. D) Software లో ideal filters ని implement చేయడం చాలా ఖరీదైనది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why should an engineer be cautious when applying an 'ideal' filter to economic time series data? A) It can create artifacts like false cycles that do not exist in the real data. B) Economic data always has a higher sampling rate than electrical signals. C) Ideal filters only work on mechanical beam-mass systems. D) Ideal filters are too expensive to implement in software. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is the primary goal of the normalization process? A) To create a visual representation of data flow B) To maximize the amount of storage space used C) To increase the speed of hardware execution D) To minimize data redundancy and prevent anomalies ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Normalization process యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది? A) Data flow యొక్క visual representation ని సృష్టించడం B) ఉపయోగించే storage space ని maximize చేయడం C) Hardware execution speed ని పెంచడం D) Data redundancy ని minimize చేసి anomalies ని నివారించడం జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following is the primary goal of the normalization process? A) To create a visual representation of data flow B) To maximize the amount of storage space used C) To increase the speed of hardware execution D) To minimize data redundancy and prevent anomalies ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a RISC architecture, how is the sequencing of hardware operations typically managed compared to microcoded systems? A) By storing all instructions in SRAM for flexibility B) By using a complex microcode engine for every instruction C) By using a player piano mechanism for instruction sequencing D) Through direct hardware control or compiler scheduling, minimizing microcode reliance ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Microcoded systems తో పోలిస్తే RISC architecture లో hardware operations యొక్క sequencing సాధారణంగా ఎలా నిర్వహించబడుతుంది? A) Flexibility కోసం అన్ని instructions ని SRAM లో store చేయడం ద్వారా B) ప్రతి instruction కి సంక్లిష్టమైన microcode engine ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా C) Instruction sequencing కోసం player piano mechanism ఉపయోగించడం ద్వారా D) Direct hardware control లేదా compiler scheduling ద్వారా, microcode పై ఆధారపడటాన్ని తగ్గిస్తూ జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In a RISC architecture, how is the sequencing of hardware operations typically managed compared to microcoded systems? A) By storing all instructions in SRAM for flexibility B) By using a complex microcode engine for every instruction C) By using a player piano mechanism for instruction sequencing D) Through direct hardware control or compiler scheduling, minimizing microcode reliance ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is forced commutation necessary in some thyristor circuits? A) To reduce the gate trigger voltage B) To turn off the thyristor when natural commutation is not possible C) To improve the rate of rise D) To increase the holding current ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: కొన్ని thyristor circuits లో forced commutation ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) Gate trigger voltage ని తగ్గించడానికి B) Natural commutation సాధ్యం కానప్పుడు thyristor ని turn off చేయడానికి C) Rate of rise ని మెరుగుపరచడానికి D) Holding current ని పెంచడానికి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is forced commutation necessary in some thyristor circuits? A) To reduce the gate trigger voltage B) To turn off the thyristor when natural commutation is not possible C) To improve the rate of rise D) To increase the holding current ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is TF-IDF considered a refinement over the simple bag-of-words model? A) It only considers the most frequent terms in a document. B) It reduces the computational complexity of text processing. C) It assigns weights to words based on their frequency in a document and across the corpus. D) It accounts for the order of words in a document. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: సాధారణ bag-of-words model కంటే TF-IDF ని మెరుగుదలగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) అది document లోని అత్యంత తరచుగా వచ్చే terms ని మాత్రమే పరిగణిస్తుంది. B) అది text processing యొక్క computational complexity ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Document లో మరియు corpus అంతటా words యొక్క frequency ఆధారంగా వాటికి weights కేటాయిస్తుంది. D) Document లోని words order ని అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is TF-IDF considered a refinement over the simple bag-of-words model? A) It only considers the most frequent terms in a document. B) It reduces the computational complexity of text processing. C) It assigns weights to words based on their frequency in a document and across the corpus. D) It accounts for the order of words in a document. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the steepest descent method exhibit a zigzag path when solving a linear system with a large condition number? A) The step size is always too large. B) Orthogonality of residuals forces directions to alternate. C) The function is non-convex. D) The gradient becomes zero at every step. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: పెద్ద condition number ఉన్న linear system ని solve చేసేటప్పుడు steepest descent method zigzag path ని ఎందుకు చూపిస్తుంది? A) Step size ఎల్లప్పుడూ చాలా పెద్దదిగా ఉంటుంది. B) Residuals యొక్క orthogonality దిశలు మారుతూ ఉండేలా చేస్తుంది. C) Function non-convex. D) ప్రతి step లో gradient సున్నా అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does the steepest descent method exhibit a zigzag path when solving a linear system with a large condition number? A) The step size is always too large. B) Orthogonality of residuals forces directions to alternate. C) The function is non-convex. D) The gradient becomes zero at every step. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using multi-head attention in a GAT layer? A) It allows the model to focus on different types of neighbor relationships simultaneously. B) It reduces the number of trainable parameters compared to single-head attention. C) It eliminates the need for an activation function in the network. D) It ensures the layer is permutation equivariant by design. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: GAT layer లో multi-head attention ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) వేర్వేరు రకాల neighbor relationships పై model ఒకేసారి దృష్టి పెట్టడానికి అది అనుమతిస్తుంది. B) Single-head attention తో పోలిస్తే అది trainable parameters సంఖ్యను తగ్గిస్తుంది. C) Network లో activation function అవసరాన్ని అది తొలగిస్తుంది. D) Design ద్వారానే layer permutation equivariant గా ఉండేలా అది చూస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using multi-head attention in a GAT layer? A) It allows the model to focus on different types of neighbor relationships simultaneously. B) It reduces the number of trainable parameters compared to single-head attention. C) It eliminates the need for an activation function in the network. D) It ensures the layer is permutation equivariant by design. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary reason for using dynamic programming to solve the knapsack problem? A) It is the only method that handles real numbers B) It solves the problem in pseudo-polynomial time C) It provides a polynomial-time exact solution D) It reduces the problem to a linear decision tree ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Knapsack problem ని solve చేయడానికి dynamic programming ఉపయోగించడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏమిటి? A) Real numbers ని handle చేసే ఏకైక method అదే B) అది problem ని pseudo-polynomial time లో solve చేస్తుంది C) అది polynomial-time exact solution ని అందిస్తుంది D) అది problem ని linear decision tree గా తగ్గిస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary reason for using dynamic programming to solve the knapsack problem? A) It is the only method that handles real numbers B) It solves the problem in pseudo-polynomial time C) It provides a polynomial-time exact solution D) It reduces the problem to a linear decision tree ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In what specific context is a SWER system typically chosen? A) Electrifying remote, sparsely populated rural areas B) Interconnecting two major transmission networks C) High-density urban downtowns D) Powering heavy industrial factory machines ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ నిర్దిష్ట సందర్భంలో SWER system ని సాధారణంగా ఎంచుకుంటారు? A) దూరంగా ఉన్న, తక్కువ జనాభా ఉన్న గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాలకు విద్యుదీకరణ B) రెండు ప్రధాన transmission networks ని అనుసంధానించడం C) ఎక్కువ జనసాంద్రత ఉన్న నగర కేంద్రాలు D) భారీ industrial factory machines కి power అందించడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In what specific context is a SWER system typically chosen? A) Electrifying remote, sparsely populated rural areas B) Interconnecting two major transmission networks C) High-density urban downtowns D) Powering heavy industrial factory machines ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary function of a branch history register in a two-level adaptive predictor? A) To record the outcomes of the last n executions of a specific branch. B) To generate pseudorandom numbers for random branch prediction. C) To store the program counter of the next instruction to fetch. D) To hold the target address of the most recent taken branch. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Two-level adaptive predictor లో branch history register యొక్క ప్రధాన function ఏమిటి? A) ఒక నిర్దిష్ట branch యొక్క చివరి n executions ఫలితాలను record చేయడం. B) Random branch prediction కోసం pseudorandom numbers ని generate చేయడం. C) Fetch చేయాల్సిన తదుపరి instruction యొక్క program counter ని store చేయడం. D) ఇటీవల taken అయిన branch యొక్క target address ని ఉంచుకోవడం. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary function of a branch history register in a two-level adaptive predictor? A) To record the outcomes of the last n executions of a specific branch. B) To generate pseudorandom numbers for random branch prediction. C) To store the program counter of the next instruction to fetch. D) To hold the target address of the most recent taken branch. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes a 'safe state' in the context of resource allocation? A) All processes have already reached their maximum resource claim. B) The system is currently not executing any processes. C) There is at least one sequence of resource requests where all processes can terminate. D) The system has zero resources currently allocated to any process. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Resource allocation సందర్భంలో 'safe state' ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) అన్ని processes ఇప్పటికే తమ maximum resource claim ని చేరుకున్నాయి. B) System ప్రస్తుతం ఏ processes నూ execute చేయడం లేదు. C) అన్ని processes terminate కాగల కనీసం ఒక resource requests sequence ఉంది. D) System ప్రస్తుతం ఏ process కీ resources కేటాయించలేదు. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes a 'safe state' in the context of resource allocation? A) All processes have already reached their maximum resource claim. B) The system is currently not executing any processes. C) There is at least one sequence of resource requests where all processes can terminate. D) The system has zero resources currently allocated to any process. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If the temperature of the cold reservoir is lowered while keeping the hot reservoir temperature constant, what happens to the maximum efficiency of a Carnot engine? A) It increases because the ratio of temperatures is reduced. B) It remains unchanged because it depends only on the hot reservoir temperature. C) It decreases because the temperature difference is reduced. D) It becomes zero because no work can be extracted. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Hot reservoir temperature ని స్థిరంగా ఉంచుతూ cold reservoir temperature ని తగ్గిస్తే, Carnot engine యొక్క maximum efficiency కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Temperatures ratio తగ్గడం వల్ల అది పెరుగుతుంది. B) అది hot reservoir temperature పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది కాబట్టి మారకుండా ఉంటుంది. C) Temperature difference తగ్గడం వల్ల అది తగ్గుతుంది. D) ఏ work నూ పొందలేము కాబట్టి అది సున్నా అవుతుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: If the temperature of the cold reservoir is lowered while keeping the hot reservoir temperature constant, what happens to the maximum efficiency of a Carnot engine? A) It increases because the ratio of temperatures is reduced. B) It remains unchanged because it depends only on the hot reservoir temperature. C) It decreases because the temperature difference is reduced. D) It becomes zero because no work can be extracted. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental requirement for a system to be considered observable? A) The system must be linear and time-invariant. B) All state variables must be directly measurable by physical sensors. C) The system must have a unique state-transition matrix. D) The internal states must be estimable using only the system's output measurements. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక system observable గా పరిగణించబడటానికి ప్రాథమిక requirement ఏమిటి? A) System linear మరియు time-invariant గా ఉండాలి. B) అన్ని state variables ని physical sensors ద్వారా నేరుగా కొలవగలగాలి. C) System కి unique state-transition matrix ఉండాలి. D) System యొక్క output measurements ని మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించి internal states ని అంచనా వేయగలగాలి. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental requirement for a system to be considered observable? A) The system must be linear and time-invariant. B) All state variables must be directly measurable by physical sensors. C) The system must have a unique state-transition matrix. D) The internal states must be estimable using only the system's output measurements. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a guard interval help in an OFDM system? A) It eliminates the need for orthogonal subcarriers B) It mitigates intersymbol interference caused by multipath propagation C) It increases the total bandwidth required D) It improves the peak-to-average-power ratio ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: OFDM system లో guard interval ఎలా సహాయపడుతుంది? A) అది orthogonal subcarriers అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది B) Multipath propagation వల్ల కలిగే intersymbol interference ని అది తగ్గిస్తుంది C) అది అవసరమైన మొత్తం bandwidth ని పెంచుతుంది D) అది peak-to-average-power ratio ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a guard interval help in an OFDM system? A) It eliminates the need for orthogonal subcarriers B) It mitigates intersymbol interference caused by multipath propagation C) It increases the total bandwidth required D) It improves the peak-to-average-power ratio ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How are status output signals from an ALU typically used? A) To convert the ALU's integer output into a floating-point number. B) To control conditional branching and to make information available for future ALU operations. C) To increase the word size of the ALU for multi-precision arithmetic. D) To reset the external circuitry and prepare the ALU for a new clock cycle. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ALU నుండి వచ్చే status output signals సాధారణంగా ఎలా ఉపయోగించబడతాయి? A) ALU యొక్క integer output ని floating-point number గా మార్చడానికి. B) Conditional branching ని నియంత్రించడానికి మరియు భవిష్యత్ ALU operations కి సమాచారాన్ని అందుబాటులో ఉంచడానికి. C) Multi-precision arithmetic కోసం ALU యొక్క word size ని పెంచడానికి. D) External circuitry ని reset చేసి కొత్త clock cycle కి ALU ని సిద్ధం చేయడానికి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How are status output signals from an ALU typically used? A) To convert the ALU's integer output into a floating-point number. B) To control conditional branching and to make information available for future ALU operations. C) To increase the word size of the ALU for multi-precision arithmetic. D) To reset the external circuitry and prepare the ALU for a new clock cycle. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of using an approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm? A) To improve the classification accuracy of the k-NN model. B) To handle high-dimensional data where exact methods fail. C) To reduce the computational cost of finding neighbors in large datasets. D) To learn an optimal distance metric for the feature space. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) k-NN model యొక్క classification accuracy ని మెరుగుపరచడం. B) Exact methods విఫలమయ్యే high-dimensional data ని handle చేయడం. C) పెద్ద datasets లో neighbors ని కనుగొనే computational cost ని తగ్గించడం. D) Feature space కోసం optimal distance metric ని నేర్చుకోవడం. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of using an approximate nearest neighbor search algorithm? A) To improve the classification accuracy of the k-NN model.
