B) To handle high-dimensional data where exact methods fail. C) To reduce the computational cost of finding neighbors in large datasets. D) To learn an optimal distance metric for the feature space. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How do peephole connections alter the standard decision-making process of an LSTM gate? A) They allow the gates to inspect the cell state directly B) They remove the need for the output gate entirely C) They change the activation function to a linear function D) They force the network to only look at future inputs ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Peephole connections LSTM gate యొక్క standard నిర్ణయ ప్రక్రియను ఎలా మారుస్తాయి? A) Gates cell state ని నేరుగా పరిశీలించడానికి అవి అనుమతిస్తాయి B) అవి output gate అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తాయి C) అవి activation function ని linear function గా మారుస్తాయి D) Network భవిష్యత్ inputs ని మాత్రమే చూసేలా అవి బలవంతం చేస్తాయి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How do peephole connections alter the standard decision-making process of an LSTM gate? A) They allow the gates to inspect the cell state directly B) They remove the need for the output gate entirely C) They change the activation function to a linear function D) They force the network to only look at future inputs ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: For a system described by a linear constant coefficient differential equation to be causal, what must be true of its impulse response h(t)? A) h(t) must be zero for all t < 0 B) h(t) must be equal to the input signal C) h(t) must be constant for all t D) h(t) must be zero for all t > 0 ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Linear constant coefficient differential equation తో వివరించబడిన system causal కావాలంటే, దాని impulse response h(t) గురించి ఏది నిజం కావాలి? A) అన్ని t < 0 కి h(t) సున్నాగా ఉండాలి B) h(t) input signal కి సమానంగా ఉండాలి C) అన్ని t కి h(t) constant గా ఉండాలి D) అన్ని t > 0 కి h(t) సున్నాగా ఉండాలి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: For a system described by a linear constant coefficient differential equation to be causal, what must be true of its impulse response h(t)? A) h(t) must be zero for all t < 0 B) h(t) must be equal to the input signal C) h(t) must be constant for all t D) h(t) must be zero for all t > 0 ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the SPI bus when CPOL is set to 1? A) The slave select signal becomes active high B) The clock signal idles at a logical low voltage C) The clock signal idles at a logical high voltage D) The first data bit is output on the first clock edge ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: CPOL ని 1 గా set చేసినప్పుడు SPI bus కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Slave select signal active high అవుతుంది B) Clock signal logical low voltage వద్ద idle గా ఉంటుంది C) Clock signal logical high voltage వద్ద idle గా ఉంటుంది D) మొదటి data bit మొదటి clock edge పై output అవుతుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What happens to the SPI bus when CPOL is set to 1? A) The slave select signal becomes active high B) The clock signal idles at a logical low voltage C) The clock signal idles at a logical high voltage D) The first data bit is output on the first clock edge ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How are ideal independent voltage and current sources modified when finding the Thévenin equivalent resistance Rth of a network? A) Both voltage and current sources are short-circuited B) Voltage sources are open-circuited and current sources are short-circuited C) Both voltage and current sources are replaced by equal resistors D) Voltage sources are short-circuited and current sources are open-circuited ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక network యొక్క Thévenin equivalent resistance Rth ని కనుగొనేటప్పుడు ideal independent voltage మరియు current sources ఎలా మార్చబడతాయి? A) Voltage మరియు current sources రెండూ short-circuit చేయబడతాయి B) Voltage sources open-circuit చేయబడతాయి మరియు current sources short-circuit చేయబడతాయి C) Voltage మరియు current sources రెండూ సమాన resistors తో భర్తీ చేయబడతాయి D) Voltage sources short-circuit చేయబడతాయి మరియు current sources open-circuit చేయబడతాయి జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How are ideal independent voltage and current sources modified when finding the Thévenin equivalent resistance Rth of a network? A) Both voltage and current sources are short-circuited B) Voltage sources are open-circuited and current sources are short-circuited C) Both voltage and current sources are replaced by equal resistors D) Voltage sources are short-circuited and current sources are open-circuited ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to a superconductor maintained below its critical temperature when an external magnetic field exceeds its critical magnetic field? A) It undergoes complete mechanical disintegration due to magnetic pressure. B) It abruptly transitions back into the normal resistive conducting state. C) It creates an infinite internal electric current to resist the field. D) Its critical temperature permanently shifts above room temperature. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: తన critical temperature కంటే తక్కువలో ఉంచిన superconductor పై external magnetic field దాని critical magnetic field ని మించినప్పుడు దానికి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Magnetic pressure వల్ల అది పూర్తిగా mechanical గా విచ్ఛిన్నమవుతుంది. B) అది అకస్మాత్తుగా తిరిగి normal resistive conducting state కి మారుతుంది. C) Field ని ప్రతిఘటించడానికి అది infinite internal electric current ని సృష్టిస్తుంది. D) దాని critical temperature శాశ్వతంగా room temperature కంటే పైకి మారుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to a superconductor maintained below its critical temperature when an external magnetic field exceeds its critical magnetic field? A) It undergoes complete mechanical disintegration due to magnetic pressure. B) It abruptly transitions back into the normal resistive conducting state. C) It creates an infinite internal electric current to resist the field. D) Its critical temperature permanently shifts above room temperature. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the transient response of an RLC circuit when its damping factor (ζ) is adjusted to exactly 1? A) The circuit returns to equilibrium in the shortest time without oscillating B) The circuit undergoes sustained oscillations at its undamped natural frequency C) The circuit exhibits slow, decaying sinusoidal oscillations over multiple cycles D) The circuit voltage increases exponentially without reaching a steady state ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: RLC circuit యొక్క damping factor (ζ) ని కచ్చితంగా 1 కి సర్దుబాటు చేసినప్పుడు దాని transient response కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Circuit oscillate అవ్వకుండా అతి తక్కువ సమయంలో equilibrium కి తిరిగి వస్తుంది B) Circuit తన undamped natural frequency వద్ద నిరంతర oscillations కి లోనవుతుంది C) Circuit అనేక cycles పాటు నెమ్మదిగా తగ్గే sinusoidal oscillations ని చూపిస్తుంది D) Circuit voltage steady state ని చేరకుండా exponential గా పెరుగుతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What happens to the transient response of an RLC circuit when its damping factor (ζ) is adjusted to exactly 1? A) The circuit returns to equilibrium in the shortest time without oscillating B) The circuit undergoes sustained oscillations at its undamped natural frequency C) The circuit exhibits slow, decaying sinusoidal oscillations over multiple cycles D) The circuit voltage increases exponentially without reaching a steady state ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary implication of a process being wide-sense stationary regarding its autocorrelation function? A) The mean of the process must be zero. B) The autocorrelation is always equal to the variance. C) The autocorrelation must be constant for all time lags. D) The autocorrelation depends only on the time lag between samples. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక process wide-sense stationary కావడం దాని autocorrelation function గురించి ప్రధానంగా ఏమి సూచిస్తుంది? A) Process యొక్క mean సున్నాగా ఉండాలి. B) Autocorrelation ఎల్లప్పుడూ variance కి సమానం. C) అన్ని time lags కి autocorrelation constant గా ఉండాలి. D) Autocorrelation samples మధ్య time lag పై మాత్రమే ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary implication of a process being wide-sense stationary regarding its autocorrelation function? A) The mean of the process must be zero. B) The autocorrelation is always equal to the variance. C) The autocorrelation must be constant for all time lags. D) The autocorrelation depends only on the time lag between samples. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: According to BCS theory, how do two negatively charged electrons form an attractive Cooper pair? A) Through the magnetic attraction of their perfectly aligned parallel spins. B) Through an indirect interaction mediated by deformations in the positive ion lattice (phonons). C) By direct electrostatic Coulomb attraction when moving close to the speed of light. D) Via gravitational attraction intensified by cryogenic conditions. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: BCS theory ప్రకారం, negative charge ఉన్న రెండు electrons ఆకర్షించే Cooper pair ని ఎలా ఏర్పరుస్తాయి? A) వాటి పూర్తిగా align అయిన parallel spins యొక్క magnetic attraction ద్వారా. B) Positive ion lattice లోని deformations (phonons) ద్వారా జరిగే పరోక్ష interaction ద్వారా. C) కాంతి వేగానికి దగ్గరగా కదులుతున్నప్పుడు ప్రత్యక్ష electrostatic Coulomb attraction ద్వారా. D) Cryogenic పరిస్థితుల వల్ల తీవ్రమైన gravitational attraction ద్వారా. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: According to BCS theory, how do two negatively charged electrons form an attractive Cooper pair? A) Through the magnetic attraction of their perfectly aligned parallel spins. B) Through an indirect interaction mediated by deformations in the positive ion lattice (phonons). C) By direct electrostatic Coulomb attraction when moving close to the speed of light. D) Via gravitational attraction intensified by cryogenic conditions. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens geometrically to an eigenvector corresponding to a negative eigenvalue under a linear transformation? A) It shears into an orthogonal subspace B) It reverses its direction while scaling in magnitude C) It collapses permanently to the zero vector D) It rotates by ninety degrees without scaling ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Linear transformation కింద negative eigenvalue కి అనుగుణమైన eigenvector కి geometric గా ఏమవుతుంది? A) అది ఒక orthogonal subspace లోకి shear అవుతుంది B) Magnitude లో scale అవుతూ అది తన దిశను తిప్పుకుంటుంది C) అది శాశ్వతంగా zero vector గా కుదించుకుపోతుంది D) Scale కాకుండా అది తొంభై డిగ్రీలు తిరుగుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens geometrically to an eigenvector corresponding to a negative eigenvalue under a linear transformation? A) It shears into an orthogonal subspace B) It reverses its direction while scaling in magnitude C) It collapses permanently to the zero vector D) It rotates by ninety degrees without scaling ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the core economic advantage of shifting from an on-premises model to a cloud computing model? A) It guarantees 100% uptime for all business applications. B) It provides exclusive physical hardware dedicated solely to one customer. C) It replaces large upfront capital expenditures with variable operational expenditures. D) It eliminates the need for any internal IT staff. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: On-premises model నుండి cloud computing model కి మారడం వల్ల ముఖ్య ఆర్థిక ప్రయోజనాన్ని ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) అన్ని business applications కి 100% uptime కి అది హామీ ఇస్తుంది. B) ఒకే customer కి మాత్రమే కేటాయించిన ప్రత్యేక physical hardware ని అది అందిస్తుంది. C) పెద్ద ముందస్తు capital expenditures ని variable operational expenditures తో భర్తీ చేస్తుంది. D) అది internal IT staff అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the core economic advantage of shifting from an on-premises model to a cloud computing model? A) It guarantees 100% uptime for all business applications. B) It provides exclusive physical hardware dedicated solely to one customer. C) It replaces large upfront capital expenditures with variable operational expenditures. D) It eliminates the need for any internal IT staff. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental difference between model compression and knowledge distillation? A) Model compression is a subset of reverse knowledge distillation B) Knowledge distillation is only applicable to recurrent neural networks C) Knowledge distillation always requires more training data than model compression D) Model compression reduces size without training a new model, whereas distillation trains a new, smaller model ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Model compression మరియు knowledge distillation మధ్య ప్రాథమిక తేడాను ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) Model compression అనేది reverse knowledge distillation యొక్క subset B) Knowledge distillation recurrent neural networks కి మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది C) Knowledge distillation కి ఎల్లప్పుడూ model compression కంటే ఎక్కువ training data అవసరం D) Model compression కొత్త model ని train చేయకుండా size ని తగ్గిస్తుంది, distillation కొత్త, చిన్న model ని train చేస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes the fundamental difference between model compression and knowledge distillation? A) Model compression is a subset of reverse knowledge distillation B) Knowledge distillation is only applicable to recurrent neural networks C) Knowledge distillation always requires more training data than model compression D) Model compression reduces size without training a new model, whereas distillation trains a new, smaller model ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What distinguishes a single container from a containerized system? A) A containerized system requires a separate OS kernel for each individual container. B) A single container is a portable environment, while a system is the collective group sharing one OS kernel. C) A single container manages the load balancing and scaling of applications. D) A containerized system runs on a non-cloud environment, while a container runs on a cloud. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Single container ని containerized system నుండి ఏది వేరు చేస్తుంది? A) Containerized system కి ప్రతి container కి విడిగా OS kernel అవసరం. B) Single container ఒక portable environment, system అంటే ఒకే OS kernel ని పంచుకునే సమూహం. C) Single container applications యొక్క load balancing మరియు scaling ని నిర్వహిస్తుంది. D) Containerized system non-cloud environment పై run అవుతుంది, container cloud పై run అవుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What distinguishes a single container from a containerized system? A) A containerized system requires a separate OS kernel for each individual container. B) A single container is a portable environment, while a system is the collective group sharing one OS kernel. C) A single container manages the load balancing and scaling of applications. D) A containerized system runs on a non-cloud environment, while a container runs on a cloud. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What hardware component is directly responsible for converting a virtual address to a physical address? A) The translation lookaside buffer (TLB) B) The CPU's arithmetic logic unit (ALU) C) The memory management unit (MMU) D) The disk controller ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Virtual address ని physical address గా మార్చడానికి నేరుగా బాధ్యత వహించే hardware component ఏది? A) Translation lookaside buffer (TLB) B) CPU యొక్క arithmetic logic unit (ALU) C) Memory management unit (MMU) D) Disk controller జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What hardware component is directly responsible for converting a virtual address to a physical address? A) The translation lookaside buffer (TLB) B) The CPU's arithmetic logic unit (ALU) C) The memory management unit (MMU) D) The disk controller ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: How does dynamic pressure change if the flow velocity of a fluid doubles while density remains constant? A) It quadruples. B) It doubles. C) It decreases by half. D) It remains the same. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Density స్థిరంగా ఉండగా fluid యొక్క flow velocity రెట్టింపు అయితే dynamic pressure ఎలా మారుతుంది? A) అది నాలుగు రెట్లు అవుతుంది. B) అది రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది. C) అది సగానికి తగ్గుతుంది. D) అది అలాగే ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does dynamic pressure change if the flow velocity of a fluid doubles while density remains constant? A) It quadruples. B) It doubles. C) It decreases by half. D) It remains the same. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a critical requirement for connecting a synchronous generator to an existing power grid? A) The generator must operate at a fixed mechanical speed B) The generator must be a permanent magnet type C) The generator must be synchronized with the grid's frequency and phase D) The generator must use a commutator for DC output ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న power grid కి synchronous generator ని connect చేయడానికి కీలకమైన requirement ఏమిటి? A) Generator ఒక fixed mechanical speed వద్ద పనిచేయాలి B) Generator permanent magnet రకం అయి ఉండాలి C) Generator grid యొక్క frequency మరియు phase తో synchronize అయి ఉండాలి D) DC output కోసం generator commutator ఉపయోగించాలి జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a critical requirement for connecting a synchronous generator to an existing power grid? A) The generator must operate at a fixed mechanical speed B) The generator must be a permanent magnet type C) The generator must be synchronized with the grid's frequency and phase D) The generator must use a commutator for DC output ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does the von Neumann bottleneck limit a computer's overall performance? A) The CPU lacks the ability to perform complex arithmetic operations. B) The control unit cannot sequence operations fast enough. C) Memory capacity is too small to store large programs. D) A single bus must be shared to fetch both instructions and data, creating a throughput limit. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Von Neumann bottleneck computer యొక్క మొత్తం performance ని ఎందుకు పరిమితం చేస్తుంది? A) CPU కి సంక్లిష్టమైన arithmetic operations చేసే సామర్థ్యం లేదు. B) Control unit operations ని తగినంత వేగంగా sequence చేయలేదు. C) పెద్ద programs ని store చేయడానికి memory capacity చాలా చిన్నది. D) Instructions మరియు data రెండింటినీ fetch చేయడానికి ఒకే bus ని పంచుకోవాలి, దీనివల్ల throughput పరిమితి ఏర్పడుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does the von Neumann bottleneck limit a computer's overall performance? A) The CPU lacks the ability to perform complex arithmetic operations. B) The control unit cannot sequence operations fast enough. C) Memory capacity is too small to store large programs. D) A single bus must be shared to fetch both instructions and data, creating a throughput limit. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What causes bound charge in dielectric materials? A) The microscopic displacement of electrons relative to atomic nuclei under an external electric field. B) The accumulation of free electrons on the surface of the material. C) The ionization of atoms due to high electric field strength. D) The transfer of electrons between atoms in an external field. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Dielectric materials లో bound charge కి కారణం ఏమిటి? A) External electric field కింద atomic nuclei కి సంబంధించి electrons యొక్క సూక్ష్మ displacement. B) Material ఉపరితలంపై free electrons పేరుకుపోవడం. C) ఎక్కువ electric field strength వల్ల atoms యొక్క ionization. D) External field లో atoms మధ్య electrons బదిలీ. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What causes bound charge in dielectric materials? A) The microscopic displacement of electrons relative to atomic nuclei under an external electric field. B) The accumulation of free electrons on the surface of the material. C) The ionization of atoms due to high electric field strength. D) The transfer of electrons between atoms in an external field. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) considered a combination of PSK and ASK? A) Because it uses two different modulation alphabets for I and Q channels. B) Because it requires both analog and digital signal processing. C) Because it uses both phase and amplitude variations of the carrier signal simultaneously. D) Because it transmits on two separate carrier frequencies. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) ని PSK మరియు ASK ల కలయికగా ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే అది I మరియు Q channels కి రెండు వేర్వేరు modulation alphabets ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. B) ఎందుకంటే దానికి analog మరియు digital signal processing రెండూ అవసరం. C) ఎందుకంటే అది carrier signal యొక్క phase మరియు amplitude variations రెండింటినీ ఒకేసారి ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే అది రెండు వేర్వేరు carrier frequencies పై transmit చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) considered a combination of PSK and ASK? A) Because it uses two different modulation alphabets for I and Q channels. B) Because it requires both analog and digital signal processing. C) Because it uses both phase and amplitude variations of the carrier signal simultaneously. D) Because it transmits on two separate carrier frequencies. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of infinitesimal strain theory, what key assumption is made regarding the geometry of the material? A) Rotations are negligible, but strains must be large. B) The deformed and undeformed configurations are assumed to be identical. C) The material remains rigid and does not deform at all. D) The material is assumed to be infinitely long. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Infinitesimal strain theory సందర్భంలో material geometry గురించి ఏ ముఖ్య assumption చేయబడుతుంది? A) Rotations నిర్లక్ష్యం చేయదగినవి, కానీ strains పెద్దవిగా ఉండాలి. B) Deformed మరియు undeformed configurations ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయని ఊహించబడుతుంది. C) Material rigid గా ఉండి అసలు deform కాదు. D) Material అనంతంగా పొడవుగా ఉందని ఊహించబడుతుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In the context of infinitesimal strain theory, what key assumption is made regarding the geometry of the material? A) Rotations are negligible, but strains must be large. B) The deformed and undeformed configurations are assumed to be identical. C) The material remains rigid and does not deform at all. D) The material is assumed to be infinitely long. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the brightness constancy constraint insufficient on its own to determine the complete optical flow vector at a pixel? A) It cannot account for changes in lighting conditions. B) It provides only one equation for two unknown velocity components. C) It calculates only the magnitude of motion, not the direction. D) It assumes the camera is stationary, which is rarely true. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక pixel వద్ద పూర్తి optical flow vector ని నిర్ణయించడానికి brightness constancy constraint ఒక్కటే ఎందుకు సరిపోదు? A) Lighting conditions లో మార్పులను అది పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోలేదు. B) రెండు తెలియని velocity components కి అది ఒకే ఒక equation ని ఇస్తుంది. C) అది motion యొక్క magnitude ని మాత్రమే లెక్కిస్తుంది, దిశను కాదు. D) Camera stationary గా ఉందని అది ఊహిస్తుంది, ఇది చాలా అరుదుగా నిజం. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the brightness constancy constraint insufficient on its own to determine the complete optical flow vector at a pixel? A) It cannot account for changes in lighting conditions. B) It provides only one equation for two unknown velocity components. C) It calculates only the magnitude of motion, not the direction. D) It assumes the camera is stationary, which is rarely true. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Daily Scrum meeting? A) To allow stakeholders to provide feedback on the daily progress B) To report progress toward the sprint goal and identify potential blockers C) To assign tasks to team members based on their expertise D) To perform a detailed technical code review for the daily tasks ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Daily Scrum meeting యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) రోజువారీ పురోగతిపై stakeholders feedback ఇవ్వడానికి అనుమతించడం B) Sprint goal వైపు పురోగతిని report చేసి, సంభావ్య blockers ని గుర్తించడం C) Team members కి వారి నైపుణ్యం ఆధారంగా tasks కేటాయించడం D) రోజువారీ tasks కోసం వివరణాత్మక technical code review చేయడం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the Daily Scrum meeting? A) To allow stakeholders to provide feedback on the daily progress B) To report progress toward the sprint goal and identify potential blockers C) To assign tasks to team members based on their expertise D) To perform a detailed technical code review for the daily tasks ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does memoization change the execution profile of a recursive function? A) It prevents the function from calling itself B) It removes the need for a recurrence relation C) It converts the function into an iterative one D) It increases memory usage while decreasing computation time ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Memoization ఒక recursive function యొక్క execution profile ని ఎలా మారుస్తుంది? A) Function తనను తాను call చేసుకోకుండా అది నివారిస్తుంది B) అది recurrence relation అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది C) అది function ని iterative function గా మారుస్తుంది D) అది computation time ని తగ్గిస్తూ memory usage ని పెంచుతుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does memoization change the execution profile of a recursive function? A) It prevents the function from calling itself B) It removes the need for a recurrence relation C) It converts the function into an iterative one D) It increases memory usage while decreasing computation time ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a deterministic finite automaton considered 'deterministic'? A) Because it can be minimized to a canonical form B) Because it has a finite number of states C) Because it has a unique next state for each state-input pair D) Because it accepts a regular language ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Deterministic finite automaton ని 'deterministic' అని ఎందుకు పరిగణిస్తారు? A) ఎందుకంటే దాన్ని canonical form కి minimize చేయవచ్చు B) ఎందుకంటే దానికి finite సంఖ్యలో states ఉంటాయి C) ఎందుకంటే ప్రతి state-input pair కి దానికి ఒక unique next state ఉంటుంది D) ఎందుకంటే అది ఒక regular language ని accept చేస్తుంది జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is a deterministic finite automaton considered 'deterministic'? A) Because it can be minimized to a canonical form B) Because it has a finite number of states C) Because it has a unique next state for each state-input pair D) Because it accepts a regular language ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What was the key insight that led David Patterson to start the Berkeley RISC project? A) That 32-bit formats were necessary B) That microcode was too complex and inefficient C) That IBM 801 was the best design D) That CISC architectures were too slow ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: David Patterson ని Berkeley RISC project ప్రారంభించేలా చేసిన ముఖ్య అంతర్దృష్టి ఏమిటి? A) 32-bit formats అవసరమని B) Microcode చాలా సంక్లిష్టమైనది మరియు అసమర్థమైనదని C) IBM 801 అత్యుత్తమ design అని D) CISC architectures చాలా నెమ్మదిగా ఉన్నాయని జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What was the key insight that led David Patterson to start the Berkeley RISC project? A) That 32-bit formats were necessary B) That microcode was too complex and inefficient C) That IBM 801 was the best design D) That CISC architectures were too slow ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary consequence of a model overfitting the training data? A) It will perfectly generalize to any new data B) It will have zero training error and high validation error C) It will ignore the noise in the training data D) It will have high training error and low validation error ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక model training data ను overfit చేస్తే వచ్చే ప్రధాన పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) అది ఏ కొత్త data కైనా పూర్తిగా generalize అవుతుంది B) దానికి training error సున్నా గా, validation error ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది C) అది training data లోని noise ను పట్టించుకోదు D) దానికి training error ఎక్కువగా, validation error తక్కువగా ఉంటుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the primary consequence of a model overfitting the training data? A) It will perfectly generalize to any new data B) It will have zero training error and high validation error C) It will ignore the noise in the training data D) It will have high training error and low validation error ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does differentiability of a complex function at a point differ fundamentally from differentiability of a real function of two real variables? A) Real differentiability of component functions automatically guarantees complex differentiability. B) Complex differentiability requires the difference quotient limit to be identical along any path in the complex plane, which is much stronger. C) A complex differentiable function is not necessarily infinitely differentiable unlike real differentiable functions. D) Complex differentiability only requires the directional derivatives along the real and imaginary axes to exist. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక బిందువు వద్ద complex function యొక్క differentiability, రెండు real variables ఉన్న real function యొక్క differentiability కంటే ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Component functions యొక్క real differentiability వల్ల complex differentiability ఆటోమేటిక్‌గా హామీ అవుతుంది. B) Complex differentiability కి complex plane లో ఏ path వెంబడి వెళ్ళినా difference quotient limit ఒకేలా ఉండాలి, ఇది చాలా బలమైన షరతు. C) Real differentiable functions లా కాకుండా, complex differentiable function తప్పనిసరిగా infinitely differentiable కాదు. D) Complex differentiability కి real మరియు imaginary axes వెంబడి directional derivatives ఉంటే చాలు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does differentiability of a complex function at a point differ fundamentally from differentiability of a real function of two real variables? A) Real differentiability of component functions automatically guarantees complex differentiability. B) Complex differentiability requires the difference quotient limit to be identical along any path in the complex plane, which is much stronger. C) A complex differentiable function is not necessarily infinitely differentiable unlike real differentiable functions. D) Complex differentiability only requires the directional derivatives along the real and imaginary axes to exist. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the message hashed before signing in a hash-then-sign scheme? A) To prevent key-only existential forgery attacks B) To make the message shorter and faster to sign C) To encrypt the message content D) To generate a random padding for the signature ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Hash-then-sign scheme లో sign చేసే ముందు message ను ఎందుకు hash చేస్తారు? A) Key-only existential forgery attacks ను నివారించడానికి B) Message ను చిన్నదిగా చేసి వేగంగా sign చేయడానికి C) Message content ను encrypt చేయడానికి D) Signature కోసం random padding ను generate చేయడానికి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the message hashed before signing in a hash-then-sign scheme? A) To prevent key-only existential forgery attacks B) To make the message shorter and faster to sign C) To encrypt the message content D) To generate a random padding for the signature ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the Serial clock line (SCL) function on an I2C bus? A) It is a bidirectional line that is driven low by the master and pulled high by resistors. B) It is a dedicated line that carries only clock signals and no data. C) It is a bidirectional line that is pulled high and driven low by nodes. D) It is a unidirectional line driven by the master node only. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: I2C bus పై Serial clock line (SCL) ఎలా పనిచేస్తుంది? A) ఇది master ద్వారా low కి drive చేయబడే, resistors ద్వారా high కి pull చేయబడే bidirectional line. B) ఇది కేవలం clock signals మాత్రమే మోసే, data మోయని ప్రత్యేక line. C) ఇది high కి pull చేయబడి, nodes ద్వారా low కి drive చేయబడే bidirectional line. D) ఇది master node మాత్రమే drive చేసే unidirectional line. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: How does the Serial clock line (SCL) function on an I2C bus? A) It is a bidirectional line that is driven low by the master and pulled high by resistors. B) It is a dedicated line that carries only clock signals and no data. C) It is a bidirectional line that is pulled high and driven low by nodes. D) It is a unidirectional line driven by the master node only. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following is true according to the Wiener–Khinchin theorem? A) The autocorrelation is equivalent to the Fourier transform of the signal. B) The autocorrelation and power spectral density are Fourier transform pairs. C) The autocorrelation matrix is always a diagonal matrix. D) The theorem only applies to deterministic signals. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Wiener–Khinchin theorem ప్రకారం కింది వాటిలో ఏది నిజం? A) Autocorrelation అనేది signal యొక్క Fourier transform కు సమానం. B) Autocorrelation మరియు power spectral density లు Fourier transform pairs. C) Autocorrelation matrix ఎల్లప్పుడూ diagonal matrix అవుతుంది. D) ఈ theorem కేవలం deterministic signals కే వర్తిస్తుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Which of the following is true according to the Wiener–Khinchin theorem? A) The autocorrelation is equivalent to the Fourier transform of the signal. B) The autocorrelation and power spectral density are Fourier transform pairs. C) The autocorrelation matrix is always a diagonal matrix. D) The theorem only applies to deterministic signals. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of rational factor resampling, what is the typical first step when increasing the sample rate? A) Performing decimation by the numerator B) Removing every second sample C) Increasing the sequence through interpolation D) Applying a highpass filter ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Rational factor resampling సందర్భంలో, sample rate ను పెంచేటప్పుడు సాధారణంగా మొదటి step ఏమిటి? A) Numerator తో decimation చేయడం B) ప్రతి రెండవ sample ను తొలగించడం C) Interpolation ద్వారా sequence ను పెంచడం D) Highpass filter ను apply చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: In the context of rational factor resampling, what is the typical first step when increasing the sample rate? A) Performing decimation by the numerator B) Removing every second sample C) Increasing the sequence through interpolation D) Applying a highpass filter ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of the reject procedure in a backtracking algorithm? A) To report a valid solution to the user B) To find the first valid solution quickly C) To prune branches of the search tree that cannot lead to valid solutions D) To generate the next extension of a partial candidate ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Backtracking algorithm లో reject procedure యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) User కి ఒక valid solution ను report చేయడం B) మొదటి valid solution ను త్వరగా కనుగొనడం C) Valid solutions కి దారితీయలేని search tree branches ను prune చేయడం D) Partial candidate యొక్క తదుపరి extension ను generate చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of the reject procedure in a backtracking algorithm? A) To report a valid solution to the user B) To find the first valid solution quickly C) To prune branches of the search tree that cannot lead to valid solutions D) To generate the next extension of a partial candidate ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In an LTI system, how is the output signal typically determined from the input signal? A) By convolving the input signal with the system's impulse response B) By performing a circular shift of the input only C) By calculating the absolute value of the input D) By multiplying the input by a constant coefficient ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక LTI system లో, input signal నుండి output signal ను సాధారణంగా ఎలా నిర్ణయిస్తారు? A) Input signal ను system యొక్క impulse response తో convolve చేయడం ద్వారా B) Input పై కేవలం circular shift చేయడం ద్వారా C) Input యొక్క absolute value ను లెక్కించడం ద్వారా D) Input ను ఒక constant coefficient తో గుణించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In an LTI system, how is the output signal typically determined from the input signal? A) By convolving the input signal with the system's impulse response B) By performing a circular shift of the input only C) By calculating the absolute value of the input D) By multiplying the input by a constant coefficient ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the first step in the maintenance change cycle? A) Receiving a change request from a customer B) Releasing the software to end users C) Implementing the change D) Testing the existing functionality ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Maintenance change cycle లో మొదటి step ఏమిటి? A) Customer నుండి change request ను స్వీకరించడం B) Software ను end users కి release చేయడం C) Change ను implement చేయడం D) ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న functionality ని test చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the first step in the maintenance change cycle? A) Receiving a change request from a customer B) Releasing the software to end users C) Implementing the change D) Testing the existing functionality ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is 'Divide and Conquer' often distinguished from Dynamic Programming? A) DP cannot solve shortest path problems B) Dynamic programming is only for economics C) Divide and conquer breaks problems into smaller independent parts D) Divide and conquer uses recursion while DP does not ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: 'Divide and Conquer' ను Dynamic Programming నుండి తరచుగా ఎందుకు వేరుగా చూస్తారు? A) DP shortest path problems ను solve చేయలేదు B) Dynamic programming కేవలం economics కోసం మాత్రమే C) Divide and conquer problems ను చిన్న independent భాగాలుగా విభజిస్తుంది D) Divide and conquer recursion ను వాడుతుంది కానీ DP వాడదు జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why is 'Divide and Conquer' often distinguished from Dynamic Programming? A) DP cannot solve shortest path problems B) Dynamic programming is only for economics C) Divide and conquer breaks problems into smaller independent parts D) Divide and conquer uses recursion while DP does not ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: For a discrete-time LTI system to be both causal and bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable, what condition must its transfer function ROC satisfy? A) It must consist strictly of an open annulus not touching the unit circle. B) It must extend outwards from the outermost pole and encompass the unit circle. C) It can be any region as long as poles lie on the imaginary axis. D) It must lie entirely inside the unit circle enclosing the origin. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక discrete-time LTI system causal మరియు bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable రెండూ కావాలంటే, దాని transfer function ROC ఏ షరతును తీర్చాలి? A) అది unit circle ను తాకని ఒక open annulus మాత్రమే అయి ఉండాలి. B) అది outermost pole నుండి బయటికి విస్తరించి, unit circle ను కలిగి ఉండాలి. C) Poles imaginary axis పై ఉన్నంత వరకు అది ఏ region అయినా కావచ్చు. D) అది origin ను కలుపుకొని పూర్తిగా unit circle లోపల ఉండాలి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: For a discrete-time LTI system to be both causal and bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stable, what condition must its transfer function ROC satisfy? A) It must consist strictly of an open annulus not touching the unit circle. B) It must extend outwards from the outermost pole and encompass the unit circle. C) It can be any region as long as poles lie on the imaginary axis. D) It must lie entirely inside the unit circle enclosing the origin. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary purpose of applying state feedback in a control system? A) To convert a discrete system into a continuous one. B) To reduce the number of state variables. C) To estimate the system's state from its output. D) To stabilize an unstable system or modify its dynamics. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Control system లో state feedback ను apply చేయడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) Discrete system ను continuous system గా మార్చడం. B) State variables సంఖ్యను తగ్గించడం. C) System output నుండి దాని state ను estimate చేయడం. D) Unstable system ను stabilize చేయడం లేదా దాని dynamics ను మార్చడం. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary purpose of applying state feedback in a control system? A) To convert a discrete system into a continuous one. B) To reduce the number of state variables. C) To estimate the system's state from its output. D) To stabilize an unstable system or modify its dynamics. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Which scenario best describes a shear force acting on a structural member? A) A purely rotational force applied to the center of gravity of an object. B) A load applied perpendicular to a beam's cross-section causing it to stretch. C) Two parallel forces acting in opposite directions on different parts of a body. D) Forces acting towards each other causing the material to shorten. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక structural member పై పనిచేసే shear force ను ఏ సందర్భం ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) ఒక వస్తువు center of gravity వద్ద apply చేసిన పూర్తిగా rotational force. B) Beam cross-section కి లంబంగా apply చేసి దానిని సాగదీసే load. C) ఒక body లోని వేర్వేరు భాగాలపై వ్యతిరేక దిశల్లో పనిచేసే రెండు parallel forces. D) ఒకదానివైపు ఒకటి పనిచేసి material ను కుదించే forces. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which scenario best describes a shear force acting on a structural member? A) A purely rotational force applied to the center of gravity of an object. B) A load applied perpendicular to a beam's cross-section causing it to stretch. C) Two parallel forces acting in opposite directions on different parts of a body. D) Forces acting towards each other causing the material to shorten. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens in an electron double-slit experiment if detectors are added at the slits to determine which slit each electron passes through? A) The intensity of the interference fringes doubles due to detection energy. B) The interference pattern is destroyed and replaced by two particle-like bands. C) The interference pattern shifts phase but retains its fringes. D) The electrons bounce off and fail to reach the detection screen. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Electron double-slit experiment లో, ప్రతి electron ఏ slit గుండా వెళ్తుందో తెలుసుకోవడానికి slits వద్ద detectors పెడితే ఏమవుతుంది? A) Detection energy వల్ల interference fringes intensity రెట్టింపు అవుతుంది. B) Interference pattern నాశనమై, దాని స్థానంలో రెండు particle లాంటి bands వస్తాయి. C) Interference pattern phase మారుతుంది కానీ fringes అలాగే ఉంటాయి. D) Electrons వెనక్కి bounce అయి detection screen ను చేరలేవు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens in an electron double-slit experiment if detectors are added at the slits to determine which slit each electron passes through? A) The intensity of the interference fringes doubles due to detection energy. B) The interference pattern is destroyed and replaced by two particle-like bands. C) The interference pattern shifts phase but retains its fringes. D) The electrons bounce off and fail to reach the detection screen. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the consequence of high shift variance in a wavelet image compression system? A) Improved time resolution B) Artifacts like ringing in the reconstructed image C) Increased compression ratio D) Better frequency resolution ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Wavelet image compression system లో shift variance ఎక్కువగా ఉంటే దాని పరిణామం ఏమిటి? A) Time resolution మెరుగవుతుంది B) Reconstructed image లో ringing లాంటి artifacts వస్తాయి C) Compression ratio పెరుగుతుంది D) Frequency resolution మెరుగవుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What is the consequence of high shift variance in a wavelet image compression system? A) Improved time resolution B) Artifacts like ringing in the reconstructed image C) Increased compression ratio D) Better frequency resolution ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: When does a data hazard occur in a pipelined processor? A) When an instruction depends on the result of a previous instruction B) When instructions are executed out of order C) When a branch is taken unexpectedly D) When the pipeline is empty ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Pipelined processor లో data hazard ఎప్పుడు వస్తుంది? A) ఒక instruction దాని ముందు instruction యొక్క result పై ఆధారపడినప్పుడు B) Instructions out of order గా execute అయినప్పుడు C) ఒక branch అనుకోకుండా take అయినప్పుడు D) Pipeline ఖాళీగా ఉన్నప్పుడు జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: When does a data hazard occur in a pipelined processor? A) When an instruction depends on the result of a previous instruction B) When instructions are executed out of order C) When a branch is taken unexpectedly D) When the pipeline is empty ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What does it signify if the kernel of a linear transformation T: V -> W contains only the zero vector? A) The transformation is surjective (onto) B) The transformation is injective (one-to-one) C) The transformation maps every vector in V to zero D) The dimension of V must exceed the dimension of W ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక linear transformation T: V -> W యొక్క kernel లో కేవలం zero vector మాత్రమే ఉంటే దాని అర్థం ఏమిటి? A) Transformation surjective (onto) అవుతుంది B) Transformation injective (one-to-one) అవుతుంది C) Transformation V లోని ప్రతి vector ను zero కి map చేస్తుంది D) V యొక్క dimension తప్పనిసరిగా W యొక్క dimension కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉండాలి జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What does it signify if the kernel of a linear transformation T: V -> W contains only the zero vector? A) The transformation is surjective (onto) B) The transformation is injective (one-to-one) C) The transformation maps every vector in V to zero D) The dimension of V must exceed the dimension of W ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What happens to the inductor's magnetic field during the on-state of a boost converter? A) It remains constant due to steady current B) It is generated or increased as the switch closes C) It collapses, releasing energy to the load D) It reverses polarity to push current backward ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Boost converter యొక్క on-state సమయంలో inductor యొక్క magnetic field కి ఏమవుతుంది? A) Steady current వల్ల అది స్థిరంగా ఉంటుంది B) Switch close అవగానే అది ఏర్పడుతుంది లేదా పెరుగుతుంది C) అది collapse అయి, load కి energy ని విడుదల చేస్తుంది D) Current ను వెనక్కి నెట్టడానికి దాని polarity మారుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What happens to the inductor's magnetic field during the on-state of a boost converter? A) It remains constant due to steady current B) It is generated or increased as the switch closes C) It collapses, releasing energy to the load D) It reverses polarity to push current backward ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In a system using cooperative scheduling, what must a running fiber do to allow another fiber to execute? A) It must explicitly yield control to the scheduler B) It must request a higher priority from the operating system C) It must terminate itself and be recreated by the kernel D) It must wait for a timer interrupt from the kernel ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Cooperative scheduling వాడే system లో, మరొక fiber execute అవ్వడానికి running fiber ఏమి చేయాలి? A) అది control ను scheduler కి స్పష్టంగా yield చేయాలి B) అది operating system నుండి ఎక్కువ priority ని request చేయాలి C) అది తనను తాను terminate చేసుకుని kernel ద్వారా మళ్ళీ create అవ్వాలి D) అది kernel నుండి timer interrupt కోసం wait చేయాలి జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: In a system using cooperative scheduling, what must a running fiber do to allow another fiber to execute? A) It must explicitly yield control to the scheduler B) It must request a higher priority from the operating system C) It must terminate itself and be recreated by the kernel D) It must wait for a timer interrupt from the kernel ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does Fourier analysis utilize the superposition principle to analyze complex stimuli? A) By converting non-linear differential equations into algebraic linear equations B) By multiplying individual wave functions together in quantum state space C) By decomposing a complex signal into simple sinusoids and summing their individual linear responses D) By ignoring the phase component of input signals to approximate net amplitude ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex stimuli ని analyze చేయడానికి Fourier analysis superposition principle ను ఎలా ఉపయోగిస్తుంది? A) Non-linear differential equations ను algebraic linear equations గా మార్చడం ద్వారా B) Quantum state space లో individual wave functions ను ఒకదానితో ఒకటి గుణించడం ద్వారా C) Complex signal ను simple sinusoids గా విడగొట్టి, వాటి individual linear responses ను కలపడం ద్వారా D) Net amplitude ను అంచనా వేయడానికి input signals యొక్క phase component ను విస్మరించడం ద్వారా జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: How does Fourier analysis utilize the superposition principle to analyze complex stimuli? A) By converting non-linear differential equations into algebraic linear equations B) By multiplying individual wave functions together in quantum state space C) By decomposing a complex signal into simple sinusoids and summing their individual linear responses D) By ignoring the phase component of input signals to approximate net amplitude ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Which of the following best describes a system with a 'flat' frequency response? A) A system that transforms all input signals into square waves B) A system with zero phase shift at all frequencies C) A system that reproduces all signals in a band without attenuation or emphasis D) A system that only responds to a single frequency ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: 'Flat' frequency response ఉన్న system ను కింది వాటిలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వివరిస్తుంది? A) అన్ని input signals ను square waves గా మార్చే system B) అన్ని frequencies వద్ద zero phase shift ఉన్న system C) ఒక band లోని అన్ని signals ను attenuation లేదా emphasis లేకుండా reproduce చేసే system D) ఒకే ఒక frequency కి మాత్రమే respond అయ్యే system జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Which of the following best describes a system with a 'flat' frequency response? A) A system that transforms all input signals into square waves B) A system with zero phase shift at all frequencies C) A system that reproduces all signals in a band without attenuation or emphasis D) A system that only responds to a single frequency ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: If a signal is decimated by an integer factor of M, how does the resulting sampling rate compare to the original? A) It remains exactly the same B) It is divided by M C) It is increased by M D) It is multiplied by M ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఒక signal ను integer factor M తో decimate చేస్తే, వచ్చే sampling rate అసలు దానితో పోలిస్తే ఎలా ఉంటుంది? A) అది సరిగ్గా అలాగే ఉంటుంది B) అది M తో భాగించబడుతుంది C) అది M మేరకు పెరుగుతుంది D) అది M తో గుణించబడుతుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: If a signal is decimated by an integer factor of M, how does the resulting sampling rate compare to the original? A) It remains exactly the same B) It is divided by M C) It is increased by M D) It is multiplied by M ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is digital image processing preferred over analog image processing for complex algorithms? A) It avoids noise and distortion buildup during processing B) It uses only simple mathematical operations C) It cannot be modeled in multidimensional systems D) It requires less computational power ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Complex algorithms కోసం analog image processing కంటే digital image processing ను ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) Processing సమయంలో noise మరియు distortion పేరుకుపోవడాన్ని ఇది నివారిస్తుంది B) ఇది కేవలం simple mathematical operations ను మాత్రమే వాడుతుంది C) దీనిని multidimensional systems లో model చేయలేము D) దీనికి తక్కువ computational power సరిపోతుంది జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is digital image processing preferred over analog image processing for complex algorithms? A) It avoids noise and distortion buildup during processing B) It uses only simple mathematical operations C) It cannot be modeled in multidimensional systems D) It requires less computational power ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of embedded systems, why is a microprocessor control program often preferred over non-programmable controls? A) It operates at a significantly higher clock speed than non-programmable logic. B) It eliminates the need for any hardware components like sensors or actuators. C) It is always more power-efficient regardless of the specific software routine. D) It requires less physical space and can be easily tailored to fit specific product needs. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Embedded systems సందర్భంలో, non-programmable controls కంటే microprocessor control program ను తరచుగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడతారు? A) ఇది non-programmable logic కంటే చాలా ఎక్కువ clock speed తో పనిచేస్తుంది. B) ఇది sensors లేదా actuators లాంటి hardware components అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. C) Software routine ఏదైనా సరే ఇది ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఎక్కువ power-efficient గా ఉంటుంది. D) దీనికి తక్కువ physical space సరిపోతుంది, మరియు నిర్దిష్ట product అవసరాలకు తగ్గట్టుగా సులభంగా మార్చవచ్చు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of embedded systems, why is a microprocessor control program often preferred over non-programmable controls? A) It operates at a significantly higher clock speed than non-programmable logic. B) It eliminates the need for any hardware components like sensors or actuators. C) It is always more power-efficient regardless of the specific software routine. D) It requires less physical space and can be easily tailored to fit specific product needs. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary purpose of using an intermediate representation in static analysis? A) To generate user documentation B) To transform the code into machine language C) To analyze and transform code without executing it D) To execute the program faster ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Static analysis లో intermediate representation ను ఉపయోగించడం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి? A) User documentation ను generate చేయడం B) Code ను machine language గా మార్చడం C) Code ను execute చేయకుండానే analyze చేయడం మరియు transform చేయడం D) Program ను వేగంగా execute చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a primary purpose of using an intermediate representation in static analysis? A) To generate user documentation B) To transform the code into machine language C) To analyze and transform code without executing it D) To execute the program faster ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does an intrinsic semiconductor behave like an insulator at absolute zero temperature (0 K)? A) Charge carriers recombine instantly before any electric current can be established. B) The band gap expands to infinity at extremely low temperatures. C) The thermal motion of atoms blocks the passage of current through the lattice. D) All electrons are completely localized within the valence band, leaving the conduction band entirely empty. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Absolute zero temperature (0 K) వద్ద intrinsic semiconductor ఎందుకు insulator లా ప్రవర్తిస్తుంది? A) ఏ electric current ఏర్పడక ముందే charge carriers వెంటనే recombine అవుతాయి. B) చాలా తక్కువ temperatures వద్ద band gap అనంతంగా పెరుగుతుంది. C) Atoms యొక్క thermal motion lattice గుండా current ప్రవాహాన్ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది. D) అన్ని electrons పూర్తిగా valence band లోనే localize అయి ఉంటాయి, conduction band పూర్తిగా ఖాళీగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why does an intrinsic semiconductor behave like an insulator at absolute zero temperature (0 K)? A) Charge carriers recombine instantly before any electric current can be established. B) The band gap expands to infinity at extremely low temperatures. C) The thermal motion of atoms blocks the passage of current through the lattice. D) All electrons are completely localized within the valence band, leaving the conduction band entirely empty. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a key advantage of using a local branch predictor over a global one? A) It always achieves a 100% prediction accuracy on any code. B) It eliminates the need for a pattern history table entirely. C) It requires less hardware by sharing a single history buffer. D) It can better predict patterns specific to a single branch instruction. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Global branch predictor తో పోలిస్తే local branch predictor ను వాడటంలో ముఖ్యమైన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) ఇది ఏ code పైనైనా ఎల్లప్పుడూ 100% prediction accuracy సాధిస్తుంది. B) ఇది pattern history table అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. C) ఒకే history buffer ను share చేయడం వల్ల దీనికి తక్కువ hardware సరిపోతుంది. D) ఇది ఒకే branch instruction కి ప్రత్యేకమైన patterns ను బాగా predict చేయగలదు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is a key advantage of using a local branch predictor over a global one? A) It always achieves a 100% prediction accuracy on any code. B) It eliminates the need for a pattern history table entirely. C) It requires less hardware by sharing a single history buffer. D) It can better predict patterns specific to a single branch instruction. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is busy-waiting generally considered inefficient in software solutions for mutual exclusion? A) It requires complex hardware support that is not widely available. B) It consumes CPU cycles while a thread waits for a resource to become available. C) It leads to immediate deadlock in all cases. D) It cannot be used in multiprocessor systems. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Mutual exclusion కోసం software solutions లో busy-waiting ను సాధారణంగా ఎందుకు inefficient గా భావిస్తారు? A) దీనికి విస్తృతంగా అందుబాటులో లేని complex hardware support అవసరం. B) ఒక resource అందుబాటులోకి వచ్చే వరకు thread wait చేస్తున్నప్పుడు ఇది CPU cycles ను వినియోగిస్తుంది. C) ఇది అన్ని సందర్భాల్లో వెంటనే deadlock కి దారితీస్తుంది. D) దీనిని multiprocessor systems లో వాడలేము. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is busy-waiting generally considered inefficient in software solutions for mutual exclusion? A) It requires complex hardware support that is not widely available. B) It consumes CPU cycles while a thread waits for a resource to become available. C) It leads to immediate deadlock in all cases. D) It cannot be used in multiprocessor systems. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the stress tensor relate the traction vector to the orientation of a surface? A) By multiplying the traction vector with the area of the surface B) By representing the traction vector as a function of the normal vector's components C) By using the dot product of the traction vector and the normal vector D) By projecting the traction vector onto the normal vector of the surface ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Stress tensor, traction vector ను surface యొక్క orientation తో ఎలా సంబంధం కలుపుతుంది? A) Traction vector ను surface area తో గుణించడం ద్వారా B) Traction vector ను normal vector components యొక్క function గా సూచించడం ద్వారా C) Traction vector మరియు normal vector ల dot product ను వాడటం ద్వారా D) Traction vector ను surface యొక్క normal vector పై project చేయడం ద్వారా జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does the stress tensor relate the traction vector to the orientation of a surface? A) By multiplying the traction vector with the area of the surface B) By representing the traction vector as a function of the normal vector's components C) By using the dot product of the traction vector and the normal vector D) By projecting the traction vector onto the normal vector of the surface ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of page replacement, how does the LRU algorithm decide which page to swap out? A) It selects the page that was first loaded into memory. B) It selects the page that belongs to the largest process. C) It selects the page that is currently being used by the CPU. D) It selects the page that has not been accessed for the longest period of time. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Page replacement సందర్భంలో, LRU algorithm ఏ page ను swap out చేయాలో ఎలా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది? A) Memory లోకి మొదట load అయిన page ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. B) అతిపెద్ద process కి చెందిన page ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. C) ప్రస్తుతం CPU వాడుతున్న page ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. D) అత్యంత ఎక్కువ కాలం access చేయబడని page ను ఎంచుకుంటుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of page replacement, how does the LRU algorithm decide which page to swap out? A) It selects the page that was first loaded into memory. B) It selects the page that belongs to the largest process. C) It selects the page that is currently being used by the CPU. D) It selects the page that has not been accessed for the longest period of time. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the product of two distinct phasors generally not represented as a standard single-frequency phasor? A) Multiplying sinusoids in time yields sum and difference frequencies, violating single-frequency assumptions B) The angle of the resulting phasor would become undefined in the complex plane C) Multiplying complex numbers alters the RMS values unpredictably D) Phasors can only be multiplied by purely real scalar values ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: రెండు వేర్వేరు phasors యొక్క product ను సాధారణంగా ఒక standard single-frequency phasor గా ఎందుకు సూచించలేము? A) Time లో sinusoids ను గుణిస్తే sum మరియు difference frequencies వస్తాయి, ఇది single-frequency assumption ను ఉల్లంఘిస్తుంది B) వచ్చే phasor యొక్క angle complex plane లో undefined అవుతుంది C) Complex numbers ను గుణిస్తే RMS values అనూహ్యంగా మారుతాయి D) Phasors ను కేవలం purely real scalar values తో మాత్రమే గుణించగలం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: Why is the product of two distinct phasors generally not represented as a standard single-frequency phasor? A) Multiplying sinusoids in time yields sum and difference frequencies, violating single-frequency assumptions B) The angle of the resulting phasor would become undefined in the complex plane C) Multiplying complex numbers alters the RMS values unpredictably D) Phasors can only be multiplied by purely real scalar values ANSWER: A
